articles.title: Exposed Construction Materials and Components in Concealed Spaces

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art16.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] , and except as otherwise provided in this Subsection, only construction materials and components permitted in [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:noncombustible construction] shall be permitted to have exposed surfaces in concealed spaces within floor, roof, and wall assemblies in a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] .

Exposed surfaces are permitted in a concealed space created by the attachment of a material or assembly of materials conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art4.sent1:long] , provided the concealed space is not more than 25 mm deep .

The minimum dimensions stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art3.table1:long] need not apply at cutouts in vertical or horizontal structural mass timber elements where outlet boxes are installed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art3:long] (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote37:long] .)

The exposed surfaces of the cutouts described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art17.sent1:short] need not be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art4.sent1:long] .
Outlet boxes on opposite sides of a structural mass timber element having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] shall be separated by a distance of not less than 600 mm .

Except as permitted by  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art1.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art1.sent4:short] , and  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art5:long] , the rating of a material, assembly of materials or a structural member that is required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , shall be determined on the basis of the results of tests conducted in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs101]
A material, assembly of materials or a structural member is permitted to be assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] on the basis of  Appendix [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] .
A ceiling assembly is permitted to be assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] on the basis of Assembly Number R1 in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art3.table2:long] .

A ceiling membrane is permitted to be assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] on the basis of Assembly Number M1 or M2 in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art3.table2:long] .

The limit on the rise of temperature on the unexposed surface of an assembly as required by the tests referred to in  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art1.sent1:long] shall not apply to an exterior wall that has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] of 1.2 m or more, provided correction is made for radiation from the unexposed surface in accordance with  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.sent9:long] .
Floor, roof and ceiling assemblies shall be rated for exposure to fire on the underside.
[REF:term:frwll:Firewalls] and interior vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] shall be rated for exposure to fire on each side.
Exterior walls shall be rated for exposure to fire from inside the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

The use of materials or assemblies having a greater [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] than required shall impose no obligation to exceed in whole or in part the minimum [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance ratings] required by this Part.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art5.sent2:short] and by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:medium] for mixed types of construction, all loadbearing walls, columns and arches in the [REF:term:tr:storey] immediately below a floor or roof assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the supported floor or roof assembly.

The [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art3.sent2:short] shall have an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the abutting [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art3.sent5:short] , joints located in a horizontal plane between a floor and an exterior wall shall be sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:astme2307] has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ]of the horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

Joints between ceilings and walls, between floors and walls, and between walls at corners need not comply with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art3.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art3.sent4:short] where such joints consist of gypsum board that is attached to framing members and arranged so as to restrict the passage of flame and smoke through the joints. A leakage-rated door assembly need not be installed where a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] served by a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] has

clauses.text: a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] , or
an open-air balcony that is sized to accommodate the number of occupants for which the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is intended.

content.text: The size of an opening in an interior [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required to be protected with a [REF:term:clr:closure] shall be not more than 11 m^{2} , with no dimension more than 3.7 m , if a [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] on either side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

The size of an opening in an interior [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required to be protected with a [REF:term:clr:closure] shall be not more than 22 m^{2} , with no dimension more than 6 m , provided the [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] on both sides of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

articles.title: Location of Fire Dampers and Smoke Dampers

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art8:long] , a [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] having a [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent2:long] shall be installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10:long] in ducts or air-transfer openings that penetrate an assembly required to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art9:long] , a smoke damper or a combination smoke/ [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] shall be installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art11:long] in ducts or air-transfer openings that penetrate an assembly required to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , where the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation]

clauses.text: separates a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] ,
contains an egress door referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent2:long] ,
serves an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly] , [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm:treatment] , [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention] or [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] , or
is installed to meet the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent4:long] .

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art8.sent2:short] , the requirement for [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent1:long] is permitted to be waived for

clauses.text: ducts that serve commercial cooking equipment (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:long] ),

continuous [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] ducts having a melting point above 760°C that penetrate a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art1.sent1:long] between [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly] , [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile] , [REF:term:lw-hzrd-:low-hazard industrial] , [REF:term:mdm-hzrd:medium-hazard industrial] or [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] ,
ducts or air-transfer openings that penetrate a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , or
[REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] ducts or air-transfer openings that penetrate a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

content.text: The requirement for [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent1:long] is permitted to be waived for [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] branch ducts having a melting point above 760°C that penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] ,

clauses.text: provided the ducts

subclauses.text: have a cross-sectional area not more than 0.013 m^{2} and serve only air-conditioning units or combined air-conditioning and heating units discharging air not more than 1.2 m above the floor, or

extend not less than 500 mm inside [REF:term:xht-dct:exhaust duct] risers that are under negative pressure and in which the airflow is upward as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art4:long] , or

clauses.text: where the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] separates a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , provided each individual duct exhausts directly to the outdoors at the top of the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] .

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art9.sent2:short] , the requirement for smoke dampers or combination smoke/ [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent2:long] is permitted to be waived for ducts

clauses.text: that serve commercial cooking equipment (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:long] ),
in which all inlet and outlet openings serve not more than one [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] , or

that penetrate a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:long] or in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent4:long] , provided

subclauses.text: the movement of air is continuous, and
the configuration of the air-handling system prevents the recirculation of exhaust or return air under fire emergency conditions.

content.text: The requirement for smoke dampers or combination smoke/ [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent2:long] is permitted to be waived for [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] branch ducts having a melting point above 760°C that penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] ,

clauses.text: provided the ducts

subclauses.text: have a cross-sectional area not more than 0.013 m^{2} and serve only air-conditioning units or combined air-conditioning and heating units discharging air not more than 1.2 m above the floor,

extend not less than 500 mm inside [REF:term:xht-dct:exhaust duct] risers that are under negative pressure and in which the airflow is upward as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art4:long] , or
are required to function as part of a smoke control system, or

clauses.text: where the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] separates a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , provided each individual duct exhausts directly to the outdoors at the top of the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] .

content.text: A [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] shall be installed in the plane of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] so as to stay in place should the duct become dislodged during a fire. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote31:short] .)

A [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] shall be arranged so as to close automatically upon the operation of a fusible link conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs505] or other heat-actuated or smoke-actuated device.
A heat-actuated device referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10.sent2:short] shall

clauses.text: be located where it is readily affected by an abnormal rise in temperature in the duct, and
have a temperature rating approximately 30°C above the maximum temperature that would exist in the system, whether it is in operation or shut down.

content.text: A [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] tested in the vertical or horizontal position shall be installed in the position in which it was tested.

A tightly fitted access door shall be installed for each [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] to provide access for the inspection of the damper and the resetting of the release device. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote32:short] .)
Where smoke dampers are used as a [REF:term:clr:closure] in an air-transfer opening, they shall be installed in the plane of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

Where combination smoke/ [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] are used as a [REF:term:clr:closure] in a duct, they shall be installed within 610 mm of the plane of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , provided there is no inlet or outlet opening between the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] and the damper.

Except as required by a smoke control system, smoke dampers and combination smoke/ [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] shall be configured so as to close automatically upon a signal from an adjacent [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detector] located as described in [REF:standard:ulcs524] within 1.5 m horizontally of the duct or air-transfer opening in the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation]

clauses.text: on both sides of the air-transfer opening, or
in the duct downstream of the smoke damper or combination smoke/ [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] .

content.text: Smoke dampers or combination smoke/ [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] shall be installed in the vertical or horizontal position in which they were tested.

A tightly fitted access door shall be installed for each smoke damper and combination smoke/ [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] to provide access for their inspection and the resetting of the release device. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote32:long] .)
A door assembly having a [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] not less than 20 min is permitted to be used as a [REF:term:clr:closure] in

clauses.text: a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] more than 1 h , located between

subclauses.text: a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and a [REF:term:t:suite] ,
a corridor and adjacent sleeping rooms, or
a corridor and adjacent classrooms, offices and libraries in Group A, Division 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] , or

clauses.text: a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] more than 45 min , located in a [REF:term:bldng:building] not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] .

content.text: The requirements for [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] sills and [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] floor coverings in [REF:standard:nfpa80] do not apply to a door described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent1:short] .
A door described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent1:short] shall have clearances of not more than 6 mm at the bottom and not more than 3 mm at the sides and top.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent2:short] , every door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , other than doors to freight elevators and dumbwaiters, shall be equipped with a self-closing device designed to return the door to the closed position after each use.
A self-closing device need not be provided on a door that is located between

clauses.text: a classroom and a corridor providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from the classroom in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] ,

a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and an adjacent room of [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height ] provided the door is not located in a dead-end portion of the corridor,

a patients' sleeping room and a corridor serving the patients' sleeping room, provided the room and corridor are within a [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] in a hospital or nursing home with [REF:term:trtm:treatment] that complies with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5:long] , or

a patients' sleeping room and an adjacent room that serves the patients' sleeping room, provided these rooms are within a [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] in a hospital or nursing home with [REF:term:trtm:treatment] that complies with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5:long]

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10.sent2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent3:number] , a hold-open device is permitted to be used on a [REF:term:clr:closure ] in a required [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , other than on an [REF:term:xt:exit] stair door in a [REF:term:bldng:building] more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] and on a door for a vestibule required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7:long] , provided the device is designed to release the [REF:term:clr:closure] in conformance with this Article.

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent6:short] , where the [REF:term:bldng:building] is provided with a fire alarm system, a hold-open device permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent1:short] shall release

clauses.text: in a single-stage system, upon any signal from the fire alarm system, and
in a 2-stage system,

subclauses.text: upon any [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] from the fire alarm system, or
upon actuation of any adjacent [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] .

content.text: Where the [REF:term:bldng:building] is provided with a fire alarm system, a hold-open device permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent1:short] shall release upon a signal from a [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detector] connected to the fire alarm system and located as described in [REF:standard:ulcs524] where the hold-open device is used on

clauses.text: an [REF:term:xt:exit] door,
a door opening into a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] ,
an egress door referred to in  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent2:long] ,
a [REF:term:clr:closure] serving an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly] , [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment] , [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention] , or [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] ,
a door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent4:long] , or
a door required to function as part of a smoke control system.

content.text: Where the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not provided with a fire alarm system, a hold-open device permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent1:short] shall release upon a signal from a [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] located on each side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] at ceiling level within 1.5 m horizontally of the [REF:term:clr:closure] opening in the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , where the hold-open device is used on [REF:term:clr:closures] described in  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent3.clause1:medium] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent3.clause5:short] .

Where a hold-open device is used on [REF:term:clr:closures] other than those described in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent4:short] , it is permitted to be released upon actuation of a heat-actuated device.

A hold-open device used on a door located between a corridor used by the public and an adjacent sleeping room in a [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment occupancy] need not release automatically as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent2:short] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5:long] , a swing-type door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] shall be equipped with a positive latching mechanism designed to hold the door in the closed position after each use.

Except as permitted by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art18:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art19:long] for the separation of [REF:term:xt:exits] , an opening in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not more than 1 h is permitted to be protected with fixed wired glass assemblies or glass blocks installed in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa80] (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17:long] )

Wired glass assemblies permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent1:short] and described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] are permitted to be used as [REF:term:clr:closures] in vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] without being tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent1:long] .

Glass blocks permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent1:short] shall be installed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect2:long] and reinforced with steel reinforcement in each horizontal joint.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art19:long] , the maximum temperature rise on the opaque portion of the unexposed side of a door used as a [REF:term:clr:closure ] in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] in a location shown in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art17.table1:long] shall conform to the Table when tested in conformance with  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent1:long] .

Between an [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosure and the adjacent [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height]
Between an [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosure and the adjacent [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] (except as permitted above)

articles.title: Area Limits for Wired Glass, Glass Block and Safety Glazing

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art19:long] , the maximum aggregate area of wired glass or safety glazing in a door used in the locations shown in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art17.table1:long] shall conform to the Table. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote33:short] .)

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art19:long] , the maximum aggregate area of glass block, wired glass or safety glazing panels not in a door used in the locations shown in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art17.table1:long] shall conform to the Table.

articles.title: Temperature Rise and Area Limits Waived

content.text: The temperature rise limits and glass area limits required by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art17:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art18:long] are waived for a [REF:term:clr:closure ] between an [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosure and an enclosed vestibule or corridor, provided

clauses.text: the vestibule or corridor is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation ] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min ,

the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art19.sent1.clause1:short] contains no wired glass, glass block or safety glazing within 3 m of the [REF:term:clr:closure] into the [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosure, and
the vestibule or corridor contains no [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] .

subsections.title: Penetrations in Fire Separations and Fire-Rated Assemblies

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent2:short]  to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art3:long] , penetrations of a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] shall be

clauses.text: sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an F rating not less than the required [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , or
cast in place, where the item penetrating the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is steel, ferrous, copper, concrete or masonry (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote36:short] ).

see_also.content: (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4:long] for requirements regarding penetrations by [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] drain, waste and vent piping.)

content.text: Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent6:short] , penetrations of a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] or a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] that is required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2:long] shall be sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

Except as permitted in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent6:short]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent7:short] , penetrations of a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4.art2.sent2:long] shall be sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] of the assembly.

Sprinklers are permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] without having to meet the [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] requirements of  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent1:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short] , provided the annular space created by the penetration of a fire sprinkler is covered by a metal escutcheon plate in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13]

Unless specifically designed with a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] , [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] are permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] without having to meet the [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] requirements of  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent1:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short] , provided the [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] is installed in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa80]

Service equipment penetrations through a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] as described in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short] that are contained within the cavity of a wall above and below the horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] are permitted to be sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

Service equipment penetrations through a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short] are permitted to be sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , provided the penetration

clauses.text: is contained within the concealed space of a floor or ceiling assembly having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] ,
is located above a ceiling membrane that is a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , or
is contained within a [REF:term:hrzntl-r:horizontal service space] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4:long] that is directly above or below the floor.

content.text: Ducts, electrical outlet boxes, pipes, totally enclosed raceways, optical fibre cables, electrical wires and cables, and other similar service equipment are permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided they are protected at the penetration with a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent1:long] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote37:short] .)

[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible ] totally enclosed raceways that are embedded in a concrete floor slab are permitted in an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided the concrete cover between the raceway and the bottom of the slab is not less than 50 mm .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art3.sent3:short] , outlet boxes are permitted to penetrate the membrane of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided they are sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115]

[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] outlet boxes are permitted to penetrate the membrane of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided they are sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short] , [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] outlet boxes that penetrate a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art3.sent1:short] , provided

clauses.text: they do not exceed

subclauses.text: 0.016 m^{2} in area, and
an aggregate area of 0.065 m^{2} in any 9.3 m^{2} of surface area, and

clauses.text: the annular space between the membrane and the [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] electrical outlet boxes does not exceed 3 mm .

content.text: Outlet boxes on opposite sides of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] shall be separated by

clauses.text: a horizontal distance of not less than 600 mm ,
a [REF:term:fr-blk:fire block] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] , or

a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] installed on each outlet box that has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115]

content.text: [REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] sprinkler piping is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] provided the [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] on each side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible ] water distribution piping is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] that is required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided the piping is protected at the penetration with a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] in conformance with  Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4.clause1:medium] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4.clause2:short] .

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent5:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent8:short] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] piping shall not be used in a drain, waste and vent piping system if any part of that system penetrates

clauses.text: a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , or
a membrane that forms part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

content.text: [REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible ] drain, waste and vent piping is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] or a membrane that forms part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided

clauses.text: except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4.clause2:short] , the piping is sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] required for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115]

in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , the piping is sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] with a pressure differential of 50 Pa between the exposed and unexposed sides, with the higher pressure on the exposed side, and
the piping is not located in a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] .

content.text: [REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] drain, waste and vent piping is permitted on one side of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] provided it is not located in a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] .

[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] piping for central vacuum systems is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , provided the installation conforms to the requirements that apply to [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] drain, waste and vent piping specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4:short] .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent8:short] , penetrations of a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] that incorporate transitions between [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] and [REF:term:cmbtbl:noncombustible] drain, waste and vent piping shall be sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] required for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] with a pressure differential of 50 Pa between the exposed and unexposed sides, with the higher pressure on the exposed side.

Transitions between vertical [REF:term:cmbtbl:noncombustible] drain, waste and vent piping and [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] branches for drain, waste and vent piping are permitted on either side of a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , provided they are not located in a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote39:short] .)

A membrane ceiling forming part of an assembly assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] on the basis of  Appendix [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] or  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art1.sent4:long] is permitted to be penetrated by openings leading into ducts within the ceiling space, provided

clauses.text: the ducts are sheet steel, and
the number of openings and their protection conform to the requirements of  Appendix [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] .

revisions.text: A membrane ceiling forming part of an assembly assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] on the basis of  Appendix [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] is permitted to be penetrated by openings leading into ducts within the ceiling space, provided

clauses.text: the ducts are sheet steel, and
the number of openings and their protection conform to the requirements of  Appendix [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] .

revisions.text: A membrane ceiling forming part of an assembly assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] on the basis of  Appendix [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] or  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art1.sent4:long] is permitted to be penetrated by openings leading into ducts within the ceiling space, provided

content.text: A ceiling assembly used as a [REF:term:plnm:plenum] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4.art3:long]

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art1.sent2:short] , the connections and supports for structural framing members that are connected to or supported on a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] and have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] less than that required for the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] , shall be designed so that the failure of the framing systems during a fire will not affect the integrity of the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] during the fire.

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art1.sent1:short] does not apply to a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] consisting of two separate wall assemblies each tied to its respective [REF:term:bldng:building] frame but not to each other, provided each wall assembly is

clauses.text: a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having one half of the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required for the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art2.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art2.sent2:short] , and
designed so that the collapse of one wall assembly will not cause collapse of the other.

content.text: A [REF:term:frwll:firewall] is permitted to be supported on the structural frame of a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] provided the supporting frame has a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] .
Piping, ducts and totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] raceways shall be installed so that their collapse will not cause collapse of the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] .

A [REF:term:frwll:firewall] that separates a [REF:term:bldng:building] or [REF:term:bldng:buildings] with [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] containing a Group E or a Group F, Division 1 or 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 4 h , except that where the upper portion of a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] separates [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] containing other than Group E or Group F, Division 1 or 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] , the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the upper portion of the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] is permitted to be not less than 2 h .

A [REF:term:frwll:firewall ] that separates a [REF:term:bldng:building ] or [REF:term:bldng:buildings] with [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] containing [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] other than Group E or Group F, Division 1 or 2 shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art2.sent4:short] , the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] , except for [REF:term:clr:closures] , shall be provided by masonry or concrete.
A [REF:term:frwll:firewall] permitted to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not more than 2 h need not be constructed of masonry or concrete, provided

clauses.text: the assembly providing the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] is protected against damage that would compromise the integrity of the assembly, and
the design conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art17:long]

content.text: A [REF:term:frwll:firewall] shall extend from the ground continuously through, or adjacent to, all [REF:term:tr:storeys] of a [REF:term:bldng:building] or [REF:term:bldng:buildings] so separated, except that a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] located above a [REF:term:bmnt:basement]  [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2:long] is permitted to commence at the floor assembly immediately above the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] . (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art1.sent3:long] .)
A [REF:term:frwll:firewall] is permitted to terminate on the underside of a reinforced concrete roof slab, provided

clauses.text: the roof slab on both sides of the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] has a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than

subclauses.text: 1 h if the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] is required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h , or
2 h if the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] is required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 4 h , and

clauses.text: there are no concealed spaces within the roof slab in that portion immediately above the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] .

content.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art4.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art3.sent2:long] , a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] shall extend above the roof surface to form a parapet not less than

clauses.text: 150 mm high for a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h , and
900 mm high for a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 4 h .

content.text: A [REF:term:frwll:firewall] that separates 2 [REF:term:bldng:buildings] with roofs at different elevations need not extend above the upper roof surface to form a parapet, provided the difference in elevation between the roofs is more than 3 m .
Openings in a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] shall conform to the size limits described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art6:long]
The aggregate width of openings in a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] within a [REF:term:tr:storey] shall be not more than 25% of the entire length of the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] .

The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art14:long] shall apply to the external walls of 2 [REF:term:bldng:buildings] that meet at a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] at an angle less than 135° .

[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] material shall not extend across the end of a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] but is permitted to extend across a roof above a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] that is terminated in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art3.sent2:long] .

If [REF:term:bldng:buildings ] are separated by a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] projections on the exterior of one [REF:term:bldng:building] , including balconies, platforms, canopies, eave projections and stairs, that extend outward beyond the end of the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] , shall not be permitted within 2.4 m of [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] projections and window or door openings of the adjacent [REF:term:bldng:building] . (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art6:long] )

Concealed spaces in interior wall, ceiling and crawl spaces shall be separated from concealed spaces in exterior walls and [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof spaces] by [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long]

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art2.sent2:short] , [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] shall be provided to block off concealed spaces within a wall assembly

clauses.text: at every floor level,
at every ceiling level where the ceiling forms part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , and
so that the maximum horizontal dimension is not more than 20 m and the maximum vertical dimension is not more than 3 m .

content.text: [REF:term:fr-blk:Fire blocks] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art2.sent1:short] are not required, provided

clauses.text: the wall space is filled with insulation,
the exposed construction materials and any insulation within the wall space are [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] ,

the exposed materials within the space, including insulation but not including wiring, piping or similar services, have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not more than 25 on any exposed surface, or any surface that would be exposed by cutting through the material in any direction, and [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] are installed so that the vertical distance between them is not more than 10 m , or
the insulated wall assembly contains not more than one concealed air space, and the horizontal thickness of that air space is not more than 25 mm .

articles.title: Fire Blocks between Nailing and Supporting Elements

content.text: In a [REF:term:bldng:building] required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] , a concealed space in which there is an exposed ceiling finish with a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] more than 25 shall be provided with [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] between wood nailing elements so that the maximum area of the concealed space is not more than 2 m^{2} .

In a [REF:term:bldng:building] required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] , [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] shall be provided in the concealed spaces created by the wood members permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art10.sent2:long] so that the maximum area of a concealed space is not more than 10 m^{ 2} .

In a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] , a concealed space in which there is an exposed ceiling finish with a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] more than 25 shall be provided with [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] between wood nailing elements so that the maximum area of the concealed space is not more than 2 m^{2} . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote41:short] .)

In a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] , [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] shall be provided in the concealed spaces created by the wood members permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art12.sent1:long] so that the maximum area of a concealed space is not more than 10 m^{2} .

articles.title: Fire Blocks between Vertical and Horizontal Spaces

content.text: [REF:term:fr-blk:Fire blocks] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] shall be provided

clauses.text: at all interconnections between concealed vertical and horizontal spaces in interior coved ceilings, drop ceilings and soffits in which the exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] more than 25, and

at the end of each run and at each floor level in concealed spaces between stair stringers in which the exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] more than 25.

articles.title: Fire Blocks in Horizontal Concealed Spaces

content.text: Except for crawl spaces conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art6.sent1:long] and as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art5.sent3:short] , horizontal concealed spaces within a floor assembly or roof assembly of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] , in which sprinklers are not installed, shall be separated by construction conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] into compartments

clauses.text: not more than 600 m^{2} in area with no dimension more than 60 m if the exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating ]not more than 25, and
not more than 300 m^{2} in area with no dimension more than 20 m if the exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] more than 25.

content.text: A concealed space in an exterior cornice, a mansard-style roof, a balcony or a canopy in which exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating ] more than 25, shall be separated by construction conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long]

clauses.text: at locations where the concealed space extends across the ends of required vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] , and
so that the maximum dimension in the concealed space is not more than 20 m .

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art5.sent5:short] , in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or parts thereof conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long] , horizontal concealed spaces within a floor assembly or roof assembly of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] shall be separated by construction conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] into compartments that are

clauses.text: not more than 600 m^{2} in area with no dimension more than 60 m , if the exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not more than 25, and
not more than 300 m^{2} in area with no dimension more than 20 m , if the exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] more than 25.

content.text: Except for crawl spaces conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art6.sent1:long] and except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art5.sent5:short] , in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or parts thereof conforming to  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:number] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:number] , horizontal concealed spaces within a floor assembly or roof assembly of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] shall be separated by construction conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] into compartments that are

clauses.text: not more than 600 m^{2} in area with no dimension more than 60 m , if the exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not more than 25, and

not more than 300 m^{2} in area with no dimension more than 20 m , if the exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] more than 25. (See  Notes [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote32:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote33:short] .)

articles.title: Interior Finishes, Furnishings and Decorative Materials

content.text: Except as otherwise provided by this Subsection, interior finishes, furnishings and decorative materials shall conform to [REF:external:nfc:Section 2.3. of Division B of the ] [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc] .
Interior finish material shall include any material that forms part of the interior surface of a floor, wall, [REF:term:prttn:partition] or ceiling, including

clauses.text: interior cladding of plaster, wood or tile,
surfacing of fabric, paint, plastic, veneer or wallpaper,
doors, windows and trim,
lighting elements such as light diffusers and lenses forming part of the finished surface of the ceiling, and
carpet material that overlies a floor that is not intended as the finished floor.

content.text: Except as otherwise required or permitted by this Subsection, the [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of interior wall and ceiling finishes, including glazing and skylights, shall be not more than 150 and shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art2.table1:long]

[REF:term:hv-tmbr-:heavy timber construction] ,
[REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] , or

Where [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or parts thereof conforming to  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:number] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:number] include non-contiguous roof assemblies at different elevations, the roof coverings referred to in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect15.art2.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect15.art2.sent4:short] are permitted to be evaluated separately to determine the roof covering classification required.

revisions.text: Where [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or parts thereof conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long] include non-contiguous roof assemblies at different elevations, the roof coverings referred to in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect15.art2.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect15.art2.sent4:short] are permitted to be evaluated separately to determine the roof covering classification required.

Where [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or parts thereof conforming to  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:number] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:number] include non-contiguous roof assemblies at different elevations, the roof coverings referred to in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect15.art2.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect15.art2.sent4:short] are permitted to be evaluated separately to determine the roof covering classification required.

content.text: Fabrics used as part of an awning, canopy or marquee that is located within or attached to a [REF:term:bldng:building] of any type of construction shall conform to [REF:standard:ulcs109]
The [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be based on

clauses.text: the number of seats in an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy ] having fixed seats,
2 persons per sleeping room in a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , or

the number of persons for which the area is designed, but not less than that determined from [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17.art1.table1:long] for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies ] other than those described in  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17.art1.sent1.clause1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17.art1.sent1.clause2:short] , unless it can be shown that the area will be occupied by fewer persons.

content.text: If a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or part thereof has been designed for an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] other than that determined from [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17.art1.table1:long] , a permanent sign indicating that [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] shall be posted in a conspicuous location.
For the purposes of this Article, [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] , tiers and balconies shall be regarded as part of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] .

If a room or group of rooms is intended for different [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] at different times, the value to be used from [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17.art1.table1:long] shall be the value which gives the greatest number of persons for the [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] concerned.

content.text: Tents and [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structures] shall conform to  Sections [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4:long]
An [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structure] shall not be located above the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] on any [REF:term:bldng:building] .
An [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structure] shall not be used for Groups B, C, or Group F, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] or for classrooms.
An [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structure] shall be designed as open floor space without interior walls, [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] , intermediate floors or similar construction.

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect18.art3.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect18.art3.sent4:short] , every tent and [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structure] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3:long]
Tents and [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structures]

clauses.text: shall not be erected closer than 3 m to other structures on the same property except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect18.art3.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect18.art3.sent4:short] , and
shall be sufficiently distant from one another to provide an area to be used as a means of emergency egress.

content.text: Tents and [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structures] not occupied by the public

clauses.text: need not be separated from one another, and
are permitted to be erected less than 3 m from other structures on the same property provided this spacing does not create a hazard to the public.

content.text: Tents not more than 120 m^{2} in ground area, located on fair grounds or similar open spaces, need not be separated from one another provided this does not create a hazard to the public.

The ground enclosed by a tent or [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structure] and not less than 3 m of ground outside the structure shall be cleared of all flammable material or vegetation that will spread fire.
Every tent and [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structure] and all tarpaulins and decorative materials used in connection with these structures shall conform to [REF:standard:ulcs109]
An [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structure] used as a place of assembly for more than 200 persons shall have either

clauses.text: an automatic emergency engine-generator set capable of powering one blower continuously for 4 h , or
a supplementary blower powered by an automatic internal combustion engine.

content.text: The electrical system and equipment in a tent or [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structure] , including electrical fuses and switches, shall be inaccessible to the public.
Cables on the ground in areas used by the public in a tent or [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structure] shall be placed in trenches or protected by covers to prevent damage from traffic.
A rooftop enclosure shall not be considered as a [REF:term:tr:storey] in calculating the [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] if it is provided for

clauses.text: elevator machinery,
a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] ,
a stairway used for no purpose other than for access or egress,
an elevator lobby used for no purpose other than for access or egress, or
a combination thereof.

content.text: Space under tiers of seats in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of the arena type shall not be considered as adding to the [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] provided the space is used only for dressing rooms, concession stands and similar purposes incidental to the [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent5:short] , the space above a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] need not be considered as a [REF:term:tr:storey] in calculating the [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , provided

clauses.text: the aggregate area of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] that are not superimposed does not exceed 40% of the open area of the room in which they are located (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote48:short] ), and

except as permitted in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art13.sent3:long] , the space above the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is used as an open area without [REF:term:prttn:partitions] or subdividing walls higher than 1 070 mm above the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] floor.

content.text: Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent5:short] , the space above a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] need not be considered as a [REF:term:tr:storey] in calculating the [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , provided

clauses.text: the aggregate area of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] that are not superimposed and do not meet the conditions of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent3:short] does not exceed 10% of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in which they are located, and
the area of a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] in a [REF:term:t:suite] does not exceed 10% of the area of that [REF:term:t:suite] .

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent6:short] , each level of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] that is partly or wholly superimposed above the first level of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] shall be considered as a [REF:term:tr:storey] in calculating the [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] .

Platforms intended solely for periodic inspection and elevated maintenance catwalks need not be considered as floor assemblies or [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] for the purpose of calculating [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , provided

clauses.text: they are not used for storage, and
they are constructed with [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] materials, unless the [REF:term:bldng:building] is permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] .

content.text: The space above a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent3:short] is permitted to include an enclosed space whose area does not exceed 10% of the open area of the room in which the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is located provided the enclosed space does not obstruct visual communication between the open space above the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] and the room in which it is located. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote48:long] .)

A [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] in which facilities are included to permit a person to enter and to undertake maintenance and other operations pertaining to [REF:term:bldng:building] services from within the [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space ] need not be considered a [REF:term:tr:storey] if it conforms to  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art14:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art25:long] , and  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent11:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent2:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent7:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent3:number] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art4.sent9:long] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote49:short] .)

articles.title: Storage Garage Considered as a Separate Building

content.text: A [REF:term:bmnt:basement] used primarily as a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] is permitted to be considered as a separate [REF:term:bldng:building] for the purposes of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] and  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent3:short] , provided the floor and roof assemblies above the [REF:term:bmnt:basement] and the exterior walls of the [REF:term:bmnt:basement] above the adjoining ground level are constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations ] of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h and protected in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art2.sent4.clause1:long] , except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2.sent2:short] . (See  Notes [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote40:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote95:long] .)

The exterior wall of a [REF:term:bmnt:basement] that is required to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2.sent1:short] is permitted to be penetrated by openings that are not protected by [REF:term:clr:closures] provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout,
every opening in the exterior wall is separated from [REF:term:tr:storeys] above the opening by a projection of the floor or roof assembly above the [REF:term:bmnt:basement] , extending not less than

subclauses.text: 1 m beyond the exterior face of the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] if the upper [REF:term:tr:storeys] are required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] , or

2 m beyond the exterior face of the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] if the upper [REF:term:tr:storeys] are permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] or [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] , or

clauses.text: the exterior walls of any [REF:term:tr:storeys] located above the floor or roof assembly referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2.sent1:short] are recessed behind the outer edge of the assembly by not less than

subclauses.text: 1 m if the upper [REF:term:tr:storeys] are required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] , or
2 m if the upper [REF:term:tr:storeys] are permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] or [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] .

content.text: The floor or roof assembly projection referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2.sent2.clause2:medium] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h and shall have no openings within the projection.

For the purposes of this Section any part of a roof that is pitched at an angle of 60° or more to the horizontal and is adjacent to a space intended for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] within a [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be considered as part of an exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Except as permitted by  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art47.sent3:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art49.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art50.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art52.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art53.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art54.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art55.sent3:number] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93.sent3:number] , a floor assembly immediately above a [REF:term:bmnt:basement] shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] conforming to the requirements of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:medium] for a floor assembly, but not less than 45 min .

revisions.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art47.sent3:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art49.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art50.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art52.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art53.sent3:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art54.sent3:number] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art55.sent3:long] , a floor assembly immediately above a [REF:term:bmnt:basement] shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] conforming to the requirements of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long] for a floor assembly, but not less than 45 min .

content.text: All [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing] walls, columns and arches supporting a floor assembly immediately above a [REF:term:bmnt:basement] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art4.sent1:short] for the floor assembly.

subsections.title: Building Size and Construction Relative to Occupancy

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art3:long] , a [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be constructed in conformance with this Subsection to prevent fire spread and collapse caused by the effects of fire. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect3:long] for [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations ] between [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] .)

A structure that cannot be identified with the characteristics of a [REF:term:bldng:building] in Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:number:3.2.2.20.] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:number:3.2.2.92.] shall be protected against fire spread and collapse in conformance with good fire protection engineering practice. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote50:short] .) (See also Notes [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote1:short:A-3] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote94:short:A-3.2.5.12.(1)] .)
Fire protection is not required for

clauses.text: steel lintels above openings not more than 2 m wide in [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing] walls and not more than 3 m wide in non- [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing] walls,

steel lintels above openings more than 2 m wide in [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing] walls and more than 3 m wide in non- [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing] walls provided the lintels are supported at intervals of not more than 2 m by structural members with the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] ,
the bottom flanges of shelf angles and plates that are not a part of the structural frame,

steel members for framework around elevator hoistway doorways, steel for the support of elevator and dumbwaiter guides, counterweights and other similar equipment, that are entirely enclosed in a hoistway and are not a part of the structural frame of the [REF:term:bldng:building] ,
steel members of stairways and escalators that are not a part of the structural frame of a [REF:term:bldng:building] ,

steel members of porches, exterior balconies, exterior stairways, fire escapes, cornices, marquees and other similar appurtenances, provided they are outside an exterior wall of a [REF:term:bldng:building] , and

articles.title: Limiting Distance and Area of Unprotected Openings

content.text: Except as permitted by Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art10:number:3.2.3.10.] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art12:number:3.2.3.12.] , the area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] in an [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] for the applicable [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] shall be not more than the value determined in accordance with

clauses.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table2:long:Table 3.2.3.1.-B] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table3:number:3.2.3.1.-C] for an [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art2:long] of a [REF:term:bldng:building] or [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] which is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , or

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table4:long:Table 3.2.3.1.-D] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table5:number:3.2.3.1.-E] for an [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art2:long] of a [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered]  [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] that is part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] which is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2:long]

content.text: The area of the [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] in an [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] shall be the aggregate area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] expressed as a percentage of the area of the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table2:long:Table 3.2.3.1.-B] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table3:number:3.2.3.1.-C] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table4:number:3.2.3.1.-D] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table5:number:3.2.3.1.-E] . clauses.text: the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] shall be taken as the projection of the exterior wall onto a vertical plane located so that no portion of the exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] or of a [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] , if the [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] complies with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art2:long] , is between the vertical plane and the line to which the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] is measured, and

the area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] shall be determined from [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table2:long:Table 3.2.3.1.-B] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table3:number:3.2.3.1.-C] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table4:number:3.2.3.1.-D] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.table5:number:3.2.3.1.-E] .

articles.title: Wall Enclosing Attic or Roof Space

content.text: An exterior wall enclosing an [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] and located above an [REF:term:bldng:exposing building face] , shall be constructed in conformance with the requirements for the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] .
A [REF:term:prt-wll:party wall] shall be constructed as a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote59:short] .)

articles.title: Wall with Limiting Distance Less Than 1.2 m

content.text: Openings in a wall that has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] less than 1.2 m shall be protected by [REF:term:clr:closures] whose [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] is in conformance with the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required for the wall.
Wired glass or glass block shall not be used for a [REF:term:clr:closure] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art5.sent1:short] .

Except for a [REF:term:bldng:building] containing one or two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] only, [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] projections on the exterior of a wall that could expose an adjacent [REF:term:bldng:building] to fire spread and are more than 1 m above ground level, including balconies, platforms, canopies and stairs, shall not be permitted within

clauses.text: 1.2 m of a property line or the centre line of a [REF:term:pblc-w:public way] , or
2.4 m of a [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] projection on another [REF:term:bldng:building] on the same property.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art6.sent4:short] , where the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] of not more than 0.45 m , projecting roof soffits shall not be constructed above the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] . Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art6.sent4:short] , where the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] of more than 0.45 m , the face of roof soffits shall not project to less than 0.45 m from the property line.
