[REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material that complies with the criteria for testing and the conditions of acceptance stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art8.sent2:short] when tested in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs101]

content.text: The criteria for testing and the conditions of acceptance for a wall assembly to satisfy the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:medium] are that

clauses.text: the fire exposed area of the wall assembly shall be not less than 9.3 m^{2} and have no dimension less than 2.75 m ,
the exposed surface shall include typical vertical and horizontal joints,
the test shall be continued for not less than 15 min and the standard time/temperature curve of the referenced standard shall be followed,
the [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] protective material must remain in place and no through openings should develop that are visible when viewed normal to the face of the material, and
the [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] protective material should not disintegrate in a manner that would permit fire to propagate along the surface of the test assembly.

content.text: The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art8.sent1:short] are waived for wall assemblies that comply with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art5:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote5:short:Note A-3.1.4.1.(1)] .)

content.text: Structural members of [REF:term:hv-tmbr-:heavy timber construction] , including beams, columns and arches, that are placed wholly or partly outside the exterior face of a [REF:term:bldng:building] and are 3 m or more from the property line or the centre line of a public thoroughfare need not be covered with [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] cladding.

An [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] in a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] with all [REF:term:tr:storeys] constructed as [REF:term:pn-r-tr:open-air storeys] is permitted to have unlimited [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] provided it has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] not less than 3 m .

The [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] of a [REF:term:tr:storey] that faces a [REF:term:trt:street] and is at the same level as the [REF:term:trt:street] is permitted to have unlimited [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] if the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] is not less than 9 m .

articles.title: Low Fire Load, One Storey Building

content.text: An [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] of a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:lw-hzrd-:low-hazard industrial occupancy] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art91:long] is permitted to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible construction] without a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] provided

clauses.text: it is not a [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing] wall, and
the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] is not less than 3 m .

content.text: Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art7.sent5:long] , the maximum area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] in any [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] of a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] is permitted to be doubled if the openings are glazed with

clauses.text: glass block conforming to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art16:long] , or
wired glass assemblies conforming to  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD.appsect2.subsect3.article15:medium] of Appendix D.

content.text: Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent3:short] and as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art3.sent1:long] , if the plane of an exterior wall of an [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosure forms an angle less than 135° with the plane of an exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] it serves, and an opening in the exterior wall of the [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosure could be exposed to fire from an opening in the exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , the opening in either the exterior wall of the [REF:term:xt:exit] or the exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be protected in conformance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent4:short] where the opening in the exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building ] is within 3 m horizontally and

clauses.text: less than 10 m below an opening in the exterior wall of the [REF:term:xt:exit] , or
less than 2 m above an opening in the exterior wall of the [REF:term:xt:exit] .

content.text: If an unenclosed exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] could be exposed to fire from an opening in the exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] it serves, the opening in the exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be protected in conformance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent4:short] where the opening in the exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] is within 3 m horizontally and

clauses.text: less than 10 m below the [REF:term:xt:exit] stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , or
less than 5 m above the [REF:term:xt:exit] stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] .

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art3.sent1:long] , if an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] door in one [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] is within 3 m horizontally of an opening in another [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] and the exterior walls of these [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] intersect at an exterior angle of less than 135° , the opening shall be protected in conformance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent4:short] .
The opening protection referred to in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent1:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent3:short] shall consist of

clauses.text: glass block conforming to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art16:long] ,
a wired glass assembly conforming to  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD.appsect2.subsect3.article15:medium] of Appendix D, or

a [REF:term:clr:closure] conforming to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8:long] and  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art14:long]

content.text: Except as required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art14.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent1:long] or as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19.sent5:long] , if an [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected opening] in an exterior wall of a [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] is exposed to an [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected opening] in the exterior wall of another [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] , and the planes of the 2 walls are parallel or at an angle less than 135° , measured from the exterior of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , the [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] in the 2 [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] shall be separated by a distance not less than D_{o} where [EQ:display:es000595q1] but in no case less than 1 m , and [LIST:variable]

items.description: = the greater required [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] for the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building faces] of the 2 [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] , and

= the angle made by the intersecting planes of the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building faces] of the 2 [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] (in the case where the exterior walls are parallel and face each other, <italic>θ</italic> = 0° ).

content.text: The exterior wall of each [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art14.sent1:short] within the distance, D_{o}, shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the interior vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between the [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] and the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art14.sent1:short] does not apply to [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] of [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] within a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, but shall apply to

clauses.text: [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] of [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] on opposite sides of a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] , and
exposure from [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] of a [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] that is not protected by an automatic sprinkler system.

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19.sent5:long] , if a wall in a [REF:term:bldng:building ] is exposed to a fire hazard from an adjoining roof of a separate [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] in the same [REF:term:bldng:building] , and the exposed wall contains windows within 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] vertically and 5 m horizontally of the roof, the roof shall contain no skylights within 5 m of the exposed wall.

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art16.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art16.sent4:short] , where there is a common [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] above more than 2 [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] or above more than 2 patients' sleeping rooms, and the common [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] projects beyond the exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , the soffit, and any opening in the soffit or other surface of the projection located within 2 500 mm of a window or door opening, shall be protected by

clauses.text: [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material

subclauses.text: not less than 0.38 mm thick, and
having a melting point not below 650°C ,

clauses.text: plywood not less than 11 mm thick,
strandboard or waferboard not less than 12.5 mm thick, or
lumber not less than 11 mm thick.

content.text: The soffit protection required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art16.sent1:short] shall extend the full width of the opening and to not less than 1 200 mm on either side of it, and shall apply to all openings through the soffit within this limit.

If an eave overhang is completely separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] by the use of [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] , the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art16.sent1:short] do not apply.
The protection required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art16.sent1:short] for projections is permitted to be omitted if

clauses.text: the [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] behind the window and door openings are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] , and

all rooms, including closets and bathrooms, having openings in the wall beneath the soffit are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , notwithstanding exceptions permitted in the standards referenced in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] for the installation of automatic sprinkler systems.

articles.title: Canopy Protection for Vertically Separated Openings

content.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent3:short] , if a [REF:term:tr:storey] classified as a Group E or Group F, Division 1 or 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] is required to be separated from the [REF:term:tr:storey] above by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] ,

clauses.text: every opening in the exterior wall of the lower [REF:term:tr:storey ] that is located vertically below an opening in the [REF:term:tr:storey] above shall be separated from the [REF:term:tr:storey] above by a canopy projecting not less than 1 m from the face of the [REF:term:bldng:building] at the intervening floor level, and

the canopy required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent1.clause1:short] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the floor assembly but need not be more than 1 h , except as required elsewhere in this Subsection.

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent3:short] , the canopy required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent1:short] is permitted to be omitted if the exterior wall of the upper [REF:term:tr:storey] is recessed not less than 1 m behind the exterior wall containing the opening in the lower [REF:term:tr:storey] .

The requirements of  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent2:short] are permitted to be waived if the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

A covered vehicular passageway designed as a receiving or shipping area shall be separated from every [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] adjoining it by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1.5 h .
A covered vehicular passageway constructed below [REF:term:grade:grade] shall be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] .

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art20.sent2:long] , if [REF:term:bldng:buildings] are connected by a [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] , each [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be separated from the [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19.sent4:short] , a [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] connected to a [REF:term:bldng:building] required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] shall also be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19.sent4:short] , a [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] connected to a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] shall be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] or [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] .

A [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] connected to a [REF:term:bldng:building] required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] or to a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] is permitted to be of [REF:term:hv-tmbr-:heavy timber construction] , provided

clauses.text: not less than 50% of the area of any enclosing perimeter walls is open to the outdoors, and
the [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] is at ground level.

content.text: A [REF:term:wlkw:walkway ] of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] used only as a pedestrian thoroughfare need not conform to the requirements of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art14:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art15:long]
A [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] between [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be not more than 9 m wide.
An underground [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] shall not be designed or used for any purpose other than pedestrian travel unless

clauses.text: the purpose is acceptable to the [REF:term:thrt-hvn:authority having jurisdiction] , and
sprinklers are installed in any space in the [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] containing an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] .

content.text: [REF:term:bldng:Buildings] connected by an underground [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] shall be separated from the [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .
An underground [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] shall be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] suitable for an underground location.
In an underground [REF:term:wlkw:walkway]

clauses.text: smoke barrier doors shall be installed at intervals of not more than 100 m , or

the travel distance from the door of an adjacent room or space to the nearest [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be not more than one and a half times the least allowable travel distance to an [REF:term:xt:exit] for any of the adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1:long] .

content.text: An underground [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] between [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be not more than 9 m wide.

articles.title: Storage and Process Equipment Located Outdoors

content.text: Location of outdoor storage and outdoor process equipment in relation to [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall conform to Parts 3 and 4 of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code.

articles.title: Installation of Service Lines Under Buildings

content.text: When a [REF:term:bldng:building] is erected over existing buried flammable gas mains, such service lines shall be encased in gas-tight conduits in conformance with [REF:standard:csaz662]

articles.title: Determination of Requirement for a Fire Alarm System

content.text: Except as permitted in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent3:short] , a fire alarm system shall be installed in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] in which an automatic sprinkler system is required by this Part.
[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] in which a sprinkler system is installed in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13d] need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent1:short] .

[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] that contain fewer than 9 sprinklers conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent4:long] need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent1:short] .

Except as permitted by Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent5:short:(5)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent6:short:(6)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent4:number:3.2.4.2.(4)] , a fire alarm system shall be installed in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout and that contains

clauses.text: a [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] ,
an [REF:term:mpdd-gr-:impeded egress zone] ,
more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] , including the [REF:term:tr:storeys] below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] ,
a total [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 300, other than in open air seating areas,
an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 150 above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] , other than in open air seating areas,
a school, college, or child care facility, including a daycare facility for children, with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 40,
a licensed beverage establishment or a licensed restaurant, with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 150,
a [REF:term:lw-hzrd-:low-hazard industrial occupancy] with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 75 above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] ,
a [REF:term:mdm-hzrd:medium-hazard industrial occupancy] with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 75 above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] ,
a [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] with sleeping accommodation for more than 10 persons ,
a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 25, or
an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 300 below an open air seating area.

content.text: A fire alarm system is not required in a [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , where

clauses.text: not more than 4 [REF:term:t:suites] share a common [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] , or
each [REF:term:t:suite] has direct access to an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] facility leading to ground level.

content.text: A fire alarm system is not required in a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long] that is contained in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] provided there are no other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] in the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

A fire alarm system shall be installed in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] designed and constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10:long] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnoteA-3.2.10.2.1-2:long] .)

revisions.text: A fire alarm system shall be installed in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] designed and constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10:long] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnoteA-3.2.10.2.1-2:long] .)
revisions.change_summary: Added new sentence requiring fire alarm systems in buildings designed per Subsection 3.2.10.

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent6:short] , if there are openings through a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] , other than those for piping, tubing, wiring and totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] raceways, the requirements in this Subsection shall apply to the [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] on both sides of the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] as if they were in the same [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent4:short] , if a [REF:term:bldng:building] contains more than one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] and a fire alarm system is required, a single system shall serve all [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent4:short] , if a fire alarm system is required in any portion of a [REF:term:bldng:building] , it shall be installed throughout the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent5:short] , the requirements in this Subsection are permitted to be applied to each portion of a [REF:term:bldng:building] not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , in which a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h separates the portion from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] as if it were a separate [REF:term:bldng:building] , provided there are no openings through the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , other than those for piping, tubing, wiring and totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] raceways.

The permission in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent4:short] to consider separated portions of a [REF:term:bldng:building] as separate [REF:term:bldng:buildings] does not apply to [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] and storage rooms.

[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] interconnected by [REF:term:wlkw:walkways] permitted in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art20:long] or by vestibules provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art3:long] shall be treated as separate [REF:term:bldng:buildings] for the purpose of fire alarm installation required by this Subsection.
A fire alarm system shall be

clauses.text: a single-stage system in a Group F, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] ,
except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art3.sent1.clause3:short] , a 2-stage system in a Group B [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] ,
a single- or 2-stage system in a Group B, Division 3 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] where the [REF:term:bldng:building] is 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] or less in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , and
a single- or 2-stage system in all other cases.

content.text: A single stage fire alarm system shall, upon the operation of any manual station, waterflow detecting device, or [REF:term:fr-dtctr:fire detector] , cause an [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] to sound on all audible signal devices in the system. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote64:short] .)
A 2-stage fire alarm system shall

clauses.text: cause an [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] to sound upon the operation of any manual station, waterflow detecting device, or [REF:term:fr-dtctr:fire detector] ,
automatically cause an [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] to sound if the [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] is not acknowledged within 5 min of its initiation, and

have manual stations, each of which is equipped so that the use of a key or other similar device causes an [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] to sound that continues to sound upon removal of the key or similar device from the manual station (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote65:short] ).

content.text: A 2-stage fire alarm system is permitted to be zone coded so that, upon the operation of any manual station, waterflow detecting device, or [REF:term:fr-dtctr:fire detector] ,

clauses.text: a coded [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] is sounded indicating the zone of alarm initiation,
the coded [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] is repeated in its entirety not less than 4 times, and

a continuous [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] is sounded upon completion of the coded signals referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art4.sent3.clause2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art4.sent4:short] .

content.text: If a second manual station, waterflow detecting device, or [REF:term:fr-dtctr:fire detector] is operated in a fire alarm system with zone coding as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art4.sent3:short] , in a zone other than that for which the first [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] was sounded, the coded [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] for the first zone shall be completed before the coded [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] for the second zone is repeated not less than 4 times.

articles.title: Installation and Verification of Fire Alarm Systems

content.text: Fire alarm systems, including the voice communication capability where provided, shall be installed in conformance with CAN/ULC-S524, "Standard for Installation of Fire Alarm Systems."
Fire alarm systems shall be verified in conformance with CAN/ULC-S537, "Standard for Verification of Fire Alarm Systems," to ensure they are operating satisfactorily.
A fire alarm system shall be designed so that when an [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] is actuated, it cannot be silenced automatically before a period of time has elapsed that is not less than

clauses.text: 5 min for a [REF:term:bldng:building] not required to be equipped with an annunciator, and
20 min for any other [REF:term:bldng:building] .

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent8:long] and  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent3:short] , a fire alarm system shall not incorporate manual silencing switches other than those installed inside the fire alarm control unit. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote67:short] .)

A single stage fire alarm system installed in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] that has an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 300 shall be designed to notify the fire department, in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:short] , that an [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] has been initiated.

A fire alarm system that includes waterflow-indicating devices shall be designed to notify the fire department in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:short] when an alarm is initiated.

A 2-stage fire alarm system shall be designed to notify the fire department, in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:short] , that an [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] has been initiated.

Notification of the fire department, as required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent1:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent3:short] , shall be provided in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs561] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote68:short] .)

Where a single stage fire alarm system is installed in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent1:short] does not apply, a legible notice that is not easily removed shall be affixed to the wall near each manual station stating

clauses.text: that the fire department is to be notified in the event of a fire emergency, and
the emergency telephone number for the municipality or for the fire department (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote69:short] ).

content.text: Helicopter landing areas on roofs shall be provided with telephone extensions or means to notify the fire department.

Except as permitted by Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent3:short:(3)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent5:short:(5)] , an annunciator shall be installed in close proximity to a [REF:term:bldng:building] entrance that faces a [REF:term:trt:street] or an access route for fire department vehicles that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent1:long] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent6:short] , the annunciator required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent1:short] shall have separate zone indication of the actuation of the alarm initiating devices in each

clauses.text: [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] so that the area of coverage for each zone in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] is not more than 2 000 m^{2} ,
[REF:term:flr-r:floor area] so that the area of coverage for each zone is neither

subclauses.text: more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] , nor
more than the system area limits specified in NFPA 13, "Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems,"

clauses.text: shaft required to be equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] ,
air-handling system required to be equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] ,
fire extinguishing system required by NFPA 96, "Standard for Ventilation Control and Fire Protection of Commercial Cooking Operations,"
[REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] ,
[REF:term:mpdd-gr-:impeded egress zone] , and
[REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:long] .

content.text: An annunciator need not be provided for a fire alarm system if not more than one zone indicator is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent2:short] .

If an annunciator is not installed as part of a fire alarm system in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent1:short] , a visible and audible trouble signal device shall be provided inside the main entrance of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .
The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent1:short] are waived in a [REF:term:bldng:building]

clauses.text: in which an automatic sprinkler system is not installed,
that has an aggregate area for all [REF:term:tr:storeys] of not more than 2 000 m^{2} , and
that is not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] .

content.text: The area limits of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent2.clause1:medium] are waived for an interior undivided open space used as an arena, a rink, or a swimming pool provided that other spaces in the [REF:term:bldng:building ] that are separated from the open space are individually zoned in accordance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent2:short] .

A fire alarm control unit installed in close proximity to a [REF:term:bldng:building] entrance that faces a [REF:term:trt:street] or an access route for fire department vehicles that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent1:long] is deemed to satisfy the requirement for an annunciator, provided all indicators required for an annunciator or trouble signal device are included on the control unit.
Electrical supervision shall be provided for a fire alarm system.

If a fire alarm system in a [REF:term:bldng:building] is required to have an annunciator by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent1:long] , except for hose valves, all valves controlling water supplies in a standpipe system shall be equipped with an electrically supervised switch for transmitting a trouble signal to the annunciator in the event of movement of the valve handle.
An automatic sprinkler system shall be electrically supervised to indicate a supervisory signal on the [REF:term:bldng:building] fire alarm system annunciator for each of the following:

clauses.text: movement of a valve handle that controls the supply of water to sprinklers,
loss of excess water pressure required to prevent false alarms in a wet pipe system,
loss of air pressure in a dry pipe system,
loss of air pressure in a pressure tank,
a significant change in water level in any water storage container used for firefighting purposes,
loss of power to any automatically starting fire pump (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote71:short] ), and
a temperature approaching the freezing point in any dry pipe valve enclosure or water storage container used for firefighting purposes.

content.text: A fire pump shall be electrically supervised as stipulated in [REF:standard:nfpa20]
Heat-tracing cables installed on standpipe risers and sprinkler lines shall be electrically supervised by the fire alarm system for loss of power.

Indication of a supervisory signal in accordance with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent5:short] shall be transmitted to the fire department in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:long] .
[REF:term:fr-dtctr:Fire detectors] required by this Code shall be connected to the fire alarm system.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art10.sent3:short] , if a fire alarm system is required in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , [REF:term:fr-dtctr:fire detectors] shall be installed in the following spaces:

clauses.text: storage rooms not within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] ,
[REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] not within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] ,
janitors' rooms,
rooms in which hazardous substances are to be used or stored (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote125:short:Note A-3.3.1.2.(1)] ),
elevator hoistways and dumbwaiter shafts, and
laundry rooms in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] , but not those within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] .

content.text: [REF:term:fr-dtctr:Fire detectors] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art10.sent2:short] need not be provided within [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] that are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

[REF:term:fr-dtctr:Fire detectors] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art10.sent2:short] shall be installed in elevator hoistways and dumbwaiter shafts where a sprinkler system is not installed within the hoistway or shaft.
If a fire alarm system is installed, [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] shall be installed in

clauses.text: except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent2:short] , each sleeping room and each corridor serving as part of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from sleeping rooms in portions of a [REF:term:bldng:building] classified as a Group B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] ,
each room in a [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] and corridors serving those rooms,
each corridor in portions of a [REF:term:bldng:building] classified as a Group A, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] ,
each [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] in portions of a [REF:term:bldng:building] classified as a Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] ,
each [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shaft other than those serving only a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] or an open [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] ,
the vicinity of draft stops required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art6:long] , and
elevator machine rooms.

content.text: [REF:term:mk-dtctr:Smoke detectors] need not be installed in sleeping rooms and in corridors serving the sleeping rooms within a [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] where [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] are installed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long]

[REF:term:mk-dtctr:Smoke detectors] required in the sleeping rooms of a [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment] or [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancy] shall, upon actuation, provide an audible and visible signal to staff serving those rooms so that the room or location containing the actuated [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detector] can be easily identified. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote73:short] .)

[REF:term:mk-dtctr:Smoke detectors] required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent1.clause7:medium] shall, upon actuation, recall the elevators served by the elevator machine room in which the [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detector] is installed.

Except as permitted in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent6:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent7:short] , [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] installed in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] required to be equipped with a fire alarm system shall be located near the entrance to [REF:term:wlkw:walkways] described in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art20:long] or vestibules provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art3:long]

[REF:term:mk-dtctr:Smoke detectors] installed at the entrance to the [REF:term:wlkw:walkways] in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14:long] shall be deemed to meet the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent5:short] .

[REF:term:mk-dtctr:Smoke detectors] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent5:short] may be replaced with [REF:term:fr-dtctr:fire detectors] in Group F [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] where the [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] may be subjected to false alarms due to the activities within the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

If a fire alarm system is installed, an air-handling system shall be designed to prevent the circulation of smoke upon a signal from a duct-type [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detector ] if the air-handling system

clauses.text: serves more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] ,
serves more than one [REF:term:t:suite] in a [REF:term:tr:storey] , or
serves more than one [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:long] .

content.text: A central vacuum cleaning system in a [REF:term:bldng:building] equipped with a fire alarm system shall be designed to shut down upon actuation of the fire alarm system.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art14.sent3:short] , in a [REF:term:bldng:building] having elevators that serve [REF:term:tr:storeys] above the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] and that are equipped with an automatic emergency recall feature, [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] shall be installed in the elevator lobbies on the recall level so that when these [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] are actuated, the elevators will automatically return directly to an alternate floor level.
[REF:term:mk-dtctr:Smoke detectors] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art14.sent1:short] shall be designed as part of the [REF:term:bldng:building] fire alarm system.

The alternate floor recall feature required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art14.sent1:short] is not required if the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] containing the recall level is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

An automatic sprinkler system shall be equipped with waterflow detecting devices and, if an annunciator is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8:long] , shall be installed so that each device serves

clauses.text: not more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] , and

except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent2:medium] , an area on each [REF:term:tr:storey] that is not more than the system area limits as specified in [REF:standard:nfpa13]

content.text: Waterflow-detecting devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art15.sent1:short] shall be connected to the fire alarm system so that, upon its actuation, an [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] or an [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] is initiated.
The actuation of each waterflow detecting device required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art15.sent1:short] shall be indicated separately on the fire alarm system annunciator.

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art16.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art16.sent3:short] , where a fire alarm system is installed, a manual station shall be installed in every [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] near

clauses.text: every principal entrance to the [REF:term:bldng:building] , and
every required [REF:term:xt:exit] , and
every other egress facility that has been designed and identified as an [REF:term:xt:exit] and has all the features of a required [REF:term:xt:exit] .

content.text: In a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, a manual station is not required at an exterior egress doorway from a [REF:term:t:suite] that does not lead to an interior shared [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] in a hotel or motel not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , provided each [REF:term:t:suite] is served by an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] facility leading directly to ground level.

In a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, a manual station is not required at an exterior egress doorway from a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] that does not lead to an interior shared [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] containing only [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , provided each [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is served by an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] facility leading directly to ground level.

In a [REF:term:bldng:building] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art16.sent2:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art16.sent3:short] , manual stations shall be installed near doorways leading from shared interior corridors to the exterior.
Where a fire alarm system is installed, a manually operated fire alarm station shall be installed on the roof at each [REF:term:xt:exit] from a helicopter landing area.

In a 2-stage fire alarm system described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art4.sent2:long] , the same audible signal devices are permitted to be used to sound the [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signals] and the [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] .

If audible signal devices with voice reproduction capabilities are intended for paging and similar voice message use, other than during a fire emergency, they shall be installed so that [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signals] and [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] take priority over all other signals.
Audible signal devices forming part of a fire alarm or voice communication system shall not be used for playing music or background noise.
Audible signal devices forming part of a fire alarm system shall be installed in a [REF:term:bldng:building] so that

clauses.text: [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] are clearly audible throughout the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] and throughout any [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] on a roof, and

[REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signals] are clearly audible in continuously staffed locations, and where there are no continuously staffed locations, throughout the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] and throughout any [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] on a roof.

content.text: The sound pattern of an [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] shall conform to the temporal pattern defined in Clause 4.2 of ISO 8201, "Acoustics – Audible emergency evacuation signal." (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote77:short:Note A-3.2.4.18.(2)] .)

The sound patterns of [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signals] shall be significantly different from the temporal patterns of [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote78:short] .)
The fire [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] sound pressure level shall be not more than 110 dBA in any normally occupied area. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote79:short] .)

The sound pressure level in a sleeping room from a fire alarm audible signal device shall be not less than 75 dBA in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] when any intervening doors between the device and the sleeping room are closed. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote80:short] .)

Audible signal devices in sleeping rooms in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] shall emit a low frequency signal. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote81:short] .)

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent5:short] , the sound pressure level from a fire alarm system's audible signal device within a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be not less than 10 dBA above the ambient noise level and not less than 65 dBA when any intervening doors between the device and the rest of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] are closed.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent12:short] , audible signal devices located within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall include a means for them to be manually silenced for a period of not more than 10 min , after which time the devices shall restore themselves to normal operation. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote82:short] .)

Audible signal devices within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] shall be connected to the fire alarm system

clauses.text: in a manner such that a single open circuit at one device will not impair the operation of other audible signal devices on that same circuit that serve the other [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] , or

on separate signal circuits that are not connected to the devices in any other [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] .

content.text: In a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part thereof classified as a [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] ,

clauses.text: separate circuits shall be provided for audible signal devices on each [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , and

audible signal devices within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] shall be wired on separate signal circuits from those not within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] .

content.text: Audible signal devices shall be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] and shall be connected to the fire alarm system.

Audible signal devices within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] that are wired on separate signal circuits in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent9.clause2:medium] need not include a means for manual signal silencing as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent8:short] , provided the fire alarm system includes a provision for an automatic signal silence within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , where

clauses.text: the automatic signal silence cannot occur within the first 60 s of operation or within the zone of initiation,
a subsequent alarm elsewhere in the [REF:term:bldng:building] will reactuate the silenced audible signal devices within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] ,
after a period of not more than 10 min , the silenced audible signal devices will be restored to continuous audible signal if the alarm is not acknowledged, and

the voice communication systems referred to in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art23:long] have a provision to override the automatic signal silence to allow the transmission of voice messages through silenced audible signal device circuits that serve the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] .

content.text: If a 2-stage fire alarm system has been installed with an automatic signal silence as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent12:short] , the system shall be designed so that any silenced audible signal devices serving [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] are reactuated whenever an [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] is required to be transmitted as part of the second stage. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote82:short:Note A-3.2.4.18.(8)] .)
Where a fire alarm system is installed, visible signal devices shall be provided in addition to [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] devices

clauses.text: in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or portions thereof intended for use primarily by persons who are deaf or hard of hearing,
in [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancies] in which music and other sounds associated with performances could exceed 100 dBA ,
in any [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in which the ambient noise level is more than 87 dBA ,
in any [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in which the occupants

subclauses.text: use ear protection devices,
are located in an audiometric booth, or
are located in sound-insulating enclosures,

clauses.text: in [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] serving a Group B, C, D or E [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] ,
in corridors used by the public serving a Group A [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] ,
in not less than 10% of the [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] in a hotel or motel (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote84:short] ), and
in washrooms, except those located within

subclauses.text: [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] ,
[REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] , or
patients' sleeping rooms.

content.text: Visible signal devices are permitted to be installed in lieu of audible signal devices in the compartments referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art6:long]

Visible signal devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent1:short] shall be installed so that the signal from at least one device is visible throughout the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or portion thereof in which they are installed. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote85:short] .)

Visible signal devices shall be installed in the rooms and spaces required by  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long] and  Section [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8:long] and shall

clauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent5:short] where a fire alarm system is provided,
conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent6:short] where a fire alarm system is not provided,
have a luminous intensity of not less than

subclauses.text: 75 candela , if the strobe light is located in a sleeping room or bed space, and
15 candela , if the strobe light is not located in a sleeping room or bed space,

clauses.text: produce between 1 and 3 flashes per second, with the flashes synchronized when more than one strobe light is visible from a single location, and
be installed in each

subclauses.text: sleeping room or bed space,
room closed off from the living area by a door, including bathrooms, and
living area and any hallway serving the living area.

content.text: The visible signal devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent4:short] shall

clauses.text: consist of strobe lights conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs526] that are designed to operate as part of the fire alarm system, and
be located in conformance with the installation requirements for visible signal devices in CAN/ULC-S524, "Standard for Installation of Fire Alarm Systems."

content.text: Where a fire alarm system is not provided, the visible signal devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent4:short] shall

clauses.text: consist of strobe lights conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs526] ,
be connected to, and activated by,

subclauses.text: the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] required by Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:number:3.2.4.20.] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art1:number:9.10.19.1.] , or

the [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] permitted by Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:number:3.2.4.20.] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art21:number:3.2.4.21.] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art8:number:9.10.19.8.] , and

clauses.text: be located not less than 2 100 mm above the floor on a wall or ceiling in a location that will maximize effectiveness.

content.text: Each adaptable [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall be provided with special outlet boxes and cover plates that

clauses.text: are designed, located and wired specifically to allow strobe lights to operate in conformance with

subclauses.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent5:short] where a fire alarm system is provided, or
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent6:short] where a fire alarm system is not provided,

clauses.text: are permanently identified as "FIRE - Strobe Light Connection Only,"
are installed in the locations described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent4.clause5:medium] , and

for the purposes of providing power to the strobe lights that may be connected to the outlet boxes, are assumed that the total special outlets for at least 20 percent of the adaptable [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] in the [REF:term:bldng:building] are in use.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art21:long] , [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] shall be installed in accordance with this Article.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent5:short] and permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent10:short] , [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] conforming to CAN/ULC-S531, "Standard for Smoke Alarms," shall be installed in each [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and, except for [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment] or [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancies] required to have a fire alarm system, in each sleeping room not within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] .
At least one [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] shall be installed on each [REF:term:tr:storey] of a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] .
On any [REF:term:tr:storey] of a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] containing sleeping rooms, a [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] shall be installed

clauses.text: in each sleeping room, and

in a location between the sleeping rooms and the remainder of the [REF:term:tr:storey] , and if the sleeping rooms are served by a hallway, the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] shall be located in the hallway.

content.text: Where a [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] has individual [REF:term:t:suites] for residents, a [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] shall be installed

clauses.text: in each sleeping room, and

in a location between the sleeping rooms and the remainder of the [REF:term:t:suite] , and if the sleeping rooms are served by a corridor within the [REF:term:t:suite] , the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] shall be located in the corridor.

content.text: A [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] shall be installed on or near the ceiling.

In hotels and motels with a fire alarm system, [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] installed in rooms required to have a visible signal device connected to the fire alarm system as specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent1.clause7:long] shall have a visible signal component installed in accordance with CAN/ULC-S524, "Standard for Installation of Fire Alarm Systems."

In hotels and motels without a fire alarm system, [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] installed in sleeping rooms of not less than 10% of the [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall have a visible signal component installed in accordance with CAN/ULC-S524, "Standard for Installation of Fire Alarm Systems." (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote84:short:Note A-3.2.4.19.(1)(g)] .)

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent10:short] , [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] referred in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent2:short] shall

clauses.text: be installed with permanent connections to an electrical circuit (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote86:short] ),
have no disconnect switch between the overcurrent device and the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] , and

except for the visible signal component required in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent8:short] , in case the regular power supply to the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] is interrupted, be provided with a battery as an alternative power source that can continue to provide power to the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] for a period of no less than 7 days in the normal condition, followed by 4 minutes of alarm.

content.text: [REF:term:t:Suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] are permitted to be equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] , provided the [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors]

clauses.text: are capable of independently sounding audible signals with a sound pressure level between 75 dBA and 110 dBA within the individual [REF:term:t:suites] (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote79:short:Note A-3.2.4.18.(4)] ),
except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent11:short] , are installed in conformance with CAN/ULC-S524, "Standard for Installation of Fire Alarm Systems," and
form part of the fire alarm system.

content.text: [REF:term:mk-dtctr:Smoke detectors] permitted to be installed in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent10:short] are permitted to sound localized alarms within individual [REF:term:t:suites] , and need not sound an alarm throughout the rest of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

If more than one [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] is required in a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] shall be interconnected so that the actuation of one [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] will cause all [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] within the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] to sound.
A [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent2:short] shall be installed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs553]

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent15:short] , a manually operated silencing device shall be incorporated within the circuitry of a [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] installed in a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] so that it will silence the signal emitted by the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] for a period of not more than 10 min , after which the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] will reset and again sound the alarm if the level of smoke in the vicinity is sufficient to reactuate the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] .

[REF:term:t:Suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] installed to CAN/ULC-S524, "Standard for Installation of Fire Alarm Systems," as part of the fire alarm system in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent10:short] , need not incorporate the manually operated device required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent14:short] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote87:short:Note A-3.2.4.20.(10)] .)
The sound patterns of [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] shall

clauses.text: meet the temporal patterns of [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote77:short:Note A-3.2.4.18.(2)] ), or
be a combination temporal pattern and voice relay.

content.text: Sleeping rooms and bed spaces provided in [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancies] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not equipped with a 2-stage fire alarm system shall be equipped with visible signal devices conforming to this Article. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art3.sent1.clause3:medium] .)

Except where a fire alarm system is installed or required in a [REF:term:bldng:building] , [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] forming part of a residential fire warning system installed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs540] are permitted to be installed in lieu of all [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long] , provided the system

clauses.text: is capable of sounding audible signals in accordance with  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art5:number] ,
is powered in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4:long] , and
is provided with a silencing device in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art6:long]

articles.title: Voice Communication Systems for High Buildings

content.text: A voice communication system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] shall

clauses.text: consist of a two-way means of communication with the central alarm and control facility and to the mechanical control centre from each [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , and

be capable of broadcasting prerecorded, synthesized, or live messages from the central alarm and control facility that are audible and intelligible in all parts of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , except that this requirement does not apply to elevator cars (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote88:short] ).

content.text: The voice communication system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent1:short] shall include a means to silence the [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] in a single stage fire alarm system while voice instructions are being transmitted, but only after the [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] has initially sounded for not less than 30 s .

The voice communication system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent1:short] shall include a means to silence the [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] and the [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] in a 2-stage fire alarm system while voice instructions are being transmitted, but only after the [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] has initially sounded for not less than

clauses.text: 10 s in hospitals that have supervisory personnel on duty for twenty-four hours each day, or
30 s for all other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] .

content.text: The voice communication system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent1.clause2:medium] shall be designed so that the [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] in a 2-stage fire alarm system can be selectively transmitted to any zone or zones while maintaining an [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] or selectively transmitting voice instructions to any other zone or zones in the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

The 2-way communication system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent1.clause1:medium] shall be installed so that emergency telephones are located in each [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] near [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shafts.

Visible signal devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent1:long] ,  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long] and  Section [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8:long] shall continue to emit a visible signal while voice instructions are being transmitted.
Where the facility is not equipped with staff trained to provide instructions over the loudspeakers, a pre-recorded message shall be provided.

Except for Group B, Division 1 and Group F, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] , where a fire alarm system is required under [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4:long] , a one-way voice communication system shall be installed in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] where a 2-stage fire alarm system is installed and whose [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] exceeds 1 000 .
The one-way voice communication system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art23.sent1:short] shall consist of loudspeakers that are

clauses.text: operated from the central alarm and control facility or, in the absence of such a facility, from a designated area, and
except in elevator cars, designed and located so that transmitted messages are audible and intelligible in all parts of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

content.text: Where the facility is not equipped with staff trained to provide instructions over the loudspeakers, a pre-recorded message shall be provided.

The one-way voice communication system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art23.sent1:short] shall meet the silencing and transmission requirements of Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent2:number:3.2.4.22.(2)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent4:number:(4)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent6:number:(6)] .

Except for [REF:term:tr:storeys] below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] , direct access for firefighting shall be provided from the outdoors to every [REF:term:tr:storey] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout and whose floor level is less than 25 m above [REF:term:grade:grade] , by at least one unobstructed window or access panel for each 15 m of wall in each wall required to face a [REF:term:trt:street] by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long]
An opening for access required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art1.sent1:short] shall

clauses.text: have a sill no higher than 900 mm above the inside floor, and
be not less than 1 100 mm high by not less than

subclauses.text: 550 mm wide for a [REF:term:bldng:building] not designed for the storage or use of [REF:term:dngr-gd:dangerous goods] , or
750 mm wide for a [REF:term:bldng:building] designed for the storage or use of [REF:term:dngr-gd:dangerous goods] .

content.text: Access panels above the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] shall be readily openable from both inside and outside, or the opening shall be glazed with plain glass.

Direct access from at least one [REF:term:trt:street] shall be provided from the outdoors in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] to each [REF:term:bmnt:basement] having a horizontal dimension more than 25 m .
The access required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art2.sent1:short] is permitted to be provided by

clauses.text: doors, windows or other means that provide an opening not less than 1 100 mm high and 550 mm wide, with a sill no higher than 900 mm above the inside floor, or
an interior stairway immediately accessible from the outdoors.

content.text: On a [REF:term:bldng:building] more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] where the slope of the roof is less than 1 in 4, all main roof areas shall be provided with direct access from the [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] immediately below, either by

clauses.text: a stairway, or
a hatch not less than 550 mm by 900 mm with a fixed ladder.

content.text: A [REF:term:bldng:building ] which is more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] or more than 600 m^{2} in [REF:term:bldng-r:building area] shall be provided with access routes for fire department vehicles

clauses.text: to the [REF:term:bldng-r:building] face having a principal entrance, and

to each [REF:term:bldng:building] face having access openings for firefighting as required by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art2:long]

content.text: Access routes required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] shall be located so that the principal entrance and every access opening required by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art2:long] are located not less than 3 m and not more than 15 m from the closest portion of the access route required for fire department use, measured horizontally from the face of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .
Access routes shall be provided to a [REF:term:bldng:building] so that

clauses.text: for a [REF:term:bldng:building] provided with a fire department connection, a fire department pumper vehicle can be located adjacent to the hydrants referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art15:long] ,

for a [REF:term:bldng:building] not provided with a fire department connection, a fire department pumper vehicle can be located so that the length of the access route from a hydrant to the vehicle plus the unobstructed path of travel for the firefighter from the vehicle to the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not more than 90 m , and
the unobstructed path of travel for the firefighter from the vehicle to the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not more than 45 m .

content.text: The unobstructed path of travel for the firefighter required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent2:short] from the vehicle to the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be measured from the vehicle to the fire department connection provided for the [REF:term:bldng:building] , except that if no fire department connection is provided, the path of travel shall be measured to the principal entrance of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

If a portion of a [REF:term:bldng:building] is completely cut off from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] so that there is no access to the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , the access routes required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent2:short] shall be located so that the unobstructed path of travel from the vehicle to one entrance of each portion of the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not more than 45 m .
A portion of a roadway or yard provided as a required access route for fire department use shall

clauses.text: have a clear width not less than 6 m , unless it can be shown that lesser widths are satisfactory,
have a centre-line radius not less than 12 m ,
have an overhead clearance not less than 5 m ,
have a change of gradient not more than 1 in 12.5 over a minimum distance of 15 m ,
be designed to support the expected loads imposed by firefighting equipment and be surfaced with concrete, asphalt or other material designed to permit accessibility under all climatic conditions,
have turnaround facilities for any dead-end portion of the access route more than 90 m long, and
be connected with a public thoroughfare.

content.text: For [REF:term:bldng:buildings] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long] , no portion of the access route described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art10.sent3:long] shall be more than 20 m below the uppermost floor level.
Every [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be provided with an adequate water supply for firefighting. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote91:short] .)

Except for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] constructed of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] in conformance with  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] , [REF:term:bldng:buildings] that are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout with a sprinkler system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] or have a standpipe system conforming to  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art10:long] are deemed to comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art7.sent1:short] .

revisions.text: [REF:term:bldng:Buildings] that are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout with a sprinkler system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] or have a standpipe system conforming to  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art10:long] are deemed to comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art7.sent1:short] .

Except for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] constructed of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] in conformance with  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] , [REF:term:bldng:buildings] that are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout with a sprinkler system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] or have a standpipe system conforming to  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art10:long] are deemed to comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art7.sent1:short] .
revisions.change_summary: Added exemption for buildings constructed of encapsulated mass timber construction conforming to Articles 3.2.2.48, 3.2.2.57 or 3.2.2.93

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8.sent2:short] , a standpipe system shall be installed in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is

clauses.text: more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] ,
more than 14 m high measured between [REF:term:grade:grade] and the ceiling of the top [REF:term:tr:storey] , or

not more than 14 m high measured between [REF:term:grade:grade] and the ceiling of the top [REF:term:tr:storey] but has a [REF:term:bldng-r:building area] exceeding the area shown in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8.table1:long] for the applicable [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] unless the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

content.text: A standpipe system need not be installed in a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] conforming to  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long] , provided the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not more than 15 m high .

Except as provided in Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art9.sent2:short:(2)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art9.sent5:short:(5)] ,  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art10:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art11:long] , and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent2:long] , the design, construction, installation and testing of a standpipe system shall conform to [REF:standard:nfpa14]
A dry standpipe that is not connected to a water supply shall not be considered as fulfilling the requirements of this Article.
If more than one standpipe is provided, the total water supply need not be more than 30 L/s .

The residual water pressure at the design flow rate at the topmost hose connection of a standpipe system that is required to be installed in a [REF:term:bldng:building] is permitted to be less than 690 kPa provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered ] throughout,

the water supply at the base of the sprinkler riser is capable of meeting, without a fire pump, the design flow rate and pressure demand of the sprinkler system, including the inside and outside hose allowance, and

fire protection equipment is available to deliver, by means of the fire department connection, the full demand flow rate at a residual water pressure of 690 kPa at the topmost hose connection of the standpipe system (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote92:short] ).

content.text: A fire department connection shall be provided for every standpipe system.
Hose connections shall be located in [REF:term:xt:exits] , in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa14]
Hose connections are not required within a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] .
Hose connections shall be provided with sufficient clearance to permit the use of a standard fire department hose key.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art10.sent5:short] , 64 mm diam hose connections shall be installed in a standpipe system.

Hose connections for 64 mm diam hose are not required in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not more than 25 m high, measured between [REF:term:grade:grade] and the ceiling level of the top [REF:term:tr:storey] and in which an automatic sprinkler system is not installed.
Hose stations for 38 mm diam hose shall be installed for a standpipe system in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

Hose stations for a 38 mm diam hose shall be installed for a standpipe system within every [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote93:short] .)
Hose stations shall be located in the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] within 5 m of [REF:term:xt:exits] and at other locations to provide coverage of the entire [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] .
A hose station located on one side of a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] shall be considered to serve only the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] on that side of the [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] .
A hose cabinet shall be located so that its door, when fully opened, will not obstruct the required width of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] .
