Where a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part thereof is used as a [REF:term:dstr:distillery] and the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] , small hose ( 38 mm ) stations are permitted to be supplied from interior sprinkler piping.

Where a hose station is provided in grain handling and storage facilities in which [REF:term:cmbtbl-dst:combustible dusts] are produced in quantities or concentrations that create an explosion or fire hazard, fog and fine spray nozzles shall be used instead of nozzles that discharge a solid stream of water to prevent [REF:term:cmbtbl-dst:combustible dusts] from being raised into suspension.

Except as permitted by Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short:(2)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent4:short:(4)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent9:short:(9)] , an automatic sprinkler system shall be designed, constructed, installed and tested in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa13] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote94:short] .)

Instead of the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short] , [REF:standard:nfpa13r] is permitted to be used for the design, construction and installation of an automatic sprinkler system installed

clauses.text: in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] containing no other [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] that

subclauses.text: is not more than 4 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] and conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art47:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art49:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:medium] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art52:number] or  or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art55:number] , or
is not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] and conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect1.art3:long] , or

clauses.text: in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] with not more than 10 occupants that is not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] and conforms to one of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art42:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art46:long]

content.text: Instead of the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short] , [REF:standard:nfpa13d] is permitted to be used for the design, construction and installation of an automatic sprinkler system installed

clauses.text: in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] throughout that contains not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] ,
in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] , provided

subclauses.text: it contains not more than two [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] ,
it has not more than five residents throughout, and
a 30-minute water supply demand can be met, and

clauses.text: in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] throughout that contains more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , provided

subclauses.text: except for a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] , no [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is located above another [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] ,

all [REF:term:t:suites] are separated by a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 1 h that provides continuous protection from the top of the footing to the underside of the roof deck, with any space between the top of the wall and the roof deck tightly filled with mineral wool or [REF:term:cmbtbl:noncombustible] material,
each [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] has its own sprinkler water supply provided in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13d]
a passive purge sprinkler system design is used as described in [REF:standard:nfpa13d] and

where the sprinkler system is taken into consideration for the reduction of [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] , all rooms, including closets, bathrooms and attached garages, that adjoin an [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] are sprinklered, notwithstanding any exemption stated in [REF:standard:nfpa13d]

content.text: If a [REF:term:bldng:building] contains fewer than 9 sprinklers, the water supply for these sprinklers is permitted to be supplied from the domestic water system for the [REF:term:bldng:building] provided the required flow for the sprinklers can be met by the domestic system.
If a water supply serves both an automatic sprinkler system and a system serving other equipment, control valves shall be provided so that either system can be shut off independently.

Notwithstanding the requirements of the standards referenced in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short] regarding the installation of automatic sprinkler systems, sprinklers shall not be omitted in any room or closet in the [REF:term:tr:storey] immediately below a roof assembly. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote96:short] .)

Notwithstanding the requirements of the standards referenced in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short] regarding the installation of automatic sprinkler systems, in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] , balconies and exterior decks shall not be required to be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

revisions.text: Notwithstanding the requirements of the standards referenced in Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short:(1)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short:(2)] regarding the installation of automatic sprinkler systems, in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] conforming to Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:number:3.2.2.48.] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:number:3.2.2.51.] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:number:3.2.2.57.] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:number:3.2.2.60.] , sprinklers shall be provided for balconies and decks exceeding 610 mm in depth measured perpendicular to the exterior wall. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote97:short:Note A-3.2.5.12.(7)] .)

Notwithstanding the requirements of the standards referenced in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short] regarding the installation of automatic sprinkler systems, in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] , balconies and exterior decks shall not be required to be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .
revisions.change_summary: Added reference to Article 3.2.2.93 (changed "or 3.2.2.60" to ", 3.2.2.60 or 3.2.2.93")

content.text: Sprinklers in elevator machine rooms shall have a temperature rating not less than that required for an intermediate temperature classification and shall be protected against physical damage. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote98:short] .)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8:long] , closely spaced sprinklers and associated draft stops need not be installed around floor openings in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa13]

Fast response sprinklers shall be installed in [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] , [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancies] , [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment occupancies] and [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancies] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote3251210:short:Note A-3.2.5.12.(10)] .)

[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible ] sprinkler piping shall be used only for sprinkler systems in [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] and other light-hazard [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote99:short] .)
[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible ] sprinkler piping shall meet the requirements of [REF:standard:ulcc199p]

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent5:short] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] sprinkler piping shall be separated from the area served by the sprinkler system, and from any other [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] , by ceilings, walls, or soffits consisting of, as a minimum,

clauses.text: lath and plaster,
gypsum board not less than 9.5 mm thick,
plywood not less than 13 mm thick, or
a suspended membrane ceiling with

subclauses.text: steel suspension grids, and
lay-in panels or tiles having a mass not less than 1.7 kg/m^{2} .

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent5:short] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] sprinkler piping may be located above a ceiling provided that the distance between the edge of any ceiling opening that is not protected in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent3:short] and the nearest sprinkler is not more than 300 mm .

Where [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] sprinkler piping has been tested in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcc199p] and has been shown to meet the requirements therein without additional protection, conformance to  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent4:short] is not required.

An automatic sprinkler system shall be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] if flooring for access within the [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] is other than catwalks.

The sprinkler system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art14.sent1:short] shall be equipped with waterflow detecting devices, with each device serving not more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] .
The waterflow detecting devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art14.sent2:short] shall be connected to the fire alarm system, to

clauses.text: initiate an [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] in a 2-stage system or an [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] in a single stage system, and
indicate separately on the fire alarm system annunciator the actuation of each device.

content.text: The fire department connection for a standpipe system shall be located so that the distance from the fire department connection to a hydrant is not more than 45 m and is unobstructed.
The fire department connection for an automatic sprinkler system shall be located so that the distance from the fire department connection to a hydrant is not more than 45 m and is unobstructed.
Portable extinguishers shall be provided and installed in accordance with the British Columbia Fire Code.
In a Group B, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] , portable fire extinguishers are permitted to be located in secure areas, or in lockable cabinets provided

clauses.text: identical keys for all cabinets are located at all supervisory or security stations, or
electrical remote release devices are provided and are connected to an emergency power supply.

content.text: Equipment forming part of a fire protection system shall be protected from freezing if

clauses.text: it could be adversely affected by freezing temperatures, and
it is located in an unheated area.

content.text: If a fire pump is installed, it shall be installed in accordance with the requirements of [REF:standard:nfpa20] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote100:short] .)
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art1.sent2:short] , this Subsection applies to a [REF:term:bldng:building]

clauses.text: of Group A, D, E or F [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] classification that is more than

subclauses.text: 36 m high, measured between [REF:term:grade:grade] and the floor level of the top [REF:term:tr:storey] , or

18 m high, measured between [REF:term:grade:grade] and the floor level of the top [REF:term:tr:storey] , and in which the cumulative or total [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] on or above any [REF:term:tr:storey] above [REF:term:grade:grade] , other than the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] , divided by 1.8 times the width in metres of all [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs at that [REF:term:tr:storey] , exceeds 300,

clauses.text: containing a Group B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] in which the floor level of the highest [REF:term:tr:storey] of that [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] is more than 18 m above [REF:term:grade:grade] ,

containing a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] located above the third [REF:term:tr:storey] designed or intended as a Group B, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , or
containing a Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] whose floor level is more than 18 m above [REF:term:grade:grade] .

content.text: Except as required by  Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art1.sent1.clause3:short] , this Subsection applies to a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] constructed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] in which the floor level of the highest [REF:term:tr:storey] is more than 18 m above [REF:term:grade:grade] .

revisions.text: This Subsection applies to a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] constructed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long] in which the floor level of the highest [REF:term:tr:storey] is more than 18 m above [REF:term:grade:grade] .

Except as required by  Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art1.sent1.clause3:short] , this Subsection applies to a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] constructed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] in which the floor level of the highest [REF:term:tr:storey] is more than 18 m above [REF:term:grade:grade] .
revisions.change_summary: Added reference to Article 3.2.2.93 and reference to Clause 3.2.6.1.(1)(c)

content.text: A [REF:term:bldng:building] to which this Subsection applies shall be designed in accordance with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2.sent6:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art3:long] to limit the danger to occupants and firefighters from exposure to smoke in a [REF:term:bldng:building] fire.

A [REF:term:bldng:building] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2.sent1:short] shall be designed so that, during a period of 2 h after the start of a fire, each [REF:term:xt:exit] stair serving [REF:term:tr:storeys] below the lowest [REF:term:xt-lvl:exit level ] will not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from the fire floor, assuming an outdoor temperature equal to the January design temperature on a 2.5% basis determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect1.subsect3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote102:short] .)
Each stairway that serves [REF:term:tr:storeys] above the lowest [REF:term:xt-lvl:exit level] shall have a vent to the outdoors, at or near the bottom of the stair shaft, that

clauses.text: has an openable area of 0.05 m^{2} for every door between the stair shaft and a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , but not less than 1.8 m^{2} ,
opens directly to the outdoors or into a vestibule that has a similar opening to the outdoors, and
has a door or [REF:term:clr:closure] that

subclauses.text: is openable manually, and
can remain in the open position during a fire emergency.

content.text: Measures shall be taken to limit movement of smoke from a fire in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] below the lowest [REF:term:xt-tr:exit storey] into upper [REF:term:tr:storeys] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote104:short] .)

Except for exhaust fans in kitchens, washrooms and bathrooms in [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , and except for fans used for smoke venting as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6:long] , air moving fans in a system that serves more than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] shall be designed and installed so that in the event of a fire these fans can be stopped by means of a manually operated switch at the central alarm and control facility.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art12:long] or where there is a conflict with other smoke control measures in the [REF:term:bldng:building] , air-handling systems used to provide make-up air to [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] serving [REF:term:t:suites] in a Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] shall not shut down automatically upon activation of the fire alarm so as to maintain corridor pressurization.

If a [REF:term:bldng:building] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art1:long] is connected to any other [REF:term:bldng:building] , measures shall be taken to limit movement of contaminated air from one [REF:term:bldng:building] into another during a fire. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote105:short] .)
Manual emergency recall shall be provided for all elevators serving [REF:term:tr:storeys] above the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] .
Key-operated switches for emergency recall required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art4.sent1:short] shall be provided in a conspicuous location at

clauses.text: each elevator lobby on the recall level, and
the central alarm and control facility required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art7:long]

content.text: In-car emergency service switches shall be provided in all elevator cars.
Keys to operate the switches required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art4.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art4.sent3:short] shall be

clauses.text: provided in a suitably identified box conspicuously located on the outside of an elevator hoistway near the central alarm and control facility required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art7:long] , and
kept at the central alarm and control facility.

content.text: At least one elevator shall be provided for use by firefighters in conformance with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent6:short] .

The elevator referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent1:short] shall have a useable platform area not less than 2.2 m^{2} and shall be capable of carrying a load of 900 kg to the top floor that it serves from a landing on the [REF:term:tr:storey] containing the entrance for firefighter access referred to in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long] within 1 min .
Each elevator for use by firefighters shall

clauses.text: be provided with a [REF:term:clr:closure] at each shaft opening so that the interlock mechanism remains mechanically engaged and electrical continuity is maintained in the interlock circuits and associated wiring for a period of not less than 1 h when the assembly is subjected to the standard fire exposure described in [REF:standard:ulcs104]

be protected with a vestibule containing no [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] and separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min , or

be protected with a corridor containing no [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] and separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building ] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent5:short] , an elevator referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent1:short] shall be capable of providing transportation from the [REF:term:tr:storey] containing the entrance for firefighter access referred to in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long] to every floor that is above [REF:term:grade:grade] in the [REF:term:bldng:building] and that is normally served by the elevator system.

If it is necessary to change elevators to reach any floor referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent4:short] , the system shall be designed so that not more than one change of elevator is required when travelling to any floor in the [REF:term:bldng:building] from the [REF:term:tr:storey] containing the entrance for firefighter access referred to in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long]
Electrical conductors for the operation of the elevator referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent1:short] shall

clauses.text: be installed in [REF:term:rvc-pc:service spaces] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6:long] that do not contain other [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] material, or

conform to CAN/ULC-S139, "Standard for Fire Test for Circuit Integrity of Fire-Resistive Power, Instrumentation, Control and Data Cables," including the hose stream application, to provide a circuit integrity rating of not less than 1 h (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote106:short:Note A-3.2.6.5.(6)(b)] ).

content.text: Means of venting each [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to the outdoors shall be provided by windows, wall panels, smoke shafts, or the [REF:term:bldng:building] exhaust system. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote107:short] .)
Fixed glass windows shall not be used for the venting required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6.sent1:short] if the breaking of the windows could endanger pedestrians below.
Openable windows used for the venting required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6.sent1:short] shall be permanently marked so that they are easily identifiable.
Elevator hoistways shall not be designed for the venting required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6.sent1:short] .

A central alarm and control facility shall be provided on the [REF:term:tr:storey] containing the entrance for firefighter access referred to in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long] in a location that

clauses.text: is readily accessible to firefighters entering the [REF:term:bldng:building] , and
takes into account the effect of background noise likely to occur under fire emergency conditions, so that the facility can properly perform its required function under these conditions.

content.text: The central alarm and control facility required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art7.sent1:short] shall include

clauses.text: means to control the voice communication system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art8:long] , so that messages can be sent to

subclauses.text: all loudspeakers simultaneously,
individual [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] , and
[REF:term:xt:exit] stairwells,

clauses.text: means to indicate audibly and visually [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signals ] and [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] and a switch to

subclauses.text: silence the audible portion of these signals, and
indicate visually that the audible portion has been silenced,

clauses.text: means to indicate visually that elevators are on emergency recall,
an annunciator conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8:long] ,
means to transmit [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signals] and [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] to the fire department in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7:long] ,
means to release hold-open devices on doors to vestibules,
means to manually actuate [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] in the [REF:term:bldng:building] selectively to any zone or zones,

means to silence the [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art7.sent2.clause7:short] in conformance with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent3:long] ,
means, as appropriate to the measure for fire safety provided in the [REF:term:bldng:building] , to

subclauses.text: actuate auxiliary equipment identified in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art3:number] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6:number] , or
communicate with a continually staffed auxiliary equipment control centre,

clauses.text: means to communicate with telephones in elevator cars, separate from connections to firefighters' telephones, if elevator cars are required by the Safety Standards Act and pursuant regulations to be equipped with a telephone,
means to indicate visually, individual sprinkler system waterflow signals,
means to indicate audibly and visually, sprinkler and standpipe system supervisory signals and trouble signals,
a switch to silence the audible portion of a supervisory signal or a trouble signal, and
visual indication that the audible portion of a supervisory signal or a trouble signal has been silenced.

content.text: A voice communication system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22:long] shall be provided in a [REF:term:bldng:building] if

clauses.text: the floor of the top [REF:term:tr:storey] is more than 36 m above [REF:term:grade:grade] , or

a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] located above the third [REF:term:tr:storey] is designed or intended for use as a Group B, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] .

content.text: The systems for control of smoke movement and mechanical venting required by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6:long] shall be tested to ensure satisfactory operation. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote110:short] .)

An accessible path of travel required by  Section [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8:long] , an [REF:term:xt:exit] , a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , or a corridor providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] for the public or serving patients' sleeping rooms or classrooms shall be equipped to provide illumination to an average level not less than 50 lx at floor or tread level and at angles and intersections at changes of level where there are stairs or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] .
The minimum level of the illumination required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent1:short] shall be 10 lx .

Rooms and spaces used by the public shall be equipped to provide illumination as described in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent4:short]  to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect34.subsect2.art7:long]
The minimum level of illumination over the entire length of escalators and moving walks shall be not less than 100 lx at the level of the treads and walking surfaces.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent6:short] and except for light switches and internally illuminated controls, the minimum level of illumination at controls required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art6:long] shall be not less than 100 lx .

Where visual information is provided at controls referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent5:short] , the minimum level of illumination at the controls shall be not less than 200 lx , except where the visual information is internally illuminated.

Except for internally illuminated signs, the minimum level of illumination at signs displaying visual information required by Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art10.sent5.clause2:number:3.4.6.10.(5)(b)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause7:number:3.4.6.16.(5)(g)] , Subclause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause12.subclause2:number:3.4.6.16.(5)(l)(ii)] , Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6.clause4:number:3.4.6.16.(6)(d)] , Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art18.sent3:number:3.4.6.18.(3)] , Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art18.sent4.clause1:number:3.4.6.18.(4)(a)] and Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art19:number:3.4.6.19.] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art10:number:3.8.2.10.] shall be not less than 200 lx.
Lighting outlets in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy ] shall be provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect34.subsect2:long]
A recessed lighting fixture shall not be located in an insulated ceiling unless the fixture is designed for this type of installation.
Emergency lighting shall be provided to an average level of illumination not less than 10 lx at floor or tread level in

clauses.text: [REF:term:xt:exits] ,
principal routes providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] in open [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] and in [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] ,
corridors used by the public,
corridors serving sleeping rooms in a [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment occupancy] ,
corridors serving sleeping rooms in a [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] , except corridors serving sleeping rooms within individual [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] ,
corridors serving classrooms,
underground [REF:term:wlkw:walkways] ,
[REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] ,
[REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] or parts thereof where the public may congregate

subclauses.text: in Group A, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] , or
in Group A, Division 2 and 3 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of 60 or more,

clauses.text: [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] or parts thereof where persons are cared for that are within daycare facilities, including daycare facilities for children,
food preparation areas in commercial kitchens,
public washrooms,

locations where doors are equipped with an electromagnetic lock as described in Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause11:number:3.4.6.16.(5)(k)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6.clause7:number:(6)(g)] , and
universal washrooms, universal shower rooms and accessible change spaces required by Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8:number:3.8.2.8.]

content.text: Emergency lighting to provide an average level of illumination of not less than 10 lx at floor or catwalk level shall be included in a [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space ] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] .

The minimum value of the illumination required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent2:short] shall be not less than 1 lx .

In addition to the requirements of  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent1:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent3:short] , the installation of battery-operated emergency lighting in buildings or part thereof where [REF:term:trtm:treatment] is provided shall conform to the appropriate requirements of [REF:standard:csaz32]
An emergency power supply shall be

clauses.text: provided to maintain the emergency lighting required by this Subsection from a power source such as batteries or generators that will continue to supply power in the event that the regular power supply to the [REF:term:bldng:building] is interrupted, and
so designed and installed that upon failure of the regular power it will assume the electrical load automatically for a period of

subclauses.text: 2 h for a [REF:term:bldng:building] within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] ,
1 h for a [REF:term:bldng:building] of Group B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] classification that is not within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] ,
1 h for a [REF:term:bldng:building] constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long] , and
30 min for a [REF:term:bldng:building] of any other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] .

content.text: If self-contained emergency lighting units are used, they shall conform to [REF:standard:csac22.2no.141]

Except as required by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art6:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art7:long] , an emergency electrical power supply system shall be installed in conformance with [REF:standard:csac282] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent1:long] for emergency electrical power supply for voice communication systems.)

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art7:long] , an emergency electrical power supply system for emergency equipment required by this Part for [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment occupancies] shall be installed in conformance with [REF:standard:csaz32] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote112:short] .)

If a liquid or gas fuel-fired engine or turbine for an emergency electric power supply is dependent on a fuel supply from outside the [REF:term:bldng:building] , the fuel supply shall be provided with a suitably-identified separate shut-off valve outside the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

articles.title: Emergency Power for Fire Alarm Systems

content.text: Fire alarm systems, including those incorporating a voice communication system, shall be provided with an emergency power supply conforming to  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent4:short] .
The emergency power supply required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent1:short] shall be supplied from

clauses.text: a generator,
batteries, or
a combination thereof.

content.text: The emergency power supply required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent1:short] shall be capable of providing

clauses.text: supervisory power for not less than 24 h , and
immediately following that period, emergency power under full load for not less than

subclauses.text: 2 h for a [REF:term:bldng:building] within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] ,
1 h for a [REF:term:bldng:building] classified as a Group B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] that is not within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] ,
1 h for a [REF:term:bldng:building] constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long] ,
5 min for a [REF:term:bldng:building] not required to be equipped with an annunciator, and
30 min for any other [REF:term:bldng:building] .

content.text: The emergency power supply required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent1:short] shall be designed so that, in the event of a failure of the normal power source, there is an immediate automatic transfer to emergency power with no loss of information.
An emergency power supply capable of operating under a full load for not less than 2 h shall be provided by an emergency generator for

clauses.text: every elevator serving [REF:term:tr:storeys] above the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is more than 36 m high measured between [REF:term:grade:grade] and the floor level of the top [REF:term:tr:storey] and every elevator for firefighters in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent2:short] ,

except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent4:short] , equipment that supplies water for fire suppression as required by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art7:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8:medium]  and Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:long]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art18.sent1:medium] , if the supply depends solely on electrical power supplied to the [REF:term:bldng:building] ,

fans and other electrical equipment that are installed to maintain the air quality specified in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art6:medium] ,
fans required for venting by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6:long] , and

fans required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent1.clause3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art7:long] in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long]

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent3:short] , the emergency power supply for elevators required by Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent1.clause1:medium:(1)(a)] shall be capable of operating all elevators for firefighters plus one additional elevator simultaneously.

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent2:short] does not apply if the time to recall all elevators under emergency power supply is not more than 5 min , each from its most remote [REF:term:tr:storey] to

clauses.text: the [REF:term:tr:storey] containing the entrance for firefighter access referred to in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long] , or
to a transfer lobby.

content.text: The emergency power supply required by Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent1.clause2:medium:(1)(b)] for the equipment that supplies water for fire suppression need not be provided for sprinkler systems conforming to NFPA 13D, "Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems in One- and Two-Family Dwellings and Manufactured Homes."

The protection of electrical and emergency conductors referred to in Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1.clause1:short:(a)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1.clause3:short:(c)] shall conform to the requirements stated in Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short:(2)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent11:short:(11)] :

clauses.text: electrical conductors located within [REF:term:bldng:buildings] identified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art1:long] serving

subclauses.text: fire alarms,
emergency lighting, or
emergency equipment within the scope of Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2:number:3.2.6.2.] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art8:number:3.2.6.8.] ,

clauses.text: emergency conductors serving fire pumps required to be installed under [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art18:long] , and
electrical conductors serving mechanical systems serving

subclauses.text: areas of refuge identified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art6.sent1.clause2:long] , or

[REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use areas] identified in Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent4.clause1:number:3.3.3.7.(4)(a)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent4.clause2:number:(b)] .

content.text: Except as otherwise required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent3:short] and permitted by this Article, electrical conductors that are used in conjunction with systems identified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1:short] shall

clauses.text: conform to CAN/ULC-S139, "Standard for Fire Test for Circuit Integrity of Fire-Resistive Power, Instrumentation, Control and Data Cables," including the hose stream application, to provide a circuit integrity rating of not less than 1 h (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote115:short:Note A-3.2.7.10.(2)(a) and (3)(a)] ) (see also Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent6.clause2:number:3.2.6.5.(6)(b)] ), or

be located in a [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] that has a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

content.text: Electrical conductors identified in Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1.clause3:medium:(1)(c)] shall

clauses.text: conform to CAN/ULC-S139, "Standard for Fire Test for Circuit Integrity of Fire-Resistive Power, Instrumentation, Control and Data Cables," including the hose stream application, to provide a circuit integrity rating of not less than 2 h (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote115:short:Note A-3.2.7.10.(2)(a) and (3)(a)] ), or

be located in a [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] that has a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h .

content.text: The [REF:term:rvc-pc:service spaces] referred to in Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2.clause2:medium:(2)(b)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent3.clause2:medium:(3)(b)] shall not contain any [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] materials other than the conductors being protected.

Except as stated in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent9:short] , the electrical conductors referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1:short] are those that extend from the source of emergency power to

clauses.text: the equipment served, or
the distribution equipment supplying power to the equipment served, if both are in the same room (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote116:short] ).

content.text: If a fire alarm transponder or annunciator in one [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] is connected to a central processing unit or another transponder or annunciator located in a different [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] , the electrical conductors connecting them shall be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short] .

Fire alarm system branch circuits within a [REF:term:tr:storey] that connect transponders and individual devices need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote117:short] .)

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent9:short] , if a distribution panel supplies power to emergency lighting, the power supply conductors leading up to the distribution panel shall be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short] .

Conductors leading from a distribution panel referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent8:short] to emergency lighting units in the same [REF:term:tr:storey] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short] .

Distribution panels serving emergency lighting units located on other [REF:term:tr:storeys] shall be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] separated from the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of at least 1 h .

Conductors leading from a distribution panel to emergency lighting units located on other [REF:term:tr:storeys] shall be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short] between the distribution panel and the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] where the emergency lighting units are located.

subsections.title: Mezzanines and Openings through Floor Assemblies

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3:long] , the portions of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] that do not terminate at an exterior wall, a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] or a vertical shaft shall

clauses.text: terminate at a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the floor assembly and extending from the floor assembly to the underside of the floor or roof assembly above, or
be protected in conformance with the requirements of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long]

content.text: The penetration of a floor assembly by an [REF:term:xt:exit] or a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] shall conform to the requirements of  Sections [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6:long]

A [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] containing sleeping rooms in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of Group B, Division 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] shall not be constructed as part of an [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] .

A [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] need not terminate at a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] nor be protected in conformance with the requirements of Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:number:3.2.8.3.] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:number:3.2.8.8.] provided the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine]

clauses.text: serves a Group A, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] ,
serves a Group A, Division 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy ] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] not more than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng:building] height, or
serves a Group A, C, D, E or F [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] and

subclauses.text: is 500 m^{2} or less in area, and
conforms to Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent3:number:3.2.1.1.(3)] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent4:number:(4)] .

content.text: Except for floors referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art3.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2:long] , openings through a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] for vehicular ramps in a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] are not required to be protected with [REF:term:clr:closures ] and need not conform to this Subsection.

If a [REF:term:clr:closure ] in an opening in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] would disrupt the nature of a manufacturing process, such as a continuous flow of material from [REF:term:tr:storey] to [REF:term:tr:storey] , the [REF:term:clr:closure] for the opening is permitted to be omitted provided precautions are taken to offset the resulting hazard. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote118:short] .)

An [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] in a Group B, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] need not conform to the requirements of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long] provided the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] does not interconnect more than 2 adjacent [REF:term:tr:storeys] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent6:short] , openings for escalators and inclined moving walks need not conform to the requirements in Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:number:3.2.8.3.] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:number:3.2.8.8.] provided

clauses.text: the opening for each escalator or walk does not exceed 10 m^{2},
the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout,
closely spaced sprinklers and associated draft stops are installed around the openings in conformance with NFPA 13, "Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems," and

the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] contains only Group A, Division 1, 2 or 3, Group D or Group E [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote120:short:Note A-3.2.8.2.(6)(c)] ).

content.text: An [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] need not conform to the requirements of Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:number:3.2.8.3.] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:number:3.2.8.8.] , provided

clauses.text: it consists of the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] and the [REF:term:tr:storey] next above or below it, but not both,

it is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout or, where the [REF:term:bldng-r:building area] is not more than one half of the area permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] , the openings through the floor are used only for stairways, escalators or moving walks (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote119:short] ), and
it contains only Group A, Division 1, 2 or 3, Group D, Group E, or Group F, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote120:short] ).

content.text: A [REF:term:bldng:building] containing an [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] shall be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

Except for large floor openings as defined in NFPA 13, "Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems," closely spaced sprinklers and associated draft stops shall be installed around floor openings in conformance with NFPA 13.
An [REF:term:xt:exit ] opening into an [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space ] shall be protected at each opening into the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] by a vestibule

clauses.text: with doorways that are not less than 1.8 m apart,

that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] that is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote27:short:Note A-3.1.8.1.(1)(b)] ), and

that is designed to limit the passage of smoke so that the [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shaft does not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from the fire floor, assuming an outdoor temperature equal to the January design temperature on a 2.5% basis determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect1.subsect3:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote121:short] ).

content.text: An [REF:term:xt:exit ] opening into an [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space ] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent6:long] .

If an elevator hoistway opens into an [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] and into [REF:term:tr:storeys] above the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] , either the elevator doors opening into the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] or the elevator doors opening into the [REF:term:tr:storeys] above the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] shall be protected by vestibules conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent1:short] .
A [REF:term:prt-flr-spc:protected floor space] used to satisfy the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent6.clause2:long] shall

clauses.text: be separated from the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the floor assembly of the [REF:term:tr:storey] in which it is located,

have all openings in the vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between a [REF:term:prt-flr-spc:protected floor space] and the adjacent [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] protected by vestibules conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent1:long] , and
be designed so that it is not necessary to enter the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] to reach an [REF:term:xt:exit] .

content.text: A draft stop shall be provided at each floor level within an [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] , immediately adjacent to and surrounding the opening, and shall be not less than 500 mm deep measured from ceiling level down to the underside of the draft stop.

A mechanical exhaust system shall be provided to remove air from an [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] at a rate of 4 air changes per hour. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote122:short] .)

The mechanical exhaust system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art7.sent1:short] shall be actuated by a switch located on the [REF:term:tr:storey] containing the entrance for firefighter access referred to in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long] near the annunciator for the fire alarm system.

An [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] shall be designed so that the [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] contents, excluding interior finishes, in those parts of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in which the ceiling is more than 8 m above the floor, are limited to not more than 16 g of [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] material for each cubic metre of volume of the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] .

subsections.title: Integrated Fire Protection and Life Safety Systems

content.text: Where fire protection and life safety systems and systems with fire protection and life safety functions are integrated with each other, they shall be tested as a whole in accordance with [REF:standard:ulcs1001] to verify that they have been properly integrated. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote123:short] .)

subsections.title: Requirements for Residential Buildings with a Single Exit

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art1.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art1.sent4:short] , this Subsection applies to [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of only [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] that

clauses.text: are not more than six [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] ,

have a height not more than 18 m measured between the floor of the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] and the uppermost floor level, excluding any floor level within a rooftop [REF:term:ncls:enclosure] that is not considered as a [REF:term:tr:storey] in calculating [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent1:long] ,
contain not more than four [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] on each floor,
does not exceed an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of 24 persons per floor, and
have a [REF:term:trvl-dst:travel distance] from

subclauses.text: any part of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to an [REF:term:xt:exit] not more than 25 m , and
each [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] to an [REF:term:xt:exit] of not more than 6 m .

content.text: This Subsection does not apply to [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1:long] to be served by one [REF:term:xt:exit] .
This Subsection does not apply to detached houses, semi-detached houses, houses with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] , duplexes, triplexes, townhouses or row houses.
[REF:term:rdntl-cc:Residential]  [REF:term:bldng:buildings] with a single [REF:term:xt:exit] are not permitted for

clauses.text: hotels, motels, dormitories or lodging houses,
[REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] clubs, colleges or schools,
monasteries,
seniors' residences, or
care facilities accepted for residential use pursuant to provincial legislation.

content.text: This Subsection, in accordance with the application of this Article and in conformance with the provisions of this Subsection and all other applicable provisions of this Code, may be used as an alternate to the requirements for a second [REF:term:xt:exit] in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2:long] .

Notwithstanding the permissions in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent4:short] , a [REF:term:bldng:building] to which this Subsection applies shall be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout with an automatic sprinkler system designed, constructed, installed and tested in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa13] , "Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems." (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnoteA-3.2.10.2.1-2:long] .) (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent7:long] .)

All balconies and decks shall be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art2.sent1:short] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnoteA-3.2.10.2.1-2:long] .)

The [REF:term:xt:exit] facility shall be constructed either of [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] construction or, notwithstanding the application of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art7:long] , with finishes that do not exceed the maximum [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] and maximum smoke developed classification for [REF:term:xt:exit] stairways in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art7.table1:long] , and shall

clauses.text: be separated from all other spaces in the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h ,
be not less than 1 500 mm wide,
discharge directly to the exterior of the [REF:term:bldng:building] without passing through a lobby,
be designed to limit the probability of storage or the accumulation of material, and
have signs posted in conspicuous locations near each landing to indicate that storage is not permitted.

content.text: The discharge from the [REF:term:xt:exit] stair described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art2.sent3.clause3:long] shall be located not less than 3 m and not more than 15 m from the closest portion of the access route required for fire department use, measured horizontally from the face of the [REF:term:bldng:building] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnoteA-3.2.10.2.4:long] .)

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art3.sent3:short] and notwithstanding the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] , a [REF:term:bldng:building] to which this Subsection applies that is greater than four [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] shall be designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2:long] .

Fans required to limit smoke movement by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art3.sent1:short] shall be provided with an emergency power supply capable of operating under full load for not less than 2 h provided by an emergency generator. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9:long] .)

Pressurization of the stair shaft described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art3.sent1:short] is not required if each doorway from the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] serving the [REF:term:xt:exit] facility is protected with a vestibule on the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] side of the doorway

clauses.text: consisting of a [REF:term:clr:closure] in the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor]

subclauses.text: equipped with electromagnetic hold-open devices that release upon activation of the fire alarm system, and
that has a [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] not less than a 45 min , and

clauses.text: that forms a space that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min

subclauses.text: that contains no [REF:term:t:suite] entry doors, and
with the distance from doorway to the [REF:term:xt:exit] facility and the [REF:term:clr:closure] not less than 1 800 mm long and a width of the path between doorways not less than 1 500 mm .

content.text: Elevator hoistways shall not be designed as a means of venting.

The systems for control of smoke movement required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art3.sent1:short] shall be tested to ensure satisfactory operation. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art9.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnoteA-3.2.6.9.1:long] .)

articles.title: Doors in Public Corridors and Suite Entry Doors

content.text: All doors along [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] and all [REF:term:t:suite] entry doors shall be equipped with electromagnetic hold-open devices designed to release upon activation of the fire alarm system in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14:long] .

Hold-open devices on [REF:term:t:suite] entry doors shall not require a force applied to the door or release device of more than 22 N to allow the occupant to manually release the door from the hold-open position to allow it to close.
[REF:term:t:Suite] entry doors shall have a [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] of not less than 45 min .

content.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art1.sent3:short] , a [REF:term:t:suite] shall be separated from adjoining [REF:term:t:suites] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h . (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3:long] for [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm:treatment] or [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancies] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2:long] for [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] , and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7:long] for [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] .)

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art1.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h but not less than 45 min provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: [REF:term:ccpnc:Occupancies] that are served by [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4.sent4.clause2:long] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, are not required to be separated from one another by [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations ] provided the [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] are

clauses.text: [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] ,
fast food vending operations that do not provide seating for customers,
[REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancy] , or
any combination of these occupancies.

content.text: No [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is required between [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] .

Except as provided in  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6:long] , the storage, handling and use of hazardous substances shall be in conformance with

clauses.text: provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws, or
in the absence of the regulations or bylaws referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art2.sent1.clause1:short] , the British Columbia Fire Code.

content.text: Systems for the ventilation of cooking equipment that is not within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and is used in processes producing grease-laden vapours shall be designed and installed in conformance with  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art5:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect9.subsect1.art3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote126:short] .)
A fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliance] shall not be installed in a corridor serving as an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] .

[REF:term:cc-t-xt:Access to exit] within [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] shall conform to  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5:long] , in addition to the requirements of this Subsection.

If a podium, terrace, platform or contained open space is provided, egress requirements shall conform to the appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art5.sent1:long] for rooms and [REF:term:t:suites] .

[REF:term:mn-f-gr:Means of egress] shall be provided from every podium, terrace, platform or contained open space used or intended for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , to [REF:term:xt:exits] in conformance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4:long] .

[REF:term:mn-f-gr:Means of egress] from an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] on a roof serving only a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall be provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4:long] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent4:short] and except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent6:short] , a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] at the roof level, designed in conformance with the requirements for [REF:term:xt:exits] in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4:long] , shall be provided from an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] on a roof.

At least two separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] at the roof level, designed in conformance with the requirements for [REF:term:xt:exits] in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4:long] , shall be provided from a roof used or intended for an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 60.

For the purposes of  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent6:short] , the occupied area of the [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] on a roof shall be used in place of [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] .

A rooftop enclosure that does not serve as part of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] for an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] on a roof in accordance with  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent5:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent6:short] shall be provided with an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] that leads to an [REF:term:xt:exit]

clauses.text: at the roof level, or
on the [REF:term:tr:storey] immediately below the roof.

content.text: A rooftop enclosure which is more than 200 m m² in area shall be provided with at least 2 [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] .
Two points of egress shall be provided for a [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] if

clauses.text: the area is more than 200 m m² , or
the travel distance measured from any point in the [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] to a point of egress is more than 25 m .

content.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent6:medium] , each [REF:term:t:suite] in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that contains more than one [REF:term:t:suite] shall have

clauses.text: an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] doorway, or
a doorway

subclauses.text: into a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , or
to an exterior passageway.

content.text: Except for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] designed and constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10:long] and except as permitted by this Section and by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent2:medium] , at the point where a doorway referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent11:short] opens onto a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or exterior passageway, it shall be possible to go in opposite directions to each of 2 separate [REF:term:xt:exits] .

revisions.text: Except as permitted by this Section and by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent2:long] , at the point where a doorway referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent11:short] opens onto a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or exterior passageway, it shall be possible to go in opposite directions to each of 2 separate [REF:term:xt:exits] .

Except for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] designed and constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10:long] and except as permitted by this Section and by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent2:medium] , at the point where a doorway referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent11:short] opens onto a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or exterior passageway, it shall be possible to go in opposite directions to each of 2 separate [REF:term:xt:exits] .
revisions.change_summary: Replaced Sentence 3.3.1.3.(12) to add exception for buildings designed per Subsection 3.2.10.

content.text: Except as otherwise required by this Part or as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4.sent4:short] , a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:tr:storey] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4.sent3:short] and  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4.sent4.clause1:medium] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4.sent4.clause2:short] , the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and the remainder of the [REF:term:tr:storey] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min .

If a [REF:term:tr:storey] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, no [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] is required for a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and the remainder of the [REF:term:tr:storey] , provided the corridor does not serve a [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment] or [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancy] or a [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote27:short:Note A-3.1.8.1.(1)(b)] .)
No [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is required in a [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered]  [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] between a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and

clauses.text: except as required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent8:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent1:long] , and notwithstanding [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent2:long] , the remainder of a [REF:term:tr:storey] , provided the travel distance from any part of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to an [REF:term:xt:exit] is not more than 45 m ,

a room or a [REF:term:t:suite] , provided the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art9.sent4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause4:long] , or

a space containing plumbing fixtures required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2:long] , provided the space and the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] are separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:tr:storey] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required between the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and the remainder of the [REF:term:tr:storey] .

content.text: Except for [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , a minimum of 2 egress doorways located so that one doorway could provide egress from the room or [REF:term:t:suite] as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3:long] if the other doorway becomes inaccessible to the occupants due to a fire which originates in the room or [REF:term:t:suite] , shall be provided for every room and every [REF:term:t:suite]

clauses.text: that is used for a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy ] and whose area is more than 15 m^{2} ,
intended for an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 60,
in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, and

subclauses.text: the area of a room or [REF:term:t:suite] is more than the value in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art5.table1:long:Table 3.3.1.5.-A] , or
the travel distance within the room or [REF:term:t:suite] to the nearest egress doorway is more than the value in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art5.table1:long:Table 3.3.1.5.-A] , or

clauses.text: in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout and does not contain a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] and

subclauses.text: the travel distance to an egress doorway is more than 25 m , or
the area of the room or [REF:term:t:suite] is more than the value in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art5.table2:long:Table 3.3.1.5.-B] .

content.text: Where 2 egress doorways are required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art5.sent1:short] , they shall be placed at a distance from one another equal to or greater than one third of the maximum overall diagonal dimension of the area to be served, measured as the shortest distance that smoke would have to travel between the nearest required egress doors.

content.text: If more than one egress doorway is required from a room or [REF:term:t:suite] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art5:long] , the travel distance within the room or [REF:term:t:suite] to the nearest egress doorway shall not exceed the maximum travel distances specified in Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause1:number:3.4.2.5.(1)(a)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause2:short:(b)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause3:short:(c)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause6:short:(f)] for [REF:term:xt:exits] .

articles.title: Protection on Floor Areas with an Accessible Path of Travel

content.text: Every [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout and that has an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall

clauses.text: be served by an elevator

subclauses.text: conforming to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent4:number:3.2.6.5.(4)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent6:number:(6)] ,

protected against fire in conformance with Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent3.clause2:number:3.2.6.5.(3)(b)] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent3.clause3:short:(c)] , and

in a [REF:term:bldng:building] over 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys ] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , protected against smoke movement so that the hoistway will not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from a fire floor during a period of 2 h after the start of a fire, assuming an outdoor temperature equal to the January design temperature on a 2.5% basis determined in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect1.subsect3:long] ,

clauses.text: be divided into at least 2 zones by [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations ] conforming to  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent2:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art5.sent6:long] so that (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote128:short] )

subclauses.text: persons with disabilities can be accommodated in each zone, and

the travel distance from any point in one zone to a doorway leading to another zone shall be not more than the value for travel distance permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1:long] for the [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] classification of the zone,

clauses.text: in the case of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] , be provided with balconies conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent4:short] , except on a [REF:term:tr:storey] containing an accessible entrance that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art2:long] ,
have an accessible exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] at ground level, or
have a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] leading to ground level.

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent3:short] , the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:medium] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:medium] is permitted to be less than 1 h but not less than 45 min provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: A balcony required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause3:medium] shall

clauses.text: have direct access from the [REF:term:t:suite] or [REF:term:flr-r:floor area]
be not less than 1 500 mm deep from the outside face of the exterior wall to the inside edge of the balcony with a clear perpendicular dimension of not less than 1 700 mm , and
provide not less than 2 m m² of balcony space for each accessible sleeping room or bed space.

content.text: The [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] on either side of a horizontal [REF:term:xt:exit] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art10:long] is permitted to be considered as a zone in applying the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:medium] .

Except within the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] of a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] , the minimum headroom clearance in every [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4:long] for [REF:term:xt:exits] .
