(See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent5:long] .)

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art8.sent3:short] and except for paths of travel in [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] and [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , protruding [REF:term:bldng:building] elements located within 1 980 mm of the floor shall not project more than 100 mm horizontally into paths of travel in a manner that would create a hazard. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote129:short] .)

The horizontal projection of a protruding [REF:term:bldng:building] element referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art8.sent2:short] is permitted to be more than 100 mm , provided the clearance between the protruding element and the floor is less than 680 mm . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote129:short] .)
The minimum width of a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] shall be 1 100 mm .

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent3:long] , the minimum unobstructed width of a corridor used by the public or a corridor serving classrooms or patients' sleeping rooms shall be 1 100 mm .
If a corridor contains an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , the [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall not reduce the unobstructed width of the corridor to less than its required width.
If a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause4:long] contains an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] ,

clauses.text: the [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall be located so that for pedestrian travel there is an unobstructed width not less than 3 m at all times adjacent and parallel to all rooms and [REF:term:t:suites ] that front onto the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , and
the combined area of all [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] in the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] shall be not more than 15% of the area of the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] .

content.text: Except for a dead-end corridor that is entirely within a [REF:term:t:suite] or as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent6:long] , a dead-end corridor is permitted provided it is not more than 6 m long.
Except as otherwise stated in this Section, aisles shall be provided in conformance with the British Columbia Fire Code.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12:long] , a door that opens into a corridor or other facility providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit ] from a [REF:term:t:suite] or room not located within a [REF:term:t:suite] shall swing on a vertical axis.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12:long] , a door that opens into a corridor or other facility providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit ] from a room or [REF:term:t:suite] that is used or intended for an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 60 or for a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] shall swing in the direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt:exit] .
Every door that divides a corridor that is not wholly contained within a [REF:term:t:suite] shall swing on a vertical axis in the direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt:exit] .

If a pair of doors is installed in a corridor that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] in both directions, the doors shall swing in opposite directions, with the door on the right hand side swinging in the direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt:exit] .

Doors that serve storage [REF:term:t:suites] not more than 28 m^{2} in area in warehousing [REF:term:bldng:buildings] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent1:short] .

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent5:medium] , a sliding door provided in the locations described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11:long] shall

clauses.text: be designed and installed to swing on the vertical axis in the direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt:exit] when pressure is applied, and
be identified as a swinging door by means of a label or decal affixed to it.

content.text: In a Group B, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , or in an [REF:term:mpdd-gr-:impeded egress zone] in other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] , sliding doors used in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11:long]

Movable [REF:term:prttn:partitions] used to separate a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] from an adjacent [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] or a [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancy] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12.sent1:short] and Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent1:number:3.3.1.11.(1)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent2:number:(2)] , provided the [REF:term:prttn:partitions] are not located in the only [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote130:short] .)

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art4:long] , a door that opens into or is located within a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or other facility that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from a [REF:term:t:suite] shall

clauses.text: provide a clear opening of not less than 850 mm if there is only one door leaf,
in a doorway with multiple leaves, have the active leaf providing a clear opening of not less than 850 mm ,
not open onto a step, and
have a threshold not more than 13 mm higher than the surrounding finished floor surface, and where it is higher than 6 mm , shall be beveled to a slope not steeper than 1 in 2, except where it

subclauses.text: is used to confine the spillage of [REF:term:flmmbl-l:flammable liquids] within a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] or within a room in an [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancy] , or
provides access to an exterior balcony, unless the balcony is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause3:long] .

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent7:short] , a door in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] shall be readily openable in travelling to an [REF:term:xt:exit] without requiring keys, special devices or specialized knowledge of the door-opening mechanism.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent4:short] , door release hardware shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and the door shall be openable with not more than one releasing operation. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent4:long] .)

An egress door from an individual [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or from a [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] is permitted to be provided with additional devices that require a releasing operation additional to the main door release hardware, provided the devices are readily operable from the inside without the use of keys, special devices or specialized knowledge. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote131:short] .)
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent9:long] , door release hardware shall be installed between 900 mm and 1 100 mm above the finished floor.

An egress door in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] serving a [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] or an [REF:term:mpdd-gr-:impeded egress zone] is permitted to be equipped with locking devices, provided they can be released either locally or remotely in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent8:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent9:short] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote132:short] .)

A door in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] is permitted to be equipped with an electromagnetic lock conforming to Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5:number:3.4.6.16.(5)] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6:number:(6)] .
Local locking devices permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:short] shall be operable by a key from both sides of the door.

Controls for the remote release of door locking devices permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:short] shall be located in an area readily available to security personnel.
Locking devices permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:short] that are electrically operated shall be

clauses.text: designed to operate on emergency power, and
capable of manual release by security personnel.

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art14.sent2:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art7:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2:long] , [REF:term:rmp:ramps] and stairways that do not serve as [REF:term:xt:exits] shall conform to the requirements for [REF:term:xt:exit]  [REF:term:rmp:ramps] and stairways stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent8:long] and  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4:long] ,  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art1:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art9:long]

[REF:term:rmp:Ramps] and stairways that serve [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] , [REF:term:rvc-pc:service spaces] or [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art14.sent1:short] , provided

clauses.text: they are intended only for occasional use for servicing equipment and machinery, and
they do not serve as [REF:term:xt:exits] .

content.text: An exterior passageway leading to a required [REF:term:xt:exit] shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4:long] for exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] passageways.

articles.title: Tapered Treads in a Curved Flight

content.text: [REF:term:flght:Flights] of stairs shall consist solely of

clauses.text: straight [REF:term:flght:flights] , or
curved [REF:term:flght:flights] complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art16.sent2:short] .

content.text: [REF:term:tpr-thr:Tapered treads] in a curved [REF:term:flght:flight] that is not required as an [REF:term:xt:exit] shall have

clauses.text: a minimum [REF:term:run:run] of 150 mm ,
a [REF:term:run:run] not less than 280 mm when measured at a point 300 mm from the centre line of the handrail at the narrow end of the tread, and
a riser conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8.sent2:long] .

content.text: [REF:term:tpr-thr:Tapered treads] shall have a consistent angle and uniform [REF:term:run:run] and rise dimensions in accordance with the construction tolerances stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8:long] when measured at a point 300 mm from the centre line of the handrail at the narrow end of the tread.
All [REF:term:tpr-thr:tapered treads] within a [REF:term:flght:flight] shall turn in the same direction.
The capacity of an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] shall be based on the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of the portion of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] served.
In an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] the required width of [REF:term:rmp:ramps] with a slope not more than 1 in 8, doorways, and corridors shall be based on not less than 6.1 mm per person.
In an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] the required width of a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] with a slope more than 1 in 8 shall be based on not less than 9.2 mm per person.

In an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] used or intended to be used for patients in a Group B, Division 2 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] or residents in a Group B, Division 3 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , the required width of corridors, doorways, and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall be based on not less than 18.4 mm per person.

The capacity of stairs in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] shall conform to the requirements for stairs in Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent1:number:3.4.3.2.(1)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent3:number:(3)] .

In a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:long] , an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] that is part of the principal entrance serving a dance hall or a licensed beverage establishment with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 250 shall provide at least one half of the required [REF:term:xt:exit] width.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9:long] , a [REF:term:guard:guard] not less than 1 070 mm high shall be provided

clauses.text: around any roof to which access is provided for purposes other than maintenance,
at openings into smoke shafts referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] that are less than 1 070 mm above the floor, and

at each raised floor, [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] , balcony, gallery, interior or exterior vehicular ramp, and at other locations where (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote41:short:Note A-9.8.8.1.] )

subclauses.text: the difference in elevation is more than 600 mm between the walking surface and the adjacent surface, or
the adjacent surface within 1.2 m of the walking surface has a slope of more than 1 in 2.

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent4:long] and  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art7:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art10:number] , openings through [REF:term:guard:guards] shall be of a size that prevents the passage of a spherical object whose diameter is more than 100 mm .

Openings through [REF:term:guard:guards] other than those required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18.sent1:short] that serve [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] other than [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] shall be of a size that

clauses.text: prevents the passage of a spherical object whose diameter is 100 mm , or
permits the passage of a spherical object whose diameter is 200 mm .

content.text: Except for [REF:term:guard:guards] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art10:long] , [REF:term:guard:guards] that protect a level located more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] or 4.2 m above the adjacent level shall be designed so that no member, attachment or opening located between 140 mm and 900 mm above the level protected by the [REF:term:guard:guard] facilitates climbing. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote47:short:Note A-9.8.8.6.(1)] .)
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18.sent1:short:Sentence (1)] does not apply

clauses.text: to the front edges of [REF:term:tg:stages] ,
to floor pits in [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garages] ,
to loading docks, or
where access is provided for maintenance purposes only.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art19.sent2:short] , tactile attention indicators complying with [REF:external:csab651:Clauses 4.3.5.3.1, 4.3.5.3.3 and 4.3.5.3.4 of ] [REF:standard:csab651] shall be installed

clauses.text: at the top of [REF:term:flght:flights] of stairs that are unenclosed, and
at drop-off edges with a change in elevation greater than 300 mm that are unprotected by a [REF:term:guard:guard] .

content.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art19.sent1:short] does not apply to [REF:term:rvc-pc:service spaces] , bleachers addressed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2:long] , [REF:term:tg:stages] , loading docks, [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] , within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , and to stairs and drop-off edges serving not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent5:short] , a glass or transparent door shall be designed and constructed so that the existence and position of the door is readily apparent, by attaching visually contrasting hardware, bars or other permanent fixtures to it.
The visibility of fully glazed transparent doors, sidelights and panels shall be enhanced through the inclusion of mullions, markings or other elements that

clauses.text: are visually contrasting,
are at least 50 mm high,
extend the full width of the door, sidelight or panel, and
are located between 1 350 mm and 1 500 mm above the floor.

content.text: A glass door shall be constructed of

clauses.text: laminated or tempered safety glazing conforming to [REF:standard:cgsb-12.1] or
wired glass conforming to CAN/CGSB-12.11-M, "Wired Safety Glass."

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent5:short] , transparent panels used in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] that, because of their physical configuration or design, could be mistaken as a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] shall be made inaccessible by barriers or railings.

Sliding glass [REF:term:prttn:partitions] that separate a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] from an adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] and that are open during normal working hours need not conform to  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent4:short] , provided the [REF:term:prttn:partitions] are suitably marked in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent2:short] to indicate their existence and position.
Where vision glass is provided in doors or transparent sidelights, the lowest edge of the glass shall be no higher than 900 mm above floor level.

Glass in doors and in sidelights that could be mistaken for doors, within or at the entrances to [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and in public areas, shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect6.subsect1.art4:long]

A window in a public area that extends to less than 1 000 mm above the floor and is located above the second [REF:term:tr:storey] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] , shall be protected by a barrier or railing to not less than 1 070 mm above the floor, or the window shall be non-openable and designed to withstand the lateral design loads for balcony [REF:term:guard:guards] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art14:long]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art21.sent2:short] , an exhaust ventilation system designed in conformance with the appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6:long] shall be provided in a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] in which dust, fumes, gases, vapour or other impurities or contaminants have the potential to create a fire or explosion hazard. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect4.art13:long] )

Where a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] is penetrated by a ventilation system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art21.sent1:short] for power-ventilated enclosures in laboratories, the ducts shall be

clauses.text: continuously enclosed from the first penetrated [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] to any subsequent [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] or concealed spaces and all the way through to the outdoors so that the highest [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of all the penetrated [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] is maintained, and

exempted from the requirement to be equipped with a [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] , smoke damper and combination smoke/ [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7:long]

content.text: Explosion relief devices, vents or other protective measures conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect9.subsect1.art2:long] shall be provided for a space in which substances or conditions that have the potential to create an explosion hazard are present as a result of the principal use of a [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art22.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art22.sent3:short] , a room or space within a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] for the storage of janitorial supplies shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] not less than 1 h .

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation ] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art22.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h but not less than 45 min provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art22.sent1:short] is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] if the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in which the room or space is located is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art23.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art23.sent3:short] , in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] , a laundry room in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is not within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] not less than 1 h .

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art23.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h but not less than 45 min provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art23.sent1:short] is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] if the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in which the laundry room is located is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

No obstruction shall be permitted in any [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] that would restrict the width of a normal [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress ] from any part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to less than 750 mm unless an alternative [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress ] is provided adjacent to, accessible from, and plainly visible from the obstructed [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote134:short] .)

Illuminated signs conforming to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent2:number:3.4.5.1.(2)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent6:number:(6)] shall be provided to indicate the direction to egress points in a [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] .
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art26.sent2:short] , welding and cutting operations shall be carried out in a room

clauses.text: separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h , or
protected by an automatic fire extinguishing system.

content.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art26.sent1:short] shall not apply to [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] where the welding and cutting operations do not present a fire or explosion hazard to adjacent areas.
This Subsection applies to [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancies] and to outdoor places of assembly.

Except as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art1.sent3:short] , provisions 12.2.3.2, 12.2.3.3, 12.2.5.4, 12.2.5.5, 12.2.5.6, 12.2.11.1, 12.4.1 and 12.4.2 of Chapter 12 of [REF:standard:nfpa101] are permitted to be used in lieu of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art11:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art12:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote135:short] .)

The minimum clear width of aisle accessways between rows of seats shall be calculated according to provisions 12.2.5.5.2, 12.2.5.5.4.1 and 12.2.5.5.5.1 of Chapter 12 of [REF:standard:nfpa101] except that in no case shall the width be less than 400 mm .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art2.sent2:short] , the seating area of a Group A, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall be separated from adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] in the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h if the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] in the seating area exceeds 200.

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation ] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art2.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h but not less than 45 min provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: If usable space exists under tiers of seats in arena-type [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min shall be provided between the space and the seats or the space shall be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .
Non-fixed seating shall conform to the British Columbia Fire Code.

Except for the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art8:long] for bench-type seats and except as required or permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent2:short] and  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art11:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art12:long] , fixed seats in places of assembly shall be

clauses.text: attached or secured to the floor, platform or platform riser,
provided with arms and back, and

arranged in rows having an unobstructed passage not less than 400 mm wide measured horizontally between plumb lines from the backs of the seats in one row and the edges of the furthest forward projection of the seats in the next row in the unoccupied position.

content.text: For fixed seats with backs and with folding tablet arms, the value of 400 mm required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent1.clause3:medium] shall be measured when the tablet arms are in the use position, but is permitted to be measured in the stored position provided

clauses.text: there are not more than 7 seats between any seat and the nearest aisle,
the seats are located in a lecture hall or an auditorium used for instructional purposes, and
the tablet arm, when raised manually to a vertical position, falls by the force of gravity to the stored position.

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent4:short] , aisles shall be located so that there are not more than 7 seats with backs or 20 seats without backs between any seat and the nearest aisle.
The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent3:short] do not apply if

clauses.text: egress doorways are provided to serve both ends of rows of seats,
each doorway referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent4.clause1:short] serves not more than 3 rows of seats, and
each row contains not more than 100 seats.

content.text: Except as required by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art11:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art12:long] , aisles leading to [REF:term:xt:exits ] shall be provided in conformance with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent17:short] in places of assembly which contain fixed seats.
The minimum clear width of aisles shall be not less than 1 100 mm , except that the width is permitted to be reduced to not less than

clauses.text: 750 mm if serving not more than 60 seats, and
900 mm if serving seats on one side only.

content.text: Except in the case of bleacher seats, the minimum clear width of aisles referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent2:short] shall be measured at the point farthest from an [REF:term:xt:exit] , cross aisle or foyer and shall be increased by 25 mm for each metre of distance toward the [REF:term:xt:exit] , cross aisle or foyer.

Aisles shall terminate in a cross aisle, foyer or [REF:term:xt:exit] , and the width of the cross aisle, foyer or [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be not less than the required width of the widest aisle plus 50% of the total required width of the remaining aisles that it serves.
Dead-end aisles shall be not more than 6 m long.
The length of travel to an [REF:term:xt:exit] door by any aisle shall be not more than 45 m .
Side aisles shall be not less than 1 100 mm wide if seating is provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent4:long] .
An aisle that has a slope not more than 1 in 8 shall not be stepped.
An aisle that slopes more than 1 in 8 shall be stepped.
The passageway between rows of seats served by a stepped aisle shall be level at right angles to the line of travel.
The riser of a step in an aisle shall be

clauses.text: not less than 110 mm high, and
not more than 200 mm high.

content.text: Variations are permitted in riser height provided

clauses.text: the height of adjacent risers does not vary by more than 6 mm , and
the width of a tread or a platform in the direction of travel is not less than 430 mm .

content.text: Steps in an aisle shall

clauses.text: have a [REF:term:run:run] not less than 230 mm exclusive of nosings,
have a tread width not less than 250 mm ,
extend to the adjacent rows of seats in a manner that will not create a hazard from tripping, and
have a finish on the treads conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art1.sent1:long] .

content.text: The location of every riser in an aisle shall be made apparent from both directions of travel by strategically placed lighting or contrasting marking stripes.
A platform in an aisle shall be level, except that a slope not more than 1 in 50 is permitted for a platform that is not less than 430 mm wide in the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel.
If a step is used at the entry to a row of seats from a stepped aisle, an unobstructed platform not less than 800 mm square shall be provided adjacent to the aisle.
The finish of the surface of a platform in or adjacent to a stepped aisle shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art1.sent1:long] .

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent4:short] , a corridor used by the public in an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] as an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation ] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h but not less than 45 min provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent1:short] is permitted to be waived if the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in which the corridor is located is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

The requirement for a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent1:short] is permitted to be waived if the distance from any point in the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to an [REF:term:xt:exit] measured along the path of travel to the [REF:term:xt:exit] does not exceed the travel distance permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5:long]

A door equipped with a latching mechanism in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from a room or [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] containing an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 100 shall be equipped with a device that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent3:long] .
If fixed bench-type seats without arms are provided, the seat width per person shall be assumed to be 450 mm .
The centre-to-centre spacing between rows of bench-type seats shall be not less than 760 mm if back rests are provided, and not less than 550 mm if back rests are not provided.
A clear space of not less than 300 mm shall be provided between the back of each seat and the front of the seat immediately behind it.

Except as required by Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent2:short:(2)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent4:short:(4)] for bleacher seats, [REF:term:guard:guards] shall be installed in outdoor and indoor places of assembly with fixed seats so that

clauses.text: at the fascia of every box, balcony or gallery where the seats extend to the edge, the height of [REF:term:guard:guards] is not less than

subclauses.text: 760 mm in front of the seats, and
920 mm if located at the end of aisles or at the foot of steps,

clauses.text: the height of [REF:term:guard:guards] along every cross aisle other than those adjacent to the fascia of every box, balcony or gallery is not less than 660 mm , except that [REF:term:guard:guards ] need not be provided if the backs of the seats along the front side of the aisle are not less than 600 mm above the floor of the aisle, and

where the seating is arranged in successive tiers and the height of rise between platforms is more than 450 mm , the height of [REF:term:guard:guards] is not less than 660 mm along the entire row of seats at the edge of the platform.

content.text: The backs and ends of bleacher seats more than 1 200 mm above the ground or floor that are not adjacent to a wall shall be protected with a [REF:term:guard:guard]

clauses.text: not less than 1 070 mm high above an adjacent aisle surface or foot rest, and
not less than 920 mm high above the centre of an adjacent seat board.

content.text: If the front of a bleacher is more than 600 mm above the ground or floor, it shall be protected with a [REF:term:guard:guard] not less than 840 mm high above the front foot rest.

The size of any opening in a [REF:term:guard:guard] required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent3:short] shall not allow the passage of a sphere whose diameter is more than 300 mm .
Handrails shall be provided in aisles with steps in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art10.table1:long]

content.title: Types and Location of Handrails in Aisles with Steps

content.value: Aisle Serving Seating on One Side
Aisle Serving Seating on Both Sides

a continuous handrail located on the side of the aisle opposite the seats that conforms to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:number:3.4.6.5.(5)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent8:number:(8)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:number:(11)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent13:number:(13)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent14:number:(14)]

a handrail located on one side at the end of each row of seats that conforms to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:number:3.4.6.5.(5)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent8:number:(8)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:number:(11)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent13:number:(13)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent14:number:(14)]

a centre-line handrail that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art10.sent2:short] or a continuous handrail located on the side of the aisle opposite the seats that conforms to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:number:3.4.6.5.(5)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent8:number:(8)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:number:(11)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent13:number:(13)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent14:number:(14)] , plus a handrail located at the end of each row of seats that conforms to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:number:3.4.6.5.(5)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent8:number:(8)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:number:(11)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent13:number:(13)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent14:number:(14)]
a centre line handrail that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art10.sent2:short]

content.text: Handrails installed along aisle centre lines as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art10.table1:long] shall

clauses.text: comply with Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:number:3.4.6.5.(5)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent7:number:(7)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent14:number:(14)] ,
have gaps not less than 560 mm and not more than 915 mm wide, measured horizontally, at intervals not exceeding five rows,
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:long] at terminations and required gaps, and
have an intermediate rail located 305 mm below the principal handrail.

content.text: A Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] and each tier or balcony that has a capacity of more than

clauses.text: 1 000 persons shall have not less than 3 separate [REF:term:xt:exits] , or
4 000 persons shall have not less than 4 separate [REF:term:xt:exits] .

content.text: In a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , every seat shall be located so that the travel distance is not more than 45 m measured along the path of travel from the seat to

clauses.text: the ground,
an [REF:term:xt:exit] ,
an opening to a passageway leading from the seating area, or
a portal, a vomitory or any other opening through the seating deck structure.

content.text: [REF:term:xt:Exits] from outdoor stadia or grandstands shall be located not more than 25 m apart.

The capacity of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] for a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy ] shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent3:long] .
Aisles in a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall

clauses.text: be located so that there are not more than 20 seats between any seat and the nearest aisle, and
be not less than 1 200 mm wide, except that an aisle serving less than 60 persons is permitted to be 750 mm wide.

content.text: Steps provided in aisles of bleachers of the telescopic type shall

clauses.text: have risers not more than 250 mm high, and
have treads with a [REF:term:run:run] not less than 280 mm .

content.text: If the vertical distance between seating platforms in bleachers is more than 280 mm , an intermediate step shall be provided the full width of the aisle and proportioned to provide 2 equal risers between platforms.

If the vertical distance between seating platforms in bleachers is more than 450 mm , 2 intermediate steps shall be provided the full width of the aisle so that there are 3 equal risers between platforms.
If the passageway between rows of seats is not a closed deck, footboards shall be provided so that

clauses.text: the total width of the footboards shall be not less than three quarters of the centre-to-centre spacing between rows of seats, and
the spacing between footboard members shall be not more than 25 mm .

content.text: Openings above footboards and below the seats in rows of bleacher seats shall be provided with intermediate construction so that there is no opening that would permit the passage of a sphere of more than 100 mm in diameter.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art13.sent2:short] , a library book storage room that is not normally accessible to the public shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h if it

clauses.text: is more than 250 m^{2} in area, or
contains book stacks that

subclauses.text: are more than 10 m high, or
penetrate more than one floor assembly.

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art13.sent1:short] is not required if the book storage room is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

Open book shelves are permitted above and below a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] floor in a library [REF:term:bldng:building] provided the height of the shelves is not more than 2.1 m but not more than 75% of the floor-to-ceiling height of the space above or below the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] floor assembly.
A [REF:term:tg:stage] for theatrical performances and ancillary spaces, including workshops, dressing rooms and storage areas, shall be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

A [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h shall be provided between a [REF:term:tg:stage] for theatrical performances and ancillary spaces, including workshops, dressing rooms and storage areas.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art14.sent6:short] , a [REF:term:tg:stage] for theatrical performances and ancillary spaces, including workshops, dressing rooms and storage areas, shall be separated from the seating area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] not less than 1 h , except for a proscenium opening protected with

clauses.text: a sprinkler deluge system conforming to the requirements of [REF:standard:nfpa13]
an unframed fire curtain if the opening is not more than 20 m wide, or
a semi-rigid fire curtain if the opening is more than 20 m wide.

content.text: A fire curtain required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art14.sent3:short] shall be of a type acceptable to the [REF:term:thrt-hvn:authority having jurisdiction] and designed to close

clauses.text: automatically upon the actuation of the sprinkler system,
automatically upon actuation of the fire alarm system, and
manually by remote control devices located at the curtain control panel and at each side of the [REF:term:tg:stage] .

content.text: At least 2 vents for the purpose of venting fire and smoke to the outside of a [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be provided above a [REF:term:tg:stage] designed for theatrical performances and shall

clauses.text: have an aggregate area not less than one eighth of the area of the [REF:term:tg:stage] behind the proscenium opening, and
be arranged to open automatically upon actuation of the sprinkler system.

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art14.sent3:short] is not required between a [REF:term:tg:stage] and a seating area in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, provided a sprinkler deluge system is installed at the boundary between the [REF:term:tg:stage] and the seating area.
In a Group A, Division 2 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] used for the serving of food and beverages, an interior [REF:term:flght:flight] of stairs with fewer than 3 risers is permitted provided it

clauses.text: is not less than 900 mm wide,
is illuminated at all times that occupants are on the premises, and
has a handrail on each side.

content.text: Where storage rooms are required by Part 4 of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code for the storage of [REF:term:flmmbl-l:flammable liquids] or [REF:term:cmbtbl-l:combustible liquids] in [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancies] , such rooms shall not be located above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] .
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17.sent3:short] , glazing in all fixed and operable panels of doors shall conform to Class A of [REF:standard:cgsb-12.1]
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17.sent4:short] , glazing in all fixed and operable panels of windows shall conform to Class A of [REF:standard:cgsb-12.1]
Glazing in individual fixed or operable panels of a door need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17.sent1:short] , where

clauses.text: the bottom exposed edge of the glazing is located more than 1 525 mm above the walking surface on each side of the door, or
the glazed opening in the door does not permit the passage of a sphere whose diameter is more than 75 mm .

content.text: Glazing in individual fixed or operable panels of a window need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17.sent2:short] , where

clauses.text: the bottom exposed edge of the glazing is located more than 1 525 mm above the walking surface on each side of the window, or
the glazing is located more than 915 mm away from the walking surface on each side of the window measured perpendicular to the plane of the glazing.

articles.title: Daycare Facilities for Children under 30 Months

content.text: A daycare facility for children where children under 30 months are accommodated shall be located

clauses.text: in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, or
not more than 1 [REF:term:tr:storey] above or below a [REF:term:tr:storey] with an [REF:term:xt:exit] that opens directly to the exterior of the [REF:term:bldng:building] at ground level.

content.text: A fire alarm system shall be installed in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that contains a daycare facility described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent1:short] if

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] contains one or more other [REF:term:t:suites] , or
the daycare facility shares an interior [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] .

content.text: If a fire alarm system is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent2:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4:long] to be installed in a daycare facility described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent1:short] , [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] shall be installed in

clauses.text: each room of the daycare facility, and
each corridor serving as part of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from the daycare facility.

content.text: If a fire alarm system is not installed in a daycare facility described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent1:short] , [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs531] shall be installed in

clauses.text: each room of the daycare facility, and
each corridor serving as part of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from the daycare facility.

content.text: [REF:term:mk-lrm:Smoke alarms] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent4:short] shall

clauses.text: comply with Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent6:number:3.2.4.20.(6)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent12:number:(12)] , and

if more than one [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] is required, be wired so that the actuation of one of the required [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] will cause all the required [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] to sound.

content.text: This Subsection applies to [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment] and [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancies] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote138:short] .)

articles.title: Separations between Care, Treatment or Detention Occupancies and Repair Garages

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art5.sent1:long] between a [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment] or [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancy] and a [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garage] shall have no openings.
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent2:short] , a corridor used by the public or serving patients' or residents' sleeping rooms shall have no dead-end portion.
Corridors are permitted to have dead-portions, where

clauses.text: the area served by the dead-end portion has a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] , or
the corridor serves a [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] and the dead-end portion does not exceed 6 m .

content.text: Corridors shall be not less than

clauses.text: 2 400 mm wide in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment occupancy] where the corridors may be used to move patients or residents in beds,
1 650 mm wide

subclauses.text: in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care] or [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment occupancy] where the corridors will not be used to move patients or residents in beds, and
in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] with more than 10 residents and where the corridors serve the residents, or

clauses.text: 1 100 mm wide in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] with not more than 10 residents.

content.text: Paired doors in a corridor referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent3.clause1:medium:Clause (3)(a)] shall

clauses.text: swing in opposite directions, the right-hand door swinging in the direction of travel, and
be not less than 1 100 mm wide.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art4.sent2:short] and within individual [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] , the minimum clear width of a doorway shall be 850 mm where it opens into or is located within a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or other facility that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] for patients or residents in [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] containing [REF:term:ca-cc:care] or [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment occupancies] .
The minimum clear width of doorways through which it is necessary to move patients in bed shall be 1 050 mm . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote139:short] .)

[REF:term:flr-r:Floor areas] containing patients' or residents' sleeping rooms in a [REF:term:ca-cc:care] or [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment occupancy] where overnight sleeping accommodation is provided for more than a total of 10 patients or residents shall conform to  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent13:short] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent3:short] , a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent1:short] shall be divided into not less than 2 [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] , each not more than 1 000 m^{2} in area.

The [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] on either side of a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit ] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art10:long] is permitted to be considered as a [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] in applying the requirements of this Article.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent5:short] , [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] separating [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:short] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent4:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h but not less than 45 min provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: The travel distance from any point within each [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:short] to a door to an adjoining [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] shall be not more than 45 m .

Each [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:short] shall be capable of accommodating, in addition to its own occupants, the occupants of the largest adjacent [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] based on a clear floor space of 2.5 m^{2} per patient in the adjacent [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] .

Except as provided in Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent9:short:(9)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent13:short:(13)] , walls between patients' or residents' sleeping rooms and the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] but are not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] unless one is required by other provisions in this Part. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote27:short:Note A-3.1.8.1.(1)(b)] .)

The [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent8:short] do not apply to walls within a group of intercommunicating patients' or residents' sleeping rooms, provided the group of rooms does not

clauses.text: contain more than 5 patients or residents, or
include storage, bathing or toilet facilities serving persons not occupying the group of rooms.

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent8:short] do not apply to walls within individual [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] .
A door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent8:short] is permitted to be equipped with a roller latch.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent13:short] , a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent8:short] shall not have any grilles, louvres or other openings.
A door or wall separating a patient's or resident's sleeping room from an ensuite toilet room, shower room or similar ancillary space is permitted to incorporate grilles and louvres, provided

clauses.text: the adjacent rooms are not used to store flammable or [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] materials, and
the openings are located so that smoke cannot pass through these rooms to other parts of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

content.text: Walls between individual [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] and the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] shall be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that specified for [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] in Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent1:number:3.3.4.2.(1)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent2:number:(2)] .

Floor assemblies within individual [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] need not be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] , provided the [REF:term:t:suites] meet the conditions described in Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3.clause1:number:3.3.4.2.(3)(a)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3.clause2:number:(b)] .

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art6.sent1:long] is permitted to be waived if the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is located between individual [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancy] and an attached [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] containing not more than 5 vehicles , provided the conditions described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent4:long] are met.
Compartments containing rooms such as operating rooms, recovery rooms, delivery rooms and intensive care units, from which it is impracticable to move patients in an emergency, shall be

clauses.text: separated from adjacent spaces by [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h , and

provided with a mechanical air supply so that during a period of 2 h after the start of a fire in another space, the compartments will not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from the fire area.

content.text: A [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] shall conform to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent2:short:(2)] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent5:short:(5)] .

A [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent4:short] , a [REF:term:bldng:building] that includes a [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] shall be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

A [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] , in a [REF:term:bldng:building] for which  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] do not require the installation of an automatic sprinkler system, is not required to be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent3:short] provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] is designed so that during a period of 2 h after the start of a fire in the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] other [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] will not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] ,
the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] does not exceed 500 m^{2} in [REF:term:bldng-r:building area] ,
the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] does not exceed one [REF:term:tr:storey] in [REF:term:bldng-hght:building height] , and

the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h .

revisions.text: A [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] , in a [REF:term:bldng:building] for which Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:number:3.2.2.20.] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:number:3.2.2.92.] do not require the installation of an automatic sprinkler system, is not required to be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent3:short] provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] is designed so that during a period of 2 h after the start of a fire in the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] other [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] will not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] ,

the [REF:term:bldng:building] is designed so that during a period of 2 h after the start of a fire in another part of the [REF:term:bldng:building] the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area ] will not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from the other part of the [REF:term:bldng:building] ,
all doors are designed to be remotely released in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:long] , and
the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] does not contain any rooms lined with [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] padding.

revisions.text: A [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] , in a [REF:term:bldng:building] for which  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] do not require the installation of an automatic sprinkler system, is not required to be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent3:short] provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] is designed so that during a period of 2 h after the start of a fire in the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] other [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] will not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] ,
the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] does not exceed 500 m^{2} in [REF:term:bldng-r:building area] ,
the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] does not exceed one [REF:term:tr:storey] in [REF:term:bldng-hght:building height] , and

the [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h .

revisions.change_summary: Changed reference from 3.2.2.92 to 3.2.2.93

content.text: A corridor serving a [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] shall have no dead-end portion unless the area served by the dead-end portion has a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] .
This Subsection applies to [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] .

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art9.sent2:long] , [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall be separated from each other and the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation ] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h but not less than 45 min provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: Floor assemblies within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] need not be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] provided

clauses.text: the distance between the lowest floor level and the uppermost floor level within the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is not more than 6 m , and

the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] not less than

subclauses.text: 1 h if the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout,
45 min if the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout and it is not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , or
1 h if the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout and it is more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] .

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art6.sent1:long] is permitted to be waived if the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is located between a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and an attached [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] containing not more than 5 vehicles, provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and the attached [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] ,

the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and the attached [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] are separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] in conformance with Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent1:number] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3:number] ,
there are no air duct systems connecting the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] and the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] ,
the construction between the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] and the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] provides an effective barrier to gas and exhaust fumes, and
every door between the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] and the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is

subclauses.text: tight fitting and weather-stripped to provide an effective barrier against the passage of gas and exhaust fumes,
fitted with a self-closing device, and
not located in a room intended for sleeping.

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art6.sent1:long] is not required between a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and an attached [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] , serving that [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] only, provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and its attached [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] are separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] in conformance with Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent1:number] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3:number] ,
there are no air duct systems connecting the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] and the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] ,
the construction between the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] and the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] provides an effective barrier to gas and exhaust fumes, and
every door between the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] and the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is

subclauses.text: tight fitting and weather-stripped to provide an effective barrier against the passage of gas and exhaust fumes,
fitted with a self-closing device, and
not located in a room intended for sleeping.

content.text: Sprinklers shall be installed in a storage room provided for the use of tenants in a [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] within a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] but not contained within a [REF:term:t:suite] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art3.sent3:short] , a storage room referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art3.sent1:short] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation ] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art3.sent2:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h but not less than 45 min provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: Except for the storage of [REF:term:flmmbl-l:flammable liquids] and [REF:term:cmbtbl-l:combustible liquids] inside a single-family [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and garages or sheds attached to these [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , where storage rooms are required by Part 4 of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code for the storage of [REF:term:flmmbl-l:flammable liquids] or [REF:term:cmbtbl-l:combustible liquids] in [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] , such rooms shall not be located above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] .

Single [REF:term:tr:storey]  [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] in an apartment [REF:term:bldng:building] need not lead to a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or exterior passageway on the same [REF:term:tr:storey ] provided the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] are served by private stairways leading directly to a public [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] on the [REF:term:tr:storey]

clauses.text: immediately above, and
immediately below.

content.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent4:short] , a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] containing more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] shall have an [REF:term:xt:exit] door or an egress door opening directly into a public [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from the uppermost [REF:term:tr:storey] and from the lowest [REF:term:tr:storey] of the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] so that each of these [REF:term:tr:storeys] is served by an [REF:term:xt:exit] or egress door located not more than 1.5 m above or below its floor level.
A single [REF:term:xt:exit] is permitted from a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] provided the [REF:term:xt:exit] is an exterior doorway not more than 1.5 m above adjacent ground level and

clauses.text: it is not necessary to travel up or down more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] to reach the [REF:term:xt:exit] door, or
the uppermost floor level opens to a balcony not more than 6 m above adjacent ground level.

content.text: An egress door from either the uppermost [REF:term:tr:storey] or the lowest [REF:term:tr:storey] of a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent2:short] , need not be provided if that [REF:term:tr:storey] is served by a stairway that

clauses.text: leads to a public [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] ,
has no direct access to any other [REF:term:tr:storey] in the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , and

is separated from the other [REF:term:tr:storeys] in the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min .

content.text: In a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , a doorway from a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is permitted to open directly into an [REF:term:xt:exit] stairway provided the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] has a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] .

If a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] has a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] , one [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is permitted to pass through

clauses.text: an interior corridor served by a single [REF:term:xt:exit] ,
an exterior balcony served by a single [REF:term:xt:exit] stairway, or
an exterior passageway served by a single [REF:term:xt:exit] stairway.

content.text: Except for hotels and motels, a door opening onto a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] which provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from a [REF:term:t:suite] shall be designed not to lock automatically. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote143:short] .)
Occupants of [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] shall be protected from airborne noise in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part5.sect8:long]

articles.title: Stairs, Ramps, Landings, Handrails and Guards for Dwelling Units

content.text: Except as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art8:long] , stairs, [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , landings, handrails and [REF:term:guard:guards] within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall conform to the appropriate requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8:long]

Exterior stairs, [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , landings, handrails and [REF:term:guard:guards] serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , and loads on [REF:term:guard:guards] serving not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , shall conform to the appropriate requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8:long]
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art8.sent2:short] , openable windows in [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall be protected by

clauses.text: a [REF:term:guard:guard] with a minimum height of 1 070 mm constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18:long] , or

a mechanism that can only be released with the use of tools or special knowledge to control the free swinging or sliding operation of the openable part of the window so as to limit any clear unobstructed opening to not more than 100 mm measured either vertically or horizontally.

content.text: Windows need not be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art8.sent1:short] where

clauses.text: the only opening having greater dimensions than those allowed by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art8.sent1.clause2:medium] is located higher than 1 070 mm above the finished floor, or
the bottom edge of the openable portion of the window is located less than 1 800 mm above the floor or ground on the other side of the window.

content.text: [REF:term:dwllng-n:Dwelling units] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect7.subsect2.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect7.subsect5:long] .
This Subsection applies to [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] .

In addition to other requirements in this Code for the installation of automatic fire extinguishing systems, an appropriate fire extinguishing system shall be installed in every [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancy]  [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to provide protection if required by

clauses.text: provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws, or
the British Columbia Fire Code, in the absence of the regulations or bylaws referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art2.sent1.clause1:short] .

content.text: A [REF:term:bmnt:basement] shall not be used for the storage, manufacture or handling of volatile solids, liquids or gases that generate explosive air-vapour mixtures or for processes that involve explosive dusts.

Entrances and [REF:term:xt:exits] to a [REF:term:bmnt:basement] and to rooms containing [REF:term:bldng:building] services shall be separate from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] in which

clauses.text: the storage, manufacture or handling of volatile materials can generate explosive air-vapour mixtures, or
processes occur that produce explosive dusts.

content.text: [REF:term:bmnt:Basements] and rooms referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art3.sent2:short] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building ] with a vapour-tight separation.

If access is provided from a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] to a stair tower or elevator serving [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] above the level of the [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] , the access shall be through a vestibule conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent4:long] .
Treads and landings in interior stairs that extend to the roof of a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] shall be designed to be free of accumulations of ice and snow.

A mechanical [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] not more than 4 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , in which no persons other than parking attendants are permitted above the [REF:term:trt:street] floor level, need not have a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between the [REF:term:xt:exits] and the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

A garage shall be provided with natural or mechanical ventilation in conformance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect9.subsect1.art2:long] to prevent excessive accumulation of carbon monoxide, exhaust fumes or flammable and toxic vapours.
The clear height in a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] shall be not less than 2 m .
Where garage floors or ramps are 600 mm or more above the adjacent ground or floor level, every opening through such floors and the perimeter of floors and ramps shall be provided with

clauses.text: a continuous curb not less than 140 mm high, a [REF:term:guard:guard] not less than 1 070 mm high, and a vehicle guardrail not less than 500 mm high conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent7:short] , or
a full-height wall conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent7:short] .

content.text: Vehicle guardrails and full-height walls required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent6:short] shall be designed and constructed to withstand the loading values stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art15.sent1:long] .

Except for [REF:term:pn-r-tr:open-air storeys] , every [REF:term:tr:storey] of a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] or [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garage] located below [REF:term:grade:grade] shall be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .
