A [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garage] and any ancillary spaces serving it, including waiting rooms, reception rooms, tool and parts storage areas and supervisory office space, shall be separated from other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h .

Except as permitted by Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent5:number] , a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] shall be separated from other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1.5 h .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent2:short] , if access is provided through a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] and a Group A, Division 1 or Group B [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , the access shall be through a vestibule conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent4:short] .

If access is provided through a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] and a Group B, Division 3 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] with not more than 10 occupants, access need not be through a vestibule, provided the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] complies with Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent5.clause2:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent5.clause4:number] .

In a [REF:term:bldng:building] more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , access through a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] and a Group A, Division 2, 3 or 4, or a Group C [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , shall be through a vestibule conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent4:short] .

If access is provided through a vestibule, as required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent1:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent1:long] , the vestibule shall

clauses.text: be not less than 1.8 m long,
be ventilated

subclauses.text: naturally to outside air by a vent that has an unobstructed area of not less than 0.1 m^{2} for each door that opens into the vestibule but not less than 0.4 m^{2} , or
mechanically at a rate of 14 m^{3}/h for each square metre of vestibule floor surface area, and

clauses.text: have openings between the vestibule and an adjoining [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] provided with self-closing doors with no hold-open devices.

content.text: Facilities for the dispensing of fuel having a [REF:term:flh-pnt:flash point] below 37.8°C shall not be installed above any space intended for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] .

Facilities for the dispensing of fuel having a [REF:term:flh-pnt:flash point] below 37.8°C shall not be installed in any [REF:term:bldng:building] , except that this requirement does not apply to a canopy which is open on not less than 75% of its perimeter.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.subsect3.art1.sent5:long] or unless the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, each individual tenancy in a multiple tenant self storage warehouse classified as an [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancy] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min .
Except where they serve [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] , [REF:term:guard:guards] in [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] are permitted to consist of

clauses.text: a top railing, and
one or more intermediate rails spaced such that openings through the [REF:term:guard:guard] are of a size that prevents the passage of a spherical object whose diameter is 535 mm .

content.text: This Subsection applies to design and fire protection requirements for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or parts thereof used for the storage, handling, use and processing of [REF:term:dngr-gd:dangerous goods] , including [REF:term:flmmbl-l:flammable liquids] and [REF:term:cmbtbl-l:combustible liquids] , in quantities in excess of those identified in Table 3.2.7.1. of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote144:short] .)

Solid and liquid [REF:term:dngr-gd:dangerous goods] classified as oxidizers or organic peroxides shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h .

Reactive materials shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote145:short] .)

The design of [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or parts thereof used for the storage of [REF:term:dngr-gd:dangerous goods] classified as explosives shall conform to the [REF:standard:nrcan_ea] and its Regulations, published by Natural Resources Canada.

Where wiring or electrical equipment is located in areas in which flammable gases or vapours, [REF:term:cmbtbl-dst:combustible dusts] or [REF:term:cmbtbl-fbr:combustible fibres] are present in quantities sufficient to create a hazard, such wiring and electrical equipment shall conform to the requirements for hazardous locations as required by the Safety Standards Act and pursuant regulations. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote146:short] .)

articles.title: Indoor Storage of Anhydrous Ammonia and Flammable, Toxic and Oxidizing Gases

content.text: Where required by the British Columbia Fire Code, cylinders of [REF:term:dngr-gd:dangerous goods] classified as flammable gases stored indoors shall be located in a room

clauses.text: that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a gas-tight [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of at least 2 h ,
that is located on an exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] ,
that can be entered from the exterior, and
whose [REF:term:clr:closures] leading to the interior of the [REF:term:bldng:building] are

subclauses.text: equipped with self-closing devices that keep the [REF:term:clr:closures] closed when not in use, and
constructed so as to prevent the migration of gases from the room into other parts of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

content.text: Where required by the British Columbia Fire Code, cylinders of anhydrous ammonia or [REF:term:dngr-gd:dangerous goods] classified as toxic or oxidizing gases stored indoors shall be located in a room

clauses.text: that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a gas-tight [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of at least 1 h ,
that is located on an exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] ,
that can be entered from the exterior, and
whose [REF:term:clr:closures] leading to the interior of the [REF:term:bldng:building] are

subclauses.text: equipped with self-closing devices that keep the [REF:term:clr:closures] closed when not in use, and
constructed so as to prevent the migration of gases from the room into other parts of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

articles.title: Storage and Dispensing Rooms for Flammable Liquids and Combustible Liquids

content.text: [REF:term:fr-prtn:Fire separations] for rooms where [REF:term:flmmbl-l:flammable liquids] and [REF:term:cmbtbl-l:combustible liquids] are stored are required to be constructed with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] in conformance with Subsection 4.2.9. of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code.

Where Class IA or IB liquids specified in Subsection 4.1.2. of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code are dispensed within a storage room, the room shall be designed to prevent critical structural and mechanical damage from an internal explosion in conformance with good engineering practice such as that described in [REF:standard:nfpa68] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote147:short] .)

A tire storage area designed to contain more than 375 m^{3} of rubber tires shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote148:short] .)

Where Article 3.2.9.1. of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code applies due to the quantity and nature of the stored product, and as stipulated in Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art6.sent2:number] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art6.sent6:number] , [REF:term:bldng:buildings] used for the storage of ammonium nitrate shall be classified as [REF:term:mdm-hzrd:medium-hazard industrial occupancies] (Group F, Division 2).
[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] intended for the storage of ammonium nitrate shall be not more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] in [REF:term:bldng:building] height.
[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] intended for the storage of ammonium nitrate shall not

clauses.text: have [REF:term:bmnt:basements] or crawl spaces, or
contain open floor drains, tunnels, elevator pits or other pockets that might trap molten ammonium nitrate.

content.text: [REF:term:bldng:Buildings] intended for the storage of ammonium nitrate shall have not less than 0.007 m^{2} of vent area for each square metre of storage area, unless mechanical ventilation is provided.
All flooring in storage areas described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art6.sent1:short] shall be constructed of [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] materials.
[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] intended for the storage of ammonium nitrate shall be designed to prevent the ammonium nitrate from coming into contact with [REF:term:bldng:building] materials that

clauses.text: will cause the ammonium nitrate to become unstable,
may corrode or deteriorate by reason of contact with the ammonium nitrate, or
will become impregnated with the ammonium nitrate.

content.text: Floors in areas where [REF:term:dngr-gd:dangerous goods] are stored shall be constructed of impermeable materials to prevent the absorption of chemicals.

In [REF:term:prcs-plnt:process plants] , areas where unstable liquids are handled or where small-scale unit chemical processes occur shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h .

[REF:term:prcs-plnt:Process plants] where Class I and II [REF:term:flmmbl-l:flammable liquids] and [REF:term:cmbtbl-l:combustible liquids] are handled shall not be constructed with [REF:term:bmnt:basements] or covered pits.

[REF:term:xt:Exit] facilities complying with this Section shall be provided from every [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is intended for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote150:short] .)

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect1.art2.sent2:short] , if more than one [REF:term:xt:exit] is required from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , each [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be separate from every other [REF:term:xt:exit] leading from that [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] .

If more than 2 [REF:term:xt:exits] are provided from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , [REF:term:xt:exits] are permitted to converge in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art1.sent2:long] , provided the cumulative capacity of the converging [REF:term:xt:exits] does not contribute more than 50% of the total required [REF:term:xt:exit] width for the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] .
[REF:term:cc-t-xt:Access to exits] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3:long]
Subject to the requirements of this Section, an [REF:term:xt:exit] from any [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be one of the following, used singly or in combination:

clauses.text: an exterior doorway,
an exterior passageway,
an exterior [REF:term:rmp:ramp] ,
an exterior stairway,
a fire escape (conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7:long] ),
a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] ,
an interior passageway,
an interior [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , or
an interior stairway.

content.text: Access to an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] passageway from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be through [REF:term:xt:exit] doors at the floor level.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect1.art6.sent2:short] , [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exits] shall not comprise more than one half of the required number of [REF:term:xt:exits] from any [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] .

In a hospital or nursing home with [REF:term:trtm:treatment] , [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exits] serving patients' sleeping rooms shall comprise not more than two thirds of the required number of [REF:term:xt:exits] from any [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote151:short] .)

A slide escape shall not be erected on any [REF:term:bldng:building] as a required [REF:term:xt:exit] , but is permitted to be provided as an additional egress facility if unusual hazards are foreseen.

Glass and transparent panels in an [REF:term:xt:exit] shall conform to the appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20:long] for glass and transparent panels in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] .
No mirror shall be placed in or adjacent to any [REF:term:xt:exit] in a manner that would confuse the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] .
[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] glazing is not permitted in wall or ceiling assemblies or in [REF:term:clr:closures] used to construct an [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosure.

subsections.title: Number and Location of Exits from Floor Areas

content.text: Except for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] designed and constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10:long] and except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent4:short] , every [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] intended for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall be served by at least 2 [REF:term:xt:exits] .

revisions.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent4:short] , every [REF:term:flr-r:floor area ] intended for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall be served by at least 2 [REF:term:xt:exits] .

Except for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] designed and constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10:long] and except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent4:short] , every [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] intended for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall be served by at least 2 [REF:term:xt:exits] .
revisions.change_summary: Replaced Sentence 3.4.2.1.(1) to add exception for buildings designed per Subsection 3.2.10.

content.text: A [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] not more than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , is permitted to be served by one [REF:term:xt:exit] provided the total [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] served by the [REF:term:xt:exit] is not more than 60, and

clauses.text: in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] and the travel distance are not more than the values in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.table1:long:Table 3.4.2.1.-A] , or
in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout

subclauses.text: the travel distance is not more than 25 m , and
the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is not more than the value in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.table2:long:Table 3.4.2.1.-B] .

content.title: Criteria for One Exit (Floor Area Not Sprinklered Throughout)
Criteria for One Exit (Floor Area Sprinklered Throughout)

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent4:short] , if [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent2:short] permits a single [REF:term:xt:exit] from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] classified as Group B or Group C [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , the [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be an exterior doorway not more than 1.5 m above adjacent ground level.

The requirements of  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent2:short] are permitted to be waived for [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] that have an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] conforming to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent1:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent4:number] .

[REF:term:xt:Exits] are not required directly from rooftop enclosures that comply with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent8:medium] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent9:medium] or where they are served by [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] in conformance with Sentences 3.3.1.3.(4) to (5).

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art2.sent3:short] , the space above a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] shall be served by [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] leading to [REF:term:xt:exits] accessible at the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] level on the same basis as [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] .
The [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art2.sent1:short] , provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is not required to terminate at a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent1:long] ,
the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is not more than 60,
the area of the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] does not exceed the area limits stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art2.table1:long] , and
the distance limits stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art2.table1:long] measured along the path of travel are not exceeded from any point on the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] to

subclauses.text: an egress door serving the space that the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] overlooks, if the space is served by a single egress door, or

the egress stairway leading to an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] in the space below if that space is required to be served by 2 or more egress doorways in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art5.sent1:long] .

content.text: At least half of the required [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art2.sent1:short] if the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is not required to terminate at a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent1:long] .

content.title: Criteria for Egress from Mezzanine Space

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art3.sent2:short] , the least distance between 2 [REF:term:xt:exits] from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be

clauses.text: one half the maximum diagonal dimension of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , but need not be more than 9 m for a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] having a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , or
one half the maximum diagonal dimension of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , but not less than 9 m for all other [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] .

content.text: [REF:term:xt:Exits] need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art3.sent1:short] where

clauses.text: the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is divided so that not less than one third of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is on each side of a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , and
it is necessary to pass through the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] to travel from one [REF:term:xt:exit] to another [REF:term:xt:exit] .

content.text: The minimum distance between [REF:term:xt:exits] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art3.sent1:short] shall be the shortest distance that smoke would have to travel between the [REF:term:xt:exits] , assuming that the smoke will not penetrate an intervening [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .
The distance between 2 exterior discharges of [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs serving the same [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be

clauses.text: not less than 9 m , or
not less than 6 m , where

subclauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, and
the 2 exterior discharges are located within 15 m of a [REF:term:trt:street] .

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent2:short] , for the purposes of this Subsection, travel distance means the distance from any point in the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to an [REF:term:xt:exit] measured along the path of travel to the [REF:term:xt:exit] .

The travel distance from a [REF:term:t:suite] or a room not within a [REF:term:t:suite ] is permitted to be measured from an egress door of the [REF:term:t:suite] or room to the nearest [REF:term:xt:exit] , provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:t:suite] or room is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation]

subclauses.text: having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, or
which is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, and

clauses.text: the egress door opens onto

subclauses.text: an exterior passageway,

a corridor used by the public that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in conformance with the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4:long] for the separation of [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] , or

a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote27:short] ).

content.text: Travel distance to an [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be not more than 50 m from any point in a [REF:term:rvc-pc:service space] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] .

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent6:long] , if more than one [REF:term:xt:exit] is required from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , the [REF:term:xt:exits] shall be located so that the travel distance to at least one [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be not more than

clauses.text: 25 m in a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] ,
40 m in a [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] ,

45 m in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that contains an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] other than a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] , provided it is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout,

not more than one half of the required egress doorways from a room or [REF:term:t:suite] open into the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] if the room or [REF:term:t:suite] is required to have more than one egress doorway,

30 m in any [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] other than those referred to in  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause1:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause5:short] .

content.text: Except for a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1:short] need not apply if [REF:term:xt:exits] are placed along the perimeter of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] and are not more than 60 m apart, measured along the perimeter, provided each main aisle in the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] leads directly to an [REF:term:xt:exit] .

In a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:long] , the principal entrance serving a dance hall or a licensed beverage establishment with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 250 shall provide at least one half of the required [REF:term:xt:exit] width.

content.text: For the purpose of determining the aggregate width of [REF:term:xt:exits] , the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of every room or [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be determined in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17:long]
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent4:long] , the required [REF:term:xt:exit] width shall be cumulative if 2 or more [REF:term:xt:exits ] converge.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent3:short] , the minimum aggregate required width of [REF:term:xt:exits] serving [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] intended for [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancies] , [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] , [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancies] , [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancies] , and [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] shall be determined by multiplying the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of the area served by

clauses.text: 6.1 mm per person for [REF:term:rmp:ramps] with a slope of not more than 1 in 8, doorways, corridors and passageways,
8 mm per person for a stair consisting of steps whose rise is not more than 180 mm and whose [REF:term:run:run] is not less than 280 mm , or
9.2 mm per person for

subclauses.text: [REF:term:rmp:ramps] with a slope of more than 1 in 8, or
stairs, other than stairs conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent1.clause2:short] .

content.text: The minimum aggregate width of [REF:term:xt:exits] serving [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] intended for a [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment] or [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancy] shall be determined by multiplying the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of the area served by 18.4 mm per person.

The minimum aggregate width of [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] serving a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall be determined by multiplying the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of the area served by

clauses.text: 1.8 mm per person for

subclauses.text: aisles,
stairs other than [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs, and
[REF:term:rmp:ramps] and passageways in vomitories and [REF:term:xt:exits] , and

clauses.text: 2.4 mm per person for [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs.

content.text: Except as required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent6:short] , the required [REF:term:xt:exit] width need not be cumulative in an [REF:term:xt:exit] serving 2 or more [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] located one above the other.

The required [REF:term:xt:exit] width for an [REF:term:xt:exit] stair in an assembly hall or [REF:term:thtr:theatre] serving more than one balcony level shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent6:short] .

The required [REF:term:xt:exit] width for [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs that serve [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] designed in accordance with Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long:3.2.8.8.] shall be cumulative, unless

clauses.text: the stairs provide not less than 0.3 m^{2} of area of treads and landings for each occupant of the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote154:short] ), or

[REF:term:prt-flr-spc:protected floor spaces] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art5:long] are provided at each floor level and the [REF:term:prt-flr-spc:protected floor space] on a floor level has not less than 0.5 m^{2} of space for each occupant of that floor level of the [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] .

content.text: If more than one [REF:term:xt:exit] is required, every [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be considered as contributing not more than one half of the required [REF:term:xt:exit] width.

content.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art3.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art3.sent4:short] , no fixture, turnstile or construction shall project into or be fixed within the required width of an [REF:term:xt:exit] .

Swinging doors in their swing shall not reduce the required width of [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs or landings to less than 750 mm or reduce the width of an [REF:term:xt:exit] passageway to less than the minimum required width.
Doors shall be installed so that, when open, they do not diminish nor obstruct the required width of the [REF:term:xt:exit] .
Handrails and construction below handrails, including handrail supports and stair stringers, shall not project more than 100 mm into the required width of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress.]

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4.sent4:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4.sent5:short] , every [REF:term:xt:exit] shall have a clear height over the clear width of the [REF:term:xt:exit] of not less than 2 050 mm .

The clear height of stairways shall be measured vertically over the clear width of the stairway, from the straight line tangent to the tread and landing nosings to the lowest element above. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote38:short] )
The clear height of landings shall be measured within the clear width of the landing vertically to the lowest element above.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4.sent5:short] , the headroom clearance for doorways shall be not less than 2 030 mm .
No door closer or other device shall be installed so as to reduce the headroom clearance of a doorway to less than 1 980 mm .

Except as permitted by Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent2:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent3:long:3.3.5.4.(3)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art2.sent2:long:3.4.4.2.(2)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art3.sent1:long:3.4.4.3.(1)] , every [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] , but not less than 45 min, for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:tr:storey] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:tr:storey] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent1:short] need not be more than 2 h.

If an [REF:term:xt:exit ] stair in an assembly hall or [REF:term:thtr:theatre] serves more than one balcony level, the [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent1:short] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art2.sent2:short] , no [REF:term:xt:exit] from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] shall lead through a lobby.
Not more than one [REF:term:xt:exit] from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is permitted to lead through a lobby, provided

clauses.text: the lobby floor is not more than 4.5 m above [REF:term:grade:grade] ,
the path of travel through the lobby to the outdoors is not more than 15 m,
the adjacent rooms or premises having direct access to the lobby do not contain a [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancy] ,
the lobby is not located within an [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] other than as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent6:long] ,
the lobby conforms to the requirements for [REF:term:xt:exits] , except that

subclauses.text: rooms other than [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] and storage rooms are permitted to open onto the lobby,

the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between the lobby and a room used for the sole purpose of control and supervision of the [REF:term:bldng:building] need not have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] ,

the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between the lobby and adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] that are permitted to open onto the lobby need not have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] provided the lobby and adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , and
passenger elevators are permitted to open onto the lobby, provided the elevator doors are designed to remain closed except while loading and unloading passengers, and

clauses.text: a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent1:long] , is maintained between the lobby and any [REF:term:xt:exit] permitted by this Sentence to lead through the lobby.

content.text: The requirements of Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent1:long:3.2.3.13.(1)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent3:number] do not apply to an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] passageway provided

clauses.text: not less than 50% of the exterior side is open to the outdoors, and
an [REF:term:xt:exit] stair is provided at each end of the passageway.

content.text: A [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] that separates an [REF:term:xt:exit] from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall have no openings except for

clauses.text: standpipe and sprinkler piping,
electrical wires and cables, totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] raceways and [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] piping that serve only the [REF:term:xt:exit] ,
openings required by the provisions of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] ,
[REF:term:xt:exit] doorways, and
wired glass and glass block permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art16:long]

content.text: [REF:term:xt:Exits] within scissors stairs and other contiguous [REF:term:xt:exit] stairways shall be separated from each other by a smoke-tight [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] not less than that required for the floor assembly through which they pass.

[REF:term:fr-prtn:Fire separations] separating contiguous stairs described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art4.sent2:short] shall not be pierced by doorways, ductwork, piping or any other openings that affect the continuity of the separation.
A fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliance] shall not be installed in an [REF:term:xt:exit] .
An [REF:term:xt:exit] shall not be used as a [REF:term:plnm:plenum] for a heating, ventilating or air-conditioning system.

An [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be designed for no purpose other than for exiting, except that an [REF:term:xt:exit] is permitted also to be designed to serve as an access to a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] .
A [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] shall not open directly into an [REF:term:xt:exit] .
Storage rooms, washrooms, toilet rooms, laundry rooms and similar ancillary rooms shall not open directly into an [REF:term:xt:exit] .
[REF:term:rvc-pc:Service spaces] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] shall not open directly into an [REF:term:xt:exit] .
Every [REF:term:xt:exit] door shall have an [REF:term:xt:exit] sign providing visual information placed over or adjacent to it if the [REF:term:xt:exit] serves

clauses.text: a [REF:term:bldng:building] more than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] ,
a [REF:term:bldng:building] having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of more than 150, or
a room or [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that has a fire escape as part of a required [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] .

content.text: Every [REF:term:xt:exit] sign providing visual information shall

clauses.text: be visible on approach to the [REF:term:xt:exit] ,

consist of a green and white or lightly tinted graphical symbol meeting the colour specifications referred to in ISO 3864-1, "Graphical symbols – Safety colours and safety signs – Part 1: Design principles for safety signs and safety markings," and
conform to ISO 7010, "Graphical symbols – Safety colours and safety signs – Registered safety signs," for the following symbols (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote157:short] ):

subclauses.text: E001 emergency exit (left hand),
E002 emergency exit (right hand),
E005 Direction, arrow (90° increments), safe condition, and
E006 Direction, 45° arrow (90° increments), safe condition.

content.text: Internally illuminated [REF:term:xt:exit] signs shall be continuously illuminated and

clauses.text: where illumination of the sign is powered by an electrical circuit, be constructed in conformance with CSA C22.2 No. 141, "Emergency lighting equipment," or

where illumination of the sign is not powered by an electrical circuit, be constructed in conformance with CAN/ULC-S572, "Standard for Photoluminescent and Self-Luminous Exit Signs and Path Marking Systems." (See Note A-3.4.5.1.(3).)

content.text: Externally illuminated [REF:term:xt:exit] signs shall be continuously illuminated and be constructed in conformance with CAN/ULC-S572, "Standard for Photoluminescent and Self-Luminous Exit Signs and Path Marking Systems." (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote158:short] .)
The circuitry serving lighting for externally and internally illuminated [REF:term:xt:exit] signs shall

clauses.text: serve no equipment other than emergency equipment, and
be connected to an emergency power supply as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art4:long]

content.text: Where no [REF:term:xt:exit] is visible from a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , from a corridor used by the public in a Group A or B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] , or from principal routes serving an open [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of more than 150, an [REF:term:xt:exit] sign conforming to  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent2.clause2:medium] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent2.clause3:short] with an arrow or pointer indicating the direction of egress shall be provided.

Except for egress doorways described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent4:long] , an [REF:term:xt:exit] sign conforming to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent2:number] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent5:number] shall be placed over or adjacent to every egress doorway from rooms with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of more than 60 in Group A, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] , dance halls, licensed beverage establishments, and other similar [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] that, when occupied, have lighting levels below that which would provide easy identification of the egress doorway.

An [REF:term:xt:exit] sign displaying the word “EXIT” in tactile form that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] shall be mounted on the approach side of [REF:term:xt:exit] doors described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent1:long] , in the direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt:exit] .

articles.title: Signs for Stairs and Ramps at Exit Level

content.text: In a [REF:term:bldng:building] more than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , any part of an [REF:term:xt:exit]  [REF:term:rmp:ramp] or stairway that continues up or down past the lowest [REF:term:xt-lvl:exit level] shall have a posted sign clearly indicating that it does not lead to an [REF:term:xt:exit] .

articles.title: Slip Resistance of Ramps and Stairs

content.text: The surfaces of [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , and landings and treads

clauses.text: shall have a finish that is slip resistant, and

if accessible to the public, shall have either a colour contrast or a distinctive pattern, readily visible from both directions of travel, to demarcate the leading edge of the tread and the leading edge of the landing, as well as the beginning and end of a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] .

content.text: Treads and landings of exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs more than 10 m high shall be designed to be free of ice and snow accumulations.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art15.sent1:long] , every [REF:term:flght:flight] of interior stairs shall have not less than 3 risers.

articles.title: Maximum Vertical Rise of Stair Flights and Required Landings

content.text: No [REF:term:flght:flight] of stairs shall have a vertical rise of more than 3.7 m between floors or landings, except that a [REF:term:flght:flight] of stairs serving as an [REF:term:xt:exit ] in a Group B, Division 2 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall have a vertical rise not more than 2.4 m between floors or landings.
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art3.sent3:short] , a landing shall be provided

clauses.text: at the top and bottom of each [REF:term:flght:flight] of interior and exterior stairs,
at the top and bottom of every section of [REF:term:rmp:ramp] ,
where a doorway opens onto a stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] ,
where a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] opens onto a stair, and
where a stair opens onto a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] .

content.text: A landing may be omitted at the bottom of an exterior stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , provided there is no gate, door or fixed obstruction within the lesser of

clauses.text: the width of the stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , or

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art4.sent2:short] , a landing shall be at least as wide and as long as the width of the stairway in which it occurs.
In a straight stairway and in a stairway that turns less than 90°, the length of the landing need not be more than the lesser of

clauses.text: the required width of stair, or

content.text: The length of a landing shall be measured perpendicular to the nosing of adjacent steps, at a distance equal to half the length required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art4.sent2:short] , from the narrow edge of the landing.

Where a doorway or stairway empties onto a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] through a side wall, there shall be a level area extending across the full width of the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , and for a distance of 300 mm on either side of the wall opening, except one side if it abuts on an end wall.

Where a doorway or stairway empties onto a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] through an end wall, there shall be a level area extending across the full width of the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] and along its length for not less than 900 mm.
One handrail shall be provided on stairs that are less than 1 100 mm in width.
One handrail shall be provided on each side of

clauses.text: stairs that are 1 100 mm or more in width,
curved [REF:term:flght:flights] of any width, and
[REF:term:rmp:ramps] .

content.text: In addition to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent2:short] , intermediate handrails shall be provided so that

clauses.text: a handrail is reachable within 750 mm of all portions of the required [REF:term:xt:exit] width,

at least one portion of the stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] between two handrails is the minimum width required for stairways or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] (see  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent8:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art3.sent4:long] ), and
all other portions of the stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] between two handrails have a clear width of 510 mm or more.

content.text: Where a stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] is wider than its required [REF:term:xt:exit] width, handrails shall be located along the most direct path of travel. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote161:short] .)
Handrails shall be continuously graspable along their entire length, be free of any sharp or abrasive elements, and have

clauses.text: a circular cross-section with an outside diameter not less than 30 mm and not more than 50 mm , or
a non-circular cross-section with a perimeter not less than 100 mm and not more than 160 mm and whose largest cross-sectional dimension is not more than 57 mm .

content.text: The height of handrails on stairs, on aisles with steps and on [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall be measured vertically from the top of the handrail to

clauses.text: a straight line drawn tangent to the tread nosings of the stair or aisle step served by the handrail (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote38:short] ), or
the surface of the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , floor or landing served by the handrail.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent8:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause5:long] , the height of handrails on stairs, on aisles with steps and on [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall be

clauses.text: not less than 865 mm , and
not more than 1 070 mm .

content.text: Handrails installed in addition to required handrails need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent7:short] .
Required handrails shall be continuously graspable throughout the length of

clauses.text: a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , and
a [REF:term:flght:flight] of stairs, from the bottom riser to the top riser.

content.text: Except where interrupted by doorways, at least one handrail shall be continuous throughout the length of a stairway or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , including at landings.
Handrails shall be terminated in a manner that will not obstruct pedestrian travel or create a hazard. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote162:short] ).
At least one handrail at the side of a stairway or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] shall extend horizontally not less than 300 mm beyond the top and bottom of the stairway or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] .
The clearance between a handrail and any surface behind it shall be not less than

clauses.text: 50 mm , or
60 mm if the surface behind the handrail is rough or abrasive.

content.text: Handrails and their supports shall be designed and constructed to withstand the loading values specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art14.sent7:long] .
A [REF:term:rmp:ramp] shall have handrails on both sides.
Every [REF:term:xt:exit] shall have a wall or a well-secured [REF:term:guard:guard] on each side, where

clauses.text: there is a difference in elevation of more than 600 mm between the walking surface and the adjacent surface, or
the adjacent surface within 1.2 m of the walking surface has a slope of more than 1 in 2.

content.text: Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art6.sent4:short] , the height of [REF:term:guard:guards] for [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs and [REF:term:xt:exit]  [REF:term:rmp:ramps] as well as their landings shall be not less than 1 070 mm .
The height of [REF:term:guard:guards] shall be measured vertically to the top of the [REF:term:guard:guard] from

clauses.text: a line drawn through the outside edges of the stair nosings, or
the surface of the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] or landing.

content.text: The height of [REF:term:guard:guards] for exterior stairs and landings more than 10 m above adjacent ground level shall be not less than 1 500 mm measured vertically to the top of the [REF:term:guard:guard] from the surface of the landing or from a line drawn through the outside edges of the stair nosings.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18.sent3:long] and  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art7:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art10:short] , [REF:term:guard:guards] in [REF:term:xt:exits] shall not have any openings that permit the passage of a spherical object whose diameter is more than 100 mm.

In a stairway, a window for which the distance measured vertically between the bottom of the window and a line drawn through the outside edges of the stair nosings is less than 900 mm , or a window that extends to less than 1 070 mm above the landing, shall

clauses.text: be protected by a [REF:term:guard:guard] that is

subclauses.text: located approximately 900 mm above a line drawn through the outside edges of the stair nosings, or
not less than 1 070 mm high measured to the top of the [REF:term:guard:guard] from the surface of the landing, or

clauses.text: be fixed in position and designed to resist the lateral design loads specified for [REF:term:guard:guards] and walls in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art14:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art16:long]

content.text: Except for [REF:term:guard:guards] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art10:long] , [REF:term:guard:guards] that protect a level located more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] or 4.2 m above the adjacent level shall be designed so that no member, attachment or opening located between 140 mm and 900 mm above the level being protected by the [REF:term:guard:guard] facilitates climbing. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote47:short] .)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art7.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art7.sent3:number] and as provided for aisles in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5:long] , [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall have a uniform slope along their length and a maximum slope of 1 in 12.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8:long] , [REF:term:rmp:ramps] in [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] shall have a uniform slope along their length and a maximum slope of

clauses.text: 1 in 6 for interior [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , and
1 in 10 for exterior [REF:term:rmp:ramps] .

content.text: Curb ramps shall be designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art4.sent1.clause2:long] .

Except as permitted for [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7.art5.sent1:long] for fire escapes, steps for stairs shall have a [REF:term:run:run] of not less than 280 mm between successive steps.
Steps for stairs referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8.sent1:short] shall have

clauses.text: a rise between successive treads not less than 125 mm and not more than 180 mm , and
a riser with either no rakeback or a rakeback of not more than 38 mm , or if nosing is provided, the underside of the nosing with an angle of not less than 60° from the horizontal.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art7:long] and except for fire escape stairs, stairs that are principally used for maintenance and service, and stairs that serve [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] other than [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] , steps for stairs shall have no open risers.

Except in fire escape stairs and where an exterior stair adjoins a [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art3.sent3:long] , risers, measured as the vertical nosing-to-nosing distance, shall be of uniform height in any one [REF:term:flght:flight] , with a maximum tolerance of

clauses.text: 5 mm between adjacent treads or landings, and
10 mm between the tallest and shortest risers in a [REF:term:flght:flight] .

content.text: Except in fire escape stairs, treads shall have a uniform [REF:term:run:run] with a maximum tolerance of

clauses.text: 5 mm between adjacent treads, and
10 mm between the deepest and shallowest treads in a [REF:term:flght:flight] .

content.text: Treads and risers shall not differ significantly in [REF:term:run:run] and rise in successive [REF:term:flght:flights] in any stair system.
The slope of treads or landings shall not exceed 1 in 50 .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8.sent10:short] , the top of the nosing of stair treads shall have a rounded or beveled edge extending not less than 6 mm and not more than 13 mm measured horizontally from the front of the nosing.
The front edge of stair treads in [REF:term:xt:exits] and public [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exits] shall be at right angles to the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel.

If resilient material is used to cover the nosing of a stair tread, the minimum rounded or beveled edge required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8.sent8:short] is permitted to be reduced to 3 mm .
[REF:term:xt:Exit] stair [REF:term:flght:flights] shall consist solely of

clauses.text: straight [REF:term:flght:flights] , or
curved [REF:term:flght:flights] complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art9.sent2:short] .

content.text: A curved [REF:term:flght:flight] used as an [REF:term:xt:exit] shall have

clauses.text: a handrail on each side,
a minimum [REF:term:run:run] of 240 mm ,
a [REF:term:run:run] that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8:long] when measured at a point 300 mm from the centre line of the handrail at the narrow end of the tread, and
an inside radius that is not less than twice the stair width.

content.text: [REF:term:tpr-thr:Tapered treads] shall have a consistent angle and uniform [REF:term:run:run] and rise dimensions in accordance with the construction tolerances stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8:long] when measured at a point 300 mm from the centre line of the handrail at the narrow end of the tread.
All [REF:term:tpr-thr:tapered treads] within a [REF:term:flght:flight] shall turn in the same direction.

The [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] on each side of a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] shall be sufficient to accommodate the occupants of both [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] , allowing not less than 0.5 m^{2} of clear floor space per person, except that 1.5 m^{2} shall be provided for each person in a wheelchair and 2.5 m^{2} for each bedridden patient.

If vestibules, enclosed balconies or bridges are used as parts of a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] , their clear width shall be not less than that of the [REF:term:xt:exit] doorways opening into them, except that handrails are not permitted to project into this clear width more than 100 mm .

In a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] where there is a difference in level between the connected [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] , slopes not more than those specified for [REF:term:rmp:ramps] in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art7:long] are permitted to be used.
No stairs or steps shall be used in a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] .

If 2 doors are provided in a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] that comprises a part of the required number of [REF:term:xt:exits] from the [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] on both sides of the [REF:term:xt:exit]

clauses.text: the doors shall be mounted adjacent to each other with the door on the right side in the direction of travel through the [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] swinging in the direction of travel through the [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] , and
signs shall be provided on each side of the [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] to indicate the door that swings in the direction of travel from that side.

content.text: If a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] utilizes bridges between [REF:term:bldng:buildings ] or outside balconies, the bridges or balconies shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19:long]
The distance between a stair riser and the leading edge of a door during its swing shall be not less than 300 mm .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art11.sent3:short] and where doorways are used to confine the spillage of [REF:term:flmmbl-l:flammable liquids] within a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] or within a room in an [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancy] , a threshold for a doorway in an [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be not more than 13 mm higher than the surrounding finished floor surface.

Except for doors providing access to ground level as required by Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause5:number] , an [REF:term:xt:exit] door is permitted to open onto not more than one step which shall be not more than 150 mm high where there is a risk of blockage by ice or snow.
[REF:term:xt:Exit] doors shall be clearly identifiable. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote164:short] .)
No door leaf in an [REF:term:xt:exit] doorway with more than one leaf shall be less than 610 mm wide.

Where an [REF:term:xt:exit] door leading directly to the outside is subject to being obstructed by parked vehicles or storage because of its location, a visible sign or a physical barrier prohibiting such obstructions shall be installed on the exterior side of the door.

Except for doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art12.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art14:long] , every [REF:term:xt:exit] door shall

clauses.text: open in the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel, and
swing on its vertical axis.

content.text: [REF:term:xt:Exit] doors need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art12.sent1:short] , where

clauses.text: they serve [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] ,
they serve accessory [REF:term:bldng:buildings] serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] ,
they

subclauses.text: serve storage [REF:term:t:suites] not more than 28 m^{2} in area that are on the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] in warehousing [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , and
open directly outdoors at ground level, or

clauses.text: they serve individual self-service storage units referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10:long]

content.text: An [REF:term:xt:exit] door that is normally required to be kept closed

clauses.text: shall be provided with a self-closing mechanism, and
shall never be secured in an open position except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent1:long] .

content.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art14.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art12.sent2:medium] , an [REF:term:xt:exit] door leading directly to outdoors at ground level is permitted to be a sliding door provided it conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12.sent1:long] .

An [REF:term:xt:exit] door serving a Group B, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , or an [REF:term:mpdd-gr-:impeded egress zone] in other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] , is permitted to be a sliding door that does not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12.sent1:long] provided it is designed to be released in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13:long]
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art15.sent3:short] , a revolving door, if used, shall

clauses.text: be collapsible,
have hinged doors providing equivalent exiting capacity located adjacent to it,
be used as an [REF:term:xt:exit] from the ground floor level only,
not be used at the foot of any stairway, and
have all glass in door leaves and enclosure panels conforming to

subclauses.text: CAN/CGSB-12.1, "Safety Glazing," or
CAN/CGSB-12.11-M, "Wired Safety Glass."

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art15.sent3:short] , a revolving door shall not be considered to have an exiting capacity for more than 45 persons.

An electrically powered revolving door is not required to conform to  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art15.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art15.sent2:short] provided

clauses.text: the door leaves will collapse and stop automatic rotation of the door system and not obstruct the doorway if a force not more than that specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent2:long] is applied at the centre of a door leaf,
the door leaves are capable of being opened from inside the [REF:term:bldng:building] without requiring keys, special devices, or specialized knowledge of the door opening mechanism,
the allowable exiting capacity is based on the clear width of passage through the door enclosure when the doors are fully collapsed,
a permanent sign, whose centre line is between 1 000 mm and 1 500 mm above the floor, is placed on each face of each door leaf indicating the method for collapsing the door leaf in an emergency, and
glass used for door leaves and enclosure panels is safety glazing conforming to

subclauses.text: CAN/CGSB-12.1, "Safety Glazing," or
CAN/CGSB-12.11-M, "Wired Safety Glass."

content.text: Except for devices on doors serving a [REF:term:cntnd-r:contained use area] or an [REF:term:mpdd-gr-:impeded egress zone] designed to be remotely released in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13:long] , and except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17:long] , locking, latching and other fastening devices on a principal entrance door to a [REF:term:bldng:building] as well as those on every [REF:term:xt:exit] door shall include release hardware complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] to permit the door to be readily opened from the inside with not more than one releasing operation and without requiring keys, special devices or specialized knowledge of the door-opening mechanism. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote165:short] .)
If a door is equipped with a latching mechanism, a device complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent3:short] shall be installed on

clauses.text: every [REF:term:xt:exit] door from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] containing an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 100,

every door leading to an [REF:term:xt:exit] lobby from an [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shaft, and every exterior door leading from an [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shaft in a [REF:term:bldng:building] having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] more than 100, and
every [REF:term:xt:exit] door from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] containing a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] .

content.text: The device required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent2:short] shall

clauses.text: extend across not less than one half of the width of the door,
release the latch, and

allow the door to swing wide open when a force not more than that specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent8:long] is applied to the device in the direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt:exit] .

content.text: Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent8:long] , every [REF:term:xt:exit] door shall be designed and installed so that, when the latch is released, the door will open under a force of not more than 90 N, applied at the knob or other latch releasing device.

Electromagnetic locks that do not incorporate latches, pins or other similar devices to keep the door in the closed position are permitted to be installed on doors, other than those leading directly from a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] , provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] is equipped with a fire alarm system,
the locking device releases upon actuation of the [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] from the [REF:term:bldng:building's] fire alarm system,
the locking device releases immediately upon loss of power controlling the electromagnetic locking mechanism and its associated auxiliary controls,

except for locking devices installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6:short] , the locking device releases immediately upon actuation of a manually operated switch readily accessible only to authorized personnel,

except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause12:short] , a force of not more than 90 N applied to the door opening hardware initiates an irreversible process that will release the locking device within 15 s and not re-lock until the door has been opened,
upon release, the locking device must be reset manually by the actuation of the switch referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause4:short] ,

a visual information sign complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] is permanently mounted on the door to indicate that the locking device will release within 15 s of applying pressure to the door-opening hardware,

a tactile information sign complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] is permanently mounted near the door to indicate that the locking device will release within 15 s of applying pressure to the door-opening hardware,
the total time delay for all electromagnetic locks in any path of egress to release is not more than 15 s,
where a bypass switch is installed to allow testing of the fire alarm system, actuation of the switch

subclauses.text: can prevent the release of the locking device by the fire alarm system, as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause2:short] , during the test, and

causes an audible and visible signal to be indicated at the fire alarm annunciator panel required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9:long] and at the monitoring station specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent4:long] ,

clauses.text: emergency lighting complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent1:long] is provided, and

where they are installed on doors providing emergency crossover access to [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] from [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art18:long] ,

subclauses.text: the locking device releases immediately upon the operation of a manual station for the fire alarm system located on the wall on the [REF:term:xt:exit] stair side not more than 600 mm from the door,

a visual information sign displaying the words “Re-entry door unlocked by fire alarm” that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] is permanently mounted on the door on the [REF:term:xt:exit] stair side, and

a tactile information sign displaying the words “Re-entry door unlocked by fire alarm” that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] is permanently mounted near the door on the exit stair side.

content.text: Electromagnetic locks that do not incorporate latches, pins or other similar devices to keep the door in the closed position are permitted to be installed on doors in Group B, Division 2 and Division 3 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] , provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] is

subclauses.text: equipped with a fire alarm system, and
[REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] ,

clauses.text: the electromagnetic lock releases upon

subclauses.text: actuation of the [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] from the [REF:term:bldng:building's] fire alarm system,
loss of its power supply and of power to its auxiliary controls,
actuation of a manually operated switch that is readily accessible at a constantly attended location within the locked space, and
actuation of the manual station installed within 0.5 m of each door and equipped with an auxiliary contact, which directly releases the electromagnetic lock,

clauses.text: upon release, the electromagnetic lock requires manual resetting by actuation of the switch referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6.clause2.subclause3:short:Subclause (b)(iii)] ,
a visual information sign complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] that displays the words “Emergency exit unlocked by fire alarm” is permanently mounted on the door,
a tactile information sign complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] that displays the words “Emergency exit unlocked by fire alarm” is permanently mounted near the door,

the operation of any by-pass switch, where provided for testing of the fire alarm system, sets off an audible signal and a visible signal at the fire alarm annunciator panel and at the monitoring station referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:long] , and
emergency lighting complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent1:long] is provided.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent9:long] , door release hardware for the operation of the doors referred to in this Section shall be installed between 900 mm and 1 100 mm above the finished floor.

articles.title: Security for Banks and Mercantile Floor Areas

content.text: If a [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent1:long] are permitted to be waived for [REF:term:xt:exit] and egress doors complying with Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent2:number] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent9:number] that serve a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] used exclusively for

clauses.text: a bank, or
the sale of retail merchandise.

content.text: [REF:term:xt:Exit] and egress doors referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent1:short] shall be designed to prevent locking at any time that the part of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that they serve is open to the public.

A sign with the words “This door shall not be locked at any time that the public is present” in letters not less than 50 mm high shall be permanently affixed to both sides of doors referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent1:short] .

[REF:term:xt:Exit] and egress facilities complying with Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent5:number] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent9:number] shall be incorporated for egress by persons other than the public from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or a part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent1:short] during times when the public is neither present nor being admitted to the area that they serve.
In [REF:term:xt:exit] and egress facilities referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent4:short] , at least one door at each [REF:term:xt:exit] and egress location shall

clauses.text: be operable in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent1:long] , or
be equipped with locks conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5:long] that release immediately

subclauses.text: if an [REF:term:lrt-gnl:alert signal] or [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signal] is initiated in the fire alarm system, or
the sprinkler system is actuated.

content.text: A door referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent5:short] shall be permanently and distinctly marked to indicate that it is an emergency [REF:term:xt:exit] .

[REF:term:xt:Exit] and egress facilities required for evacuation of persons other than the public from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or a part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent1:short] shall have an aggregate width based on the maximum number of persons other than the public and determined in accordance with Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art1:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art3:long:3.4.3.3.]

Travel distance to an [REF:term:xt:exit] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent7:short] shall not exceed the travel distance determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2:long]

[REF:term:xt:Exit] and egress doors serving a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent1:short] are permitted to be equipped with locks that require keys, special devices or specialized knowledge of the door opening mechanism, provided

clauses.text: the doors do not lead into [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs,
the doors do not lead from [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs to the exterior of the [REF:term:bldng:building] ,
the doors do not serve any other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] ,
the area served contains at least one telephone

subclauses.text: that is accessible and in operation at all times,
that is not coin or card operated, and
marked to indicate that it is for emergency use,

clauses.text: the area served is illuminated by normal power or by emergency power when the doors are locked,
there are provisions that enable an announcement to be made throughout the area served before the locks are fastened, and
the locks are designed for use during times that the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not occupied.

articles.title: Emergency Crossover Access to Floor Areas

content.text: Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art18.sent2:short] , doors providing access to [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] from [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs shall not have locking devices to prevent entry into any [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] from which the travel distance up or down to an unlocked door is more than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys.]

Doors referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art18.sent1:short] are permitted to be equipped with electromagnetic locks, provided they comply with Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6:number] .

Doors referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art18.sent1:short] shall be identified by visual and tactile information signs complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] mounted on the stairway side to indicate that they are openable from that side.
Locked doors intended to prevent entry into a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] from an [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shall

clauses.text: be identified by visual and tactile information signs complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] mounted on the stairway side to indicate the location of the nearest unlocked door in each direction of travel, and

be openable with a master key that fits all locking devices and is kept in a designated location accessible to firefighters or be provided with a wired glass panel not less than 0.0645 m^{2} in area and located not more than 300 mm from the door opening hardware.

content.text: Where access to [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] through unlocked doors is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art18.sent1:short] , it shall be possible for a person entering the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to have access through unlocked doors within the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to at least one other [REF:term:xt:exit] .

articles.title: Floor Numbering and Identification of Stair Shafts

content.text: Arabic numerals indicating the assigned floor number in both visual and tactile forms in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] shall be mounted permanently on the wall on the stair side and on the floor side at the latch side of doors to [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shafts.

Upper case letters indicating the designation assigned to each [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shaft in both visual and tactile forms in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] shall be mounted permanently on the wall on the stair side and on the floor side at the latch side of doors to [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shafts.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7.art1.sent2:short] , fire escapes shall not be erected on a [REF:term:bldng:building] .

If it is impracticable to provide one or more of the [REF:term:xt:exit] facilities listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect1.art4:long] , fire escapes conforming to  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7.art2:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7.art7:long] are permitted to serve [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] in an existing [REF:term:bldng:building] provided the [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] served are not more than

clauses.text: 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] above ground level in [REF:term:ca-cc:care] , [REF:term:trtm:treatment] or [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancies] , and
5 [REF:term:tr:storeys] above ground level in other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] .

content.text: Fire escapes shall be of metal or concrete, of the stair type extending to ground level, constructed throughout in a strong substantial manner and securely fixed to the [REF:term:bldng:building] , except that wooden fire escapes are permitted to be used on [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] if all posts and brackets are not less than 89 mm in their least dimension and all other woodwork is not less than 38 mm in its least dimension.

Access to fire escapes shall be from corridors through doors at floor level, except that access from a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is permitted to be through a casement window having an unobstructed opening not less than 1 100 mm high by 550 mm wide with a sill height of not more than 900 mm above the inside floor.
The clear area of a fire escape balcony onto which a door opens, shall be not less than 1 m^{2} .

If a fire escape serves any [REF:term:tr:storey] above the second, openings located in a zone described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7.art4.sent2:short] , including access doorways in the exterior walls of the [REF:term:bldng:building] to which the fire escape is attached, shall be protected by [REF:term:clr:closures] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8:long]
The zone referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7.art4.sent1:short] extends from any balcony, platform or stairway of a fire escape to a distance

clauses.text: 3 m horizontally,
10 m below, or
1.8 m above.
