content.text: Stairs shall be inclined at an angle of not more than 45° with the horizontal, and their steps shall have risers not more than 210 mm high and treads not less than 220 mm wide exclusive of nosing.
Stairway headroom shall be not less than 1 950 mm plus the height of one riser measured vertically above the nosing of any tread or platform.

The width of a fire escape shall conform to  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art1:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art3:long] , except that the width is permitted to be reduced to 550 mm provided the fire escape serves

clauses.text: not more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] , and
not more than 15 persons.

content.text: If a [REF:term:flght:flight] of stairs leading to the ground at the foot of a fire escape is not fixed in position, it shall be held in the raised position without a latch or locking device, and shall be fitted with a counterbalancing device that will permit it to be easily and quickly brought into position for use.

The open sides of every platform, balcony and stairway forming part of a fire escape shall be protected by [REF:term:guard:guards] not less than 920 mm high measured vertically above the nosing of any tread or platform.
The top rail of a [REF:term:guard:guard] is permitted to serve as a handrail if it is free from obstructions which could break a handhold.
A wall handrail shall be installed if the fire escape is more than 550 mm wide.

Unless it can be shown that the size of openings that exceed this limit does not present a hazard, there shall be no opening that permits the passage of a sphere whose diameter is more than 100 mm through a [REF:term:guard:guard] for a fire escape.

Unless it can be shown that the location and size of an opening do not present a hazard, a [REF:term:guard:guard] for a fire escape shall be designed so that no member, attachment or opening located between 140 mm and 900 mm above a platform or the nosing of any tread will facilitate climbing.

Platforms for a fire escape shall be provided in conformance with the requirements for stair landings in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art4:long]
This Section applies to vertical transportation facilities installed in a [REF:term:bldng:building] , including elevators, escalators and dumbwaiters.

Elevators in a [REF:term:bldng:building] within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] shall conform to  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art4:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6:long]

The design, construction, installation and [REF:term:ltrtn:alteration] of every elevator, escalator and dumbwaiter shall conform to the Safety Standards Act and pursuant regulations. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote169:long] .)

Before being placed in service, every elevator, escalator or dumbwaiter installation, including safety and control devices, shall be inspected and tested in accordance with the Safety Standards Act and pursuant regulations. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote169:long] .)
Passenger elevators shall conform to Appendix E of [REF:standard:asmea17.1]

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5.subsect3.art1.sent2:short] , a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] used as an elevator hoistway shall be separated from all other portions of each adjacent [REF:term:tr:storey] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5.subsect3.art1.table1:long] for the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:tr:storey] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:tr:storey] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.title: Fire Separation for Vertical Transportation Space

content.value: [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:Fire-Resistance Rating] of [REF:term:fr-prtn:Fire Separation] Required for Floor Assembly
Minimum [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:Fire-Resistance Rating] of [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:Vertical Service Space] for Elevator Hoistway
Minimum [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:Fire-Resistance Rating] of [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:Vertical Service Space] for Dumbwaiters

content.text: Passenger elevators, other than those provided for firefighters in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5:long] , are permitted to be located within [REF:term:ntrcnnct:interconnected floor space] without being enclosed in a hoistway separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , provided the elevator machinery is located in a room separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for hoistways by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5.subsect3.art1.sent1:short] .

A [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] containing a dumbwaiter shall be separated from all other portions of each adjacent [REF:term:tr:storey] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5.subsect3.art1.table1:long] for the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:tr:storey] or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:tr:storey] , if there is no floor assembly above.

articles.title: Fire Separations for Elevator Machine Rooms

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5.subsect3.art3.sent2:short] , a room containing elevator machinery shall be separated from all other parts of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] containing the elevator hoistway.

A room containing elevator machinery need not be separated from the elevator hoistway that it serves provided the room and the hoistway are separated from all other parts of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] containing the elevator hoistway.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5.subsect4.art1.sent2:short] , if one or more elevators are provided in a [REF:term:bldng:building] , at least one elevator on each [REF:term:tr:storey] with access to an elevator shall have inside dimensions that will accommodate and provide adequate access for a patient stretcher 2 010 mm long and 610 mm wide in the prone position. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote170:short] .)

The inside dimensions stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5.subsect4.art1.sent1:short] do not apply to limited-use/limited-application elevators designed and installed in accordance with [REF:standard:asmea17.1]
An elevator satisfying the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5.subsect4.art1.sent1:short] shall be clearly identified on the main entrance level of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .
Arabic numerals indicating the assigned floor number shall be mounted permanently on both jambs of passenger elevator hoistway entrances in conformance with Appendix E of [REF:standard:asmea17.1]

The provisions of this Section apply to [REF:term:hrzntl-r:horizontal service spaces] , [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service spaces] , [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof spaces] , ducts, crawl spaces, shaft spaces, [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] , and mechanical penthouses, and facilities contained therein.
The installation of electrical wiring and electrical equipment shall conform to the requirements of the Safety Standards Act and pursuant regulations.
A lightning protection system, when provided, shall conform to the requirements of CAN/CSA-B72-M, "Installation Code for Lightning Protection Systems."
[REF:term:rvc-pc:Service spaces] shall not be designed to facilitate subsequent use as storage space.
A fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliance] installed on the roof of a [REF:term:bldng:building] or in another location outside the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be installed not less than

clauses.text: 1.2 m from a property line, measured horizontally, and

3 m from an adjacent wall of the same [REF:term:bldng:building] if that wall contains any opening within 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] above and 5 m horizontally from the [REF:term:pplnc:appliance] , unless every opening within these limits is protected by

subclauses.text: a [REF:term:clr:closure] having a [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] not less than 45 min determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art4:long] , or
a wired glass assembly permitted for use in a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] and described in  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD.appsect2.subsect3.article15:medium] of Appendix D.

content.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art1.sent2:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art1.sent8:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art1.sent9:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art1.sent10:short] , fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] shall be installed in [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art1.sent3:short] , a fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliance] that serves only one room or [REF:term:t:suite] is not required to be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

A solid-fuel-burning [REF:term:pplnc:appliance] shall not be located in a [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garage] , a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] , or any other location where it could be exposed to flammable vapours or gases, unless

clauses.text: it is enclosed in a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h ,
it is supplied with combustion air directly from outside the [REF:term:bldng:building] , and
the heat that it generates is supplied indirectly to the space served by means of ducts or piping.

content.text: A [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] containing an incinerator shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h .

Equipment that uses a liquid having a [REF:term:flh-pnt:flash point] below 93.3°C shall be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

Electrical equipment that is required to be located in a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] according to the Safety Standards Act and pursuant regulations shall be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art1.sent8:short] , in a [REF:term:tr:storey] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] that contains service equipment other than that addressed by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art1.sent1:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art1.sent6:short] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .

Where a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] contains a limited quantity of service equipment, and the service equipment neither constitutes a fire hazard nor is essential to the operation of fire safety systems in the [REF:term:bldng:building] , the requirements for a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] shall not apply.
A [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is not required between a fireplace and the space it serves.
A [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is not required between a rooftop [REF:term:pplnc:appliance] and the [REF:term:bldng:building] it serves.

A [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] containing service equipment subject to possible explosion, such as [REF:term:blr:boilers] operating in excess of 100 kPa (gauge) and some types of refrigerating machinery and transformers, shall not be located directly under a required [REF:term:xt:exit] .

A [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] containing space heating, space cooling and service water heating [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] is permitted to contain other service equipment such as electrical service equipment.
A [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] containing an incinerator shall not contain other fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] .

articles.title: Storage of Combustible Refuse and Recycling

content.text: Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art3.sent9:long] , a room for the temporary storage of [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] refuse and materials for recycling shall be

clauses.text: separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h , except that a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min is permitted where the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the floor assembly is not required to exceed 45 min , and
[REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

content.text: A swing-type door from a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] containing a [REF:term:blr:boiler] or incinerator shall swing outward from the room, except that the door shall swing inward if the door opens onto a corridor or any room used for an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] . (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art4.sent7:long] .)

An electrical equipment vault required by the Safety Standards Act and pursuant regulations shall conform to Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art7.sent2:number] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art7.sent8:number] .

An electrical equipment vault referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art7.sent1:short] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] of [REF:term:sld-m:solid masonry] or concrete construction having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than

clauses.text: 3 h if the vault is not protected by an automatic fire extinguishing system, or
2 h if the vault is protected by an automatic fire extinguishing system.

content.text: If a [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, an electrical equipment vault referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art7.sent1:short] need not be [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] provided

clauses.text: the vault is designed for no purpose other than to contain the electrical equipment, and
the vault contains a [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detector] which will actuate the [REF:term:bldng:building] fire alarm system in the event of a fire in the vault.

content.text: Only pipes or ducts necessary for fire protection or the proper operation of the electrical installation shall penetrate the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art7.sent2:short] .

Explosion-relief devices and vents or other protective measures conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art21.sent3:long] shall be provided for an electrical equipment vault referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art7.sent1:short] that contains dielectric-liquid-filled electrical equipment. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote172:short] .)

An electrical equipment vault referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art7.sent1:short] shall be provided with a ventilation system designed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6:short] to prevent the ambient temperature in the vault from exceeding 40°C .

The ventilation system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art7.sent6:short] shall be separate from the system for the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] and shall be designed so that it is automatically shut off in the event of a fire in the vault.

The floor of an electrical equipment vault referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect2.art7.sent1:short] shall be liquid tight and surrounded by liquid tight walls and sills of sufficient height to confine within the vault all of the liquid from the largest item of electrical equipment, but to a height of not less than 100 mm .
Electrical equipment vaults shall be secured against unauthorized entry.

Where a generator intended to supply emergency power for lighting, fire safety and life safety systems is located in a [REF:term:bldng:building] , except where such [REF:term:bldng:building] is used solely for the purpose of housing the generator and its ancillary equipment, it shall be located in a room that

clauses.text: is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h, and
contains only the generating set and equipment related to the emergency power supply system.

subsections.title: Vertical Service Spaces and Service Facilities

articles.title: Fire Separations for Vertical Service Spaces

content.text: Except as provided in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5:long] , a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] shall be separated from all other portions of each adjacent [REF:term:tr:storey] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art1.table1:long] for the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:tr:storey] , or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:tr:storey] , if there is no floor assembly above.

content.title: Fire Separations for Vertical Service Spaces

content.value: [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:Fire-Resistance Rating] of [REF:term:fr-prtn:Fire Separation] Required for Floor Assembly

content.text: A [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] that does not extend through the roof of a [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be enclosed at the top with construction having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] walls.

A [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] that does not extend to the bottom of a [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be enclosed at the lowest level with construction having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] walls.

A vent from a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] not extending to the roof shall be enclosed within the [REF:term:bldng:building] with construction having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] walls.
Only openings that are necessary for the use of the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] shall be permitted through a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] enclosure.
Foamed plastic insulation in a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] shall be protected in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art15:long]
A linen chute or refuse chute shall

clauses.text: be impervious to moisture,
have a smooth internal surface,
be corrosion-resistant,
be constructed of [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material, and
be located in a shaft in which there are no services other than [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] drain, waste and vent piping or [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] water piping.

content.text: A shaft containing a linen chute or refuse chute shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art1.sent1:long] , but not less than

clauses.text: 1 h if the chute outlet for the discharge room is protected by an automatic, self-latching [REF:term:clr:closure] held open by a fusible link, or
2 h if no [REF:term:clr:closure] is provided at the chute outlet into the discharge room.

content.text: An interior linen chute or refuse chute shall extend not less than 1 m above the roof and shall be vented above the roof with a vent which

clauses.text: has an unobstructed area not less than the cross-sectional area of the chute, and
is equipped with a cover that will open automatically, or that can be opened manually, in the event of a fire in the chute.

content.text: Intake openings for a linen chute or a refuse chute shall

clauses.text: have an area not more than 60% of the cross-sectional area of the chute, and
be fitted with [REF:term:clr:closures] designed to close automatically and latch after use.

content.text: Intake openings for a linen chute or a refuse chute shall be located in rooms or compartments that

clauses.text: have no dimension less than 750 mm ,
are separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min ,
are designed for no other purpose, and
do not open directly into an [REF:term:xt:exit] .

content.text: Sprinklers shall be installed at the top of each linen chute or refuse chute, at alternate floor levels and in the room or bin into which the chute discharges.

The room into which a linen chute discharges shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h .
A refuse chute shall be equipped at the top with spray equipment for washing-down purposes.

A refuse chute shall discharge only into a room or bin separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h .

The room or bin into which a refuse chute discharges shall be of sufficient size to contain the refuse between normal intervals of emptying, be impervious to moisture and be equipped with a water connection and floor drain for washing-down purposes.
A room into which a refuse chute discharges shall contain no service equipment that is not related to refuse handling and disposal.
If a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] contains an [REF:term:xht-dct:exhaust duct] that serves more than one [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] ,

clauses.text: the duct shall have a fan located at or near the exhaust outlet to ensure that the duct is under negative pressure, and
the individual [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] shall not have individual fans that exhaust directly into the duct in the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] .

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art5.sent2:short] , [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] enclosing grease ducts for commercial cooking operations shall conform to [REF:standard:nfpa96]
The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of field-applied and factory-built grease duct enclosure assemblies shall be determined in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs144]

subsections.title: Horizontal Service Spaces and Service Facilities

content.text: This Subsection applies to [REF:term:hrzntl-r:horizontal service spaces] and service facilities, including ceiling spaces, duct spaces, crawl spaces and [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof spaces] .

articles.title: Fire Separations for Horizontal Service Spaces

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art5:long] , a [REF:term:hrzntl-r:horizontal service space] that penetrates a required vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] it serves in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4.art2.sent2:short] .

If a [REF:term:hrzntl-r:horizontal service space] or other concealed space is located above a required vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] other than a vertical shaft, this space need not be divided at the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art3:long] provided the construction between this space and the space below is a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] equivalent to that required for the vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , except that the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] is permitted to be not less than 30 min if the vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] more than 45 min . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote175:short] .)

A concealed space used as a [REF:term:plnm:plenum] within a floor assembly or within a roof assembly need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art18.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art1:long] , provided

clauses.text: all materials within the concealed space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not more than 25 and a smoke developed classification not more than 50, except for

subclauses.text: tubing for pneumatic controls,

optical fibre cables and electrical wires and cables with [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] insulation, jackets or sheathes that are used for the transmission of voice, sound or data and conform to  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art3.sent2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art21.sent2:long] ,

totally enclosed non-metallic raceways with an FT6 rating, when tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art23.sent1.clause1:long] , in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] or in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or parts of [REF:term:bldng:buildings] permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] , and

totally enclosed non-metallic raceways with an FT4 rating, when tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art23.sent1.clause1:long] , in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] , and

clauses.text: the supports for the ceiling membrane are of [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material having a melting point not below 760°C .

content.text: If a concealed space referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4.art3.sent1:short] is used as a return-air [REF:term:plnm:plenum] and incorporates a ceiling membrane that forms part of the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the assembly, every opening through the membrane shall be protected by a [REF:term:fr-tp-fl:fire stop flap] that

clauses.text: stops the flow of air into the concealed space in the event of a fire,
is supported in a manner that will maintain the integrity of the ceiling membrane for the duration of time required to provide the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] ,
conforms to [REF:standard:ulcs1122] and
activates at a temperature approximately 30°C above the normal maximum temperature that occurs in the return-air [REF:term:plnm:plenum] , whether the air duct system is operating or shut down.

content.text: An [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] more than 600 mm high shall be provided with access from the floor immediately below by a hatchway not less than 550 mm by 900 mm or by a stairway.

A [REF:term:hrzntl-r:horizontal service space] , consisting of ceiling and duct spaces, which is more than 1 200 mm high and 600 mm wide shall have inspection doors not less than 300 mm in both horizontal and vertical dimensions placed so that the entire interior of the duct or space can be viewed.
A crawl space shall have at least one access opening not less than 550 mm by 900 mm .

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art1.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art1.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4.art3:long] , all ducts, duct connectors, associated fittings and [REF:term:plnm:plenums] used in air duct systems shall be constructed of steel, aluminum alloy, copper, clay or other [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art1.sent3:short] , ducts, associated fittings and [REF:term:plnm:plenums] are permitted to contain [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] material provided they

clauses.text: conform to the appropriate requirements for Class 1 duct materials in [REF:standard:ulcs110]

conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art18:long] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] or in a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] ,
conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9:long] ,

are used only in horizontal runs in a [REF:term:bldng:building] required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] or in a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] ,
are not used in vertical runs serving more than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] , and
are not used in air duct systems in which the air temperature could be more than 120°C .

content.text: [REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] ducts which are part of a duct system conveying only ventilation air and are contained entirely within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] need not comply with the requirements of  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art1.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art1.sent2:short] .
Duct sealants shall have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not more than 25 and a smoke developed classification not more than 50.
Duct connectors that contain [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] materials and that are used between ducts and air outlet units shall

clauses.text: conform to the appropriate requirements for Class 1 air duct materials in [REF:standard:ulcs110]
be not more than 4 m long,
be used only in horizontal runs, and
not penetrate a required [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art2.sent2:short] , vibration isolation connectors in air duct systems shall be [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] .
[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] fabric vibration isolation connectors are permitted provided they

clauses.text: are not more than 250 mm long,
comply with the flame-resistance requirements of [REF:standard:ulcs109] and
are not used in a location where they are exposed to heated air or radiation from heat sources that could cause the exposed surface temperature to be more than 120°C .

content.text: Tape used to seal joints in air ducts, [REF:term:plnm:plenums] and other parts of air duct systems shall meet the flame-resistance requirements for fabric in [REF:standard:ulcs109]

Coverings, linings and associated adhesives and insulation for air ducts, [REF:term:plnm:plenums] and other parts of air duct systems that would have an exposed surface temperature more than 120°C when exposed to heated air or radiation from heat sources shall be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art4.sent3:short] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] coverings and linings, including associated adhesives and insulation, shall have

clauses.text: a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not more than 25 on any exposed surface, or any surface that would be exposed by cutting through the material in any direction, and
a smoke developed classification not more than 50.

content.text: The outer covering of ducts, [REF:term:plnm:plenums] and other parts of air duct systems used within an assembly of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] is permitted to have

clauses.text: an exposed surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not more than 75, and
a smoke developed classification not more than 50.

content.text: [REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] coverings and linings referred to in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art4.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art4.sent3:short] shall not flame, glow, smoulder or smoke when tested in accordance with the method of test in [REF:standard:astmc411] at the maximum temperature to which the coverings and linings are to be exposed in service.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art4.sent6:short] , foamed plastic insulation shall not be used as part of an air duct system or for insulating an air duct.

Foamed plastic insulation is permitted to be installed in a ceiling space that is used as a return air [REF:term:plnm:plenum] provided the foamed plastic insulation is protected from exposure to the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art15:long]

[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] coverings and linings of ducts, including associated adhesives and insulation, shall be interrupted where the duct penetrates a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] and at the immediate area of operation of heat sources in a duct system, including electric resistance heaters or fuel-burning heaters or [REF:term:frnc:furnaces] .
Insulation and coverings on pipes in which the temperature of the fluid exceeds 120°C shall

clauses.text: be made of [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material, or
not flame, glow, smoulder or smoke when tested in accordance with [REF:standard:astmc411] at the maximum temperature to which the insulation or covering is to be exposed in service.

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art5.sent5:short] , where [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] insulation is used on piping in a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal service space] or a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] , the insulation and coverings on that piping shall have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] , on any exposed surface and on any surface that would be exposed by cutting through the material in any direction,

clauses.text: not more than 25 in a [REF:term:bldng:building] required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] or in a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr:encapsulated mass timber construction] , or
not more than 75 in a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] .

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art5.sent5:short] , insulation and coverings on piping located in rooms and spaces other than the [REF:term:rvc-pc:service spaces] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art5.sent2:short] shall have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not more than that required for the interior finish of the ceiling of the room or space.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art5.sent5:short] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] insulation and covering used on piping in a [REF:term:bldng:building] within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] shall have a smoke developed classification not more than 100.
No [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] or smoke developed classification limits are required for [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] insulation and coverings used on piping located within a

clauses.text: concealed space in a wall,
floor slab, or
[REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] enclosure.

content.text: The clearance of [REF:term:frnc:furnace]  [REF:term:plnm:plenums] from [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] material shall conform to the requirements of the appropriate standards referenced in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect2.subsect1.art5.sent1:long] .

If the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] clearance required in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art6.sent1:short] is not more than 75 mm , the clearance between a [REF:term:ppl-dct:supply duct] and [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] material shall be not less than

clauses.text: the required [REF:term:plnm:plenum] clearance within a horizontal distance of 450 mm from the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] , and

12 mm at a horizontal distance of 450 mm or more from the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] , except that this clearance is permitted to be reduced to zero beyond a bend or offset in the duct sufficiently large to shield the remainder of the [REF:term:ppl-dct:supply duct] from direct radiation from the [REF:term:frnc:furnace] heat exchanger.

content.text: If the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] clearance required in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art6.sent1:short] is more than 75 mm but not more than 150 mm , the clearance between a [REF:term:ppl-dct:supply duct] and [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] material shall be not less than

clauses.text: the required [REF:term:plnm:plenum] clearance within a horizontal distance of 1 800 mm from the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] , and

12 mm at a horizontal distance of 1 800 mm or more from the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] , except that this distance is permitted to be reduced to zero beyond a bend or offset in the duct sufficiently large to shield the remainder of the [REF:term:ppl-dct:supply duct] from direct radiation from the [REF:term:frnc:furnace] heat exchanger.

content.text: If the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] clearance required in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art6.sent1:short] is more than 150 mm , the clearance between a [REF:term:ppl-dct:supply duct] and [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] material shall be not less than

clauses.text: the required [REF:term:plnm:plenum] clearance within a horizontal distance of 1 000 mm from the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] ,
150 mm within a horizontal distance between 1 000 mm and 1 800 mm from the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] , and

25 mm at a horizontal distance of 1 800 mm or more from the [REF:term:plnm:plenum] , except that this distance is permitted to be reduced to 8 mm beyond a bend or offset in the duct sufficiently large to shield the remainder of the [REF:term:ppl-dct:supply duct] from direct radiation from the [REF:term:frnc:furnace] heat exchanger.

content.text: If a register is installed in a floor directly over a pipeless [REF:term:frnc:furnace] , a double-walled register box with not less than 100 mm between walls, or a register box with the warm-air passage completely surrounded by the cold-air passage, shall be permitted instead of the clearances listed in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art6.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art6.sent4:short] .

articles.title: Supply, Return, Intake and Exhaust-Air Openings

content.text: [REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] grilles, diffusers and other devices for supply, return, and exhaust-air openings in rooms shall conform to the [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] and smoke developed classification requirements for the interior finish of the surface on which they are installed.

Except as required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art8.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art8.sent3:short] , [REF:term:rtrn-dct:return ducts] shall be constructed of material having a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not more than 150.

If any part of a [REF:term:rtrn-dct:return duct] will be exposed to radiation from the [REF:term:frnc:furnace] heat exchanger or other radiating part within the [REF:term:frnc:furnace] , that part of a [REF:term:rtrn-dct:return duct] directly above or within 600 mm of the outside [REF:term:frnc:furnace] casing shall be [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] .
[REF:term:rtrn-dct:Return ducts] serving solid-fuel-burning [REF:term:frnc:furnaces] shall be constructed of [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material.
[REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible]  [REF:term:rtrn-dct:return ducts] shall be lined with [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material

clauses.text: below floor registers,
at the bottom of vertical ducts, and
under [REF:term:frnc:furnaces] having a bottom return.

content.text: The height of every room and space shall be sufficient so that the ceiling or ceiling fixtures do not obstruct movement or activities below.
The unobstructed height in [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect5.subsect3:long]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art1.sent2:short] , for the purpose of this Subsection, the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] shall be determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17:long]

For the purpose of this Subsection, the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] for [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] that are classified as an [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancy] is permitted to be based solely on the total number of staff for which the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is designed, where the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is only intermittently occupied or where the presence of occupants is transitory. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote179:short] .)

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art1.sent4:short] , if the installation of a [REF:term:ntr-drng:sanitary drainage system] is not possible because of the absence of a water supply, sanitary privies, chemical closets or other means for the disposal of human waste shall be provided.
Waterless urinals are permitted to be used in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] provided with a water supply.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent2:short] , water closets shall be provided for each sex assuming that the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] is equally divided between males and females, unless the proportion of each sex expected in the [REF:term:bldng:building] can be determined with reasonable accuracy.

Both sexes are permitted to be served by a single water closet if the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] in an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] referred to in  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent4:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent8:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent10:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent11:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent12:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent14:short] is not more than 10.

Urinals are permitted to be substituted for two thirds of the number of water closets required by this Article for males, except that if only 2 water closets are required for males, one urinal is permitted to be substituted for one of the water closets.

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent2:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent6:short] , the number of water closets required for [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancies] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.table1:long:Table 3.7.2.2.-A] .

content.value: Number of Persons of Each Sex
7, plus 1 for each additional increment of 200 males in excess of 400
13, plus 1 for each additional increment of 100 females in excess of 400

content.text: The number of water closets required for primary schools and daycare facilities, including daycare facilities for children shall be at least one for each 30 males and one for each 25 females.
The number of water closets required for places of worship and undertaking premises shall be at least one for each 150 persons of each sex.

The number of water closets required for a [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment] or [REF:term:dtnt-cc:detention occupancy] shall be determined on the basis of the special needs of the [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] .

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent5:short] , the number of water closets required for a [REF:term:ca-cc:care] or [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall be at least one for each 10 persons of each sex.
At least one water closet shall be provided for each [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.sent2:short] , the number of water closets required for a [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.table2:long:Table 3.7.2.2.-B] .

content.value: Number of Persons of Each Sex

content.text: In a [REF:term:bldng:building] whose [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is more than 600 m^{2} and that includes one or more individual tenant spaces for a [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] or [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancy] , water closets shall be located so that they are accessible to the public when the [REF:term:bldng:building] is occupied.

The number of water closets required in a [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancy] whose area is not more than 500 m^{2} is permitted to be determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2.table2:long:Table 3.7.2.2.-B] based solely on the total number of staff.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art3.sent2:short] , at least one lavatory shall be provided in a room containing one or 2 water closets or urinals, and at least one additional lavatory shall be provided for each additional 2 water closets or urinals.

Wash fountains in circular form are permitted to be provided in lieu of lavatories required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art3.sent1:short] provided each 500 mm of circumference is considered to be the equivalent of one lavatory.
Any shelf or projection above a lavatory shall be located so that it will not be a hazard.
Lavatories required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art3.sent1:short] shall be equipped with faucets that

clauses.text: operate automatically, or
have a manual control that

subclauses.text: complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] ,
does not require the application of continuous force to maintain water flow, and
where metered, provides at least 10 s of water flow.

content.text: Glazing used for a shower or bathtub enclosure shall conform to Class A of [REF:standard:cgsb-12.1]

Wall and floor surfaces below the uppermost surfaces of a urinal shall be protected from deterioration by impervious and durable material for a distance from the urinal to a point not less than 900 mm from the projected outline of the urinal on to the wall or floor.

Floor surfaces around a water closet shall be protected from deterioration by an impervious and durable material for a distance not less than 900 mm from the projected outline of the water closet on the floor.
A floor drain shall be installed in a washroom containing a urinal equipped with an automatic flushing device.
Grab bars shall

clauses.text: be slip-resistant and free of any sharp or abrasive elements,
be mounted on surfaces that are free of any sharp or abrasive elements,
be able to resist a load of not less than 1.3 kN applied vertically or horizontally,
be 30 mm to 40 mm in diameter, and
where mounted on a wall, have a clearance of 35 mm to 45 mm from the wall.

content.text: Where a bathtub is installed in a hotel or a motel, it shall

clauses.text: have a clear floor space at least 750 mm wide along its length, except that a water closet and a lavatory are permitted to project into this space provided they do not restrict access to the bathtub,
have faucets and other controls that conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] ,
have a slip-resistant bottom surface,
have grab bars that

subclauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7.sent1:long] ,
are not less than 1 200 mm long located vertically at the end of the bathtub that is adjacent to the clear floor space, with the lower end between 180 mm and 280 mm above the bathtub rim, and
are not less than 1 200 mm long located horizontally along the length of the bathtub at 180 mm to 280 mm above the bathtub rim, and

clauses.text: be capable of being accessed along its full length with no tracks mounted on the bathtub rim.

content.text: If a non-flammable medical gas piping system is installed, it shall be installed in conformance with

clauses.text: [REF:standard:csaz7396.1] and
Part 3 of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code.

content.text: This Section is concerned with the design and construction of [REF:term:bldng:buildings] and [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] to make them [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible] .

[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] and facilities required to be [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2:long] shall be designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]
[REF:term:ltrtn:Alterations] and additions to existing [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4:long]
[REF:term:dwllng-n:Dwelling units] required to be [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling units] shall be designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5:long]
Except as required by Sentence (2), the requirements of this Section apply to all [REF:term:bldng:buildings] except

clauses.text: detached houses, semi-detached houses, houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] , duplexes, triplexes, townhouses, row houses and boarding houses (see [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.appendix.appnote7.div16:long] , Secondary Suite),
[REF:term:bldng:buildings] of Group F, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] , and
[REF:term:bldng:buildings] that are not intended to be occupied on a daily or full-time basis, including automatic telephone exchanges, pumphouses and substations.

content.text: [REF:term:dwllng-n:Dwelling units] of [REF:term:bldng:buildings] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause1:long] , as well as [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] in apartment and condominium [REF:term:bldng:buildings] that are not designed as [REF:term:adptbl-dwllng-n:adaptable dwelling units] , shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art1.sent2:long] . content.text: Except for service entrances and entrances to [REF:term:t:suites] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent2.clause12:long] , all pedestrian entrances to an [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible]  [REF:term:tr:storey] of a [REF:term:bldng:building] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art1.sent1:long] shall be [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible] and shall connect to an [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible] exterior path of travel complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art5.sent1:long] .

An [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible] entrance required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art2.sent1:short] shall be designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]

At an [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible] entrance that includes more than one doorway, only one of the doorways is required to be designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]

If a [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] or pedestrian bridge connects two [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible]  [REF:term:tr:storeys] in different [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , the path of travel from one [REF:term:tr:storey] to the other [REF:term:tr:storey] by means of the [REF:term:wlkw:walkway] or bridge shall be [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible] .

to crawl spaces,

to the floor level above or below the entrance level in [REF:term:t:suites] with more than one level, provided the floor level above or below (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote185:short] )

in a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] that is not more than two [REF:term:tr:storeys] that contains multiple [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and common interior space served by a common [REF:term:bldng:building] entrance, on a floor level that

is less than 600 m^{2} in [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] ,
is not a [REF:term:bldng:building] entrance level, and
does not contain common facilities that are not also provided on an [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible] level.

content.text: In an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] , the number of spaces designated for wheelchair use within rooms or areas with fixed seats shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.table1:long] (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art22:long] for additional requirements.)

The number of spaces designated for wheelchair use within waiting rooms or areas with fixed seats shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.table1:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote186:short] .) (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art22:long] for additional requirements.)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent6:short] , in an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] with more than 25 fixed seats, each row of seats served by two aisles shall have one adaptable seat conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] located adjacent to one of the aisles. At least 5% of the adaptable seats required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent5:short] but no more than 20 adaptable seats shall adjoin an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote187:short] .)

content.text: In a [REF:term:bldng:building] in which escalator or inclined moving walk provides access to any floor level, an interior [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall also be provided to that floor level. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote188:short] .)

The route from escalator or inclined moving walk to the [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel that leads from floor to floor as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art4.sent1:short] shall be clearly indicated by appropriate signs.

content.text: A direct exterior [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] shall be provided between an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] entrance referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art2:long] and

clauses.text: a designated [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] parking area, where provided,
an exterior passenger-loading zone, where provided,
common ancillary [REF:term:bldng:buildings] on the lot, and
a public thoroughfare. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote189:short] .)

Exterior passenger-loading zones shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]

Electrical outlets that are intended for general occupant use shall be located in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote.a3.8.2.6.2:short:Note A-3.8.2.6.(2)] .)

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art7.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art7.sent3:short] , and except for doors provided with hold-open devices, doors equipped with a self-closing device shall be equipped with power door operators complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short] that allow persons to activate the opening of the doors in the intended direction of travel, where the doors are located

in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel, between the entrance referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art7.sent1.clause1:short] and the entrance doors to [REF:term:t:suites] or rooms served by a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or a corridor used by the public (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote192:short] ), and
