(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote195:short] .)

Where a bathtub is installed in a [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] required to be [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] , it shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]

In [REF:term:bldng:buildings] containing Group A, Group B, Division 2 or Group E [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] where at least one of these [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] has an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of more than 500, at least one universal washroom on the [REF:term:tr:storey] on which the main [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] entrance to the [REF:term:bldng:building] is located shall incorporate an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] change space conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote198:short] .)

In [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] or parts of [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] designed to be [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] and used predominantly by children, in patient areas in [REF:term:trtm-cc:treatment occupancies] , and in resident areas in [REF:term:ca-cc:care occupancies] , it is permissible to design and locate plumbing fixtures and grab bars differently than described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short] to accommodate the special needs of children, patients, residents, and [REF:term:ca:care] providers.

In a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] , all classrooms, auditoria, meeting rooms and [REF:term:thtr:theatres] with an area of more than 100 m^{2} , including courtrooms of any size, shall be equipped with an assistive listening system complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]

In each location where information, goods or services are provided to the public at service counters in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] , at least one of the service counters shall be equipped with (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote197:short] .)

clauses.text: an assistive listening system or adaptive technology conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] , and
an amplification system, where there is a barrier to communication, such as a glass screen.

content.text: Unless the degree of [REF:term:ccs:access] provided is such as to make these signs unnecessary, signs providing visual information in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] shall be installed to indicate the location of

clauses.text: [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] entrances,
alternate [REF:term:ccs:access] routes,
[REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] spaces in seating areas,
[REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] refreshment facilities,
[REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] checkout lanes,
[REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] public telephones,
[REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] washrooms,
[REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] showers,
[REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] passenger-elevating devices,
[REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] parking spaces,
[REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] passenger loading zones, and
assistive listening systems or adaptive technologies.

content.text: Where a washroom is not designed to accommodate persons with physical disabilities in a [REF:term:tr:storey] to which an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel is required, signs providing visual and tactile information in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] shall be installed to indicate the location of [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] washrooms.

Except for doors that serve [REF:term:rvc-pc:service spaces] or are located within a [REF:term:t:suite] , signs installed at or near doors shall provide the same information in both visual and tactile forms in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]
Directional signs shall provide visual information in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote198:short] .)

Where a service counter is provided, at least one section of it shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote199:short] .) (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote184:long] )
In each location where one or more public telephones are installed, at least one telephone shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]
At least one for every 20 or part thereof of sleeping rooms or bed spaces shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short] where provided in

clauses.text: hotels and motels (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent1.clause7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent8:short] ), and

not including apartments and condominiums and the [REF:term:bldng:buildings] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause1:short] , other [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or parts of [REF:term:bldng:buildings] used for [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential major occupancies] (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent17:short] ).

content.text: [REF:term:bldng:Buildings] or parts thereof and facilities that are required to be [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] shall be designed in accordance with (See Note A-3.8.3.1.(1).)

clauses.text: this Subsection, or

for each [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] application listed independent of other [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] applications, the applicable provisions of [REF:standard:csab651:CSA B651] , “Accessible design for the built environment,” listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.table1:long] .

content.text: The design of each [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] application listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.table1:long] shall comply entirely with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent1.clause1:short:Clause (1)(a)] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent1.clause2:short:Clause (1)(b)] .

Except as required elsewhere in this Part or as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6:long] pertaining to doorways, the clear width of an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall be not less than 1 000 mm .

The clear width of an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel is permitted to be reduced to not less than 850 mm for a length of not more than 600 mm , provided the clear floor space at either end of the reduced-clear width section is level within a rectangular area

clauses.text: whose dimension parallel to each end of the reduced-clear width section is not less than 1 000 mm , and
whose dimension perpendicular to each end of the reduced-clear width section is not less than 1 500 mm .

content.text: Interior and exterior walking surfaces that are within an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall (See Note A-3.8.3.2.(3).)

clauses.text: have no opening that will permit the passage of a sphere more than 13 mm in diameter,
have any elongated openings oriented approximately perpendicular to the direction of travel,
be stable, firm and slip-resistant,
have a cross slope no steeper than 1 in 50,
be beveled at a maximum slope of 1 in 2 at changes in level between 6 mm and 13 mm ,
be provided with sloped floors or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] at changes in level more than 13 mm , and
be designed as a ramp complying with this Section where the path of travel has a slope steeper than 1 in 20.

content.text: An [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel is permitted to include [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , passenger elevators or other platform-equipped passenger-elevating devices to overcome a difference in level.
The width of an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel that is more than 24 m long shall be increased to not less than 1 700 mm for a length of 1 700 mm at intervals not exceeding 24 m .
Where a section of an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel is less than 1 500 mm wide for a distance of more than 12 m , it shall end in a clear floor space that is (See Note A-3.8.3.2.(6).)

clauses.text: not less than 1 700 mm in diameter,
not less than 1 700 mm by 1 500 mm , or

T-shaped with overall dimensions measuring 1 700 mm wide by 1 500 mm long, where the two arms of the “T” are not less than 1 000 mm wide and extend not less than 300 mm from each side of the base of the “T” and the base is not less than 1 000 mm wide and extends not less than 500 mm from each arm.

content.text: An [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall be equipped to provide illumination in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent1:medium] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent2:medium] . (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent3:medium] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect34.subsect2.art7:long] .)
Exterior walks that form part of an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall

clauses.text: have a slip-resistant, continuous and even surface,
be not less than 1 600 mm wide ,
have a level area conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause3:long] adjacent to an entrance doorway, and
be designed in accordance with [REF:external:csab651:Clause 8.2.1 of ] [REF:standard:csab651:CSA B651, “Accessible design for the built environment.”]

content.text: If a passenger-loading zone is provided, it shall have

clauses.text: an access aisle not less than 1 500 mm wide and 6 000 mm long adjacent and parallel to the vehicle pull-up space,

a curb ramp, designed in accordance with Clause 8.3.3 of [REF:standard:csab651:CSA B651] , “Accessible design for the built environment,” where there are curbs between the access aisle and the vehicle pull-up space, and
a clear height of not less than 2 750 mm at the pull-up space and along the vehicle access and egress routes.

content.text: Except when designed as a curb ramp in accordance with Clause 3.8.3.4.(1)(b), a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] located in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall (see Note A-3.8.3.5.(1)(c)),

clauses.text: have a clear width not less than 1 000 mm (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote155:long] ),
have a uniform slope along its length not more than 1 in 12 (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote204:short] ),

have a level area not less than 1 700 mm by 1 700 mm at the top and bottom and at intermediate levels of a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] leading to a door, so that on the latch side the level area extends not less than

subclauses.text: 600 mm beyond the edge of the door opening where the door opens towards the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , or
300 mm beyond the edge of the door opening where the door opens away from the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] ,

clauses.text: have a level area not less than 1 350 mm long and at least the same width as the [REF:term:rmp:ramp]

subclauses.text: at intervals not more than 9 m along its length, and
where there is an abrupt change in the direction of the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , and

clauses.text: except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent3:short] , be equipped with handrails conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5:long] , except that they shall be not less than 865 mm and not more than 965 mm high, and
be equipped with [REF:term:guard:guards] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art6:long]

content.text: Handrails installed in addition to required handrails need not comply with the height requirements stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause5:medium] .
The requirement for handrails in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause5:medium] need not apply to a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] serving as an aisle for fixed seating.
The surfaces of [REF:term:rmp:ramps] and landings shall

clauses.text: be hard or resilient where the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] is steeper than 1 in 15 (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote206:short] ),
have a cross slope no steeper than 1 in 50 , and
where exposed to water, be designed to drain.

content.text: [REF:term:rmp:Ramps] and landings not at ground level or adjacent to a wall shall have edge protection consisting of

clauses.text: a curb not less than 75 mm high, or
a raised barrier or rail located not more than 100 mm from the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] or landing surface.

content.text: Except where stated otherwise, this Article applies to swinging and sliding doors.
Every doorway that is located in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall have a clear width not less than 850 mm

clauses.text: for swinging doors, when measured from the face of the active leaf, in the open position of 90° to the doorway, to the outside edge of the stop on the door frame, and
for sliding doors, when measured from the edge of the door, in the open position, to the outside of the stop on the door frame.

content.text: Doorways in a path of travel to at least one bathroom within a [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall have a clear width not less than 850 mm when measured in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent2:short] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote208:short] .)
Door-operating devices shall (See also Sentence 3.3.1.13.(4) regarding additional devices.) (See Note A-3.8.3.6.(4).)

clauses.text: comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] , and
be operable at a height between 900 mm and 1 100 mm above the floor.

content.text: A threshold for a doorway referred to in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent3:short] shall be not more than 13 mm higher than the finished floor surface and shall be beveled to facilitate the passage of wheelchairs.
Power door operators required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art7.sent1:long] shall

clauses.text: activate automatically or through the use of controls that

subclauses.text: are located in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel,
are marked with the International Symbol of Access,
are located clear of the door swing and not less than 600 mm and no more than 1 500 mm from that door swing,
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause1.subclause3:long] ,
are operable from a height between 150 mm and 300 mm as well as between 900 mm and 1 100 mm above the floor, and
are operable by touching or approaching any part of their surface with a fist, arm or foot, and

clauses.text: unless equipped with safety sensors,

subclauses.text: fully open the door in not less than 3 s , and
require a force not more than 65 N to stop movement of the door.

content.text: A cane-detectable [REF:term:guard:guard] shall be installed on the hinged side of power-assisted doors that swing open into the path of travel. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote210:short] .)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent9:short] and except for a door with a power door operator complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent6:short] , when unlatched, a door in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall open when the force applied to the handle, push plate or latch-releasing device is not more than

clauses.text: 38 N in the case of an exterior swinging door,
22 N in the case of an interior swinging door, or
22 N in the case of a sliding door.

content.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent8:short] does not apply to a door at the entrance to a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , or where greater forces are required in order to close and latch the door against the prevailing difference in air pressure on opposite sides of the door. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote211:short] .)

Except for a door at the entrance to a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , a closer for an interior door in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall have a closing period of not less than 3 s measured from when the door is in an open position of 70° to the doorway, to when the door reaches a point 75 mm from the closed position, measured from the leading edge of the latch side of the door. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote212:short] .)

Unless equipped with a power door operator complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent6:short] , a swinging door in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall have a clear space on the latch side extending the height of the doorway and not less than (See Note A-3.8.3.6.(11).)

clauses.text: 600 mm beyond the edge of the door opening if the door swings toward the approach side, and
300 mm beyond the edge of the door opening if the door swings away from the approach side.

content.text: A vestibule located in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall be arranged to allow the movement of wheelchairs between doors and shall provide a distance between 2 doors in series of not less than 1 350 mm plus the width of any door that swings into the space in the path of travel from one door to another.
Only the active leaf in a multiple-leaf door in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel need conform to the requirements of this Article.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent16:short] , the clear floor space on the pull side of a swinging door in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall be level within a rectangular area of not less than 1 700 mm by 1 500 mm measured from the hinged side of the door. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote214:short] .)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent16:short] , the clear floor space on the push side of a swinging door and on each side of a sliding door in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall be level within a rectangular area (See Note A-3.8.3.6.(14) to (16).)

clauses.text: whose dimension parallel to the closed door is not less than 1 200 mm , and
whose dimension perpendicular to the closed door is not less than 1 500 mm .

content.text: Where a door referred to in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent14:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent15:short] is equipped with a power door operator complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent6:short] , the width of the clear floor space parallel to the closed door is permitted to be reduced to not less than 1 000 mm . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote214:short] .)

Except for facilities for persons with cognitive disabilities such as dementia, doorways leading from a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or a corridor used by the public that provide access to a public area or an [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be provided with a door or door frame that has a readily apparent visual contrast with adjacent wall surfaces. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote215:short] .) (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote164:long:Note A-3.4.6.11.(4)] .)
A passenger-elevating device referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3:long] located in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel shall

clauses.text: conform to

subclauses.text: Appendix E of ASME A17.1/CSA B44, “Safety Code for Elevators and Escalators,” or
[REF:standard:csab355:CSA B355] , “Platform lifts and stair lifts for barrier-free access,”

clauses.text: have a clear floor space not less than 1 500 mm long by 1 000 mm wide , and
have entry doors or gates

subclauses.text: providing a clear width not less than 850 mm in the open position if located on the short side of the passenger-elevating device, or
providing a clear width not less than 1 000 mm in the open position if located at either end of the long side of the passenger-elevating device.

content.text: Controls described in this Section shall

clauses.text: where located in a [REF:term:tr:storey] where an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel is required and unless otherwise stated,

subclauses.text: be in or adjacent to the [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel,
be mounted 400 mm to 1 200 mm above the floor, and
be adjacent to and centred on either the length or the width of a clear floor space of 1 350 mm by 800 mm ,

clauses.text: be operable

subclauses.text: with one hand in a closed fist position, without requiring tight grasping, pinching with fingers, or twisting of the wrist, and
unless otherwise stated, with a force not more than 22 N , and

clauses.text: where controls provide a feedback signal to the user, it shall be both audible and visible (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote217:short] ).

content.text: Electrical outlets described in this Section shall be located in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause1.subclause2:short:Subclause (1)(a)(ii)] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote.a3.8.2.6.2:short:Note A-3.8.2.6.(2)] .)

Visual information signs required by  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5:long]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6:short]  and Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art10:long] shall comply with [REF:external:csab651:Clauses 4.5.1, 4.5.2, 4.5.3 and 4.5.4 of ] [REF:standard:csab651] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote217:short] .)

Tactile information signs required by  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5:long]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6:medium]  and Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art10:long] shall

clauses.text: have Braille and tactile characters in accordance with [REF:external:csab651:Clauses 4.5.6.2 and 4.5.6.3 of ] [REF:standard:csab651:CSA B651, “Accessible design for the built environment,”]
be installed on the wall closest to the latch side of the door or on the nearest wall on the right side of the door, where there is no wall at the latch side, and
be centred 1 500 mm above the finished floor with the edge of the sign located not more than 300 mm from the door.

content.text: Signs required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art10:long] shall incorporate the International Symbol of Access, Modified International Symbol of Access, or the International Symbol of Access for Hearing Loss and appropriate graphical or textual information that clearly indicates the type of facilities available. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote218:short] .)
Drinking fountains required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent10:long] shall be equipped with controls that

clauses.text: activate automatically, or
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and are located on the front or on both sides of the fountain.

content.text: Where drinking fountains referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art10.sent1:short] are located in a [REF:term:tr:storey] where an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel is required, they shall (See Sentences 3.3.1.8.(2) and (3) on horizontal projections.)

clauses.text: be located along the [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel,
have a minimum clear floor space of 800 mm by 1 350 mm in front of them,
where they have frontal access, provide a knee clearance in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause5:long] , and
have a spout that

subclauses.text: is located near the front of the unit, at a height between 750 mm and 915 mm above the floor, and
directs water flow in a trajectory that is nearly parallel to the front of the unit, at a height not less than 100 mm .

content.text: Water-bottle filling stations required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent11:long] shall be equipped with controls that

clauses.text: activate automatically, or
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] .

content.text: Water-bottle filling stations required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent11:long] that are located in a [REF:term:tr:storey] where an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel is required shall (See Sentences 3.3.1.8.(2) and (3) on horizontal projections.)

clauses.text: be located along the [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel,
have a clear floor space of 800 mm by 1 350 mm in front of them (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote219:short] ),
where they have frontal access, provide a knee clearance in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause5:long] ,
be operable at a height of not more than 1 200 mm above the floor (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote219:short] ), and
be equipped with controls that

subclauses.text: activate automatically, or
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1:long] .

content.text: Water-closet stalls and enclosures required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent5:long] shall

clauses.text: be not less than 1 500 mm wide by 1 500 mm deep,
have a clear lateral transfer space adjacent to the water closet that

subclauses.text: is at least 1 500 mm long, measured from the wall behind the water closet, and
is at least 900 mm wide, measured from the closest edge of the water closet seat,

clauses.text: have a clear floor space of 1 700 mm by 1 700 mm in front of the accessible stall,
be equipped with a door that

subclauses.text: can be latched from the inside with a mechanism located 900 mm to 1 100 mm above the floor that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] ,
is aligned with either the transfer space adjacent to the water closet or with a clear floor space not less than 1 700 mm by 1 700 mm within the stall,
provides a clear opening not less than 850 mm wide when it is open,
is self-closing so that, when at rest, the door is ajar by not more than 50 mm beyond the jamb,

swings outward, unless there is sufficient floor space within the stall for the door to swing inward in addition to a clear floor space of at least 800 mm by 1 350 mm (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote221:short] ),

where the door swings outward, is provided with a horizontal, D-shaped, visually contrasting door pull not less than 140 mm long located on the inside such that its midpoint is 200 mm to 300 mm from the hinged side of the door and 900 mm to 1 100 mm above the floor (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote222:short] ), and

is provided with a horizontal, D-shaped, visually contrasting door pull not less than 140 mm long located on the outside such that its midpoint is 120 mm to 220 mm from the latch side and 900 mm to 1 100 mm above the floor,

clauses.text: have a water closet located so that the distance between the centre line of the fixture and the wall on one side is 460 mm to 480 mm ,
be equipped with an L-shaped grab bar that

subclauses.text: is mounted on the side wall closest to the water closet,

has horizontal and vertical components not less than 760 mm long mounted with the horizontal component 750 mm to 850 mm above the floor and the vertical component 150 mm in front of the water closet (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote223:short] ), and
complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7:long] ,

clauses.text: be equipped with either one grab bar at least 600 mm long and centred over the water closet, or two grab bars at least 300 mm long and located either side of the flush valve, that

subclauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7:long] ,
are mounted on the rear wall, and
are mounted at the same height as the grab bar on the side wall or 100 mm above the top of the attached water tank, if applicable,

clauses.text: be equipped with a coat hook mounted not more than 1 200 mm above the floor on a side wall and projecting not more than 50 mm from the wall, and
be equipped with a toilet paper dispenser mounted on the side wall closest to the water closet such that

subclauses.text: the bottom of the dispenser is 600 mm to 800 mm above the floor, and
the closest edge of the dispenser is not more than 300 mm from the front of the water closet.

content.text: A universal washroom shall

clauses.text: be served by an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel,
have a door complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6:long] that

subclauses.text: has a latch-operating mechanism located 900 mm to 1 100 mm above the floor that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and is capable of being locked from the inside, and released from the outside in case of emergency, and

if it is an outward swinging door that is not self-closing, has a horizontal, D-shaped, visually contrasting door pull not less than 140 mm long located on the inside so that its midpoint is not less than 200 mm and not more than 300 mm from the hinged side of the door and not less than 900 mm and not more than 1 100 mm above the floor (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote222:long] ),

clauses.text: have one lavatory conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16:long] ,
have one water closet conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art14:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause5:long] ,
have a clear lateral transfer space adjacent to the water closet that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause2:long] ,
have grab bars conforming to  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause6:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause7:short:(g)] ,
have a coat hook conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause8:long] ,
have a toilet paper dispenser conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause9:long] ,
unless a counter space of not less than 200 mm by 400 mm is provided, have a shelf located not more than 1 200 mm above the floor with a useable surface of not less than 200 mm by 400 mm ,
be designed to permit a wheelchair to turn in an open space not less than 1 700 mm in diameter, and
provide emergency lighting conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3:long] .

content.text: A universal washroom required to have an accessible change space as stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent15:long] shall

clauses.text: be equipped with an adult-sized change table that is

subclauses.text: designed to carry a minimum load of 1.3 kN ,
impervious to water, and
designed to be easily cleaned,

clauses.text: have a clear floor space to accommodate the adult-sized change table that is 810 mm wide by 1 830 mm long and does not overlap with the clear spaces required by  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art13.sent1.clause5:medium:(1)(e)] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art13.sent1.clause10:medium:(1)(j)] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art13.sent2.clause3:shortNum] , and
have a clear transfer space of 900 mm by 1 350 mm adjacent to the long side of the clear floor space for the adult-sized change table.

content.text: A water closet for a person with physical disabilities shall

clauses.text: be equipped with a seat located 430 mm to 480 mm above the floor,
flush automatically or be equipped with a flushing control that

subclauses.text: is located 500 mm to 900 mm above the floor,
is located no more than 350 mm from the transfer side, and
complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] ,

clauses.text: be equipped with a seat lid or other back support, and
where it has a tank, have a securely attached tank top.

articles.title: Water-Closet Stalls and Urinals for Persons with Limited Mobility

content.text: Water-closet stalls for persons with limited mobility required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent7:long] shall

clauses.text: be at least 1 500 mm deep and 890 mm to 940 mm wide,
be equipped with a door that

subclauses.text: has a latch-operating mechanism conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] that can be locked from the inside and released from the outside in the event of an emergency,
provides a clear opening not less than 850 mm wide when it is open, measured in accordance with Sentence 3.8.3.6.(2),
swings outward, unless the minimum dimensions required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art15.sent1.clause1:short] do not overlap with the area of the door swing,
is self-closing so that, when at rest, the door is ajar by not more than 50 mm beyond the jamb, and
has a horizontal, D-shaped, visually contrasting door pull on both sides of the door, near the latch side, located 900 mm to 1 100 mm above the finished floor,

clauses.text: have one water closet conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art14:long] centred within the stall,
have a horizontal grab bar conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7:long] on each side of the water closet that

subclauses.text: is located 750 mm to 850 mm above the floor,
begins not more than 300 mm from the wall behind the water closet, and
extends at least 450 mm in front of the toilet seat, and

clauses.text: be equipped with a coat hook mounted not more than 1 200 mm above the floor on a side wall and projecting not more than 50 mm from the wall.

content.text: Urinals described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent6:long] shall

clauses.text: be wall-mounted, with the rim located not more than 430 mm above the floor,
be adjacent to an [REF:term:ccbl-rt:accessible] route,
have a clear width of approach that is at least 800 mm wide by 1 350 mm long centred on the urinal and unobstructed by privacy screens,
have no step in front of it,
have a flush control that

subclauses.text: is automatic, or
complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and is located 900 mm to 1 100 mm above the floor, and

clauses.text: have a vertically mounted grab bar installed on each side that

subclauses.text: complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7:long] ,
is not less than 600 mm long, with its centre line 1 000 mm above the floor, and
is located not more than 380 mm from the centre line of the urinal.

content.text: Lavatories required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent8:long] shall

clauses.text: be equipped with faucets complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art3.sent4:long] ,
be located so that the distance between the centre line of the lavatory and any side wall is not less than 460 mm ,
have a clear floor space in front of the lavatory that is at least

subclauses.text: 800 mm wide , centred on the lavatory, and
1 350 mm long , of which no more than 430 mm is beneath the lavatory,

clauses.text: have a rim height not more than 865 mm above the floor,
have a clearance beneath the lavatory not less than

subclauses.text: 800 mm wide , centred on the lavatory,
735 mm high at the front edge,
685 mm high at a point 200 mm back from the front edge, and
230 mm high over the distance from a point 280 mm to a point 430 mm back from the front edge,

clauses.text: have insulated water supply and drain pipes where these pipes are exposed (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote227:short] ),
have a soap dispenser that

subclauses.text: is automatic, or

complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and is located not more than 1 100 mm above the floor, within 500 mm from the front of the lavatory (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote228:short] ), and

clauses.text: have a towel dispenser or other hand-drying equipment located close to the lavatory, with operating controls not more than 1 200 mm above the floor in an area that is [REF:term:bc-cc-t-ccbl:accessible] to persons using wheelchairs.

content.text: Mirrors required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent9:long] shall be

clauses.text: mounted with their bottom edge not more than 1 000 mm above the floor, or
fixed in an inclined position so as to be usable by a person using a wheelchair.

content.text: Showers required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent12:long] shall

clauses.text: be not less than 1 500 mm wide and 900 mm deep,

have a clear floor space at the entrance to the shower that is not less than 900 mm deep and the same width as the shower, except that fixtures are permitted to project into that space provided they do not restrict access to the shower (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote229:short] ),
have no doors or curtains that obstruct the controls or the clear floor space at the entrance to the shower,
have a slip-resistant floor surface,
have a threshold not more than 13 mm higher than the finished floor, and where it is higher than 6 mm , beveled to a slope no steeper than 1 in 2,
have 2 grab bars

subclauses.text: that conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7.sent1:long] ,
one of which is not less than 1 000 mm long and located vertically on the side wall 50 mm to 80 mm from the adjacent clear floor space, with its lower end 600 mm to 650 mm above the floor, and,

one of which is L-shaped and located on the wall opposite the entrance to the shower, with a horizontal member not less than 1 000 mm long mounted 750 mm to 870 mm above the floor and a vertical member not less than 750 mm long mounted 400 mm to 500 mm from the side wall on which the other vertical grab bar is mounted,

clauses.text: have a hinged seat that is not spring-loaded or a fixed seat with a smooth, slip-resistant surface and no rough edges, the seat being

subclauses.text: not less than 450 mm wide and 400 mm deep,
mounted on the same side wall as the vertical grab bar, at 460 mm to 480 mm above the floor,
designed to carry a minimum load of 1.3 kN ,
impervious to water, and
designed to be easily cleaned,

clauses.text: have a pressure-equalizing or thermostatic-mixing valve and other controls that

subclauses.text: comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] , and
are mounted on the wall opposite the entrance to the shower at not more than 1 200 mm above the floor and within reach of the seat,

clauses.text: have a hand-held shower head with not less than 1 800 mm of flexible hose located so that it

subclauses.text: can be reached from a seated position,
can be used in a fixed position at a height of 1 200 mm and 2 030 mm , and
does not obstruct the use of the grab bars, and

clauses.text: have recessed soap holders that can be reached from the seated position.

content.text: A universal dressing and shower room required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent13:long] shall

clauses.text: be located in an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel,
have a door capable of being locked from the inside and released from the outside in the event of an emergency,
have a lavatory and a mirror conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16:long] ,
have a shower conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art17.sent1:short] ,
have a bench that is

subclauses.text: at least 1 830 mm long by 760 mm wide and 480 mm to 520 mm high,
designed to carry a minimum load of 1.3 kN ,
impervious to water, and
designed to be easily cleaned,

clauses.text: have a clear transfer space adjacent to the long side of the bench that is 900 mm wide and as long as the bench (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote231:short] ),
have a coat hook conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause8:long] , and
provide emergency lighting conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3:long] .

content.text: A bathtub required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent14:long] shall

clauses.text: be located in a room with a clear floor space not less than 1 700 mm in diameter,
be not less than 1 500 mm long,

have a clear floor space at the entrance to the bathtub that is not less than 900 mm deep and at least the same length as the bathtub, except that fixtures are permitted to project into that space provided they do not restrict access to the shower,
be capable of being accessed along its full length with no tracks mounted on its rim,
have a pressure-equalizing or thermostatic mixing valve and other controls that

subclauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] , and
are located on the centre line or between the centre line of the bathtub and the exterior edge of the bathtub rim, at a maximum height of 450 mm above the rim,

clauses.text: have three grab bars

subclauses.text: that conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7.sent1:long] ,
that are not less than 1 200 mm long,
two of which are located vertically at each end of the bathtub, set 80 mm to 120 mm in from the outside edge of the bathtub, with their lower end 180 mm to 280 mm above the bathtub rim, and
one of which is located horizontally along the length of the bathtub at 180 mm to 280 mm above the bathtub rim,

clauses.text: have a slip-resistant bottom surface, and
be equipped with a hand-held shower head with not less than 1 800 mm of flexible hose that can be used in a fixed position at a height of 1 200 mm and 2 030 mm .

content.text: Assistive listening systems required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art9.sent1:long] shall encompass the entire seating area.

Assistive listening systems or adaptive technologies required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art9.sent2:long] shall provide for the clear communication required for the exchange of information, goods and services.
A section of a service counter required to be [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art11.sent1:long] shall

clauses.text: be not less than 800 mm long centred over a knee space conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art20.sent1.clause3:short] ,
have a surface not more than 865 mm above the floor, and
where forward-facing interaction with a person or a device is required, have a knee space underneath it that is (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote233:short] )

subclauses.text: not less than 800 mm wide,
not less than 685 mm high, and
not less than 485 mm deep.

content.text: A telephone required to be [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art12:long] shall

clauses.text: be adjacent to and centred on either the length or the width of a clear floor space not less than 1 350 mm by 800 mm ,
where a forward approach is provided, have a knee space underneath it conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art20.sent1.clause3:long] , and
be located so that its receiver and operable parts are not more than 1 200 mm above the floor.

content.text: Where provided, shelves or counters for public telephones shall

clauses.text: be level,
be not less than 305 mm deep,
have, for each telephone provided, a clear space not less than 250 mm wide having no obstruction within 250 mm above the surface, and
have a section with a surface not more than 865 mm above the floor serving at least one telephone.

content.text: Spaces designated for wheelchair use in [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancies] as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent3:long] shall conform to the following:

clauses.text: at least one designated space shall be clear and level for each increment of 200 seats and the remaining designated spaces shall be level and have removable seats,
they shall be not less than 900 mm wide and 1 700 mm long to permit a wheelchair to enter from a side approach and 1 350 mm long where the wheelchair enters from the front or rear of the space,
they shall be arranged so that

subclauses.text: at least two designated spaces are located side by side, and
at least one fixed seat is located beside each designated space,

clauses.text: they shall be located adjoining an [REF:term:brrr-fr:accessible] path of travel without infringing on egress from any row of seating or any aisle requirements, and
they shall be situated, as part of the designated seating plan, to provide a choice of viewing location and a clear view of the event taking place.

content.text: Spaces designated for wheelchair use in waiting rooms or areas as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent4:long] shall

clauses.text: be clear and level, and
comply with  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art22.sent1.clause2:medium]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art22.sent1.clause4:short] .

content.text: Adaptable seats required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent5:long] shall

clauses.text: be located adjoining an aisle without infringing on egress from any row of seating or any aisle requirements,
be equipped with a movable or removable armrest on the side of the seat adjoining the aisle, and
be situated, as part of the designated seating plan, to provide a choice of viewing location and a clear view of the event taking place.

content.text: Storage spaces for mobility aids shall be provided in a location

clauses.text: that is on the same level as and in proximity to the adaptable seats required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent5:long] ,
that is within the room side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art2:long] , and
where they will not infringe on egress.

content.text: Sleeping rooms and bed spaces required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art13.sent1:short] to be [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] shall have

clauses.text: a clear floor space that permits a turning area of not less than 1 700 mm in diameter, or not less than 1 700 mm by 1 500 mm , that could be adjacent a bed,
a pathway clearance of not less than 1 000 mm wide, that could be unobstructed by a bed, to allow functional use of the bedroom,
at least one closet that provides

subclauses.text: a clear opening width of not less than 900 mm ,

a clear floor space, that need not be separate from the turning areas required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art23.sent1.clause1:short] , of not less than 1 700 mm by 1 500 mm on at least one side of the closet (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote235a:short:Note A-3.8.5.6.(1)] )
clothes hanger rods capable of being lowered to a height of not more than 1 200 mm , and
at least one shelf capable of being lowered to a height of not more than 1 200 mm ,

clauses.text: when a balcony is provided, an [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] path of travel to an [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] balcony conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent4:short] ,

except for dedicated electrical outlets for equipment and appliances, where controls, switches and outlets are intended for frequent operation, they shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] , and
a bathroom, where provided as part of the sleeping room or bed space, or [REF:term:cc:access] to a bathroom, where not provided as part of the sleeping room or bed space

subclauses.text: conforming to  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause1:medium] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause2:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause5:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause6:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause7:number] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause8:number]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause9:short] with a water closet conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art14:long] ,
provided with a lavatory and mirror conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16:long] , and

provided with a shower conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art17:long] or a bathtub conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art18:long] , only to the extent of providing the same type of facilities provided in sleeping rooms and bed spaces where [REF:term:cc:access] is not required.

subsections.title: Alterations and Additions to Existing Buildings

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art1.sent2:short] , [REF:term:cc:access] as described in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art2:medium]  to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art8:number] shall be provided

clauses.text: to additions to existing [REF:term:bldng:buildings] where such additions have internal path of travel connections with the existing [REF:term:bldng:buildings] ,
to existing parts of [REF:term:bldng:buildings] to which additions described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art1.sent1.clause1:short] are made, and
to the extent required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art5:long] , to existing [REF:term:bldng:buildings]

subclauses.text: where the [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] is changed, or
that are altered or renovated.

content.text: This Subsection does not apply to

clauses.text: [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of new construction,
vertical additions of one [REF:term:tr:storey] not more than 600 m^{2} in [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] regardless of [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , or

horizontal or vertical additions to [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] described in  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause1:medium]  to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause3:number] .

content.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5:long] does not apply to [REF:term:altns:alterations] to existing [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] .

revisions.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5:long] does not apply to [REF:term:altns:alterations] to existing [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] .
revisions.change_summary: Added new Sentence 3 stating that Subsection 3.8.5. does not apply to alterations to existing buildings of residential occupancy

content.text: Exterior [REF:term:cc:access] shall be provided to an addition except where [REF:term:cc:access] to the addition is provided by way of the existing [REF:term:bldng:building] .
Walks and ramps for an addition shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] .
An entrance to an addition shall be [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] except where

clauses.text: the addition is [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] by an [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] path of travel from an [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] entrance serving the existing [REF:term:bldng:building] , and
not less than 50% of the pedestrian entrances to the [REF:term:bldng:building] are [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] .

content.text: Where there is a vertical addition of one [REF:term:tr:storey] and of more than 600 m^{2} in [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , or of two or more [REF:term:tr:storeys] regardless of [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] ,

clauses.text: [REF:term:cc:access] shall be provided to all additional [REF:term:tr:storeys] , and
the additional [REF:term:tr:storeys] shall conform to  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2:medium]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short] .

content.text: The construction of [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling units] and the [REF:term:bldng:building] in which they are located shall conform to the requirements of this Subsection and, as required by this Subsection, to [REF:term:cc:access] requirements for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] elsewhere in this Code.
Unless otherwise required, clear areas and spaces required in this Subsection are permitted to overlap with other clear area and space requirements.

This Subsection does not require an [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling unit] be provided with a living space, a bedroom, a bathroom or a kitchen, but when provided, those spaces and the paths connecting them shall conform to the applicable requirements of this Subsection.

References in this Subsection to provisions in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] are permitted to be designed to the applicable provisions of CSA B651, "Accessible design for the built environment," as listed in  Table [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent1:long] .

content.text: Common areas, spaces and facilities and all common exterior and interior paths of travel serving [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling units] shall be [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2:long] with [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] protected in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7:long] .
Common corridors and passageways serving [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling units] shall be equipped to provide illumination, measured at floor or tread level, of not less than 50 lx .

Each [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling unit] shall be provided with special outlet boxes and cover plates as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent7:long:Sentences 3.2.4.19.(7)] .

Unless otherwise required by this Section, common spaces and paths of travel that are not intended to serve the residents of [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling units] need not be [REF:term:ccbl:accessible] .
The principal entrance door to [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling units] shall have a clear width of not less than 850 mm when the door is in the open position.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent5:short] , there shall be a clear floor space in accordance with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent14:medium]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent15:number] adjacent to and on both sides of the [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling unit] entrance door described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent1:short] .

Within an [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling unit] , every doorway along a path of travel connecting the entrance door described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent1:short] with a living space, adaptable bedroom, adaptable bathroom, and adaptable kitchen shall have a clear width of not less than 850 mm when the door is in the open position.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent5:short] , there shall be a clear floor space in accordance with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent14:medium]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent15:number] adjacent to and on both sides of the doorways described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent3:short] .

Doorways provided with power door operators, or provided with a special outlet box and cover plates that are designed, located and wired specifically to accommodate the future installation of a power door operator, may provide the clear floor space described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent16:long] .

articles.title: Adaptable Dwelling Unit Hallways and Corridors

content.text: Hallways and corridors in [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling units] forming a path of travel connecting the entrance door described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent1:long] with a living space, adaptable bedroom, adaptable bathroom and adaptable kitchen shall have a clear width conforming to  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art2.sent1:medium]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art2.sent2:number] .
At least one bedroom or sleeping space in an [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling unit] shall have

clauses.text: a floor area that permits a turning area of not less than 1 700 mm in diameter, or not less than 1 700 mm by 1 500 mm , that could be adjacent a bed,
a pathway clearance of not less than 850 mm wide, that could be unobstructed by a bed, to allow functional use of the bedroom, and
when provided, a [REF:term:clst:closet] with

subclauses.text: a clear opening width of not less than 900 mm , and

a clear floor space, that need not be separate from the turning areas required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art6.sent1.clause1:short] , of not less than 1 700 mm in diameter or 1 700 mm by 1 500 mm on at least one side of the [REF:term:clst:closet] . (See Note A-3.8.5.6.(1).)

content.text: Though the Code doesn't regulate bed furniture or sizes or styles such as bunkbeds, designs should allow for a bed to be located to accommodate transfer from the turning area to either side of the bed, such as by flipping the orientation of the bed, as well as for functional maneuvering space in the room.
A built-in closet is not required by this Code.

at least one closet that provides

subclauses.text: a clear opening width of not less than 900 mm , and

a clear floor space, that need not be separate from the turning areas required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art6.sent1.clause1:short] , of not less than 1 700 mm in diameter or 1 700 mm by 1 500 mm on at least one side of the closet. (See Note A-3.8.5.6.(1).)

content.text: At least one bathroom in an [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling unit] shall be designed to be adaptable for use by [REF:term:bc-prsn-wth-dsblts:persons with disabilities] by providing

content.text: The kitchen in an [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling unit] shall be designed so that the [REF:term:cktp:cooktop] and sink are adjacent or can have a continuous counter between them.
A clear floor space shall be provided in the kitchen area that is not less than 1 700 mm in diameter or 1 700 mm by 1 500 mm .

The [REF:term:plmbng-t:plumbing system] serving the kitchen shall accommodate the future installation of a kitchen sink that could be installed in accordance with the requirements for the installation of a lavatory as described in  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause2:medium]  to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause6:number] . (See Note A-3.8.5.7.(1)(c) and (d).)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art9.sent2:short] , controls and switches for [REF:term:bldng:building] systems and outlets in [REF:term:bc-dptbl-dwllng-nt:adaptable dwelling units] , that are intended for frequent operation by occupants, shall not require activities for operation below 400 mm from the floor or above 1 200 mm from the floor.
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art9.sent1:short] does not apply to controls, switches and dedicated outlets for equipment or appliances.

For the purpose of this Section, the term “self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:building] ” shall mean a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is open to the public for the sole purpose of providing individual self-service storage units.
This Section applies to self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] that

clauses.text: are not more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] ,
do not contain a [REF:term:bmnt:basement] or [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] ,
consist of individual self-service storage units with external access only,
are used for no purpose other than storage, and

except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent4:short] , contain no other [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] .

content.text: Where there is a conflict between the requirements of this Section and other requirements in Part 3, this Section shall govern.
The requirements in Part 3 regarding [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] shall not apply to self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] .
Self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be classified as Group F, Division 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] .

For the purpose of applying the requirements of  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] to self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , [REF:term:bldng-r:building area] shall mean

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng-r:building area] of each [REF:term:bldng:building] , or
the total of the [REF:term:bldng-r:building areas] of all [REF:term:bldng:buildings] as a group.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect2.art2.sent3:short] , the spatial separation requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3:long] shall apply to self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] .
The distance between each group of self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be not less than 9 m.

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3:long] need not apply between [REF:term:bldng:buildings] within a group of self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , where the distance between these [REF:term:bldng:buildings] is at least 6 m .

Where [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause2:long] is applied to a group of [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent1:long] shall apply to that group of [REF:term:bldng:buildings] as if they were a single [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent6:short] , the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3:long] shall apply. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote238:short] .)
Not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is permitted to be contained within one of the self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] on a property.

A [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:short] shall be separated from individual self-service storage units by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 2 h .

Where an office not more than 50 m^{2} in area is adjacent to a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:short] , it shall be considered as part of the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] .

[REF:term:fr-prtn:Fire separations] required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art1.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art9.sent1:long] need not be provided between individual self-service storage units.
The [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] of self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be

clauses.text: subdivided into compartments not more than 500 m^{2} in area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 1 h , or
[REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

see_also.content: (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art12.sent2:long] for the exemption applying to [REF:term:xt:exit] doors of individual self-service storage units.)

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art1.sent3:long] , two public washrooms, each containing a water closet and a lavatory, shall be provided within one of the self-service storage [REF:term:bldng:buildings] on the property. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote239:short] .)

appendix.introduction: These Notes are included for explanatory purposes only and do not form part of the requirements. The number that introduces each Note corresponds to the applicable requirement in this Part.

content.content: In applying the requirements of this Part, it is intended that they be applied with discretion to buildings of unusual configuration that do not clearly conform to the specific requirements, or to buildings in which processes are carried out which make compliance with particular requirements in this Part impracticable. The definition of “building” as it applies to this Code is general and encompasses most structures, including those which would not normally be considered as buildings in the layman's sense. This occurs more often in industrial uses, particularly those involving manufacturing facilities and equipment that require specialized design that may make it impracticable to follow the specific requirements of this Part. Steel mills, aluminum plants, refining, power generation and liquid storage facilities are examples. A water tank or an oil refinery, for example, has no floor area, so it is obvious that requirements for exits from floor areas would not apply. Requirements for structural fire protection in large steel mills and pulp and paper mills, particularly in certain portions, may not be practicable to achieve in terms of the construction normally used and the operations for which the space is to be used. In other portions of the same building, however, it may be quite reasonable to require that the provisions of this Part be applied (e.g., the office portions). Similarly, areas of industrial occupancy which may be occupied only periodically by service staff, such as equipment penthouses, normally would not need to have the same type of exit facility as floor areas occupied on a continuing basis. It is expected that judgment will be exercised in evaluating the application of a requirement in those cases when extenuating circumstances require special consideration, provided the occupants' safety is not endangered.

The provisions in this Part for fire protection features installed in buildings are intended to provide a minimum acceptable level of public safety. It is intended that all fire protection features of a building, whether required or not, will be designed in conformance with good fire protection engineering practice and will meet the appropriate installation requirements in relevant standards. Good design is necessary to ensure that the level of public safety established by the Code requirements will not be reduced by a voluntary installation.

The requirements of this Part are based on the assumption that firefighting capabilities are available in the event of a fire emergency. These firefighting capabilities may take the form of a paid or volunteer public fire department or in some cases a private fire brigade. If these firefighting capabilities are not available, additional fire safety measures may be required.

Firefighting capability can vary from municipality to municipality. Generally, larger municipalities have greater firefighting capability than smaller ones. Similarly, older, well established municipalities may have better firefighting facilities than newly formed or rapidly growing ones. The level of municipal fire protection considered to be adequate will normally depend on both the size of the municipality (i.e., the number of buildings to be protected) and the size of buildings within that municipality. Since larger buildings tend to be located in larger municipalities, they are generally, but not always, favoured with a higher level of municipal protection.

Although it is reasonable to consider that some level of municipal firefighting capability was assumed in developing the fire safety provisions in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long] , this was not done on a consistent or defined basis. The requirements in the Code, while developed in the light of commonly prevailing municipal fire protection levels, do not attempt to relate the size of building to the level of municipal protection. The responsibility for controlling the maximum size of building to be permitted in a municipality in relation to local firefighting capability rests with the municipality. If a proposed building is too large, either in terms of floor area or building height, to receive reasonable protection from the municipal fire department, fire protection requirements in addition to those prescribed in this Code, may be necessary to compensate for this deficiency. Automatic sprinkler protection may be one option to be considered.

Alternatively, the municipality may, in light of its firefighting capability, elect to introduce zoning restrictions to ensure that the maximum building size is related to available municipal fire protection facilities. This is, by necessity, a somewhat arbitrary decision and should be made in consultation with the local firefighting service, who should have an appreciation of their capability to fight fires.

The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3:long] are intended to prevent fire spread from thermal radiation assuming there is adequate firefighting available. It has been found that periods of from 10 to 30 minutes usually elapse between the outbreak of fire in a building that is not protected with an automatic sprinkler system and the attainment of high radiation levels. During this period, the specified spatial separations should prove adequate to inhibit ignition of an exposed building face or the interior of an adjacent building by radiation. Subsequently, however, reduction of the fire intensity by firefighting and the protective wetting of the exposed building face will often be necessary as supplementary measures to inhibit fire spread.

In the case of a building that is sprinklered throughout, the automatic sprinkler system should control the fire to an extent that radiation to neighbouring buildings should be minimal. Although there will be some radiation effect on a sprinklered building from a fire in a neighbouring building, the internal sprinkler system should control any fires that might be ignited in the building and thereby minimize the possibility of the fire spreading into the exposed building. [REF:standard:nfpa80a] provides additional information on the possibility of fire spread at building exteriors.

The water supply requirements for fire protection installations depend on the requirements of any automatic sprinkler installations and also on the number of fire streams that may be needed at any fire, having regard to the length of time the streams will have to be used. Both these factors are largely influenced by the conditions at the building to be equipped, and the quantity and pressure of water needed for the protection of both the interior and exterior of the building must be ascertained before the water supply is decided upon. Acceptable water supplies may be a public waterworks system that has adequate pressure and discharge capacity, automatic fire pumps, pressure tanks, manually controlled fire pumps in combination with pressure tanks, gravity tanks, and manually controlled fire pumps operated by remote control devices at each hose station.

The purpose of classification is to determine which requirements apply. This Code requires classification in accordance with every major occupancy for which the building is used or intended to be used. Where necessary, an application clause has been inserted in this Part to explain how to choose between the alternative requirements which multiple occupancy classification may present.
The following are examples of the major occupancy classifications described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art1.table1:long] :[LIST:bulleted]
