content.text: Site-specific geotechnical evaluation is required to determine the values of PGA(X_{F}), PGV(X_{F}) and S_{a}(T,X_{F}) for site designation X_{F}.

Where structures on liquefiable [REF:term:l:soils] have a fundamental lateral period, T_{a}, of 0.5 s or less, the site designation X and the corresponding values of S_{a}(T,X) and PGA(X) are permitted to be determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent1:short] by assuming that the [REF:term:l:soils] are not liquefiable.

The design spectral acceleration, S(T), shall be determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art4.table3:long] , using log–log or linear interpolation for intermediate values of T. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote71:short] .)

content.value: S_{a}(0.2,X) or S_{a}(0.5,X), whichever is greater

content.text: Where required for the application of a standard referenced in this Subsection, the acceleration-based site coefficient, F_{a}, for site designation X shall be taken as S(0.2)/S_{a}(0.2,X_{450}) and the velocity-based site coefficient, F_{v}, for site designation X shall be taken as S(1.0)/S_{a}(1.0,X_{450}).
The earthquake importance factor, I_{E}, shall be determined according to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art5.table1:long]

content.title: Importance Factor for Earthquake Loads and Effects, I_{E}

table_notes.content: See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13:long]
See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote72:short] .

content.text: [REF:term:bldng:Buildings] shall be assigned a Seismic Category in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art5.table2:long] .

table_notes.content: The Seismic Category of a [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be taken as the more severe of the categories determined on the basis of I_{E}S(0.2) and I_{E}S(1.0), irrespective of the fundamental lateral period of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , T_{a}.

content.text: Structures having any of the features listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art6.table1:long] shall be designated irregular.
Structures not classified as irregular according to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art6.sent1:short] may be considered regular.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art10:long] , where the Seismic Category is SC3 or SC4, structures designated as irregular must satisfy the provisions referenced in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art6.table1:long]

table_notes.content: One- [REF:term:tr:storey] penthouses with a weight of less than 10% of the level below need not be considered in the application of this Table.
See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote73:short]
See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art7:long]
See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art10:long]
Increased stiffness in [REF:term:tr:storeys] below [REF:term:grade:grade] need not be considered in the determination of vertical stiffness irregularity.
See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art15:long]

See  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent10:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent11:short] ,  and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent4:long] .
See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art8:long]

content.value: <bold>Vertical Stiffness Irregularity</bold>For concrete and masonry shear walls, vertical stiffness irregularity shall be considered to exist where the lateral stiffness of the SFRS in any [REF:term:tr:storey] is less than 70% of the stiffness in an adjacent [REF:term:tr:storey] , or less than 80% of the average stiffness in the three [REF:term:tr:storeys] above or below. For all other types of SFRS, vertical stiffness irregularity shall be considered to exist where the inter [REF:term:tr:storey] deflection under lateral earthquake forces divided by the inter [REF:term:tr:storey] height, h_{s}, of any [REF:term:tr:storey] is greater than 130% of that of an adjacent [REF:term:tr:storey] .

<bold>Weight (mass) Irregularity</bold>Weight irregularity shall be considered to exist where the weight, W_{i}, of any [REF:term:tr:storey] is more than 150% of the weight of an adjacent [REF:term:tr:storey] . A roof that is lighter than the floor below need not be considered.

<bold>Vertical Geometric Irregularity</bold>Vertical geometric irregularity shall be considered to exist where the horizontal dimension of the SFRS in any [REF:term:tr:storey] is more than 130% of that in an adjacent [REF:term:tr:storey] .

<bold>In-Plane Discontinuity in Vertical Lateral-Force-Resisting Element</bold>Except for braced frames and moment-resisting frames, an in-plane discontinuity shall be considered to exist where there is an offset of a lateral-force-resisting element of the SFRS or a reduction in lateral stiffness of the resisting element in the [REF:term:tr:storey] below.
<bold>Out-of-Plane Offsets</bold>Discontinuities in a lateral force path, such as out-of-plane offsets of the vertical elements of the SFRS.

<bold>Discontinuity in Capacity – Weak Storey</bold>A weak [REF:term:tr:storey] is one in which the [REF:term:tr:storey] shear strength is less than that in the [REF:term:tr:storey] above. The [REF:term:tr:storey] shear strength is the total strength of all seismic-resisting elements of the SFRS sharing the [REF:term:tr:storey] shear for the direction under consideration.

<bold>Torsional Sensitivity (to be considered when diaphragms are not flexible)</bold>Torsional sensitivity shall be considered to exist when the ratio B calculated according to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent10:long] exceeds 1.7.
<bold>Non-orthogonal Systems</bold>A non-orthogonal system irregularity shall be considered to exist when the SFRS is not oriented along a set of orthogonal axes.

<bold>Gravity-Induced Lateral Demand Irregularity</bold>Gravity-induced lateral demand irregularity on the SFRS shall be considered to exist where the ratio α calculated in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art10.sent7:long] exceeds 0.1 for an SFRS with self-centering characteristics and 0.03 for other systems.

<bold>Sloped Column Irregularity</bold>Sloped column irregularity shall be considered to exist where a vertical member that is inclined more than 2° from the vertical supports a portion of the weight of the [REF:term:bldng:building] in axial compression.

content.text: Analysis for earthquake actions shall be carried out in accordance with the Dynamic Analysis Procedure described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote74:short] ), except that the Equivalent Static Force Procedure described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11:long] may be used for structures that meet any of the following criteria:

clauses.text: where the Seismic Category is SC1 or SC2,

regular structures that are less than 60 m in height and have a fundamental lateral period, T_{a}, less than 2 s in each of two orthogonal directions as defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art8:long] , or

structures with a structural irregularity of Type 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 or 8 as defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art6.table1:long] that are less than 20 m in height and have a fundamental lateral period, T_{a}, less than 0.5 s in each of two orthogonal directions as defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art8:long]

content.text: Earthquake forces shall be assumed to act in any horizontal direction, except that the following shall be considered to provide adequate design force levels in the structure:

clauses.text: where components of the SFRS are oriented along a set of orthogonal axes, independent analyses about each of the principal axes of the structure shall be performed,
where the components of the SFRS are not oriented along a set of orthogonal axes and the Seismic Category is SC1 or SC2, independent analyses about any two orthogonal axes is permitted, or

where the components of the SFRS are not oriented along a set of orthogonal axes and the Seismic Category is SC3 or SC4, analysis of the structure independently in any two orthogonal directions for 100% of the specified earthquake loads applied in one direction plus 30% of the specified earthquake loads in the perpendicular direction, with the combination requiring the greater element strength being used in the design.

articles.title: SFRS Force Modification Factors and General Restrictions

content.text: Except as provided in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art20:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art22:long] , the values of R_{d} and R_{o} and the corresponding system restrictions shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art9.table1:long] and the requirements of this Subsection.
When a particular value of R_{d} is required by this Article, the corresponding R_{o} shall be used.
For combinations of different types of SFRS acting in the same direction in the same [REF:term:tr:storey] , R_{d}R_{o} shall be taken as the lowest value of R_{d}R_{o} corresponding to these systems.

For vertical variations of R_{d}R_{o}, excluding rooftop structures not exceeding two [REF:term:tr:storeys] in height whose weight is less than the greater of 10% of W and 30% of W_{i} of the level below, the value of R_{d}R_{o} used in the design of any [REF:term:tr:storey] shall be less than or equal to the lowest value of R_{d}R_{o} used in the given direction for the [REF:term:tr:storeys] above, and the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art15.sent6:long] must be satisfied. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote76:short] .)

If it can be demonstrated through testing, research and analysis that the seismic performance of a structural system is at least equivalent to one of the types of SFRS defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art9.table1:long] , then such a structural system will qualify for values of R_{d} and R_{o} corresponding to the equivalent type in that Table. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote77:short] .)

clauses.text: the structure shall be designed to resist the additional earthquake forces due to the vertical accelerations of the mass supported by inclined vertical members (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote81:short] ), and

for braced frames, T_{a} shall not be taken as greater than 2.0 times that determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent3.clause2:short] ,

content.title: Higher Mode Factor, M_{v}, and Base Overturning Moment Reduction Factor, J

table_notes.content: For intermediate values of the spectral ratio S(0.2)/S(5.0), M_{v} and J shall be obtained by linear interpolation. For spectral ratios less than 5, M_{v} and J shall be obtained by linear interpolation with their values at a spectral ratio of 0 taken as equal to 1. For spectral ratios greater than 70, M_{v} and J shall be taken as equal to their values at a spectral ratio of 70.

For intermediate values of the fundamental lateral period, T_{a}, in cases where S(T_{a}) is obtained by log–log interpolation, M_{v} shall be obtained by linear interpolation using the values of M_{v} obtained in accordance with Note (1). In cases where S(T_{a}) is obtained by linear interpolation, the product S(T_{a})M_{v} shall be obtained by linear interpolation using the values of M_{v} obtained in accordance with Note (1).
For intermediate values of the fundamental lateral period, T_{a}, J shall be obtained by linear interpolation using the values of J obtained in accordance with Note (1).

For a combination of different SFRSs not given in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.table1:long] that are in the same direction under consideration, use the highest M_{v} factor of all the SFRSs and the corresponding value of J.
For fundamental lateral periods, T_{a }, greater than 2.0 s, use the 2.0 s values obtained in accordance with Note (1). See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent2.clause2:long] .

A “coupled” wall is a wall system with coupling beams, where at least 66% of the base overturning moment resisted by the wall system is carried by the axial tension and compression forces resulting from shear in the coupling beams.

For fundamental lateral periods, T_{a}, greater than 4.0 s , use the 4.0 s values of S(T_{a})M_{v }obtained by interpolation between 2.0 s and 5.0 s using the value of M_{v} obtained in accordance with Note (1). See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent2.clause1:long] .

For fundamental lateral periods, T_{a}, greater than 4.0 s , use the 4.0 s values of J obtained by interpolation between 2.0 s and 5.0 s using the value of J obtained in accordance with Note (1). See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent2.clause1:long] .

clauses.text: torsional moments introduced by eccentricity between the centres of mass and resistance and their dynamic amplification, and
torsional moments due to accidental eccentricities.

content.text: Torsional effects shall be accounted for as follows:

clauses.text: for a [REF:term:bldng:building] with B ≤ 1.7 or in Seismic Category SC1 or SC2, by applying torsional moments about a vertical axis at each level throughout the [REF:term:bldng:building] , derived for each of the following load cases considered separately:where F_{x} is determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent7:short] and where each element of the [REF:term:bldng:building] is designed for the most severe effect of the above load cases, or
for a [REF:term:bldng:building] with B > 1.7 in Seismic Category SC3 or SC4, by a Dynamic Analysis Procedure as specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12:long]

content.text: Where the fundamental lateral period, T_{a}, is determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent3.clause4:medium] and the [REF:term:bldng:building] is constructed with more than 4 [REF:term:tr:storeys] of continuous wood construction and has a timber SFRS consisting of shear walls with wood-based panels or of braced or moment-resisting frames as defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art9.table1:long] , the specified lateral earthquake force, V, as determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent2:short] shall be multiplied by 1.2 but need not exceed the value determined by using [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent2.clause3:medium] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote78:long] .)

Except as provided in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art19:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art21:long] , the Dynamic Analysis Procedure shall be in accordance with one of the following methods:

clauses.text: Linear Dynamic Analysis by either the Modal Response Spectrum Method or the Numerical Integration Linear Time History Method using a structural model that complies with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art3.sent8:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote83:short] ), or
Non-linear Dynamic Analysis, in which case a special study shall be performed (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote84:short] ).

content.text: The spectral acceleration values used in the Modal Response Spectrum Method shall be the design spectral acceleration values, S(T), defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent6:long] .

The ground motion time histories used in the Numerical Integration Linear Time History Method shall be compatible with a response spectrum constructed from the design spectral acceleration values, S(T), defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent6:long] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote85:short] .)
The effects of accidental torsional moments acting concurrently with the lateral earthquake forces that cause them shall be accounted for by the following methods:

clauses.text: the static effects of torsional moments due to (±0.10D_{nx})F_{x} at each level x, where F_{x} is either determined from the elastic dynamic analysis or determined from [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent7:long] multiplied by R_{d}R_{o}/I_{E}, shall be combined with the effects determined by dynamic analysis (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote86:short] ), or

if B, as defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent10:long] , is less than 1.7, it is permitted to use a three-dimensional dynamic analysis with the centres of mass shifted by a distance of −0.05D_{nx} and +0.05D_{nx}.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent6:short] , the adjusted elastic base shear, V_{ed}, shall be equal to the elastic base shear, V_{e}, obtained from a Linear Dynamic Analysis.

For [REF:term:bldng:buildings] located on a site designated as other than X_{F} that have an SFRS with R_{d} equal to or greater than 1.5, the elastic base shear, V_{e}, obtained from a Linear Dynamic Analysis may be multiplied by the larger of the following factors to obtain V_{ed}:[EQ:display:es016106q1]

content.text: V_{ed} shall be multiplied by the earthquake importance factor, I_{E}, as determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art5:long] , and shall be divided by R_{d}R_{o}, as determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art9:long] , to obtain the specified lateral earthquake force, V_{d}.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent9:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent12:short] , if V_{d}, as determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent7:short] , is less than 80% of V, as determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11:long] , V_{d} shall be taken as 0.8V.

For irregular structures requiring dynamic analysis in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art7:long] , V_{d} shall be taken as the larger of V_{d}, as determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent7:short] , and 100% of V, as determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11:long]

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent11:short] , the values of elastic [REF:term:tr:storey] shears, [REF:term:tr:storey] forces, member forces, and deflections obtained from the Linear Dynamic Analysis, including the effect of accidental torsion determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent4:short] , shall be multiplied by V_{d}/V_{e} to determine their design values.

For the purpose of calculating deflections, it is permitted to use a value of V based on the value of T_{a} determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent3.clause4:long] to obtain V_{d} in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent8:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent9:short] .

For [REF:term:bldng:buildings] constructed with more than 4 [REF:term:tr:storeys] of continuous wood construction, having a timber SFRS consisting of shear walls with wood-based panels or braced or moment-resisting frames as defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art9.table1:long] , and whose fundamental lateral period, T_{a}, is determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent3.clause4:long] , V_{d} shall be taken as the larger of V_{d}, as determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent7:short] , and 100% of V, as determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote78:long] .)

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent6:short] , lateral deflections of a structure shall be calculated in accordance with the loads and requirements defined in this Subsection.

Lateral deflections obtained from a linear elastic analysis using the methods given in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12:long] and incorporating the effects of torsion, including accidental torsional moments, shall be multiplied by R_{d}R_{o}/I_{E} and increased as required in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art10.sent8:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent1:number] to give realistic values of anticipated deflections.

Based on the lateral deflections calculated in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent2:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent6:short] , the largest inter [REF:term:tr:storey] deflection at any level shall be limited to 0.01h_{s} for [REF:term:pt-dtr-b:post-disaster buildings] , 0.02h_{s} for High Importance Category [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , and 0.025h_{s} for all other [REF:term:bldng:buildings] .

The deflections calculated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent2:short] shall be used to account for sway effects as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect3.art2.sent12:long] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote87:short] .)
The lateral deflections of a seismically isolated structure shall be calculated in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art20:long]
The lateral deflections of a structure with supplemental energy dissipation shall be calculated in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art22:long]
Adjacent structures shall be

clauses.text: separated by a distance equal to at least the square root of the sum of the squares of their individual deflections calculated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent2:long] , or
connected to each other.

content.text: The method of connection required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent1:short] shall take into account the mass, stiffness, strength, ductility and anticipated motion of the connected [REF:term:bldng:buildings] and the character of the connection.
Rigidly connected [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be assumed to have the lowest R_{d}R_{o} value of the [REF:term:bldng:buildings] connected.
[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] with non-rigid or energy-dissipating connections require special studies.

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art15.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art15.sent3:short] , diaphragms, collectors, chords, struts and connections shall be designed so as not to yield, and the design shall account for the shape of the diaphragm, including openings, and for the forces generated in the diaphragm due to the following cases, whichever one governs:

clauses.text: forces determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12:long] applied to the diaphragm are increased to reflect the lateral load capacity of the SFRS, plus forces in the diaphragm due to the transfer of forces between elements of the SFRS associated with the lateral load capacity of such elements and accounting for discontinuities and changes in stiffness in these elements, or
a minimum force corresponding to the specified lateral earthquake force, V, divided by N for the diaphragm at level x.

content.text: Steel deck roof diaphragms in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of less than 4 [REF:term:tr:storeys] or wood diaphragms that are designed and detailed according to the applicable referenced design standards to exhibit ductile behaviour shall meet the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art15.sent1:short] , except that they may yield and the forces shall be

clauses.text: for wood diaphragms acting in combination with vertical wood shear walls, equal to the specified lateral earthquake force, V,
for wood diaphragms acting in combination with other SFRSs, not less than the force corresponding to R_{d}R_{o} = 2.0, and
for steel deck roof diaphragms, not less than the force corresponding to R_{d}R_{o} = 2.0.

content.text: Where diaphragms are designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art15.sent2:short] , the struts shall be designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art15.sent1.clause1:medium] , and the collectors, chords and connections between the diaphragms and the vertical elements of the SFRS shall be designed for forces corresponding to the capacity of the diaphragms in accordance with the applicable CSA standards. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote89:short] .)

For single- [REF:term:tr:storey]  [REF:term:bldng:buildings] with steel deck or wood roof diaphragms designed with a value of R_{d} greater than 1.5 and where the calculated maximum relative deflection, Δ_{D}, of the diaphragm under lateral loads exceeds 50% of the average [REF:term:tr:storey] drift, Δ_{B}, of the adjoining vertical elements of the SFRS, dynamic magnification of the inelastic response due to the in-plane diaphragm deformations shall be accounted for in the design as follows:

clauses.text: the vertical elements of the SFRS shall be designed and detailed to any one of the following:

subclauses.text: to accommodate the anticipated magnified lateral deformations taken as R_{o}R_{d}(Δ_{B} + Δ_{D}) − R_{o}Δ_{D},
to resist the forces magnified by R_{d}(1 + Δ_{D}/Δ_{B})/(R_{d} + Δ_{D}/Δ_{B}), or
by a special study, and

clauses.text: the roof diaphragm and chords shall be designed for in-plane shears and moments determined while taking into consideration the inelastic higher mode response of the structure.

content.text: Where the Seismic Category is SC3 or SC4, the elements supporting any discontinuous wall, column or braced frame shall be designed for the lateral load capacity of the components of the SFRS they support. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote91:short] .)

Where structures have vertical variations of R_{d}R_{o} satisfying [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art9.sent4:long] , the elements of the SFRS below the level where the change in R_{d}R_{o} occurs shall be designed for the forces associated with the lateral load capacity of the SFRS above that level. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote92:short] .)

Where earthquake effects can produce forces in a column or wall due to lateral loading along both orthogonal axes, account shall be taken of the effects of potential concurrent yielding of other elements framing into the column or wall from all directions at the level under consideration and as appropriate at other levels. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote93:short] .)

The design forces associated with the lateral capacity of the SFRS need not exceed the forces determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent1:long] with R_{d}R_{o} taken as 1.0, unless otherwise provided by the applicable referenced design standards for elements, in which case the design forces associated with the lateral capacity of the SFRS need not exceed the forces determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent1:long] with R_{d}R_{o} taken as less than or equal to 1.3. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote94:short] .)

[REF:term:fndtn:Foundations] need not be designed to resist the lateral load overturning capacity of the SFRS, provided the design and the R_{d} and R_{o} for the type of SFRS used conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art9.table1:long] and that the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] is designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent4:long] .
[REF:term:fndtn:Foundation] displacements and rotations shall be considered as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent1:long] .

The increased displacements of the structure resulting from [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] movement shall be shown to be within acceptable limits for both the SFRS and the structural framing elements not considered to be part of the SFRS. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote95:short] .)

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent4:short] , [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] shall be designed to have factored shear and overturning resistances greater than the lateral load capacity of the SFRS. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote96:short] .)

The shear and overturning resistances of the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] determined using a bearing stress equal to 1.5 times the factored bearing strength of the [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] and all other resistances equal to 1.3 times the factored resistances need not exceed the forces determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent1:long] using R_{d}R_{o} = 1.0, except that the factor of 1.3 shall not apply to the portion of the resistance to uplift or overturning resulting from gravity loads.

A [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] is permitted to have a factored overturning resistance less than the lateral load overturning capacity of the supported SFRS, provided the following requirements are met:

clauses.text: neither the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] nor the supported SFRS are constrained against rotation, and
the design overturning moment of the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] is

subclauses.text: not less than 75% of the overturning capacity of the supported SFRS, and
not less than that determined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent1:long] using R_{d}R_{o} = 2.0.

content.text: The design of [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] shall be such that they are capable of transferring earthquake loads and effects between the [REF:term:bldng:building] and the ground without exceeding the capacities of the [REF:term:l:soil] and [REF:term:rck:rock] .
Where the Seismic Category is SC3 or SC4, the following requirements shall be satisfied:

clauses.text: [REF:term:pl:piles] or [REF:term:pl:pile] caps, drilled piers, and [REF:term:cn:caissons] shall be interconnected by continuous ties in not less than two directions (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote98:short] ),
[REF:term:pl:piles] , drilled piers, and [REF:term:cn:caissons] shall be embedded a minimum of 100 mm into the [REF:term:pl:pile] cap or structure, and

[REF:term:pl:piles] , drilled piers, and [REF:term:cn:caissons] , other than wood [REF:term:pl:piles] , shall be connected to the [REF:term:pl:pile] cap or structure for a minimum tension force equal to 0.15 times the factored compression load on the [REF:term:pl:pile] .

content.text: Where the Seismic Category is SC3 or SC4, [REF:term:bmnt:basement] walls shall be designed to resist earthquake lateral pressures from backfill or natural ground. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote99:short] .)
Where the Seismic Category is SC4, the following requirements shall be satisfied:

clauses.text: [REF:term:pl:piles] , drilled piers, or [REF:term:cn:caissons] shall be designed and detailed to accommodate cyclic inelastic behaviour when the design moment in the element due to earthquake effects is greater than 75% of its moment capacity (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote100:short] ), and

spread footings founded on [REF:term:l:soil] designated as X_{V}, where V_{s30} is less than or equal to 180 m/s, X_{E} or X_{F} shall be interconnected by continuous ties in not less than two directions.

content.text: Each segment of a tie between elements that is required by  Clause [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent6.clause1:medium] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent8.clause2:medium] shall be designed to carry by tension or compression a horizontal force at least equal to the greatest factored [REF:term:pl:pile] cap or column vertical load in the elements it connects, multiplied by a factor of 0.1I_{E}S(0.2), unless it can be demonstrated that equivalent restraints can be provided by other means. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote101:short] .)

The potential for liquefaction of the [REF:term:l:soil] and its consequences, such as significant ground displacement and loss of [REF:term:l:soil] strength and stiffness, shall be evaluated based on the ground motion parameters referenced in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect1.subsect3:long] , as modified by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art4:long] , and shall be taken into account in the design of the structure and its [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote102:short] .)

The potential for slope instability and its consequences, such as slope displacement, shall be evaluated based on site-specific material properties and ground motion parameters referenced in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect1.subsect3:long] , as modified by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art4:long] , and shall be taken into account in the design of the structure and its [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote103:short] .)

content.text: For [REF:term:bldng:buildings] in Seismic Category SC1 or SC2, other than [REF:term:pt-dtr-b:post-disaster buildings] , seismically isolated [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , and [REF:term:bldng:buildings] with supplemental energy dissipation systems, the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18.sent1:short] need not apply to Categories 6 through 22 of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18.table1:long]

The weight of access floors shall include the [REF:term:dd-ld:dead load] of the access floor and the weight of permanent equipment, which shall not be taken as less than 25% of the floor [REF:term:lv-ld:live load] .

When the mass of a tank plus its contents or the mass of a flexible or flexibly connected piece of machinery, fixture or equipment is greater than 10% of the mass of the supporting floor, the lateral forces shall be determined by rational analysis.

Forces shall be applied in the horizontal direction that results in the most critical loading for design, except for Category 6 of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18.table1:long] , where the forces shall be applied up and down vertically.

Connections to the structure of elements and components listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18.table1:long] shall be designed to support the component or element for gravity loads, shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18.sent1:short] , and shall also satisfy these additional requirements:

[REF:standard:aci355.2] or [REF:standard:aci355.4] as applicable,

content.text: For the purposes of this Article and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art20:long] , the following terms shall have the meanings stated herein:

clauses.text: “seismic isolation” is an alternative seismic design concept that consists of installing an isolation system with low horizontal stiffness, thereby substantially increasing the fundamental period of the structure;

“isolation system” is a collection of structural elements at the level of the isolation interface that includes all individual isolator units, all structural elements that transfer force between elements of the isolation system, all connections to other structural elements, and may also include a wind-restraint system, energy-dissipation devices, and a displacement restraint system;
“seismically isolated structure” includes the upper portion of the structure above the isolation system, the isolation system, and the portion of the structure below the isolation system;

“isolator unit” is a structural element of the isolation system that permits large lateral deformations under lateral earthquake forces and is characterized by vertical-load-carrying capability combined with increased horizontal flexibility and high vertical stiffness, energy dissipation (hysteretic or viscous), self-centering capability, and lateral restraint (sufficient elastic stiffness) under non-seismic service lateral loads;
“isolation interface” is the boundary between the isolated upper portion of the structure above the isolation system and the lower portion of the structure below the isolation system; and

“wind-restraint system” is the collection of structural elements of the isolation system that provides restraint of the seismically isolated structure for wind loads and is permitted to be either an integral part of the isolator units or a separate device.

content.text: Every seismically isolated structure and every portion thereof shall be analyzed and designed in accordance with

clauses.text: this Article and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art20:long] ,
other applicable requirements of this Subsection, and
appropriate engineering principles and current engineering practice.

content.text: For the analysis and modeling of the seismically isolated structure, the following criteria shall apply:

clauses.text: a three-dimensional Non-linear Dynamic Analysis of the structure shall be performed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote112:short] ),

unless verified from rational analysis, the inherent equivalent viscous damping—excluding the hysteretic damping provided by the isolation system or supplemental energy dissipation devices—used in the analysis shall not be taken as more than 2.5% of the critical damping at the significant modes of vibration,

all individual isolator units shall be modeled with sufficient detail to account for their non-linear force-deformation characteristics, including effects of the relevant loads, and with consideration of variations in material properties over the design life of the structure, and

except for elements of the isolation system, other components of the seismically isolated structure shall be modeled using elastic material properties in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art3.sent8:long] .

subclauses.text: a response spectrum derived from the design spectral acceleration values, S(T), defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent6:long] for site designations X_{V}, where V_{s30} is greater than 360 m/s, X_{A}, X_{B} and X_{C}, and
a 5%-damped response spectrum based on a site-specific evaluation for site designations X_{V}, where V_{s30} is less than or equal to 360 m/s, X_{D}, X_{E} and X_{F}, and

clauses.text: amplitude-scaled in an appropriate manner over the period range of 0.2T_{1} to 1.5T_{1} , where T_{1} is the period of the isolated structure determined using the post-yield stiffness of the isolation system in the horizontal direction under consideration, or the period specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art20.sent1:long] if the post-yield stiffness of the isolation system is not well defined.

content.text: The period of the isolated structure, determined using the post-yield stiffness of the isolation system in the horizontal direction under consideration, shall be greater than three times the period of the structure above the isolation interface calculated as a fixed base.

The isolation system shall be configured to produce a restoring force such that the lateral force at the TDD at the centre of mass of the isolated structure above the isolation interface is at least 0.025W_{b} greater than the lateral force at 50% of the TDD at the same location, in each horizontal direction, where W_{b} is the portion of W above the isolation interface.

The values of [REF:term:tr:storey] shears, [REF:term:tr:storey] forces, member forces, and deflections used in the design of all structural framing elements and components of the isolation system shall be obtained from analysis conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art19.sent3:long] using one of the following values, whichever produces the most critical effect:

clauses.text: mean plus I_{E} times the standard deviation of results of all Non-linear Dynamic Analyses, or
√I_{E} times the mean of the results of all Non-linear Dynamic Analyses.

content.text: The force-deformation and damping characteristics of the isolation system used in the analysis and design of seismically isolated structures shall be validated by testing at least two full-size specimens of each predominant type and size of isolator unit of the isolation system, which shall include

clauses.text: the individual isolator units,
separate supplemental damping devices, if used, and
separate sacrificial wind-restraint systems, if used.

content.text: The force-deformation characteristics and damping value of a representative sample of the isolator units installed in the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be validated by tests prior to their installation.

A diaphragm or horizontal structural elements shall provide continuity immediately above the isolation interface to transmit forces due to non-uniform ground motions from one part of the structure to another.
All structural framing elements shall be designed for the forces described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art20.sent3:short] with R_{d}R_{o} = 1.0 , except

clauses.text: for structures with I_{E} < 1.5 , all SFRSs shall be detailed in accordance with the requirements for R_{d} ≥ 1.5 and the applicable referenced design standards, and
for structures with I_{E} = 1.5 , all SFRSs shall be detailed in accordance with the requirements for R_{d} ≥ 2.0 and the applicable referenced design standards.

content.text: The height restrictions noted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art9.table1:long] need not apply to seismically isolated structures.
All isolator units shall be

clauses.text: designed for the forces described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art20.sent3:short] , and
able to accommodate the TDD determined at the specific location of each isolator unit.

content.text: The isolation system, including a separate wind-restraint system if used, shall limit lateral displacement due to wind loads across the isolation interface to a value equal to that required for the least [REF:term:tr:storey] height in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect3.art5.sent3:long] .
For the purposes of this Article and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art22:long] , the following terms shall have the meanings stated herein:

clauses.text: “supplemental energy dissipation device” is a dedicated structural element of the supplemental energy dissipation system that dissipates energy due to relative motion of each of its ends or by alternative means, and includes all pins, bolts, gusset plates, brace extensions and other components required to connect it to the other elements of the structure; a device may be classified as either displacement-dependent or velocity-dependent, or a combination thereof, and may be configured to act in either a linear or non-linear manner; and
“supplemental energy dissipation system” is a collection of energy dissipation devices installed in a structure that supplement the energy dissipation of the SFRS.

content.text: Every structure with a supplemental energy dissipation system and every portion thereof shall be designed and constructed in accordance with

clauses.text: this Article and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art22:long] ,
other applicable requirements of this Subsection, and
appropriate engineering principles and current engineering practice.

content.text: Where supplemental energy dissipation devices are used across the isolation interface of a seismically isolated structure, displacements, velocities, and accelerations shall be determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art20:long]
For the analysis and modeling of structures with supplemental energy dissipation devices, the following criteria shall apply:

clauses.text: a three-dimensional Non-linear Dynamic Analysis of the structure shall be performed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art12:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote115:short] ),
for an SFRS with R_{d} > 1.0 , the non-linear hysteretic behaviour of the SFRS shall be explicitly—with sufficient detail—accounted for in the modeling and analysis of the structure,

unless verified from rational analysis, the inherent equivalent viscous damping—excluding the damping provided by the supplemental energy dissipation devices—used in the analysis shall not be taken as more than 2.5% of the critical damping at the significant modes of vibration,

all supplemental energy dissipation devices shall be modeled with sufficient detail to account for their non-linear force deformation characteristics, including effects of the relevant loads, and with consideration of variations in their properties over the design life of the structure, and

except for the SFRS and elements of the supplemental energy dissipation system, other components of the structure shall be modeled using elastic material properties in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art3.sent8:long] .

content.text: The ground motion time histories used in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art21.sent4:short] shall be

clauses.text: appropriately selected and scaled following good engineering practice,
compatible with a 5%-damped response spectrum derived from the design spectral acceleration values, S(T), defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent6:long] , and

amplitude-scaled in an appropriate manner over the period range of 0.2T_{1} to 1.5T_{1} , where T_{1} is the fundamental lateral period of the structure with the supplemental energy dissipation system.

content.text: The values of [REF:term:tr:storey] shears, [REF:term:tr:storey] forces, member forces, and deflections for the design of all structural framing elements and all supplemental energy dissipation devices shall be obtained from analysis conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art21.sent4:long] using one of the following values, whichever produces the most critical effect:

clauses.text: mean plus I_{E} times the standard deviation of the results of all Non-linear Dynamic Analyses, or
√I_{E} times the mean of the results of all Non-linear Dynamic Analyses.

content.text: The largest inter [REF:term:tr:storey] deflection at any level of the structure as determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art22.sent1:short] shall conform to the limits stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent3:long] .

The force-deformation and force-velocity characteristics of the supplemental energy dissipation devices used in the analysis and design of structures with supplemental energy dissipation systems shall be validated by testing at least two full-size specimens of each type of supplementary energy dissipation device.

The force-deformation and force-velocity characteristics and damping values of a representative sample of the supplemental energy dissipation devices installed in the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be validated by tests prior to their installation.
All components of a supplemental energy dissipation device, except that portion of the device that dissipates energy, shall be designed to remain elastic.
All structural framing elements shall be designed

clauses.text: for an SFRS with R_{d} = 1.0, using the forces referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art22.sent1:short] with R_{d}R_{o} = 1.0, except that the SFRS shall be detailed in accordance with the requirements for R_{d} ≥ 1.5 and the applicable referenced design standards, or

for an SFRS with R_{d} > 1.0, using the forces referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art22.sent1:short] with R_{d}R_{o} = 1.0, except that the SFRS shall be detailed in accordance with the requirements for the selected R_{d} and the applicable referenced design standards.

content.text: Supplemental energy dissipation devices and other components of the supplemental energy dissipation system shall be designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art22.sent1:short] with consideration of the following:

clauses.text: low-cycle, large-displacement degradation due to earthquake loads,
high-cycle, small-displacement degradation due to wind, thermal, or other cyclic loads,
forces or displacements due to gravity loads,
adhesion of device parts due to corrosion or abrasion, biodegradation, moisture, or chemical exposure,
exposure to environmental conditions, including, but not limited to, temperature, humidity, moisture, radiation (e.g., ultraviolet light), and reactive or corrosive substances (e.g., salt water),
devices subject to failure due to low-cycle fatigue must resist wind forces without slip, movement, or inelastic cycling,
the range of thermal conditions, device wear, manufacturing tolerances, and other effects that cause device properties to vary during the design life of the device, and
connection points of devices must provide sufficient articulation to accommodate simultaneous longitudinal, lateral, and vertical displacements of the supplemental energy dissipation system.

content.text: Means of access for inspection and removal for replacement of all supplemental energy dissipation devices shall be provided.

articles.title: Additional Performance Requirements for Post-disaster Buildings, High Importance Category Buildings, and a Subset of Normal Importance Category Buildings

content.text: [REF:term:bldng:Buildings] designed in accordance with  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art19:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art22:long] need not comply with this Article.

The design of [REF:term:pt-dtr-b:post-disaster buildings] in Seismic Category SC2, SC3 or SC4 shall be verified using 5%-damped spectral acceleration values based on a 5% probability of exceedance in 50 years and shall satisfy the following requirements:

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be shown to behave elastically for a specified lateral earthquake force, V, determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent2:long] using I_{E} = 1.0 and R_{d}R_{o} = 1. 3,

the largest inter [REF:term:tr:storey] deflection at any level of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , as determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent2:long] using I_{E} = 1.0 and R_{d}R_{o} = 1.0, shall not exceed 0.005h_{s}, and

the connections of elements and components of the [REF:term:bldng:building] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18.table1:long] with R_{p} > 1.5 shall be shown to behave elastically for a specified lateral earthquake force, V_{p}, determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18.sent1:long] using R_{p} = 1.5.

content.text: The design of High Importance Category [REF:term:bldng:buildings] in Seismic Category SC3 or SC4 shall be verified using 5%-damped spectral acceleration values based on a 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years and shall satisfy the following requirements:

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be shown to behave elastically for a specified lateral earthquake force, V, determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent2:long] using I_{E} = 1.0 and R_{d}R_{o} = 1.3 ,

the largest inter [REF:term:tr:storey] deflection at any level of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , as determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent2:long] using I_{E} = 1.0 and R_{d}R_{o} = 1.0, shall not exceed 0.005h_{s}, and

the connections of elements and components of the [REF:term:bldng:building] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18.table1:long] with R_{p} > 1.3 shall be shown to behave elastically for a specified lateral earthquake force, V_{p}, determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18.sent1:long] using R_{p} = 1.3 .

content.text: For Normal Importance Category [REF:term:bldng:buildings] in Seismic Category SC4 with a height above [REF:term:grade:grade] of more than 30 m , the structural framing elements not considered to be part of the SFRS shall be designed to behave elastically for a specified lateral earthquake force, V, determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent2:long] using spectral acceleration values based on a 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years and R_{d}R_{o} = 1.3 .

For the purposes of applying  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art23.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art23.sent4:short] , torsional moments due to accidental eccentricities need not be considered if B, as determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent10:long] , does not exceed 1.7.

For the purposes of applying  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art23.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art23.sent4:short] , elements of the SFRS and structural framing elements not considered to be part of the SFRS, when included in the analysis, shall be modeled in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art3.sent8:long] using elastic properties.

All other requirements of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art2:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8.art18:long] shall be satisfied in meeting the additional requirements of this Article.
This Section applies to [REF:term:xcvtn:excavations] and [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] systems for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] .

A [REF:term:brfc-nvt:subsurface investigation] , including [REF:term:grndwtr:groundwater ] conditions, shall be carried out by or under the direction of a professional engineer having knowledge and experience in planning and executing such investigations to a degree appropriate for the [REF:term:bldng:building] and its use, the ground and the surrounding site conditions. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote116:short] .)

Drawings associated with [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] and [REF:term:xcvtn:excavations] shall conform to the appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divC.part2.sect2:long] . (See  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divC.part2.sect2.subsect4.art6:long] .)

A field review shall be carried out by the [REF:term:dgnr:designer] or by another suitably qualified person to ascertain that the subsurface conditions are consistent with the design and that construction is carried out in accordance with the design and good engineering practice. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote117:short] .)
The review required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect2.art3.sent1:short] shall be carried out

clauses.text: on a continuous basis

subclauses.text: during the construction of all [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation units] with all pertinent information recorded for each [REF:term:fndtn-nt:foundation unit] ,
during the installation and removal of retaining structures and related backfilling operations, and
during the placement of engineered [REF:term:fll:fills] that are to be used to support the [REF:term:fndtn-nt:foundation units] , and

clauses.text: as required, unless otherwise directed by the [REF:term:thrt-hvn:authority having jurisdiction] ,

subclauses.text: in the construction of all [REF:term:hllw-fnd:shallow foundation units] , and
in excavating, dewatering and other related works.

content.text: If, during construction, the [REF:term:l:soil] , [REF:term:rck:rock] or [REF:term:grndwtr:groundwater] is found not to be of the type or in the condition used in design and as indicated on the drawings, the design shall be reassessed by the [REF:term:dgnr:designer] .

If, during construction, climatic or any other conditions change the properties of the [REF:term:l:soil] , [REF:term:rck:rock] or [REF:term:grndwtr:groundwater] , the design shall be reassessed by the [REF:term:dgnr:designer] .

Wood used in [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] or in support of [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] shall conform with the appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect1:long]

Wood exposed to [REF:term:l:soil] , [REF:term:rck:rock] or air above the lowest anticipated [REF:term:grndwtr:groundwater ] table shall be treated with preservative in conformance with [REF:standard:csao80series] and the requirements of the appropriate standard as follows:

clauses.text: [REF:standard:csao80.1]
[REF:standard:csao80.2] or
[REF:standard:csao80.3]

content.text: Wood treated as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect3.art2.sent1:short] shall be cared for as provided in [REF:external:csao80.0:Clause 4 of ] [REF:standard:csao80.0]

Plain or reinforced masonry used in [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] or in support of [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] shall conform with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect2:long]

Where plain or reinforced masonry in [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] or in structures supporting [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] may be subject to conditions conducive to deterioration, protection shall be provided to prevent such deterioration.

Plain, reinforced or pre-stressed concrete used in [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] or in support of [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] shall conform with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect3:long]
Where concrete in [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] may be subject to chemical attack, it shall be treated in conformance with the requirements in [REF:standard:csaa23.1]

Steel used in [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] or in support of [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] shall conform with the appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect3:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect4:number] , unless otherwise specified in this Section.
Where steel [REF:term:pl:piles] are used in [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundations] and act as permanent load-carrying members, the steel shall conform with one of the following standards:

clauses.text: [REF:standard:astma252]
[REF:standard:astma283m]
[REF:standard:astma1008m]
[REF:standard:astma1011m] or
[REF:standard:csag40.21]

content.text: Where high strength steel is used for tendons in anchor systems used for the permanent support of a [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] or in the erection of temporary support of [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] adjacent to an [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] , it shall conform with the requirements of [REF:standard:csaa23.1]
Where conditions are corrosive to steel, adequate protection of exposed steel shall be provided. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect2.subsect1.art1:long] for use of other materials.)

The design of [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] , [REF:term:xcvtn:excavations] and [REF:term:l:soil] - and [REF:term:rck:rock] -retaining structures shall be based on a [REF:term:brfc-nvt:subsurface investigation] carried out in conformance with the requirements of this Section, and on any of the following, as appropriate:

clauses.text: application of generally accepted geotechnical and civil engineering principles by a professional engineer especially qualified in this field of work, as provided in this Section and other Sections of Part 4,

established local practice, where such practice includes successful experience both with [REF:term:l:soils] and [REF:term:rck:rocks] of similar type and condition and with a [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] or [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] of similar type, construction method, size and depth, or
in situ testing of [REF:term:fndtn-nt:foundation units] , such as the load testing of [REF:term:pl:piles] , anchors or footings, carried out by a person competent in this field of work.

content.text: The [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] of a [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be capable of resisting all the loads stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1:long] , in accordance with limit states design in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect3:long]

For the purpose of the application of the load combinations given in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect3.art2.table1:long] , the geotechnical components of loads and the factored geotechnical resistances at ULS shall be determined by a suitably qualified and experienced professional engineer. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote119:short] .)
Geotechnical components of service loads and geotechnical reactions for SLS shall be determined by a suitably qualified and experienced professional engineer.

The [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] of a [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be designed to satisfy SLS requirements within the limits that the [REF:term:bldng:building] is designed to accommodate, including total settlement and differential settlement, heave, lateral movement, tilt or rotation. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote120:short] .)

Communication, interaction and coordination between the [REF:term:dgnr:designer] and the professional engineer responsible for the geotechnical aspects of the project shall take place to a degree commensurate with the complexity and requirements of the project.

A [REF:term:brfc-nvt:subsurface investigation] shall be carried out to the depth and extent to which the [REF:term:bldng:building] or [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] will significantly change the stress in the [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] , or to such a depth and extent as to provide all the necessary information for the design and construction of the [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] or the [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] .

The identification and classification of [REF:term:l:soil] , [REF:term:rck:rock] and [REF:term:grndwtr:groundwater] and descriptions of their engineering and physical properties shall be in accordance with a widely accepted system.

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect4.art4.sent2:short] , the [REF:term:brng-rfc:bearing surface ] of a [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] shall be below the level of potential damage, including damage resulting from [REF:term:frt-ctn:frost action] , and the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] shall be designed to prevent damage resulting from [REF:term:dfrzng:adfreezing ] and frost jacking. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote121:short] .)
The [REF:term:brng-rfc:bearing surface] of a [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] need not be below the level of potential damage from frost where the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation]

clauses.text: is designed against [REF:term:frt-ctn:frost action] , or
overlies material not susceptible to [REF:term:frt-ctn:frost action] .

content.text: Where a [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] is to rest on, in or near sloping ground, this particular condition shall be provided for in the design.
Where there is eccentricity or inclination of loading in [REF:term:fndtn-nt:foundation units] , this effect shall be fully investigated and provided for in the design.
Where dynamic loading conditions apply, the effects shall be assessed by a special investigation of these conditions and provided for in the design.
Where a [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] or any part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] is subject to hydrostatic uplift, the effects shall be provided for in the design.

Where proposed construction will result in a temporary or permanent change in the [REF:term:grndwtr-:groundwater level] , the effects of this change on adjacent [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be fully investigated and provided for in the design.

Where conditions of permafrost are encountered or proven to exist, the design of the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] shall be based upon analysis of these conditions by a person especially qualified in that field of work.

Where swelling or shrinking [REF:term:l:soils] , in which movements resulting from moisture content changes may be sufficient to cause damage to a structure, are encountered or known to exist, such a condition shall be fully investigated and provided for in the design.

Where [REF:term:rck:rock] that expands or deteriorates when subjected to unfavourable environmental conditions or to stress release is known to exist, this condition shall be fully investigated and provided for in the design.
[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] may be placed on [REF:term:fll:fill] if it can be shown by [REF:term:brfc-nvt:subsurface investigation] that

clauses.text: the [REF:term:fll:fill] is or can be made capable of safely supporting the [REF:term:bldng:building] ,
detrimental movement of the [REF:term:bldng:building] or of services leading to the [REF:term:bldng:building] will not occur, and
explosive gases can be controlled or do not exist.

content.text: The structural design of the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] of a [REF:term:bldng:building] , the procedures and construction practices shall conform with the appropriate Sections of this Code unless otherwise specified in this Section.

The design of [REF:term:xcvtn:excavations] and of supports for the sides of [REF:term:xcvtn:excavations ] shall conform with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect4:long] and with this Subsection. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote122:short] .)
Every [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] shall be undertaken in such a manner as to

clauses.text: prevent movement that would cause damage to adjacent [REF:term:bldng:buildings] at all phases of construction, and
comply with the appropriate requirements of Part 8.

content.text: Material shall not be placed nor shall equipment be operated or placed in or adjacent to an [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] in a manner that may endanger the integrity of the [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] or its supports.

The sides of an [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] in [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock ] shall be supported by a retaining structure conforming with the requirements of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect5.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect5.art2:number] , except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect5.art4:long]

The sides of an [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] in [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock ] may be unsupported where a design is prepared in conformance with the requirements of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect5.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect5.art2:number]

Surface water, all [REF:term:grndwtr:groundwater] , [REF:term:prchd-gr:perched groundwater] and in particular [REF:term:rtn-grnd:artesian groundwater] shall be kept under control at all phases of [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] and construction.
At all phases of [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] and construction, loss of ground due to water or any other cause shall be prevented.

All sides of an [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] , supported and unsupported, shall be continuously maintained and protected from possible deterioration by construction activity or by the action of frost, rain and wind.
Where an [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] is backfilled, the backfill shall be placed so as to

clauses.text: provide lateral support to the [REF:term:l:soil] adjacent to the [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] , and
prevent detrimental movements.

content.text: The material used as backfill or [REF:term:fll:fill] supporting a footing, [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] or a floor on [REF:term:grade:grade] shall be of a type that is not subject to detrimental volume change with changes in moisture content and temperature.

The design of [REF:term:hllw-fnd:shallow foundations] shall be in conformance with  Subsection [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect4:long] and the requirements of this Subsection. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote123:short] .)

Where a [REF:term:hllw-fnd:shallow foundation] is to be placed on [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] , the [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] shall be cleaned of loose and unsound material and shall be adequate to support the design load taking into account temperature, precipitation, construction activities and other factors that may lead to changes in the properties of [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] .
Where a [REF:term:hllw-fnd:shallow foundation unit] has not been placed or located as indicated on the drawings,

clauses.text: the error shall be corrected, or

the design of the [REF:term:fndtn-nt:foundation unit] shall be recalculated for the altered conditions by the [REF:term:dgnr:designer ] and action taken as required in  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divC.part2.sect2.subsect4.art7:long] .

content.text: If a [REF:term:hllw-fnd:shallow foundation unit] is damaged,

clauses.text: it shall be repaired, or

the design of the [REF:term:fndtn-nt:foundation unit] shall be recalculated for the damaged condition by the [REF:term:dgnr:designer ] and action taken as required in  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divC.part2.sect2.subsect4.art7:long] .

content.text: A [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation] shall provide support for a [REF:term:bldng:building] by transferring loads by end-bearing to a competent stratum at considerable depth below the structure, or by mobilizing resistance by adhesion or friction, or both, in the [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] in which it is placed. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote124:short] .)

[REF:term:dp-fndtn:Deep foundations] shall be designed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect4:long] and this Subsection. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote125:short] .)

Where [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation units] are load tested, as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent1.clause3:long] , the determination of the number and type of load test and the interpretation of the results shall be carried out by a professional engineer especially qualified in this field of work. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote126:short] .)
The design of [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundations] shall be determined on the basis of geotechnical considerations taking into account

clauses.text: the method of installation,
the degree of inspection,
the spacing of [REF:term:fndtn-nt:foundation units] and group effects,
other requirements in this Subsection, and

the appropriate structural requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1:long] and  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect1:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect3:number] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect4:number]

content.text: The portion of a [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation unit] permanently in contact with [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] shall be structurally designed as a laterally supported compression member.

The portion of a [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation unit] that is not permanently in contact with [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] shall be structurally designed as a laterally unsupported compression member.
The structural design of prefabricated [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation units] shall allow for all stresses resulting from driving, handling and testing.

Permissible deviations from the design alignment and the location of the top of [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation units] shall be determined by design analysis and shall be indicated on the drawings.

Where a [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation unit] has not been placed within the permissible deviations referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect7.art3:long] , the condition of the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] shall be assessed by the [REF:term:dgnr:designer] , any necessary changes made and action taken as required in  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divC.part2.sect2.subsect4.art7:long] .
[REF:term:dp-fndtn:Deep foundation units] shall be installed in such a manner as not to impair

clauses.text: the strength of the [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation units] and the properties of the [REF:term:l:soil] or [REF:term:rck:rock] on or in which they are placed beyond the calculated or anticipated limits,
the integrity of previously installed [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation units] , or
the integrity of neighbouring [REF:term:bldng:buildings] .

content.text: Where inspection shows that a [REF:term:dp-fndtn:deep foundation unit] is damaged or not consistent with design or good engineering practice,

clauses.text: such a unit shall be reassessed by the [REF:term:dgnr:designer] ,
any necessary changes shall be made, and
action shall be taken as required in  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divC.part2.sect2.subsect4.art7:long] .

content.text: Where special [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] systems are used, such systems shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect4:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect1.art5.sent2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect2.subsect1.art1:long] .
Existing [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] may be used to support new or altered [REF:term:bldng:buildings] provided they comply with all pertinent requirements of this Section.
[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] and their structural members made of wood shall conform to [REF:standard:csao86]
Glued-laminated members shall be fabricated in plants conforming to [REF:standard:csao177]

In areas known to be infested by termites, the requirements in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect3.subsect2.art9:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect12.subsect1.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect15.subsect5.art1:long] shall apply.

articles.title: Design Basis for Plain and Reinforced Masonry

content.text: [REF:term:bldng:Buildings] and their structural members made of plain and reinforced masonry shall conform to [REF:standard:csas304]

articles.title: Design Basis for Plain, Reinforced and Pre-stressed Concrete

content.text: [REF:term:bldng:Buildings ] and their structural members made of plain, reinforced and pre-stressed concrete shall conform to [REF:standard:csaa23.3] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote127:short] .)
[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] and their structural members made of structural steel shall conform to [REF:standard:csas16] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote128:short] .)
[REF:term:bldng:Buildings ] and their structural members made of cold-formed steel shall conform to [REF:standard:csas136] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote129:short] .)
Steel [REF:term:bldng:building] systems shall be manufactured by companies certified in accordance with the requirements of [REF:standard:csaa660]

[REF:term:bldng:Buildings] and their structural members made of aluminum shall conform to [REF:standard:csas157s157.1] using the loads stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1:long] , in accordance with limit states design in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect3:long]
Glass used in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be designed in conformance with

clauses.text: [REF:standard:cgsb-12.20] using an adjustment factor on the wind load, W, of not less than 0.75, or
[REF:standard:astme1300] using an adjustment factor on the wind load, W, of not less than 1.0.

subsections.title: Air-, Cable- and Frame-Supported Membrane Structures

articles.title: Design Basis for Air-, Cable- and Frame-Supported Membrane Structures

content.text: The structural design of air-, cable- and frame-supported membrane structures shall conform to [REF:standard:csas367] using the loads stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1:long] , in accordance with limit states design in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect3:long]

articles.title: Design Basis for Storage Garages and Repair Garages

content.text: [REF:term:trg-grg:Storage garages] and [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garages] , including associated ramps and pedestrian areas, shall be designed in conformance with the performance requirements of [REF:standard:csas413] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote131:short] .)
Storage racks, including anchorage of racks, shall be designed for loads in accordance with this Part. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote107:short] .)

For the purpose of compliance with this Code as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent1.clause2:long] , the objectives and functional statements attributed to the acceptable solutions in this Part shall be the objectives and functional statements listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect5.subsect1.art1.table1:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.appendix.appnote1:long] .)
