articles.title: Installation of Windows, Doors and Skylights

content.text: Except as provided by Sentence (2), the installation of manufactured and pre-assembled windows, doors and skylights and the field assembly of manufactured window and door combination units shall conform to the instructions, if any, provided by the manufacturer.
In case of conflict between the provisions of this Code and instructions referred to in Sentence (1), the provisions of this Code shall govern.
Windows, doors and skylights shall be sealed to air barriers.
The sealing compound used to seal the glass component of an insulating glazing unit to the sash component shall be compatible with the sealing compound used to edge seal the glass component.
Flashing used to protect openings shall conform to  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art7:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art8:long]
Sealants shall be applied between window frames or trim and the exterior cladding or masonry in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect4:long]

All unfinished portions of the frame and other components of aluminum windows, doors or skylights in contact with the edges of masonry, concrete, stucco or plaster shall be protected with an alkali-resistant coating.

sections.title: Stairs, Ramps, Landings, Handrails and Guards

content.text: This Section applies to the design and construction of interior and exterior stairs, steps, [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , handrails and [REF:term:guard:guards] .

articles.title: Stairs, Ramps, Landings, Handrails and Guards in Garages

content.text: Where stairs, [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , landings, handrails or [REF:term:guard:guards] are installed in garages that serve a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, the garage shall be considered to be part of the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and the requirements for stairs, [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , landings, handrails and [REF:term:guard:guards] within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] shall apply.

Where a stair, [REF:term:rmp:ramp] or landing forms part of an [REF:term:xt:exit] , the appropriate requirements in  Sections [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10:long] shall also apply.
Escalators and moving walkways shall conform to the appropriate requirements in Part 3.
Tactile attention indicators shall be installed in conformance with Article 3.3.1.19.

Except as provided in Sentence (2), required [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs and public stairs serving [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall have a width of not less than 900 mm .

[REF:term:xt:Exit] stairs serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall have a width of not less than 860 mm .
Required [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs and public stairs serving [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of other than [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall have a width of not less than the greater of

clauses.text: 900 mm , or
8 mm per person based on the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] limits specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17.art1.table1:long]

content.text: At least one stair between each floor level within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , and exterior stairs serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] except required [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs, shall have a width of not less than 860 mm .

The clear height over stairs shall be measured vertically, over the clear width of the stair, from a straight line tangent to the tread and landing nosings to the lowest point above. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote155:long] and Note A-9.5.3.1.)
Except as provided in Sentences (3), the clear height over stairs shall not be less than 2 050 mm .
The clear height over stairs serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall not be less than 1 950 mm .
Reserved

Except as provided by Sentence (2), stairs in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] other than [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and houses with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] , including their common spaces, shall consist of

clauses.text: straight [REF:term:flght:flights] , or
except as provided in Sentence (4), curved [REF:term:flght:flights] .

content.text: Stairs within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] , including their common spaces, shall consist of

clauses.text: straight [REF:term:flght:flights] ,
except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent4:short] , curved [REF:term:flght:flights] ,
reserved,
except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent3:short] , [REF:term:flght:flights] with rectangular treads and winders, or
reserved.

content.text: Only one set of winders described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art6:long] shall be permitted between floor levels.
Curved [REF:term:flght:flights] in [REF:term:xt:exits] shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art9.sent2:long] .
All [REF:term:tpr-thr:tapered treads] within a [REF:term:flght:flight] shall turn in the same direction.
Except for stairs within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , at least 3 risers shall be provided in interior [REF:term:flght:flights] .
The vertical height of any [REF:term:flght:flight] of stairs shall not exceed 3.7 m .

Except for stairs serving areas only used as [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] or [REF:term:rvc-pc:service spaces] , the rise, which is measured as the vertical nosing-to-nosing distance, shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art1.table1:long]

content.title: Rise for Rectangular Treads, Tapered Treads and Winders

table_notes.content: Private stairs are exterior and interior stairs that serve[LIST:bulleted]

items.content: single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] ,
houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, or
garages that serve houses described in Clause a) or b).

table_notes.content: Public stairs are all stairs not described as service stairs or private stairs.

content.text: Except for stairs serving areas only used as [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] or [REF:term:rvc-pc:service spaces] , the [REF:term:run:run] shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art2.table1:long]

table_notes.content: Private stairs are exterior and interior stairs that serve[LIST:bulleted]

items.content: single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] ,
houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, or
garages that serve houses described in Clause a) or b).

table_notes.content: Public stairs are all stairs not described as service stairs or private stairs.

content.text: The depth of a rectangular tread shall be not less than its [REF:term:run:run] and not more than its [REF:term:run:run] plus 25 mm .
Except as provided in Sentence (3) and Article 9.8.4.6., [REF:term:tpr-thr:tapered treads] shall have a [REF:term:run:run] that

clauses.text: is not less than 150 mm at the narrow end of the tread, and

complies with the dimensions stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art2.table1:long] when measured at a point 300 mm from the centre line of the handrail at the narrow end of the tread.

content.text: [REF:term:tpr-thr:Tapered treads] in required [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs shall conform to the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art9:long]
The depth of a [REF:term:tpr-thr:tapered tread] shall be not less than its [REF:term:run:run] at any point and not more than its [REF:term:run:run] at any point plus 25 mm .

articles.title: Uniformity and Tolerances for Risers, Runs and Treads

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art4.sent2:short] , risers shall be of uniform height in any one [REF:term:flght:flight] , with a maximum tolerance of

clauses.text: 5 mm between adjacent treads or landings, and
10 mm between the tallest and shortest risers in a [REF:term:flght:flight] .

content.text: Except for required [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs, where the top or bottom riser in a stair adjoins a sloping finished walking surface, such as a garage floor, driveway or sidewalk, the height of the riser across the stair shall vary by not more than 1 in 12 .
Rectangular treads shall have a uniform [REF:term:run:run] with a maximum tolerance of

clauses.text: 5 mm between adjacent treads, and
10 mm between the deepest and shallowest treads in a [REF:term:flght:flight] .

content.text: [REF:term:tpr-thr:Tapered treads] in a [REF:term:flght:flight] shall have a uniform [REF:term:run:run] in accordance with the construction tolerances stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art4.sent3:short] when measured at a point 300 mm from the centre line of the handrail as described in Sentence 9.8.7.1.(5).
The slope of treads shall not exceed 1 in 50 .
Individual treads in winders shall turn through an angle of

clauses.text: 30° with no deviation above or below 30°, or
45° with no deviation above or below 45°.

content.text: Where winders are incorporated into a stair, each set shall not turn through more than 90°.

Treads in winders shall have a [REF:term:run:run] , measured at a point 200 mm from the narrow end of the tread, conforming to the minimum [REF:term:run:run] requirements for a private stair in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art2.table1:long] .

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art8.sent2:short] , the top of the nosings of stair treads shall have a rounded or beveled edge extending not less than 6 mm and not more than 14 mm measured horizontally from the front of the nosing.

If resilient material is used to cover the nosing of a stair tread, the minimum extension of the rounded or beveled edge required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art8.sent1:short] is permitted to be reduced to 3 mm .
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect4.art9.sent2:short] , stairs shall have no open risers.
Open risers are permitted in

clauses.text: interior and exterior stairs that serve a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] ,
fire escape stairs,
stairs that are principally used for maintenance,
stairs that serve [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] , and
stairs that serve [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] other than [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] .

content.text: This Subsection applies to pedestrian [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , except [REF:term:rmp:ramps] in an accessible path of travel.
[REF:term:rmp:Ramps] in an accessible path of travel shall conform to the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5:long]
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect5.art2.sent2:short] , [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall be not less than 1 100 mm wide.
[REF:term:rmp:Ramps] serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be not less than 860 mm wide.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect5.art3.sent2:short] , the clear height over [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall be not less than 2 050 mm .

The clear height over [REF:term:rmp:ramps] serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be not less than 1 950 mm .
The slope of [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall be not more than

clauses.text: 1 in 10 for exterior [REF:term:rmp:ramps] ,
1 in 10 for interior [REF:term:rmp:ramps] serving [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] ,
1 in 6 for [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] , and
1 in 8 for all other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] .

content.text: Where the slope of the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] is greater than 1 in 12, the maximum rise between floors or landings shall be 1 500 mm .
This Subsection applies to landings, except landings for [REF:term:rmp:ramps] in an accessible path of travel.
Landings for [REF:term:rmp:ramps] in an accessible path of travel shall conform to the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5:long]
Finished floors, and ground surfaces with a slope not exceeding 1 in 50 , at the top and bottom of stairs or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall be considered as landings.

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect6.art2.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect6.art2.sent4:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art6.sent2:long] , a landing shall be provided

clauses.text: at the top and bottom of each [REF:term:flght:flight] of interior and exterior stairs, including stairs in garages,
at the top and bottom of every [REF:term:rmp:ramp] with a slope greater than 1 in 50,
where a doorway opens onto a stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] ,
where a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] opens onto a stair, and
where a stair opens onto a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] .

content.text: Where a door at the top of a stair within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] swings away from the stair, no landing is required between the doorway and the stair. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote33:short] .)

A landing may be omitted at the top of an exterior [REF:term:flght:flight] serving a secondary entrance to a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, provided

clauses.text: the stair does not contain more than 3 risers ,
the principal door is a sliding door or swings away from the stair, and
only a storm or screen door, if any, swings over the stair and is equipped with hardware to hold it open.

content.text: A landing may be omitted at the bottom of an exterior stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , provided there is no obstruction, such as a gate or door, within the lesser of the width of the stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] or

clauses.text: 900 mm for stairs or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a secondary suite including their common spaces, and
1 100 mm for stairs or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] not described in Clause (a).

articles.title: Dimensions of Landings
articles.see_also: (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote160:long] ) (See also  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art1:long]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art6:long] regarding landings in [REF:term:xt:exits] .)

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect6.art3.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect6.art3.sent7:short] , landings shall be at least as wide and as long as the width of the stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] in which they occur.
Where the landing in a stairway or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] does not turn or turns less than 90°, the length of the landing need not be more than the lesser of

clauses.text: the required width of the stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , or

content.text: The length of a landing shall be measured perpendicular to the nosings of adjacent steps or to the end of the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , at a distance equal to half the length required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect6.art3.sent2:short] from the narrow edge of the landing.
Where stair [REF:term:flght:flights] or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] of different widths adjoin a single landing, the minimum width of the landing shall be

clauses.text: where one or more of the stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] widths do not exceed their respective required widths, not less than the greater required stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] width, or
where all of the widths of the stairs or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] exceed their respective required widths, not less than the lesser actual stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] width.

content.text: Where a door swings toward a stair, the full arc of the swing shall be over the landing.
The slope of landings shall not exceed 1 in 50 .

Where a doorway or stairway opens onto the side of a [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , the landing shall extend for a distance of not less than 300 mm on either side of the doorway or stairway, except on a side abutting an end wall.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect6.art4.sent2:short] , the clear height over landings shall be not less than 2 050 mm .
The clear height over landings serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be not less than 1 950 mm .
Except as provided in Sentences (2) to (4), handrails shall be installed on stairs and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect7.art1.table1:long]

content.title: Number of Sides of Stair or Ramp Required to Have a Handrail

content.value: Number of Sides Required to Have a Handrail
Within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite]

content.text: Except where a stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] serves not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , at least one handrail shall be located not more than 750 mm from the natural path of travel on the stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] . (See Note A-9.8.7.1.(2).)
Handrails are not required for stairs and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a secondary suite including their common spaces, where

clauses.text: interior stairs have not more than 2 risers ,
exterior stairs have not more than 3 risers , or
[REF:term:rmp:ramps] rise not more than 400 mm .

content.text: Only one handrail is required on exterior stairs having more than 3 risers provided such stairs serve not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces.

Except for stairs with winders, where a [REF:term:flght:flight] of stairs within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a secondary suite including their common spaces consists of [REF:term:tpr-thr:tapered treads] , or a mix of [REF:term:tpr-thr:tapered treads] and rectangular treads, one handrail shall be installed along the narrow end of the treads.
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect7.art2.sent3:short] , required handrails shall be continuously graspable throughout the length of

clauses.text: [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , and
[REF:term:flght:flights] of stairs, from the bottom riser to the top riser.

content.text: Except for stairs or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, at least one required handrail shall be continuous throughout the length of the stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , including at the landing except where interrupted by doorways. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote162:long] .)

For stairs or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, a handrail is permitted to start from a newel post or volute installed on the bottom tread.
Handrails shall be terminated in a manner that will not obstruct pedestrian travel or create a hazard. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote36:short] .)

Except for stairs and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] serving only one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, at least one handrail at the sides of a stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] shall extend horizontally not less than 300 mm beyond the top and bottom of each [REF:term:flght:flight] or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote37:short] .)
The height of handrails on stairs and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall be measured vertically from the top of the handrail to

clauses.text: a straight line drawn tangent to the tread nosings of the stair served by the handrail, or
the surface of the [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , floor or landing served by the handrail.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect7.art4.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause5:long] , required handrails shall be 865 mm to 1 070 mm high.
Handrails installed in addition to required handrails need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect7.art4.sent2:short] .
The clearance between a handrail and the surface behind it shall be not less than

clauses.text: 50 mm , or
where said surface is rough or abrasive, 60 mm .

content.text: All handrails shall be constructed so as to be continually graspable along their entire length with no obstruction on or above them to break a handhold. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote39:short] .)

Handrails and constructions below handrails, including handrail supports and stair stringers, shall not project more than 100 mm into the required width of a stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] . (See also  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect2.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect5.art2:long] )
Handrails and their supports shall be designed and constructed to withstand the following loads, which need not be considered to act simultaneously:

clauses.text: a concentrated load of not less than 0.9 kN applied at any point and in any direction for all handrails, and
for handrails other than those serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , a uniform load of not less than 0.7 kN/m .

content.text: Where exterior or interior handrails serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces are attached to wood studs or blocking, the attachment shall be deemed to comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect7.art7.sent1:short] , where

clauses.text: the attachment points are spaced not more than 1.2 m apart measured on the horizontal plane,
the first attachment point at either end is located no more than 300 mm from the end of the handrail, and
the fasteners consist of not less than 2 No. 8 wood screws at each point, penetrating not less than 32 mm into solid wood.

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art1.sent2:short] and except at the leading edge at the top of a [REF:term:flght:flight] , every surface to which access is provided, including but not limited to [REF:term:flght:flights] of steps and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , exterior landings, porches, balconies, [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] , galleries and raised [REF:term:wlkw:walkways] , shall be protected by a [REF:term:guard:guard] on each side that is not protected by a wall for the length where the difference in elevation is more than 600 mm between the walking surface and the adjacent surface within 1.2 m .
[REF:term:guard:Guards] are not required

clauses.text: at loading docks,
at floor pits in [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garages] , or
where access is provided for maintenance purposes only.

content.text: Doors in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] , where the finished floor on one side of the door is more than 600 mm above the floor or other constructed surface or ground level on the other side of the door, shall be protected by

clauses.text: a [REF:term:guard:guard] , or
a mechanism capable of controlling the free swinging or sliding of the door so as to limit any clear unobstructed opening to not more than 100 mm .

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art1.sent5:short] , openable windows in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall be protected by

clauses.text: a [REF:term:guard:guard] , or

a mechanism that can only be released with the use of tools or special knowledge to control the free swinging or sliding operation of the openable part of the window so as to limit any clear unobstructed opening to not more than 100 mm measured either vertically or horizontally.

content.text: Windows need not be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art1.sent4:short] , where the bottom edge of the openable portion of the window is located

clauses.text: more than 900 mm above the finished floor, or
less than 1 800 mm above the floor or ground on the other side of the window.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art1.sent7:short] , glazing installed over [REF:term:tr:stairs] , [REF:term:rmp:ramps] and landings that extends to less than 1 070 mm above the surface of the treads, [REF:term:rmp:ramp] or landing shall be

clauses.text: protected by [REF:term:guard:guards] , in accordance with this Subsection, or
non-openable and designed to withstand the specified lateral loads for balcony [REF:term:guard:guards] as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art14:long]

content.text: In [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and houses with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, glazing installed over [REF:term:tr:stairs] , [REF:term:rmp:ramps] and landings that extends to less than 900 mm above the surface of the treads, [REF:term:rmp:ramp] or landing shall be

clauses.text: protected by [REF:term:guard:guards] , in accordance with this Subsection, or
non-openable and designed to withstand the specified lateral loads for balcony [REF:term:guard:guards] as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art14:long]

content.text: Glazing installed in public areas that extends to less than 1 m from the floor and is located above the second [REF:term:tr:storey] in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall be

clauses.text: protected by [REF:term:guard:guards] in accordance with this Subsection, or
non-openable and designed to withstand the specified lateral loads for balcony [REF:term:guard:guards] as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art14:long]

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art2.sent2:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art2.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art2.sent5:short] , [REF:term:guard:guards] shall be designed to resist the specified loads prescribed in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art2.table1:long]

table_notes.content: The load that creates the most critical condition shall apply.
See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art2.sent3:short] .

Horizontal Load Applied Outward on Elements Within the [REF:term:guard:Guard] , Including Solid Panels and Balusters

[REF:term:guard:Guards] within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and exterior [REF:term:guard:guards] serving not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units]
0.5 kN/m OR concentrated load of 1.0 kN applied at any point [REF:table-note:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art2.table1.note1]

content.text: The size of the opening between any two adjacent vertical elements within a [REF:term:guard:guard] shall not exceed the limits required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art5.sent1:long] when each of these elements is subjected to a specified [REF:term:lv-ld:live load] of 0.1 kN applied in opposite directions in the in-plane direction of the [REF:term:guard:guard] so as to produce the most critical effect.

For [REF:term:guard:guards] within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and within houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces and for exterior [REF:term:guard:guards] serving not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , where the width and spacing of balusters are such that three balusters can be engaged by a load imposed over a 300 mm width, the load shall be imposed so as to engage three balusters .
None of the loads specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art2.table1:long] need be considered to act simultaneously.

For [REF:term:guard:guards] within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and within houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces and for exterior [REF:term:guard:guards] serving not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art2.table1:long] need not apply where the [REF:term:guard:guard] construction used has been demonstrated to provide effective performance.

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art3.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art3.sent3:short] , all [REF:term:guard:guards] shall be not less than 1 070 mm high.
All [REF:term:guard:guards] within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or within houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be not less than 900 mm high.

Exterior [REF:term:guard:guards] serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be not less than 900 mm high where the walking surface served by the [REF:term:guard:guard] is not more than 1 800 mm above the finished ground level.

The height of [REF:term:guard:guards] for [REF:term:flght:flights] of steps shall be measured vertically from the top of the [REF:term:guard:guard] to a line drawn through the tread nosing served by the [REF:term:guard:guard] .

articles.title: Guards for Floors and Ramps in Garages

content.text: Except for floors of garages referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect35:long] , where garage floors or ramps are 600 mm or more above the adjacent ground or floor level, every opening through a garage floor and the perimeter of floors and ramps that have no exterior walls shall be provided with

clauses.text: a continuous curb not less than 140 mm in height, and
a [REF:term:guard:guard] not less than 1 070 mm above the floor level.

content.text: Vehicle guardrails shall be designed and constructed to withstand the loading values stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art15.sent1:long] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.appendix.appnote32:long] .)

Except as permitted in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art5.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art5.sent4:short] , openings through [REF:term:guard:guards] shall be of a size that prevents the passage of a spherical object having a diameter of 100 mm . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote45:short] .)

Except for [REF:term:guard:guards] that serve [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] , the triangular openings formed by stair risers, stair treads and the bottom element of a required [REF:term:guard:guard] shall be of a size that prevents the passage of a 150 mm diam sphere.
Except where they serve [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] , [REF:term:guard:guards] in [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] are permitted to consist of

clauses.text: a top railing, and
one or more horizontal intermediate rails spaced such that the size of the openings through the [REF:term:guard:guard] prevents the passage of a spherical object having a diameter of 535 mm .

content.text: Openings through any [REF:term:guard:guard] that is not required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art1:long] and that serves an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] other than an [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancy] shall be of a size that

clauses.text: prevents the passage of a spherical object having a diameter of 100 mm , or
permits the passage of a spherical object having a diameter of 200 mm .

articles.title: Design of Guards to Not Facilitate Climbing

content.text: Except for [REF:term:guard:guards] in [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancies] , [REF:term:guard:guards] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect8.art1:long] that protect a level located more than 4.2 m above the adjacent level shall be designed so that no member, attachment or opening located between 140 mm and 900 mm above the level protected by the [REF:term:guard:guard] facilitates climbing. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote47:short] .)
Glass in [REF:term:guard:guards] shall be

clauses.text: safety glazing of the laminated or tempered type conforming to [REF:standard:cgsb-12.1] or
wired glass conforming to [REF:standard:cgsb-12.11]

content.text: Except as specified in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect9.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect9.art5:long] , stairs and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] shall be designed for strength and rigidity under uniform loading criteria to support specified loads of

clauses.text: 1.9 kPa for stairs and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, and
4.8 kPa for other stairs and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] .

content.text: Exterior concrete stairs with more than 2 risers and 2 treads shall be

clauses.text: supported on unit masonry or concrete walls or piers not less than 150 mm in cross section, or
cantilevered from the main [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] wall.

content.text: Stairs described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect9.art2.sent1:short] , when cantilevered from the [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] wall, shall be constructed and installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect10:long]
The depth below ground level for [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] for exterior steps shall conform to the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect12:long]
Exterior wood steps shall not be in direct contact with the ground unless suitably treated with a wood preservative.
Wooden stair stringers shall

clauses.text: have a minimum effective depth of 90 mm , measured perpendicularly to the bottom of the stringer at the point of minimum cross-section, and an overall depth of not less than 235 mm ,
be supported and secured top and bottom,
be not less than 25 mm actual thickness if supported along their length and 38 mm actual thickness if unsupported along their length, and

except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect9.art4.sent2:short] , be spaced not more than 900 mm o.c. in stairs serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, and 600 mm o.c. in other stairs.

content.text: For stairs serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, where risers support the front portion of the tread, the space between stringers shall be not more than 1 200 mm .

Stair treads of lumber, plywood or OSB within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] shall be not less than 25 mm actual thickness, except that, where open risers are permitted and the distance between stringers exceeds 750 mm , the treads shall be not less than 38 mm actual thickness.
Stair treads of plywood or OSB that are not continuously supported by the riser shall have their face grain or direction of face orientation at right angles to the stringers.

The finish for treads and landings of interior stairs in [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , other than stairs to unfinished [REF:term:bmnt:basements] , shall consist of hardwood, vertical grain softwood, resilient flooring or other material providing equivalent performance.

Treads and landings of interior and exterior stairs and [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , other than those within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or within houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, shall have a slip-resistant finish or be provided with slip-resistant strips that extend not more than 1 mm above the surface.
Exterior concrete steps and their anchorage system that are cantilevered from a [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] wall shall be designed and installed to support the loads to which they may be subjected.
Cantilevered concrete steps referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect10.art1:long] shall be anchored to concrete [REF:term:fndtn:foundation] walls not less than 200 mm thick.

articles.title: Prevention of Damage Due to Frost

content.text: Suitable precautions shall be taken during backfilling and grading operations to ensure that subsequent freezing of the [REF:term:l:soil] will not cause uplift forces on the underside of cantilevered concrete steps to the extent that the steps or the walls to which they are attached will be damaged.

Stairways, handrails and [REF:term:guard:guards] in a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] shall conform to the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8:long] as well as to the requirements in this Section.

In addition to the fire protection requirements provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4:long] , [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread ratings] , [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance ratings] and [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection ratings] for [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10:long]

Except for [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be the number of persons for which such areas are designed, but not fewer than that determined from [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17.art1.table1:long] , unless it can be shown that the area will be occupied by fewer persons.
The [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] for [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] shall be based on 2 persons per bedroom or sleeping area.
Except as otherwise provided in this Section, an [REF:term:xt:exit] from any [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be one of the following used singly or in combination:

clauses.text: an exterior doorway,
an exterior passageway,
an exterior [REF:term:rmp:ramp] ,
an exterior stairway,
a fire escape,
a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] ,
an interior passageway,
an interior [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , or
an interior stairway.

content.text: Fire escapes shall only be used as [REF:term:xt:exits] on existing [REF:term:bldng:buildings] and shall be designed and installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7:long]

Where a [REF:term:hrzntl-x:horizontal exit] is used, it shall conform to  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect1.art6.sent1:long] and  Article [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art10:long]
An [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be designed for no purpose other than for exiting except that an [REF:term:xt:exit] may also serve as an access to a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] .

articles.title: Elevators, Slide Escapes and Windows as Means of Egress

content.text: Elevators, slide escapes and windows shall not be considered as part of a required [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] .

Except for doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, at least one door at every principal entrance to a [REF:term:bldng:building] providing access from the exterior at ground level shall be designed in accordance with the requirements for [REF:term:xt:exits] .
Except as required by Sentences 9.9.3.3.(2) and 9.9.3.4.(3), this Subsection applies to every [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] except

clauses.text: [REF:term:xt:exits] that serve not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, and
[REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exits] within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and within houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces.

content.text: Except for doors and corridors, the width of every [REF:term:xt:exit] facility shall be not less than 900 mm . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art3:long] for doors, [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect2.art1:long] for stairs, and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect5.art2:long] for [REF:term:rmp:ramps] .)

The width of every [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , corridor used by the public, and [REF:term:xt:exit] corridor shall be not less than 1 100 mm . (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect5:long] for obstructions in corridors.)

The width of [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] and [REF:term:xt:exit] corridors that serve only a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be not less than 860 mm .

Except for stairways, doorways and [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] , the minimum clear height in [REF:term:xt:exits] and [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exits] shall be 2.1 m . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect2.art2:long] for stairs, [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect5.art3:long] for [REF:term:rmp:ramps] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect6.art4:long] for landings and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art2:long] for doorways.)
The clear height in [REF:term:xt:exits] and [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exits] in [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] shall be not less than 2 m .

The clear height in [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] and [REF:term:xt:exit] corridors that serve only a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be not less than 2 m .

Except as provided in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art6:long] , this Subsection applies to the fire protection of all [REF:term:xt:exits] except [REF:term:xt:exits] serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] .

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art2.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5:long] , every [REF:term:xt:exit] other than an exterior doorway shall be separated from each adjacent [REF:term:flr-r:floor area ] or from another [REF:term:xt:exit]

clauses.text: where there is a floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art12:long] ), and
where there is no floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than the greater of

subclauses.text: that required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8:long] for the floor assembly below, or
45 min.

content.text: Where an [REF:term:xt:exit] is located in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, the [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be separated from adjacent [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] with a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation]

clauses.text: having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 15 min where all [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] within the house are of photo-electric type and interconnected as described in Clause 9.10.19.5.(2)(a),

having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 30 min where additional [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] of photo-electric type are installed and interconnected as described in Clause 9.10.19.5.(2)(b),
having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min when [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] are not installed and interconnected as described in Clauses (a) or (b), or
that is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] if the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

content.text: A [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] common to 2 [REF:term:xt:exits] shall be smoke-tight and not be pierced by doorways, duct work, piping or any other opening that may affect the continuity of the separation.

A [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] that separates an [REF:term:xt:exit] from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall have no openings except those for electrical wiring, [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] conduit and [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] piping that serve only the [REF:term:xt:exit] , and for standpipes, sprinkler piping, [REF:term:xt:exit] doorways and wired glass and glass block permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art3:long]

The requirements in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art2.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art2.sent2:short] do not apply to an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] passageway provided the passageway has not less than 50% of its exterior sides open to the outdoors and is served by an [REF:term:xt:exit] stair at each end of the passageway.

This Article applies to wired glass in doors, and wired glass or glass block in sidelights, where these are installed in [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] between [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosures and [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] .
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art3.sent3:short] , the combined area of glazing in doors and sidelights shall not exceed 0.8 m^{2} .

Where an [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosure connects with a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] through an enclosed vestibule or corridor separated from the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] by [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] having not less than a 45 min[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , the glazed areas described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art3.sent1:short] need not be limited as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art3.sent2:short] .

articles.title: Openings Near Unenclosed Exterior Exit Stairs and Ramps

content.text: [REF:term:nprtctd-:Unprotected openings] in exterior walls of the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be protected with wired glass in fixed steel frames or glass block conforming to  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art7:long] , where

clauses.text: an unenclosed exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] provides the only [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from a [REF:term:t:suite] and is exposed to fire from [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] in the exterior walls of

subclauses.text: another [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] , or
another [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , ancillary space or common space in a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] , and

clauses.text: [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] in the exterior walls of the [REF:term:bldng:building] are within 3 m horizontally and less than 10 m below or less than 5 m above the [REF:term:xt:exit] stair or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] .

articles.title: Openings in Exterior Walls of Exits

content.text: Either openings in exterior walls of an [REF:term:xt:exit] or openings in adjacent exterior walls of the [REF:term:bldng:building] the [REF:term:xt:exit] serves shall be protected with wired glass in fixed steel frames or glass block installed in accordance with  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art7:long] , where

clauses.text: the [REF:term:xt:exit] enclosure has exterior walls that intersect the exterior walls of the [REF:term:bldng:building] at an angle of less than 135° measured on the outside of the [REF:term:bldng:building] , and
the openings in the exterior walls of the [REF:term:bldng:building ] are within 3 m horizontally and less than 2 m above the openings in the exterior walls of the [REF:term:xt:exit] .

content.text: Where an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] door in one [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] is within 3 m horizontally of an [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected opening] in another [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] and the exterior walls of these [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] intersect at an exterior angle of less than 135°, the opening shall be protected with

clauses.text: wired glass in fixed steel frames conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5:long] , or
glass block conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art7:long] .

articles.title: Stairways in 2 Storey, Group D or E Buildings

content.text: Where a [REF:term:t:suite] of Group D or E [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] is located partly on the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] and partly on the second [REF:term:tr:storey] , stairways serving the second [REF:term:tr:storey] of that [REF:term:t:suite] need not be constructed as [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs provided,

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not greater than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] ,
the [REF:term:t:suite] is separated from other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] by at least a 45 min[REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] ,
the area occupied by the [REF:term:t:suite] is not greater than 100 m^{2} per [REF:term:tr:storey] ,
the maximum travel distance from any point in the [REF:term:t:suite] to an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] is not greater than 25 m ,
the floor assemblies have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 45 min or are of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] , and
the [REF:term:bmnt:basement] and [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] are separated by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 45 min .

subsections.title: Obstructions and Hazards in Means of Egress

content.text: This Subsection applies to obstructions and hazards in every [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] except those within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] .
Where a corridor contains an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , the [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall not reduce the unobstructed width of the corridor to less than the required width of the corridor.

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect5.art3.sent2:short] , obstructions located within 1 980 mm of the floor shall not project horizontally more than 100 mm into [REF:term:xt:exit] passageways, corridors used by the public or [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] in a manner that would create a hazard for visually impaired persons travelling adjacent to walls.

The horizontal projection of an obstruction referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect5.art3.sent1:short] is permitted to exceed 100 mm where the obstruction extends to less than 680 mm above the floor. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote129:long] .)

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8.subsect7.art6:long] , no fixture, turnstile or construction shall project within the required width of an [REF:term:xt:exit] .

No obstructions such as posts or turnstiles shall be placed so as to restrict the width of a required [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to less than 750 mm unless an alternate unobstructed [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] is provided adjacent to and plainly visible from the restricted egress.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect5.art5.sent3:short] , no obstructions, such as counter gates, that do not meet the requirements for [REF:term:xt:exit] doors, shall be placed in a required [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area ] or part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] unless an alternate unobstructed [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] is provided adjacent to and plainly visible from the restricted egress.

Obstructions, such as counter gates, that do not satisfy [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect5.art5.sent2:short] , are permitted to be placed in a required [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from a part of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] in [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancies] and [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancies] , provided that the part of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] served by the obstructed [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] is not generally accessible to the public.

No mirror shall be placed in or adjacent to any [REF:term:xt:exit] so as to confuse the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] , and no mirror or draperies shall be placed on or over [REF:term:xt:exit] doors.
Fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] shall not be installed in an [REF:term:xt:exit] or corridor serving as an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] .

[REF:term:rvc-rm:Service rooms] containing equipment subject to possible explosion, such as [REF:term:blr:boilers] designed to operate at a pressure in excess of 100 kPa , and certain types of refrigerating and transformer equipment, shall not be located under required [REF:term:xt:exits] .
Ancillary rooms such as storage rooms, washrooms, toilet rooms, laundry rooms and [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] shall not open directly into an [REF:term:xt:exit] .

subsections.title: Doors in a Means of Egress

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art1.sent4:short] , obstructions created by doors shall be limited in accordance with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art1.sent3:short]

clauses.text: at [REF:term:xt:exit] doors,
at doors that open into or are located within a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , and
at doors that open into or are located within another facility that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from a [REF:term:t:suite] .

content.text: When fully open, doors described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art1.sent1:short] shall not decrease the required [REF:term:xt:exit] width by more than

clauses.text: 100 mm in [REF:term:xt:exit] corridors, and
50 mm for other [REF:term:xt:exit] facilities.

content.text: The swing of doors described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art1.sent1:short] shall not reduce the width of the path of travel to less than

clauses.text: the required [REF:term:xt:exit] width in [REF:term:xt:exit] corridors and passageways, and
750 mm on [REF:term:xt:exit] stairs or landings.

content.text: Doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] need not comply with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art1.sent3:short] .

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art2.sent3:short] , the clear opening height of doorways shall be not less than 2 030 mm high at

clauses.text: [REF:term:xt:exit] doors,
doors that open into or are located within a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , and
doors that open into or are located within another facility that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from a [REF:term:t:suite] .

content.text: The clear opening height under door closers and other devices in doorways described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art2.sent1:short] shall be not less than 1 980 mm .

Doorways serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] need not comply with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art2.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art2.sent2:short] . (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect5.subsect5.art1:long] )

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art2.sent3:short] , the clear opening height of doorways described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art2.sent1:short] serving a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be not less than 1 980 mm high.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art3.sent4:short] , the clear opening width of doorways shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art3.sent2:short] at

clauses.text: [REF:term:xt:exit] doors, and
doors that open into or are located within a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or other facility that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from a [REF:term:t:suite] .

content.text: Doorways described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art3.sent1:short] shall be

clauses.text: not less than 850 mm wide where there is only one door leaf,
not less than 850 mm wide where multiple-leaf doors are installed with only one active leaf having a latching mechanism described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art7:long] , and
not less than 1 210 mm wide where multiple-leaf doors are installed with two active leaves.

content.text: In doorways described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art3.sent1:short] that have multiple-leaf doors installed,

clauses.text: no active leaf shall be less than 850 mm wide where only one leaf is active, and
no single leaf shall be less than 610 mm wide where two leaves are active.

content.text: Doorways serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art3.sent2:short] . (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect5.subsect5.art1:long] )

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent4:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent5:short] , required [REF:term:xt:exit] doors and doors in required [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] , except doors in [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , shall swing on the vertical axis.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent5:short] , breakaway sliding doors, installed as required [REF:term:xt:exit] doors or required doors in [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] , shall be identified as swinging doors by means of a label or decal affixed to the door.
Revolving doors shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art15:long]

Movable [REF:term:prttn:partitions] used to separate a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] from an adjacent [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] or a [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancy] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent1:short] , provided the partitions are not located in the only [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote130:long] .)
[REF:term:xt:Exit] doors need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent1:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent2:short] , where

clauses.text: the doors serve accessory [REF:term:bldng:buildings] where life safety is not adversely affected,
the doors serve [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] or other accessory [REF:term:bldng:buildings] serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , or
the doors

subclauses.text: serve storage [REF:term:t:suites] of not more than 28 m^{2} in gross area that are in warehousing [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of not more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] , and
open directly to the exterior at ground level.

content.text: Except for doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, [REF:term:xt:exit] doors that are required to swing shall swing in the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel.

Doors that open onto a corridor or other facility that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from a room or [REF:term:t:suite] having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of more than 60 persons shall swing on the vertical axis in the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel.
Doors that divide a corridor that is not wholly contained within a [REF:term:t:suite] shall swing in the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel.
Where a pair of doors is installed in a corridor that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] in both directions, the doors shall

clauses.text: swing in opposite directions, with the door on the right-hand side swinging in the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel, or
swing in both directions.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art6.sent2:short] , the distance between a stair riser and the leading edge of a door during its swing, except for doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, shall be not less than 300 mm .

Where there is a danger of blockage from ice or snow, an [REF:term:xt:exit] door, including doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , may open onto not more than one step, provided the riser of such a step does not exceed 150 mm .

articles.title: Door Latching, Locking and Opening Mechanisms

content.text: Principal entrance doors, [REF:term:xt:exit] doors and doors to [REF:term:t:suites] , including exterior doors of [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , and other doors in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] shall

clauses.text: be openable from the inside or in travelling to an [REF:term:xt:exit] without requiring keys, special devices or specialized knowledge of the door-opening mechanism, or
be controlled by electromagnetic locking mechanisms in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5:long] .

content.text: Except for doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, and doors to accessory [REF:term:bldng:buildings] and to garages serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , door release hardware on doors in a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] shall be operable with one hand and the door shall be openable with not more than one releasing operation. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote131:long] .)
Door release hardware on doors in a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] shall be installed 900 mm to 1 100 mm above the finished floor.

Except for hotels and motels, a door opening onto a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from [REF:term:t:suites] shall be designed not to lock automatically if it is equipped with an automatic self-closing device. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote143:long] .)

Every [REF:term:xt:exit] door, except doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, shall be designed and installed so that when the latch is released the door will open in the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel under a force of not more than 90 N applied to the door release hardware. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent8:long] for door opening forces in an accessible path of travel.)

articles.title: Egress from Roof Area, Podiums, Terraces, Platforms and Contained Open Spaces

content.text: Except as required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art1.sent4:short] an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] shall be provided from every roof intended for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] and from every podium, terrace, platform or contained open space.

Where a roof is intended for an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of more than 60 persons, at least 2 separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] at the roof level, designed in conformance with the requirements for [REF:term:xt:exits] and located remote from each other, shall be provided.

Where a podium, terrace, platform or contained open space is provided, egress requirements shall conform to the appropriate requirements for rooms or [REF:term:t:suites] in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4:long]

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art1.sent2:short] , [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] at the roof level, designed in conformance with the requirements for [REF:term:xt:exits] shall be provided from an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] on a roof serving more than a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] .

Except as required in  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent1:long] , each [REF:term:t:suite] in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] occupied by more than one [REF:term:t:suite] shall have

clauses.text: an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] doorway,
a doorway to a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , or
a doorway to an exterior passageway.

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art3.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art2.sent2:long] , from the point where a doorway described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art2.sent1.clause2:medium] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art2.sent1.clause3:short] enters the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or exterior passageway, it shall be possible to go in opposite directions to each of 2 separate [REF:term:xt:exits] .

Except for a dead-end corridor that is entirely within a [REF:term:t:suite] and except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art2.sent1:long] , a dead-end corridor is permitted provided it is not more than 6 m long.

articles.title: Number and Spacing of Egress Doors

content.text: Except for [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , at least 2 egress doors shall be provided when the area of a room or [REF:term:t:suite] , or the distance measured from any point within the room or [REF:term:t:suite] to the nearest egress door, exceeds the values in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.table1:long]

Doors required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.sent1:short] shall be spaced so that in the event that one door is made inaccessible by a fire within such room or [REF:term:t:suite] , the other door will provide safe egress.

content.title: Maximum Areas and Travel Distances for Rooms, Suites and Mezzanines with a Single Means of Egress

content.value: Maximum Area of Room, [REF:term:t:Suite] or [REF:term:flr-r:Floor Area] , m^{2}
Maximum Distance to Egress Door, m

content.text: Required [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from [REF:term:t:suites] shall not be through any other [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] or other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] .

articles.title: Travel Distance within Rooms and Suites

content.text: Except for [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , the travel distance from any point within the room or [REF:term:t:suite] to the nearest egress door shall not exceed the maximum travel distance in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art2:long]

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art1.sent3:short] , for the purposes of this Subsection, travel distance means the distance from any point in the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] to an [REF:term:xt:exit] measured along the path of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel.

Where a room or [REF:term:t:suite] is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of at least 45 min or, in a [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered]  [REF:term:bldng:building] , by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] which is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , the travel distance may be measured from an egress door of the room or [REF:term:t:suite] to the nearest [REF:term:xt:exit] .

Where a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] is not less than 9 m wide and conforms to  Subclauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause4.subclause1:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause4.subclause4:short] , the travel distance may be determined in accordance with those Subclauses.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9:long] , at least 2 [REF:term:xt:exits] shall be provided from every [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , spaced so that the travel distance to the nearest [REF:term:xt:exit] is not more than

clauses.text: 40 m in the case of [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancies] ,
45 m for all [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] where the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , and
30 m for all other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] .

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9:long] , a single [REF:term:xt:exit] is permitted from each [REF:term:tr:storey] in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of 1 and 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] provided the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] and travel distance requirements conform to those required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4:long] and the total [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] served by an [REF:term:xt:exit] facility does not exceed 60 persons.

Where more than one [REF:term:xt:exit] is required from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , each [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be considered as contributing not more than half the required [REF:term:xt:exit] width.

Where more than one [REF:term:xt:exit] is required from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] , at least 2 [REF:term:xt:exits] shall be independent of each other and be placed remote from each other along the path of travel between them. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote49:short] .)
Not more than one [REF:term:xt:exit] from a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] is permitted to lead through a lobby.

The lobby referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5.sent1:short] shall be not more than 4.5 m above [REF:term:grade:grade] , and the path of travel through the lobby to the outdoors shall not exceed 15 m .

The lobby referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5.sent1:short] shall conform in all respects to the requirements for [REF:term:xt:exits] , except that rooms other than [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] , storage rooms and rooms of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential] or [REF:term:ndtrl-cc:industrial occupancy] are permitted to open directly onto such lobby.

Where the lobby referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5.sent1:short] and adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] that are permitted to open into the lobby are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between such [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] and the lobby need not have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote156:long] .)

Passenger elevators are permitted to open onto the lobby referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5.sent1:short] provided the elevator doors are designed to remain closed except while loading and unloading passengers.

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent3:short] , the space above a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] shall be served by [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] leading to [REF:term:xt:exits] accessible at the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] level, on the same basis as [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] .
The [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent1:short] , provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is not required to terminate at a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art1.sent2:long] ,
the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is not more than 60,
the area of the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] does not exceed the area limits stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.table1:long] , and
the distance limits stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.table1:long] , measured along the path of travel, are not exceeded from any point on the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] to

subclauses.text: an egress door serving the space that the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] overlooks if the space is served by a single egress door, or

an egress stairway leading to an [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] in the space below if that space is required to be served by 2 or more egress doorways in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.sent1:long] .

content.text: One of the [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] that is not required to terminate at a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art1.sent2:long] , and that exceeds the limits of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent2:short] is permitted to lead through the room in which the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is located, provided all other [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from that [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] lead to [REF:term:xt:exits] accessible at the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] level.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent2:short] , the maximum travel distance from any point on a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] to the nearest [REF:term:xt:exit] shall be not more than

clauses.text: 40 m in a [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] ,
45 m in a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout, provided it does not contain a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd:high-hazard industrial occupancy] , or

30 m in any [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] not referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent4.clause1:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent4.clause2:short] .

articles.title: Travel Limit to Exits or Egress Doors

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent3:short] , every [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] containing more than 1 [REF:term:tr:storey] shall have [REF:term:xt:exits] or egress doors located so that it shall not be necessary to travel up or down more than 1 [REF:term:tr:storey] to reach a level served by

clauses.text: an egress door to a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , enclosed [REF:term:xt:exit] stair or exterior passageway, or
an [REF:term:xt:exit] doorway not more than 1.5 m above adjacent ground level.

content.text: Where a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is not located above or below another [REF:term:t:suite] , the travel limit from a floor level in the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] to an [REF:term:xt:exit] or egress door may exceed 1 [REF:term:tr:storey] where that floor level is served by an openable window

clauses.text: providing an unobstructed opening of not less than 1 m in height and 0.55 m in width, and
located so that the sill is not more than

subclauses.text: 1 m above the floor, and
7 m above adjacent ground level.

content.text: The travel limit from a floor level in a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] to an [REF:term:xt:exit] or egress door may exceed 1 [REF:term:tr:storey] where that floor level has direct access to a balcony.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art3.sent1:long] , where an egress door from a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] opens onto a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or exterior passageway it shall be possible from the location where the egress door opens onto the corridor or exterior passageway to go in opposite directions to 2 separate [REF:term:xt:exits] unless the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] has a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] .

For [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] , it need not be possible to go in more than one direction to an [REF:term:xt:exit] from the location where the egress door opens into a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or exterior passageway if the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] or if each [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] has separate and direct access from each [REF:term:tr:storey] to

clauses.text: a balcony, or
an openable window conforming to  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2.clause1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2.clause2:medium] .

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent3:short] , a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall be provided with a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] where an egress door from the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] opens onto

clauses.text: an [REF:term:xt:exit] stairway serving more than one [REF:term:t:suite] ,
a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor]

subclauses.text: serving more than one [REF:term:t:suite] , and
served by a single [REF:term:xt:exit] ,

clauses.text: an exterior passageway

subclauses.text: serving more than one [REF:term:t:suite] ,
served by a single [REF:term:xt:exit] stairway or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , and
more than 1.5 m above adjacent ground level, or

clauses.text: a balcony

subclauses.text: serving more than one [REF:term:t:suite] ,
served by a single [REF:term:xt:exit] stairway or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , and
more than 1.5 m above adjacent ground level.

content.text: Where a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] is located above another [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or common space in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] , the upper [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall be provided with a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] where an egress door from that [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] opens onto an exterior passageway that

clauses.text: has a floor assembly with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] less than 45 min,
is served by a single [REF:term:xt:exit] stairway or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , and
is located more than 1.5 m above adjacent ground level.
