content.text: For [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] where an egress door from either [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] opens onto a shared egress facility served by a single [REF:term:xt:exit] stairway or [REF:term:rmp:ramp] , other than as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent2:short] , a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] need not be provided if the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] or if the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] have separate and direct access from each [REF:term:tr:storey] to

clauses.text: a balcony, or
an openable window conforming to  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2.clause1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2.clause2:medium] .

articles.title: Egress Windows or Doors for Bedrooms

content.text: Except where the [REF:term:t:suite] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , each bedroom or combination bedroom shall have at least one outside window or exterior door openable from the inside without the use of keys, tools or special knowledge and without the removal of sashes or hardware. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect5.subsect1.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote50:short] .)
The window referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent1:short] shall

clauses.text: provide an unobstructed opening of not less than 0.35 m^{2} in area with no dimension less than 380 mm , and
maintain the required opening during an emergency without the need for additional support. (See Note A-9.9.10.1.(2).)

content.text: Where a window required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent1:short] opens into a window well, a clearance of not less than 760 mm shall be provided in front of the window. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote52:short] .)

Where the sash of a window referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent3:short] swings towards the window well, the operation of the sash shall not reduce the clearance in a manner that would restrict escape in an emergency.

Where a protective enclosure is installed over the window well referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent3:short] , the enclosure shall be openable from the inside without the use of keys, tools or special knowledge of the opening mechanism.

This Subsection applies to all [REF:term:xt:exits] except those serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces.
[REF:term:xt:Exits] shall be located so as to be clearly visible or their locations shall be clearly indicated.

Where an [REF:term:xt:exit] door leading directly to the outside is subject to being obstructed by parked vehicles or storage because of its location, a visible sign or a physical barrier prohibiting such obstructions shall be installed on the exterior side of the door.
Every [REF:term:xt:exit] door shall have an [REF:term:xt:exit] sign providing visual information placed over it or adjacent to it if the [REF:term:xt:exit] serves

clauses.text: a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] ,
a [REF:term:bldng:building] having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of more than 150, or
a room or [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] that has a fire escape as part of a required [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] .

content.text: Every [REF:term:xt:exit] sign providing visual information shall

clauses.text: be visible on approach to the [REF:term:xt:exit] ,
consist of a green and white or lightly tinted graphical symbol meeting the colour specifications referred to in [REF:standard:iso3864-1] and
conform to [REF:standard:iso7010] for the following symbols (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote157:long] ):

subclauses.text: E001 emergency exit left,
E002 emergency exit right,
E005 90-degree directional arrow, and
E006 45-degree directional arrow.

content.text: Internally illuminated [REF:term:xt:exit] signs shall be continuously illuminated and

clauses.text: where illumination of the sign is powered by an electrical circuit, be constructed in conformance with [REF:standard:csac22.2no.141] or
where illumination of the sign is not powered by an electrical circuit, be constructed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs572]

content.text: Externally illuminated [REF:term:xt:exit] signs shall be continuously illuminated and be constructed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs572] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote158:long] .)
The circuitry serving lighting for externally and internally illuminated [REF:term:xt:exit] signs shall

clauses.text: serve no equipment other than emergency equipment, and

be connected to an emergency power supply as described in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent2:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent7:short] .

content.text: Where no [REF:term:xt:exit] is visible from a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] , from a corridor used by the public, or from principal routes serving an open [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] of more than 150, an [REF:term:xt:exit] sign conforming to  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect11.art3.sent2.clause2:medium] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect11.art3.sent2.clause3:short] with an arrow or pointer indicating the direction of egress shall be provided.
[REF:term:xt:Exit] signs with tactile information shall be provided in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art2:long] .

articles.title: Signs for Stairs and Ramps at Exit Level

content.text: In [REF:term:bldng:buildings] that are 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , any part of an [REF:term:xt:exit]  [REF:term:rmp:ramp] or stairway that continues up or down past the lowest [REF:term:xt-lvl:exit level] shall be clearly marked to indicate that it does not lead to an [REF:term:xt:exit] , if the portion beyond the [REF:term:xt-lvl:exit level] may be mistaken as the direction of [REF:term:xt:exit] travel.
Arabic numerals indicating the assigned floor number shall be

clauses.text: mounted permanently on the stair side of the wall at the latch side of doors to [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shafts,
not less than 60 mm high, raised approximately 0.8 mm above the surface,
located 1 500 mm from the finished floor and not more than 300 mm from the door, and
contrasting in colour with the surface on which they are applied (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote53:short] ).

content.text: This Subsection applies to the lighting of all [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] except those within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces.

Every [REF:term:xt:exit] , [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or corridor providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] for the public shall be equipped to provide illumination to an average level of not less than 50 lx at floor or tread level and at all points such as angles and intersections at changes of level where there are stairs or [REF:term:rmp:ramps] .
The minimum value of the illumination required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art2.sent1:short] shall be not less than 10 lx .
Emergency lighting shall be provided in

clauses.text: [REF:term:xt:exits] ,
principal routes providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] in an open [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] ,
corridors used by the public,
underground [REF:term:wlkw:walkways] ,
[REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] ,
public washrooms that are equipped to serve more than one person at a time,

locations where doors are equipped with an electromagnetic lock as described in  Clauses [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause11:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6.clause7:medium] , and
universal washrooms, universal shower rooms and accessible change spaces required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8:long] .

content.text: Emergency lighting required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent1:short] shall be provided from a source of energy separate from the electrical supply for the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Lighting required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent1:short] shall be designed to be automatically actuated for a period of at least 30 min when the electric lighting in the affected area is interrupted.
Illumination from lighting required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent1:short] shall be provided to average levels of not less than 10 lx at floor or tread level.
The minimum value of the illumination required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent4:short] shall be not less than 1 lx .

Where incandescent lighting is provided, lighting equal to 1 W/m^{2} of [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] shall be considered to meet the requirement in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent4:short] .
Where self-contained emergency lighting units are used, they shall conform to [REF:standard:csac22.2no.141]
For the purposes of this Section, roofs with slopes of 60° or more to the horizontal that are adjacent to a room or space intended for [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] shall be considered as a wall.

articles.title: Testing of Integrated Fire Protection and Life Safety Systems

content.text: Where life safety and fire protection systems and systems with fire protection and life safety functions are integrated with each other, they shall be tested as a whole in accordance with [REF:standard:ulcs1001] to verify that they have been properly integrated. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote123:long] .)
Tents, [REF:term:r-pprtd-:air-supported structures] , transformer vaults, [REF:term:wlkw:walkways] , elevators and escalators shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long] .
Where rooms or spaces are intended for an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] , such rooms or spaces shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long] .
[REF:term:bmnt:Basements] containing more than 1 [REF:term:tr:storey] or exceeding 600 m^{2} in area shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long] .

Where rooms or spaces are intended for the storage, manufacture or use of hazardous or explosive material, such rooms or spaces shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote125:long] .)
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art8:long] , facilities for the dispensing of fuel shall not be installed in any [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Openings through floors that are not protected by shafts or [REF:term:clr:closures] shall be protected in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8:long] (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art7.sent1:long] .)
Chutes and shafts shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3:long] except where they are entirely contained within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] .

Sprinkler systems shall be designed, constructed and installed in conformance with  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art15:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art17:long]

Standpipe and hose systems shall be designed, constructed and installed in conformance with  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art11:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art17:long]
Fire pumps shall be installed in conformance with  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art17:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art18:long]
Where fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] are installed on a roof, such [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] shall be installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect1.art5:long]

Part 9 does not apply to [REF:term:bldng:buildings] designed and constructed in accordance with Subsection 3.2.10. (See  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent2:long] of Division A and  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect1.subsect1.art1.sent3:long] of Division B.)

revisions.text: Part 9 does not apply to [REF:term:bldng:buildings] designed and constructed in accordance with Subsection 3.2.10. (See  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent2:long] of Division A and  Sentence [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect1.subsect1.art1.sent3:long] of Division B.)
revisions.change_summary: Added Sentence 9.10.1.3.(12) to clarify Part 9 does not apply to buildings designed under Subsection 3.2.10

content.text: In kitchens containing commercial cooking equipment used in processes producing grease-laden vapours, the equipment shall be designed and installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote54:short] .)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2.art2:long] , every [REF:term:bldng:building] or part thereof shall be classified according to its [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] as belonging to one of the groups or divisions described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2.art1.table1:long]

table_notes.content: See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote3:long] .

content.value: [REF:term:lw-hzrd-:Low-hazard industrial occupancies] (Does not include [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] serving individual [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] )

articles.title: Custodial, Convalescent and Residential Care Homes

content.text: Children's custodial homes and convalescent homes for ambulatory occupants living as a single housekeeping unit in a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] with sleeping accommodation for not more than 10 persons are permitted to be classified as [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] (Group C).
Reserved.
Reserved.
Reserved.
Reserved.
A care facility accepted for residential use pursuant to provincial legislation is permitted to be classified as a [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] , provided

clauses.text: occupants live as a single housekeeping unit in a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] with sleeping accommodation for not more than 10 persons ,
[REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] are installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19:long] ,
emergency lighting is provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3:long] , and
the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] throughout.

articles.title: Major Occupancies above Other Major Occupancies

content.text: Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2.art4:long] , in any [REF:term:bldng:building] containing more than one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] in which one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] is located entirely above another, the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1:long] for each portion of the [REF:term:bldng:building] containing a [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] shall be applied to that portion as if the entire [REF:term:bldng:building] was of that [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] .

articles.title: Buildings Containing More Than One Major Occupancy

content.text: In a [REF:term:bldng:building] containing more than one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] , where the aggregate area of all [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies ] in a particular group or division does not exceed 10% of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] on the [REF:term:tr:storey] on which they are located, they need not be considered as [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] for the purposes of  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2.art3:long] provided they are not classified as Group F, Division 2 [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] .

articles.title: Group A, Division 2, Low Occupant Load

content.text: This Part may apply to a Group A, Division 2 [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] that is permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art7:long] to be classified as a Group D, [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy] , provided the [REF:term:bldng:building] in which the [REF:term:mbl-ccpn:assembly occupancy] is located complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent1:long] . (See Note A-3.1.2.7.)

Except as permitted in Sentences (2) and (3), where a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] or a [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] is required in this Section for an element of a [REF:term:bldng:building] , such rating shall be determined in conformance with

clauses.text: the test methods described in Part 3,
the calculation method presented in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] , or

the construction specifications presented in  Tables [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table2:long] . (See Note A-9.10.3.1.(1)(c).)

content.text: In a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, where a minimum [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of 15 min is permitted, the construction described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art1.sent2.clause1:long] is permitted to be used.

In a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, where a minimum [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of 30 min is permitted, it is permitted to use construction having

clauses.text: walls and floor/ceiling assemblies framed with wood studs,
joist spaces filled with

subclauses.text: preformed insulation of rock or slag fibres conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs702] , "Mineral Fibre Thermal Insulation for Buildings," having a mass per unit area of not less than 1.22 kg/m^{2} of floor surface, or

wet-blown cellulose fibres conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs703] , "Cellulose Fibre Insulation for Buildings," having a density of not less than 50 kg/m^{3} to a minimum depth of 90 mm on the underside of the subfloor and the sides of the structural members,

clauses.text: stud spaces of

subclauses.text: non-loadbearing

revisions.text: [REF:term:ldbrng:non-loadbearing] assemblies filled with preformed insulation of glass fibres conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs702.1] , "Standard for Mineral Fibre Thermal Insulation for Buildings, Part 1: Material Specification," having a mass per unit area of not less than 0.6 kg/m^{2} of wall surface, and
non-loadbearing
revisions.change_summary: Amended Subclause 9.10.3.1.(3)(c)(i) by striking out "non-loadbearing" and substituting "non-loadbearing"

subclauses.text: [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing] assemblies filled with preformed insulation of rock or slag fibres conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs702.1] , "Standard for Mineral Fibre Thermal Insulation for Buildings, Part 1: Material Specification," having a mass per unit area of not less than 1.22 kg/m^{2} of wall surface, or filled with insulation of cellulose fibres conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs703] , "Standard for Cellulose Fibre Insulation (CFI) for Buildings," having a density of not less than 50 kg/m^{3} ,

clauses.text: resilient channel on one side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] spaced 400 or 600 mm o.c., and
not less than 12.7 mm thick gypsum board on ceilings and on both sides of walls. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art1.sent2.clause1:long] .)

content.text: Where a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] is required in this Section for an element of a [REF:term:bldng:building] , such rating shall be determined in accordance with the test methods described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long] , or in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] .

Unless the [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] is referred to herein as a “surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] ,” it shall apply to any surface of the element being considered that would be exposed by cutting through it as well as to the exposed surface of the element.
Floor, roof and ceiling assemblies shall be rated for exposure to fire on the underside.

Exterior walls shall be rated for exposure to fire from inside the [REF:term:bldng:building] , except that such walls need not comply with the temperature rise limitations required by the standard tests referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1:long] if such walls have a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] of not less than 1.2 m , and due allowance is made for the effects of heat radiation in accordance with the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long] .
Interior vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] required to have [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance ratings] shall be rated for exposure to fire on each side.

Where a ceiling construction has a suspended membrane ceiling with lay-in panels or tiles which contribute to the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , hold down clips or other means shall be provided to prevent the lifting of such panels or tiles in the event of a fire.

Except as required by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art2.sent1:long] , the space above a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is permitted to be excluded from the calculation of [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , provided

clauses.text: the aggregate area of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] that are not superimposed does not exceed 10% of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] of the [REF:term:bldng:building] in which they are located, and
the area of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] in a [REF:term:t:suite] does not exceed 10% of the area of that [REF:term:t:suite] on the [REF:term:tr:storey] on which it is located.

content.text: Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art2.sent1:long] , the space above a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is permitted to be excluded from the calculation of [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , provided

clauses.text: the aggregate area of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] that are not superimposed does not exceed 40% of the open area of the room in which they are located (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote48:long] ), and

except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1.sent3:short] , the space above the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] floor is used as an open area without [REF:term:prttn:partitions] or subdividing walls higher than 1 070 mm above the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] floor.

content.text: The space above a [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1.sent2:short] is permitted to include an enclosed space whose area does not exceed 10% of the open area of the room in which the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is located, provided the enclosed space does not obstruct visual communication between the open space above the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] and the room in which it is located.

For the purpose of determining [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] , the areas of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] that are not considered as [REF:term:tr:storeys] shall be added to the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] of the [REF:term:tr:storey] on which they are located. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote58:short] .)

Platforms and catwalks intended solely for periodic inspection and maintenance need not be considered as floor assemblies or [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] for the purpose of calculating [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] , provided

clauses.text: they are not used for storage, and
they are constructed with [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] materials, unless the [REF:term:bldng:building] is permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] .

articles.title: More Than One Level of Mezzanine

content.text: Each level of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] that is partly or wholly superimposed above the first level of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] shall be considered as a [REF:term:tr:storey] in calculating the [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] .

Where a [REF:term:bmnt:basement] is used primarily as a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] , the [REF:term:bmnt:basement] is permitted to be considered as a separate [REF:term:bldng:building] for the purposes of this Section provided the floor above the [REF:term:bmnt:basement] and the exterior walls of the [REF:term:bmnt:basement] above the adjoining ground level are constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] of masonry or concrete having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h .
A rooftop enclosure shall not be considered as a [REF:term:tr:storey] in calculating the [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] if the rooftop enclosure is provided for

clauses.text: elevator machinery,
a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] ,
a stairway used for no purpose other than for access or egress,
an elevator lobby used for no purpose other than for access or egress, or
a combination thereof.

subsections.title: Permitted Openings in Wall and Ceiling Membranes

articles.title: Permitted Openings in Wall and Ceiling Membranes

content.text: Except as permitted in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent3:short] , a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] shall not be pierced by openings into the assembly unless the assembly has been tested and rated for such openings.

A wall or ceiling membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] is permitted to be pierced by openings for electrical and similar service outlet boxes, provided such outlet boxes and the penetrations conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8:long]

A membrane ceiling forming part of an assembly assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] on the basis of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table2:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] is permitted to be pierced by openings leading to ducts within the ceiling space, provided the ducts, the amount of openings and their protection conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] .

Where a [REF:term:bldng:building] or part of a [REF:term:bldng:building] is required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] elements shall be limited in conformance with the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5:long]

[REF:term:hv-tmbr-:Heavy timber construction] shall be considered to have a 45 min[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] when it is constructed in accordance with the requirements for [REF:term:hv-tmbr-:heavy timber construction] in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art7:long]

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art3:long] , structural steel members used in construction required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] shall be protected to provide the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

subsections.title: Fire Resistance and Combustibility in Relation to Occupancy, Height and Supported Elements

articles.title: Fire-Resistance Ratings for Floors and Roofs

content.text: Except as otherwise provided in this Subsection, the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance ratings] of floors and roofs shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2:long] for mixed [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21:long] for construction camps.)

content.title: Fire-Resistance Ratings for Floors and Roofs

content.value: Floors Except Floors over Crawl Spaces

content.text: The requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long] for roof assemblies to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] are permitted to be waived in [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered]  [REF:term:bldng:buildings] where

clauses.text: the sprinkler system is electrically supervised in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent3:long] , and
the operation of the sprinkler system will cause a signal to be transmitted to the fire department in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:long] .

articles.title: Fire-Resistance Ratings for Walls, Columns and Arches

content.text: Except as otherwise provided in this Subsection, all [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing] walls, columns and arches in the [REF:term:tr:storey] immediately below a floor or roof assembly shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than that required for the supported floor or roof assembly.

Light-frame walls, columns, arches and beams as well as [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing] steel elements that support floors between [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] in a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be protected by not less than 12.7 mm thick gypsum board. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote59:short] .)

Where an assembly is required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] and to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , it shall be supported by [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] .
Construction supporting a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art3:long]

[REF:term:mzznn:Mezzanines] required to be counted as [REF:term:tr:storeys] in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art2:long] shall be constructed in conformance with the requirements for “Floors Except Floors over Crawl Spaces” in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long]

Where a portion of a roof supports an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , that portion shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] conforming to the rating for “Floors Except Floors over Crawl Spaces” in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long]

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art8.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art8.sent3:short] , the floor assembly of every exterior passageway used as part of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] of not less than 45 min or be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible construction] .

No [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] is required for floors of exterior passageways serving [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of Group D, E or F [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] that are not more than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] .
No [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] is required for floors of exterior passageways serving

clauses.text: reserved,

a single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] where no [REF:term:t:suite] is located above or below the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent2:long] ).

content.text: Where a crawl space exceeds 1.8 m in height or is used for any [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] or as a [REF:term:plnm:plenum] in [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] or for the passage of [REF:term:fl-pp:flue pipes] , it shall be considered as a [REF:term:bmnt:basement] in applying the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1:long]
[REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long] does not apply to

clauses.text: a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] that has no other [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] above or below it,
houses with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, or
a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] that is not above or below another [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] .

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance ratings] of floors, roofs, [REF:term:ldbrng:loadbearing ] walls, columns and arches need not conform to this Subsection if such assemblies conform in all respects to the appropriate requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2:long]

title.text: Fire Separations between Rooms and Spaces within Buildings

revisions.text: Fire Separations and Smoke-tight Barriers between Rooms and Spaces within Buildings
Fire Separations between Rooms and Spaces within Buildings
revisions.change_summary: Amended Subsection 9.10.9. title by striking out "and Smoke-tight Barriers"

content.text: This Subsection applies to

clauses.text: [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] required between rooms and spaces in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , except between rooms and spaces within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , and
reserved.

content.text: Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art3:long] , a wall or floor assembly required to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation ] shall be constructed as a continuous barrier against the spread of fire and retard the passage of smoke.
Reserved.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent6:short] , the continuity of a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] where it abuts another [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , a floor, a ceiling, or a roof shall be maintained by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the abutting [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote60:short] .) (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote29:long] .)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent6:short] , joints located in a horizontal plane between a floor and an exterior wall shall be sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:astme2307] has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent6:short] , all gypsum board joints in the assemblies described in Sentence (1) shall conform to [REF:standard:csaa82.31] to maintain the integrity of the smoke-tight barrier over the entire surface.

Joints between ceilings and walls, between floors and walls, and between walls at corners need not comply with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent3:short]  to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent5:short] where such joints consist of gypsum board that is attached to framing members and arranged so as to restrict the passage of flame and smoke through the joints. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote30:long] .)

articles.title: Openings to be Protected with Closures

content.text: Except as permitted in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art5:long]  to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8:short] , openings in required [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] shall be protected with [REF:term:clr:closures] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13:long]

Doors in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of 15 min , but not greater than 45 min , need not have a [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] provided they
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13:long] and Note A-9.10.9.3.(2).)

clauses.text: are at least 45 mm thick solid core wood doors, and
have a self-closing device.

content.text: Except as permitted in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art4.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art4.sent4:short] , all floor assemblies shall be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] .
Floor assemblies contained within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and within houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] need not be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] .

Floor assemblies for which no [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] is required by  Subsection [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8:long] and floors of [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanines] not required to be counted as [REF:term:tr:storeys] in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art2:long] need not be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] .

Where a crawl space is not required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art9:long] to be constructed as a [REF:term:bmnt:basement] , the floor above it need not be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .
[REF:term:ntrcnnct:Interconnected floor spaces] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8:long]

articles.title: General Requirements for Penetrations of Fire Separations

content.text: Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent2:short] and  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art7:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8:long] and as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art9:long] , penetrations of a required [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] shall be

clauses.text: sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an F rating not less than the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] ,
tightly fitted or cast in place, provided the penetrating item is made of steel, ferrous, copper, concrete or masonry, or
sealed to maintain the integrity of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

content.text: Penetrations of a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] shall be sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art7.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art7.sent5:short] , piping for drain, waste, vent and central vacuum systems that is not located in a vertical shaft is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] or a membrane that forms part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided the penetration is protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause2:short] .

Drain piping leading directly from a water closet through a concrete floor slab is permitted to penetrate a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane that contributes to the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , provided

clauses.text: the piping is [REF:term:ncmbtbl-:noncombustible] and the penetration is protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1:long] , or
the piping is [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] and the penetration is sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long] .

content.text: [REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] drain, waste and vent piping is permitted on one side of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , provided it is not located in a vertical shaft.

In [REF:term:bldng:buildings] containing two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] only, [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] drain, waste and vent piping is permitted on one side of a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .
Water distribution piping is permitted to partly or wholly penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided

clauses.text: the piping is [REF:term:cmbtbl:noncombustible] and the penetration is protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1:long] , or

the piping is [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] and is not located in a vertical shaft, and the penetration is sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long] .

articles.title: Penetrations by Outlet Boxes or Service Equipment in Concealed Spaces

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent2:short]  to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent5:short] , outlet boxes are permitted to penetrate the membrane of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided they are sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote63:short] .)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent2:long] , [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] outlet boxes that penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent1:short] , provided

clauses.text: they do not exceed

subclauses.text: 0.016 m^{2} in area, and
an aggregate area of 0.065 m^{2} in any 9.3 m^{2} of surface area, and

clauses.text: the annular space between the membrane and the [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] outlet boxes does not exceed 3 mm .

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent2:long] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] outlet boxes that penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent1:short] , provided

clauses.text: the outlet boxes are

subclauses.text: separated from the remainder of the space within the assembly by an enclosure of not more than 0.3 m^{2} in area made of [REF:term:fr-blk:fire block] material conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art3:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote64:short] ), or

located in a space within the assembly that is filled with preformed fibre insulation processed from rock or slag conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs702] and having a mass per unit area of not less than 1.22 kg/m^{2} of wall surface such that the exposed sides and back of the outlet box are encapsulated by the [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] insulation, and

clauses.text: the outlet boxes do not exceed an aggregate area of 0.016 m^{2} in any individual enclosure as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3.clause1.subclause1:short] or any individual insulated space as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3.clause1.subclause2:short] .

content.text: [REF:term:ncmbtbl:Noncombustible] outlet boxes conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent2:short] are permitted to be located on opposite sides of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] and need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent1:short] , provided they are

clauses.text: separated from each other by a horizontal distance of not less than 600 mm ,
separated from each other and the remainder of the wall space by an enclosure conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3.clause1.subclause1:medium] , or
located in an insulated wall space in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3.clause1.subclause2:medium] .

content.text: [REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] outlet boxes conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3:short] are permitted to be located on opposite sides of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] and need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent1:short] .

Service equipment is permitted to penetrate a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art12.sent2:long] , provided the penetration is sealed by

clauses.text: a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] ,

a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long] , where the service equipment is located entirely within the cavity of a wall assembly above and below the horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , or
a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long] , where the penetration is

subclauses.text: contained within the concealed space of a floor or ceiling assembly having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] ,
located above a ceiling membrane providing a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , or
contained within a [REF:term:hrzntl-r:horizontal service space] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art12.sent2:long] that is directly above or below a floor or ceiling.

articles.title: Penetrations by Raceways, Sprinklers and Fire Dampers

content.text: [REF:term:cmbtbl:Combustible] totally enclosed raceways that are embedded in a concrete floor slab are permitted in an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , provided the concrete cover between the raceway and the bottom of the slab is not less than 50 mm .

Totally enclosed raceways are permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , provided they are sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long] .

Sprinkler piping is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , provided the [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] on each side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

Sprinklers are permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] without having to meet the [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent6.clause1:long] , provided the annular space created by the penetration of a fire sprinkler is covered by a metal escutcheon plate in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13]

[REF:term:fr-dmpr:Fire dampers] are permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] without having to meet the [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1:long] , provided the [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] is

clauses.text: installed in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa80]
specifically designed with a [REF:term:fr-tp:firestop] , or
provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent3:long] .

content.text: In a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, ducts penetrating [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] need not be equipped with [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire dampers] in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10:long] provided they are [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] with all openings in the duct system serving only one [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] .

[REF:term:cmbtbl-c:Combustible construction] that abuts on or is supported by a [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible]  [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] shall be constructed so that its collapse under fire conditions will not cause collapse of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] .

articles.title: Reduction in Thickness of Fire Separation by Beams and Joists

content.text: Where pockets for the support of beams or joists are formed in a masonry or concrete [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , the remaining total thickness of masonry and/or grout and/or concrete shall be not less than the required equivalent thickness shown for Type S monolithic concrete in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD.appsect2.subsect1.article1.table1:long] of Appendix D for the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art12.sent2:short] , a [REF:term:hrzntl-r:horizontal service space] or other concealed space located above a required vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] shall be divided at the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] by an equivalent [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] within the space.

Where a [REF:term:hrzntl-r:horizontal service space] or other concealed space is located above a required vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] other than a vertical shaft, such space need not be divided as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art12.sent1:short] provided the construction between such space and the space below is constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , except that where the vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] greater than 45 min , the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the ceiling may be reduced to 30 min .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art13.sent2:short] , [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] shall be separated from all other [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 1 h .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art13.sent3:short] , a [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] classified as a [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall be separated from other [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancies] classified as [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile] or [REF:term:mdm-hzrd:medium-hazard industrial occupancies] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h .

Where not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] are located in a [REF:term:bldng:building] containing a [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancy] , such [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancy] shall be separated from the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having not less than 1 h[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

Not more than one [REF:term:t:suite] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall be contained within a [REF:term:bldng:building] classified as a Group F, Division 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] .

Except as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16:long] and as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art15.sent2:short] , each [REF:term:t:suite] in other than [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancies] shall be separated from adjoining [REF:term:t:suites] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 45 min .

In [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered]  [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancy ] and [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancy] that are served by [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] conforming with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4.sent4.clause2:long] are not required to be separated from each other by [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] .

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16.sent4:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art2:long] , [REF:term:t:suites] in [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] shall be separated from adjacent rooms and [REF:term:t:suites] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 45 min .

Sleeping rooms in boarding and lodging houses where sleeping accommodation is provided for not more than 8 boarders or lodgers need not be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16.sent1:short] where the sleeping rooms form part of the proprietor's residence and do not contain cooking facilities.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16.sent4:short] , [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] that contain 2 or more [REF:term:tr:storeys] including [REF:term:bmnt:basements] as well as houses with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 1 h . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote142:long] .)
In a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] , [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] shall be separated from each other and from ancillary spaces and common spaces with a fire separation

clauses.text: having a fire-resistance rating not less than 15 min when all smoke alarms within the house are of photo-electric type and interconnected as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art5.sent2.clause1:long] (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:medium] ),

having a fire-resistance rating not less than 30 min when additional smoke alarms of photo-electric type are installed and interconnected as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art5.sent2.clause2:long] (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent3:medium] ),
having a fire-resistance rating not less than 45 min when smoke alarms are not installed and interconnected as described in Clauses (a) or (b), or
that is not required to have a fire-resistance rating if the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

content.text: Except as otherwise required by this Part and as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art17.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art17.sent5:short] , [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having not less than a 45 min[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

In other than [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] , no [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] is required for [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] between a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] if

clauses.text: the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] ,
the sprinkler system is electrically supervised in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent3:long] , and
the operation of the sprinkler system will cause a signal to be transmitted to the fire department in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:long] .

content.text: In other than [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] , no [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is required between a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] if

clauses.text: the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] ,
the sprinkler system is electrically supervised in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent3:long] ,
the operation of the sprinkler system will cause a signal to be transmitted to the fire department in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:long] , and
the corridor exceeds 5 m in width.

content.text: A [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] located in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] shall be separated from the remainder of the spaces in the house with a fire separation

clauses.text: having a fire-resistance rating not less than 15 min when all smoke alarms within the house are of photo-electric type and interconnected as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art5.sent2.clause1:long] (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:medium] ),

having a fire-resistance rating not less than 30 min when additional smoke alarms of photo-electric type are installed and interconnected as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art5.sent2.clause2:long] (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent3:medium] ),
having a fire-resistance rating not less than 45 min when smoke alarms are not installed and interconnected as described in Clauses (a) or (b), or
that is not required to have a fire-resistance rating if the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

content.text: No [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is required in a [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered]  [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] between a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and a space containing plumbing fixtures required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect31:long] , provided

clauses.text: the space and the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] are separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:tr:storey] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required between the [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and the remainder of the [REF:term:tr:storey] , and
the plumbing fixtures are not located within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or [REF:term:t:suite] .

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art18.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art18.sent3:short] , a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage ] shall be separated from other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having not less than a 1.5 h[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art18.sent3:short] , [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] containing 5 motor vehicles or fewer shall be separated from other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] of not less than 1 h .

Where a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage ] serves only the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] to which it is attached or in which it is built, it shall be considered as part of that [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art18.sent2:short] need not be provided between the garage and the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art18.sent5:short] , where a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage ] is attached to or built into a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] ,(See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote65:short] .)

clauses.text: an [REF:term:r-brrr:air barrier system] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect25.subsect3:long] shall be installed between the garage and the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] to provide an effective barrier to gas and exhaust fumes, and
every door between the garage and the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art15:long]

content.text: Where membrane materials are used to provide the required airtightness in the [REF:term:r-brrr:air barrier system] , all joints shall be sealed and structurally supported.

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art19.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art19.sent3:short] , a [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garage] shall be separated from other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h .

Ancillary spaces directly serving a [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garage] , including waiting rooms, reception rooms, tool and parts storage areas and supervisory office space, need not be separated from the [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garage] but shall be separated from other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art19.sent1:short] .

The [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art19.sent1:short] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 1 h , where

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not more than one [REF:term:tr:storey] in [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] ,
the [REF:term:bldng:building] is operated as a single [REF:term:t:suite] , and
the only [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] other than the [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garage] is a [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancy] .

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art19.sent5:short] , where a [REF:term:bldng:building] containing a [REF:term:rpr-grg:repair garage ] also contains a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , an [REF:term:r-brrr:air barrier system] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect25.subsect3:long] shall be installed between the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and the [REF:term:t:suite] containing the garage to provide an effective barrier to gas and exhaust fumes. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote65:long] .)
Where membrane materials are used to provide the required airtightness in the [REF:term:r-brrr:air barrier system] , all joints shall be sealed and structurally supported.

articles.title: Exhaust Ducts Serving More Than One Fire Compartment

content.text: Where a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] contains an [REF:term:xht-dct:exhaust duct] that serves more than one [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] , the duct shall have a fan located at or near the exhaust outlet to ensure that the duct is under negative pressure.

Individual [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art20.sent1:short] shall not have fans that exhaust directly into the duct in the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] .
A central vacuum system shall serve not more than one [REF:term:t:suite] .
This Subsection applies to [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] in all [REF:term:bldng:buildings] except rooms located within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] .
The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] requirements in this Subsection do not apply to the floor assembly immediately below a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect10.art3.sent2:short] and  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect10.art5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect10.art6:long] , [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building ] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 1 h when the [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] containing the [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

Where a room contains a limited quantity of service equipment and the service equipment does not constitute a fire hazard, the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect10.art3.sent1:short] shall not apply.

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect10.art4.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect10.art4.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect10.art5:long] , fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] shall be located in a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having not less than a 1 h[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

Except as required in the [REF:term:pplnc:appliance] installation standards referenced in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect2.subsect1.art5.sent1:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect33.subsect5.art2.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect33.subsect5.art3.sent1:long] , fuel-fired [REF:term:pc-htng-:space-heating appliances] , space-cooling [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] , [REF:term:rvc-wtr-:service water heaters] and laundry [REF:term:pplnc:appliances ] need not be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect10.art4.sent1:short] ,

clauses.text: where the [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] serve

subclauses.text: not more than one room or [REF:term:t:suite] , or
a [REF:term:bldng:building] with a [REF:term:bldng-r:building area] of not more than 400 m^{2} and a [REF:term:bldng-hg:building height] of not more than 2 [REF:term:tr:storeys] , or

clauses.text: where the [REF:term:pplnc:appliances]

subclauses.text: serve a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, and

are located in a [REF:term:rvc-rm:service room] separated from the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or their common spaces by a fire separation having a fire-resistance rating not less than the fire-resistance rating required for the fire separation between the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or common spaces.

content.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect10.art4.sent1:short] does not apply to fireplaces and cooking [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] .

[REF:term:rvc-rm:Service rooms] containing incinerators shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 2 h .
The design, construction, installation and [REF:term:ltrtn:alteration] of each indoor incinerator shall conform to [REF:standard:nfpa82]

Every incinerator shall be connected to a [REF:term:chmn:chimney]  [REF:term:fl:flue] conforming to the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect21:long] and serving no other [REF:term:pplnc:appliance] .
An incinerator shall not be located in a room with other fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc:appliances] .

Rooms for the temporary storage of [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] refuse and materials for recycling in all [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] or for public storage in [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having not less than a 1 h[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , except that a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 45 min is permitted where

clauses.text: the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of the floor assembly is not required to exceed 45 min , or
the room is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect11.art2:long] , a [REF:term:prt-wll:party wall] on a property line shall be constructed as a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote59:long] .)

A [REF:term:prt-wll:party wall] on a property line of a [REF:term:bldng:building] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] need not be constructed as a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] , provided it is constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation ] having not less than a 1 h[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , where the [REF:term:prt-wll:party wall] separates

clauses.text: two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] where there is no [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] above another [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] ,
a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces, or
two houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces.

content.text: Reserved.
The wall described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect11.art2.sent1:short] shall provide continuous protection from the top of the footings to the underside of the roof deck.

Any space between the top of the wall described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect11.art2.sent1:short] and the roof deck shall be tightly filled with mineral wool or [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material.
Where [REF:term:frwll:firewalls] are used, the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long] shall apply.

subsections.title: Prevention of Fire Spread at Exterior Walls and between Storeys

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art1.sent2:short] and in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect1.art3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art5:long] , the portions of a [REF:term:flr-r:floor area] or [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine ] that do not terminate at an exterior wall, a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] or a vertical shaft, shall terminate at a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating ] not less than that required for the floor assembly that terminates at the separation.

A [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine ] need not terminate at a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation ] where the [REF:term:mzznn:mezzanine] is not required to be considered as a [REF:term:tr:storey] in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art2:long]

Where a wall in a [REF:term:bldng:building] is exposed to a fire hazard from an adjoining roof of a separate [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] in the same [REF:term:bldng:building] , the roof shall contain no skylights within a horizontal distance of 5 m of the windows in the exposed wall.

articles.title: Exterior Walls Meeting at an Angle

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art5:long] , where exterior walls of a [REF:term:bldng:building] meet at an external angle of 135° or less, the horizontal distance from an [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected opening] in one exterior wall to an [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected opening] in the other exterior wall shall be not less than 1.2 m , where these openings are

clauses.text: in different [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] , or
in different [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , ancillary spaces or common spaces in a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] .

content.text: The exterior wall of each [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art3.sent1:short] within the 1.2 m distance shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than that required for the interior vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] between the compartment and the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .
Reserved.
This Article applies to the portion of any soffit enclosing a projection that is

clauses.text: less than 2.5 m vertically above a window or door, and
less than 1.2 m from either side of the window or door.

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent4:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent5:short] , the construction described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent1:short] shall have no [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] and shall be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent3:short] , where the soffit encloses

clauses.text: a common [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] that spans more than 2 [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] and projects beyond the exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng:building] ,
a floor space where an upper [REF:term:tr:storey] projects beyond the exterior wall of a lower [REF:term:tr:storey] and

subclauses.text: a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] is required at the floor between the two, or
reserved, or

clauses.text: a floor space where an upper [REF:term:tr:storey] projects beyond the exterior wall of a lower [REF:term:tr:storey] , and the projection is continuous across

subclauses.text: a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] separating two [REF:term:t:suites] , or
reserved.

content.text: Protection required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent2:short] shall be provided by

clauses.text: [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material having a minimum thickness of 0.38 mm and a melting point not below 650°C,
not less than 12.7 mm thick gypsum soffit board or gypsum board installed according to [REF:standard:csaa82.31]
not less than 11 mm thick plywood,
not less than 12.5 mm thick OSB or waferboard, or
not less than 11 mm thick lumber.

content.text: In the case of a soffit described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent1:short] that is at the edge of an [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] and completely separated from the remainder of that [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] by [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] , the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent2:short] do not apply.

Where all [REF:term:t:suites] spanned by a common [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] or situated above or below the projecting floor are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent2:short] do not apply, provided that all rooms, including closets and bathrooms, having openings in the wall beneath the soffit are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , notwithstanding any exceptions in the sprinkler standards referenced in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long]

subsections.title: Doors, Dampers and Other Closures in Fire Separations

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art2:long] , openings in required [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] shall be protected with a [REF:term:clr:closure] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art1.table1:long] and shall be installed in conformance with Chapters 2 to 14 of [REF:standard:nfpa80] unless otherwise specified herein. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1:long] )

table_notes.content: See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art2:long]

articles.title: Solid Core Wood Door as a Closure

content.text: A 45 mm thick solid core wood door is permitted to be used where a minimum [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] of 20 min is permitted or between a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] and a [REF:term:t:suite ] provided that the door conforms to [REF:standard:ulcs113] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote68:short] .)
Doors described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art2.sent1:short] shall have not more than a 6 mm clearance beneath and not more than 3 mm at the sides and top.

Doors required to provide a 20 min[REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] or permitted to be 45 mm solid core wood shall be mounted in a wood frame of not less than 38 mm thickness where the frame has not been tested and rated.

articles.title: Doors as a Means of Egress

content.text: Doors forming part of an [REF:term:xt:exit] or a public [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6:long] in addition to this Subsection.

Wired glass conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect6.subsect1.art2:long] which has not been tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1:long] is permitted as a [REF:term:clr:closure] in a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not more than 1 h provided such glass is not less than 6 mm thick and is mounted in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5.sent2:short] .

Wired glass described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5.sent1:short] shall be mounted in fixed steel frames having a metal thickness of not less than 1.35 mm and a glazing stop of not less than 20 mm on each side of the glass.

Individual panes of glass described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5.sent1:short] shall not exceed 0.8 m^{2} in area or 1.4 m in height or width, and the area of glass not structurally supported by mullions shall not exceed 7.5 m^{2} .
Steel door frames forming part of a [REF:term:clr:closure] in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , including anchorage requirements, shall conform to [REF:standard:ulcs105]

Glass block that has not been tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1:long] is permitted as a [REF:term:clr:closure] in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not more than 1 h . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect20.subsect9.art6:long] )

The size of an opening in an interior fire separation, even where protected with a [REF:term:clr:closure] , shall not exceed 11 m^{2} , with no dimension greater than 3.7 m , when the [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] on both sides of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] are not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

The size of an opening in an interior [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] , even where protected with a [REF:term:clr:closure] , shall not exceed 22 m^{2} , with no dimension greater than 6 m , when the [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] on both sides of the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .
Every swing type door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] shall be equipped with a latch.
