Except as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art10.sent2:short] , every door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] shall have a self-closing device.

Self-closing doors are not required between [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] and [REF:term:t:suites] in [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancies] , except in dead-end corridors.
Where hold-open devices are used on doors in required [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] , they shall be installed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14:long]

Swing-type doors shall open into [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] containing fuel-fired equipment where such doors lead to [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] or rooms used for assembly but shall swing outward from such rooms in all other cases.

Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art13.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art13.sent5:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art9.sent5:long] , a duct that penetrates an assembly required to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] shall be equipped with a [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] in conformance with  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10:long]
A [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] is not required where a [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] branch duct pierces a required [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] provided the duct

clauses.text: has a melting point not below 760°C ,
has a cross-sectional area less than 130 cm^{2} , and
supplies only air-conditioning units or combined air-conditioning and heating units discharging air at not more than 1.2 m above the floor.

content.text: A [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] is not required where a [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] branch duct pierces a required [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] around an [REF:term:xht-dct:exhaust duct] riser in which the airflow is upward provided

clauses.text: the melting point of the branch duct is not below 760°C ,
the branch duct is carried up inside the riser not less than 500 mm , and
the [REF:term:xht-dct:exhaust duct] is under negative pressure as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art20:long]

content.text: [REF:term:ncmbtbl:Noncombustible] ducts that penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] separating a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] need not be equipped with a [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] at the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] provided

clauses.text: the ducts have a melting point above 760°C , and
each individual duct exhausts directly to the outside at the top of the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv:vertical service space] .

content.text: A duct serving commercial cooking equipment and piercing a required [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] need not be equipped with a [REF:term:fr-dmpr:fire damper] at the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] . (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:long] )
[REF:term:fr-tp-fl:Fire stop flaps] in ceiling membranes referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent3:long] shall

clauses.text: conform to [REF:standard:ulcs1122] and
activate at a temperature approximately 30°C above the normal maximum temperature that occurs in the ducts, whether the air duct system is operating or shut down.

articles.title: Doors between Garages and Dwelling Units

content.text: A door between an attached or built-in garage and a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall be tight fitting and weather-stripped to provide an effective barrier against the passage of gas and exhaust fumes and shall be fitted with a self-closing device.
A doorway between an attached or built-in garage and a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall not be located in a room intended for sleeping.
Where a door is installed so that it may damage the integrity of a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] if its swing is unrestricted, door stops shall be installed to prevent such damage.
This Subsection applies to [REF:term:bldng:buildings] other than those to which [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15:long] applies.

This Subsection does not apply to detached carports conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect35:long] that serve not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] .

articles.title: Area and Location of Exposing Building Face

content.text: Except as permitted by Sentence (4), the area of an [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] shall be

clauses.text: taken as the exterior wall area facing in one direction on any side of a [REF:term:bldng:building] , and
calculated as

subclauses.text: the total area measured from the finished ground level to the uppermost ceiling, or

the area for each [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] , where a [REF:term:bldng:building] is divided into [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] s by [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] with [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance ratings] not less than 45 min .

content.text: For the purpose of using [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.table1:long] to determine the maximum aggregate area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] in an irregularly shaped or skewed exterior wall, the location of the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] shall be taken as a vertical plane located so that there are no [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] between the vertical plane and the line to which the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] is measured. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote57:long] .)

For the purpose of using [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art5.table1:long] to determine the required type of construction, cladding and [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] for an irregularly shaped or skewed exterior wall,

clauses.text: the location of the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] shall be taken as a vertical plane located so that no portion of the actual [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] is between the vertical plane and the line to which the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] is measured, and

the value for the maximum area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] (see second column of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art5.table1:long] ) shall be determined using the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] measured from the location described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art2.sent3.clause1:short] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote57:long] .)

content.text: If a [REF:term:bldng:building] is divided by fire separations into [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] , the area of [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] is permitted to be calculated for each [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartment] , provided the fire separations have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min .

articles.title: Limiting Distance and Fire Department Response

content.text: Except for the purpose of applying  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent2:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent3:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent8:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent9:short] , and  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art5.sent3:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art5.sent8:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art5.sent13:short] , a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] equal to half the actual [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] shall be used as input to the requirements of this Subsection, where

clauses.text: the time from receipt of notification of a fire by the fire department until the first fire department vehicle arrives at the [REF:term:bldng:building] exceeds 10 min in 10% or more of all calls to the [REF:term:bldng:building] , and
any [REF:term:tr:storey] in the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent6:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent10:short] , the maximum aggregate area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] in an [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] shall

clauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.table1:long] ,
conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3:long] , or
where the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] is not less than 1.2 m , be equal to or less than

subclauses.text: the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] squared, for [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancies] , [REF:term:bn-nd-pr:business and personal services occupancies] and [REF:term:lw-hzrd-:low-hazard industrial occupancies] , and
half the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] squared, for [REF:term:mrcntl-c:mercantile occupancies] and [REF:term:mdm-hzrd:medium-hazard industrial occupancies] .

content.title: Maximum Aggregate Area of Unprotected Openings in Exterior Walls

table_notes.content: See also  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent6:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent7:short] to calculate the maximum permitted area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] in [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered]  [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or where wired glass or glass blocks are used.

Maximum Aggregate Area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:Unprotected Openings] ,% of [REF:term:xpng-bld:Exposing Building Face] Area

content.text: Openings in a wall having a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] of less than 1.2 m shall be protected by [REF:term:clr:closures] , of other than wired glass or glass block, whose [REF:term:fr-prtct:fire-protection rating] is in conformance with the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] required for the wall. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art1.table1:long] )

Except for [REF:term:bldng:buildings] that are [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] and for openable windows having an unobstructed opening equal to 0.35 m^{2} installed in accordance with  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent2:short] , where the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] is 2 m or less, individual [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] shall be no greater than

clauses.text: the area stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.table2:long] , or

content.title: Maximum Concentrated Area of Unprotected Openings

content.value: Maximum Area of Individual [REF:term:nprtctd-:Unprotected Openings] , m^{2}

content.text: The spacing between individual [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent3:short] that serve a single room or space described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent5:short] shall be not less than

clauses.text: 2 m horizontally of another [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected opening] that is on the same [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] and serves the single room or space, or
2 m vertically of another [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected opening] that serves the single room or space, or another room or space on the same [REF:term:tr:storey] .

content.text: For the purpose of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent4:short] , “single room or space” shall mean

clauses.text: two or more adjacent spaces having a full-height separating wall extending less than 1.5 m from the interior face of the exterior wall, or
two or more stacked spaces that are on the same [REF:term:tr:storey] .

content.text: The maximum aggregate area of [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] is permitted to be up to twice the area determined according to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent1:short] , where the [REF:term:nprtctd-:unprotected openings] are glazed with

subclauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect12:long] ,
be installed without furring members over gypsum sheathing at least 12.7 mm thick or over masonry,
have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not greater than 25 when tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect12.art1.sent2:long] , and
not exceed 2 mm in thickness exclusive of fasteners, joints and local reinforcements, or

clauses.text: the wall assembly shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art5.sent1.clause2:long] when tested in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs134]

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent4:short] , where the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] is equal to or greater than 0.6 m and less than 1.2 m , the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] and any exterior wall located above the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] that encloses an [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof space] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 45 min , and

clauses.text: the cladding shall be metal or [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] cladding installed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect20:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect11:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect28:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote69:long] ),
the cladding shall

subclauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect6:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect7:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect8:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect9:long] ,  or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect10:long] ,
be installed without furring members, or on furring not more than 25 mm thick, over gypsum sheathing at least 12.7 mm thick or over masonry, and

after conditioning in conformance with [REF:standard:astmd2898] have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not greater than 25 when tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect12.art1.sent2:long] ,

clauses.text: the cladding shall

subclauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect12:long] ,
be installed with or without furring members over gypsum sheathing at least 12.7 mm thick or over masonry,
have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] not greater than 25 when tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect12.art1.sent2:long] , and
not exceed 2 mm in thickness exclusive of fasteners, joints and local reinforcements, or

clauses.text: the wall assembly shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art5.sent1.clause2:long] when tested in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs134]

content.text: The requirements regarding [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] and type of cladding-sheathing assembly shall not apply to the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] or projections from an [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] of a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] facing a detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng:building] , or a garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng:building] facing a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , where

clauses.text: the detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng:building] serves only one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] ,
the detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng:building] is located on the same property as that [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , and
the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] served by the detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng:building] is the only [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] on the property.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent6:short] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] projections on the exterior of a wall that are more than 1 m above ground level and that could expose an adjacent [REF:term:bldng:building] to fire spread shall not be permitted within

clauses.text: 1.2 m of a property line or the centre line of a [REF:term:pblc-w:public way] , or
2.4 m of a [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] projection on another [REF:term:bldng:building] on the same property.

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent8:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent11:short] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent5:short] shall not apply to

clauses.text: [REF:term:bldng:buildings] containing one or two [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] only, and
detached garages or accessory [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , where

subclauses.text: the detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng:building] serves only one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] ,
the detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng:building] is located on the same property as that [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , and
the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] served by the detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng:building] is the only [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] on the property.

content.text: Where [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] projections on an [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] are permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent6:short] , are totally enclosed and constructed with solid faces, such as for fireplaces and [REF:term:chmn:chimneys] , and extend within 1.2 m of a property line,

clauses.text: the construction of the face and sides of the projection shall comply with the corresponding requirements for [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building faces] for [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distances] less than 1.2 m as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent2:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent3:short] , and
where the underside of the projection is more than 0.6 m above finished ground level, it shall be protected by

subclauses.text: not less than 0.38 mm thick [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] material,
unvented aluminum conforming to [REF:standard:cgsb-93.2]
not less than 12.7 mm thick gypsum soffit board or gypsum ceiling board installed according to [REF:standard:csaa82.31]
not less than 11 mm thick plywood,
not less than 12.5 mm thick OSB or waferboard, or
not less than 11 mm thick lumber.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent10:short] , where the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] of not more than 0.45 m , projecting roof soffits shall not be constructed above the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote60:long] .)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent10:short] , where the [REF:term:xpng-bld:exposing building face] has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] of more than 0.45 m , the face of roof soffits shall not project to less than 0.45 m from the property line. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote60:long] .)
The face of a roof soffit is permitted to project to the property line, where it faces a [REF:term:pblc-w:public way ] . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote72:short] .)

Where roof soffits project to less than 1.2 m from the property line, the centre line of a [REF:term:pblc-w:public way] , or an imaginary line between two [REF:term:bldng:buildings] or [REF:term:fr-cmprt:fire compartments] on the same property, they shall

clauses.text: have no openings, and
be protected by

subclauses.text: not less than 0.38 mm thick sheet steel,
unvented aluminum conforming to [REF:standard:cgsb-93.2]
not less than 12.7 mm thick gypsum soffit board or gypsum ceiling board installed according to [REF:standard:csaa82.31]
not less than 11 mm thick plywood,
not less than 12.5 mm thick OSB or waferboard, or
not less than 11 mm thick lumber.

content.text: For [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] construction, materials installed to provide the required protection for soffits may be covered with a [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] or [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] finish material.

Heavy timber and steel columns need not conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent1:short] , provided the [REF:term:lmtng-dt:limiting distance] is not less than 3 m .

articles.title: Required Fire Blocks in Concealed Spaces

content.text: Vertical concealed spaces in interior walls and exterior walls shall be separated by [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks]

clauses.text: one from the other, and
from horizontal concealed spaces.

content.text: Horizontal concealed spaces in attics, roof spaces, ceilings, floors, and crawl spaces shall be separated by [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks]

clauses.text: one from the other, and
from vertical concealed spaces.

content.text: [REF:term:fr-blk:Fire blocks] shall be provided at all interconnections between concealed vertical and horizontal spaces in interior coved ceilings, drop ceilings and soffits where the exposed construction materials within the concealed spaces have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] greater than 25.

[REF:term:fr-blk:Fire blocks] shall be provided at the top and bottom of each run of stairs where they pass through a floor containing concealed space in which the exposed construction materials within the space have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] greater than 25.

Where not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , concealed spaces of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] created by a ceiling, roof space or unoccupied attic space shall be separated by [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] into compartments

clauses.text: not more than 60 m in greatest dimension, and
where such space contains exposed construction materials having a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] greater than 25, not more than 300 m^{2} in area.

content.text: No dimension of the concealed space described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art1.sent5.clause2:medium] shall exceed 20 m .

Concealed spaces in mansard or gambrel style roofs, exterior cornices, balconies and canopies of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] in which the exposed construction materials within the space have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] exceeding 25 shall have vertical [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] at intervals of not more than 20 m and at points where such concealed spaces extend across the ends of required vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] .

articles.title: Required Fire Blocks in Wall Assemblies

content.text: Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art2.sent2:short] , [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] shall be provided to block off concealed spaces within wall assemblies, including spaces created by furring,

clauses.text: at each floor level,
at each ceiling level where the ceiling contributes to part of the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] , and
at other locations within the wall, so that the distance between [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] does not exceed 20 m horizontally and 3 m vertically.

content.text: [REF:term:fr-blk:Fire blocks] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art2.sent1:short] are not required, provided

clauses.text: the insulated wall assembly contains not more than one concealed air space whose horizontal thickness is not more than 25 mm ,
the exposed construction materials within the space are [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] ,
the exposed construction materials within the space, including insulation, but not including wiring, piping or similar services, have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 25, or
the concealed wall space is filled with insulation.

content.text: Except as permitted by  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art3.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art3.sent3:short] , [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] shall be constructed of materials that will remain in place and prevent the passage of flames for not less than 15 min when subjected to the standard fire exposure in [REF:standard:ulcs101]
[REF:term:fr-blk:Fire blocks] are deemed to comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art3.sent1:short] if they are constructed of not less than

clauses.text: 0.38 mm sheet steel,
12.7 mm gypsum board,
12.5 mm plywood, OSB or waferboard, with joints having continuous supports,
two layers of lumber, each not less than 19 mm thick, with joints staggered, or
38 mm lumber.

content.text: In a [REF:term:bldng:building] permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] , semi-rigid fibre insulation board produced from glass, rock or slag is permitted to be used to block the vertical space in a double-frame wall assembly formed at the intersection of the floor assembly and the walls, provided the width of the vertical space does not exceed 25 mm and the insulation board

clauses.text: has a density not less than 45 kg/m^{3} ,
is securely fastened to one set of studs,
extends from below the bottom of the top plates in the lower [REF:term:tr:storey] to above the top of the bottom plate in the upper [REF:term:tr:storey] , and
completely fills the portion of the vertical space between the headers and between the wall plates.

content.text: Where [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] are pierced by pipes, ducts or other elements, the effectiveness of the [REF:term:fr-blk:fire blocks] shall be maintained around such elements. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote44:long] .)

Except as otherwise provided in this Subsection, the exposed surface of every interior wall and ceiling, including skylights and glazing, shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 150.

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art1.sent3:short] , doors need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art1.sent1:short] provided they have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 200.

Doors within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , other than garage doors, need not conform to  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art1.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art1.sent2:short] .

articles.title: Ceilings in Exits or Public Corridors

content.text: At least 90% of the exposed surface of every ceiling in an [REF:term:xt:exit] or ceiling that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] in a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 25. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art6:long] )

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art3.sent2:short] , at least 90% of the exposed surfaces of every wall in an [REF:term:xt:exit] shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 25. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art6:long] )

At least 75% of the wall surface of a lobby used as an [REF:term:xt:exit] in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5:long] shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 25. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art6:long] )

Where an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] passageway provides the only [REF:term:mn-f-gr:means of egress] from the rooms or [REF:term:t:suites] it serves, the wall and ceiling finishes of that passageway, including the soffit beneath and the [REF:term:guard:guard] on the passageway, shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 25, except that up to 10% of the total wall area and 10% of the total ceiling area is permitted to have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 150.

At least 90% of the total wall surface in any [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 75, or at least 90% of the upper half of such walls shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 25. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art6:long] )

articles.title: Calculation of Wall and Ceiling Areas

content.text: Skylights, glazing, [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] doors, and [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] light diffusers and lenses shall not be considered in the calculation of wall and ceiling areas in this Subsection.

Where a [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] or a corridor used by the public contains an [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , the interior finish materials used on the walls or ceiling of such [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancy] , shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] in conformance with that required for [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridors] .

Light diffusers and lenses having [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread ratings] that exceed those permitted for the ceiling finish, shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art4.sent1:long] .

Individual [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] skylights in corridors required to be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] shall not exceed 1 m^{2} in area and shall be spaced not less than 1.2 m apart.

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art10.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art10.sent3:short] , foamed plastics that form part of a wall or ceiling assembly shall be protected from adjacent space in the [REF:term:bldng:building] , other than adjacent concealed spaces within [REF:term:ttc-r-rf:attic or roof spaces] , crawl spaces, wall assemblies and ceiling assemblies

clauses.text: by one of the interior finishes described in  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect29.subsect4:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect29.subsect9:long] ,
provided the [REF:term:bldng:building] does not contain a Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] , by sheet metal that

subclauses.text: is mechanically fastened to the supporting assembly independent of the insulation,
is not less than 0.38 mm thick, and
has a melting point not less than 650°C , or

clauses.text: by any thermal barrier that meets the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art15.sent2:long] .

content.text: A walk-in cooler or freezer consisting of factory-assembled wall, floor or ceiling panels containing foamed plastics is permitted to be used, provided the panels

clauses.text: are protected on both sides by sheet metal not less than 0.38 mm thick having a melting point not less than 650°C ,
do not contain an air space, and

have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] , determined by subjecting a sample panel with an assembled joint typical of field installation to the applicable test described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect12:long] , that is not more than that permitted for the room or space in which they are located or that they bound.

content.text: Thermosetting foamed plastic insulation having a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 200 is permitted to be used in factory-assembled doors in [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garages] serving single [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] provided that

clauses.text: the insulation is covered on the interior with a metallic foil,
the assembly has a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 200, and
the assembly incorporates no air spaces.

content.text: The interior finish of walls and ceilings in bathrooms within [REF:term:t:suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 200.

Where a covering or a lining is used with a duct, such lining or covering shall have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art4:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect33.subsect6.art4:number]

Where access is provided through a [REF:term:frwll:firewall] , the requirements in this Subsection shall apply to the [REF:term:flr-r:floor areas] on both sides of the [REF:term:frwll:firewall] as if they were in the same [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Except as permitted in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art2.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art2.sent4:short] , a fire alarm system shall be installed in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] in which a sprinkler system is installed.
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art2.sent5:short] , a fire alarm system shall be installed

clauses.text: in every [REF:term:bldng:building] that contains more than 3 [REF:term:tr:storeys] , including [REF:term:tr:storeys] below the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] ,
where the total [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] exceeds 300, or
when the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:occupant load] for any [REF:term:mjr-ccpn:major occupancy] in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art2.table1:long] is exceeded.

content.title: Maximum Occupant Load for Buildings without Fire Alarm Systems

content.value: [REF:term:ccpnt-ld:Occupant Load ] Above which a Fire Alarm System is Required

content.text: In [REF:term:bldng:buildings] in which a sprinkler system has been installed in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13d] a fire alarm system need not be installed.
In [REF:term:bldng:buildings] that contain fewer than 9 sprinklers conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent4:long] , a fire alarm system need not be installed.

A fire alarm system is not required in a [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] where an [REF:term:xt:exit] or [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] serves not more than 4 [REF:term:t:suites] or where each [REF:term:t:suite] has direct access to an exterior [REF:term:xt:exit] facility leading to ground level.

Except as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art3.sent2:short] and as required by this Subsection, where fire alarm, fire detection and smoke detection devices and systems are installed, these devices and systems and their installation shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4:long]

The following Articles in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4:long] regarding fire alarm systems do not apply to Part 9 [REF:term:bldng:buildings] :  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art10:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art12:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art13:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22:long]

articles.title: Rooms and Spaces Requiring Heat Detectors or Smoke Detectors

content.text: Where a fire alarm system is required, every [REF:term:pblc-crr:public corridor] in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] and every [REF:term:xt:exit] stair shaft shall be provided with [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] .

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art4.sent3:short] , if a fire alarm system is required in a [REF:term:bldng:building] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] , [REF:term:fr-dtctr:fire detectors] shall be installed in the following spaces:

clauses.text: storage rooms not within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] ,
[REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] not within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] ,
janitors' rooms
rooms in which hazardous substances are to be used or stored (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote125:long] ),
elevator hoistways, chutes and dumbwaiter shafts, and
laundry rooms in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] , but not those within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] .

content.text: [REF:term:ht-dtctr:Heat detectors] and [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art4.sent2:short] are not required in [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or in [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered]  [REF:term:bldng:buildings] in which the sprinkler system is electrically supervised and equipped with a water flow alarm.

articles.title: Smoke Detectors in Recirculating Air-Handling Systems

content.text: Except for a recirculating air system serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , where a fire alarm system is required to be installed, every recirculating air-handling system shall be designed to prevent the circulation of smoke upon a signal from a duct-type [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detector] where such system supplies more than one [REF:term:t:suite] on the same floor or serves more than 1 [REF:term:tr:storey] .

articles.title: Portions of Buildings Considered as Separate Buildings

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art6.sent2:short] , where a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 1 h separates a portion of a [REF:term:bldng:building] from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] and there are no openings through the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] other than those for piping, tubing, wiring and conduit, the requirements for fire alarm and detection systems may be applied to each portion so separated as if it were a separate [REF:term:bldng:building] .

The permission in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art6.sent1:short] to consider separated portions of a [REF:term:bldng:building] as separate [REF:term:bldng:buildings] does not apply to [REF:term:rvc-rm:service rooms] and storage rooms.

Central vacuum cleaning systems serving more than one [REF:term:t:suite] or [REF:term:tr:storey] in [REF:term:bldng:buildings] equipped with a fire alarm system shall be designed to shut down upon activation of the fire alarm system.

A fire alarm system is not required in a [REF:term:trg-grg:storage garage] conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long] provided there are no other [REF:term:ccpnc:occupancies] in the [REF:term:bldng:building] .
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art8:long] , [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs531] shall be installed in

clauses.text: each [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] ,
each sleeping room not within a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , and
ancillary spaces and common spaces not in [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] in a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] .

content.text: The sound patterns of [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] shall

clauses.text: meet the temporal patterns of [REF:term:lrm-gnl:alarm signals] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote77:long] ), or
be a combination of temporal pattern and voice relay.

content.text: Within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , sufficient [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] shall be installed so that

clauses.text: there is at least one [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] installed on each [REF:term:tr:storey] , including [REF:term:bmnt:basements] , and
on any [REF:term:tr:storey] of a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] containing sleeping rooms, a [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] is installed

subclauses.text: in each sleeping room, and

in a location between the sleeping rooms and the remainder of the [REF:term:tr:storey] , and if the sleeping rooms are served by a hallway, the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] shall be located in the hallway.

content.text: A [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art3.sent1:short] shall be installed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs553]

[REF:term:mk-lrm:Smoke alarms] required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art3.sent1:short] shall be installed on or near the ceiling.

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4.sent3:short] , [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art1.sent1:long] shall

clauses.text: be installed with permanent connections to an electrical circuit (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote86:long] ),
have no disconnect switch between the overcurrent device and the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] , and

in case the regular power supply to the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] is interrupted, be provided with a battery as an alternative power source that can continue to provide power to the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] for a period of no less than 7 days in the normal condition, followed by 4 minutes of alarm.

content.text: Where the [REF:term:bldng:building] is not supplied with electrical power, [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] are permitted to be battery-operated.

[REF:term:t:Suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] are permitted to be equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] , provided the [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors]

clauses.text: are capable of independently sounding audible signals with a sound pressure level between 75 dBA and 110 dBA within the individual [REF:term:t:suites] (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote79:long] ),
except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4.sent4:short] , are installed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs524] and
form part of the fire alarm system.

content.text: [REF:term:mk-dtctr:Smoke detectors] permitted to be installed in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4.sent3:short] are permitted to sound localized alarms within individual [REF:term:t:suites] , and need not sound an alarm throughout the rest of the [REF:term:bldng:building] .

Where more than one [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] is required in a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] shall be interconnected so that the actuation of any one alarm causes all alarms within the [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] to sound.
Except as provided in Sentence (3), in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces

clauses.text: all [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] shall be of photo-electric type and interconnected so that the actuation of any one [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] causes all [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] within the house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces to sound when the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] described in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art2:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art17:long] have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 15 min (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:medium] ), or

an additional [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] of photo-electric type shall be installed in each [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] and common space and be interconnected so that the actuation of one [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] will cause the additional [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] in the other [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] or common spaces to sound when the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] described in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art2:long] , [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art17:long] have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 30 min (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent3:medium] ).

content.text: Additional [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] and interconnection of [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] between [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and common spaces in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] is not required if

clauses.text: the [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separations] described in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art17:long] have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] not less than 45 min , or
the [REF:term:bldng:building] is [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .

content.text: Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art6.sent2:short] , a manually operated device shall be incorporated within the circuitry of a [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] installed in a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] so that the signal emitted by the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] can be silenced for a period of not more than 10 min , after which the [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarm] will reset and sound again if the level of smoke in the vicinity is sufficient to re-actuate it.

[REF:term:t:Suites] of [REF:term:rdntl-cc:residential occupancy] equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] installed to [REF:standard:ulcs524] which are part of the fire alarm system in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4.sent3:long] , need not incorporate the manually operated device required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art6.sent1:short] .

Where instructions are necessary to describe the maintenance and care required for [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] to ensure continuing satisfactory performance, they shall be posted in a location where they will be readily available to the occupants for reference.

Except where a fire alarm system is installed or required in a [REF:term:bldng:building] , [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detectors] forming part of a residential fire warning system installed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs540] are permitted to be installed in lieu of all [REF:term:mk-lrm:smoke alarms] required by  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art3:short] , provided that the fire warning system

clauses.text: is capable of sounding audible signals as stated in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art5:long] ,
is powered as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4:long] , and
is equipped with a silencing device as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art6:long]

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art1.sent3:short] , a window or access panel providing an opening not less than 1 100 mm high and 550 mm wide and having a sill height of not more than 900 mm above the floor shall be provided on the second and third [REF:term:tr:storeys] of every [REF:term:bldng:building] in at least one wall facing on a [REF:term:trt:street] if such [REF:term:tr:storeys] are not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] .
Access panels required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art1.sent1:short] shall be readily openable from both inside and outside or be glazed with plain glass.
Access panels required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art1.sent1:short] need not be provided in

clauses.text: [REF:term:bldng:buildings] containing only [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] where there is no [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] above another [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , or
houses with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] including their common spaces.

content.text: Except for [REF:term:bmnt:basements] in houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t:secondary suite] or [REF:term:bmnt:basements] serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , each [REF:term:bmnt:basement] that is not [REF:term:prnklrd:sprinklered] that exceeds 25 m in length or width shall be provided with direct access to the outdoors to at least one [REF:term:trt:street] .

Access required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art2.sent1:short] may be provided by a door, window or other means that provides an opening not less than 1 100 mm high and 550 mm wide, the sill height of which shall not be more than 900 mm above the floor.
Access required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art2.sent1:short] may also be provided by an interior stair accessible from the outdoors.

Access for fire department equipment shall be provided to each [REF:term:bldng:building] by means of a [REF:term:trt:street] , private roadway or yard. (See  Notes [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote77:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.appendix.appnote90:long] .)

Where access to a [REF:term:bldng:building] as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art3.sent1:short] is provided by means of a roadway or yard, the design and location of such roadway or yard shall take into account connection with public thoroughfares, weight of firefighting equipment, width of roadway, radius of curves, overhead clearance, location of fire hydrants, location of fire department connections and vehicular parking.

Portable extinguishers shall be installed in all [REF:term:bldng:buildings] , except within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , in conformance with the appropriate provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws or, in the absence of such regulations or bylaws, the [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc] .

articles.title: Freeze Protection of Fire Protection Systems

content.text: Equipment forming part of a fire protection system that may be adversely affected by freezing temperatures and that is located in an unheated area shall be protected from freezing.

Except as provided in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art2:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art9:long] , construction camps shall conform to  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect1:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20:long]

Except for sleeping rooms within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , sleeping rooms in construction camps shall be separated from each other and from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having not less than a 30 min[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

articles.title: Floor Assemblies between the First and Second Storey

content.text: Except in a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] , a floor assembly in a construction camp [REF:term:bldng:building] separating the [REF:term:frt-tr:first storey] and the second [REF:term:tr:storey] shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having not less than a 30 min[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

[REF:term:wlkw:Walkways] of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c:combustible construction] connecting [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be separated from each connected [REF:term:bldng:building] by a [REF:term:fr-prtn:fire separation] having not less than a 45 min[REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] .

Construction camp [REF:term:bldng:buildings] shall be separated from each other by a distance of not less than 10 m except as otherwise permitted in  Subsections [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14:long]  and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15:long]

Except in [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] and except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art6.sent2:short] , the surface [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of wall and ceiling surfaces in corridors and [REF:term:wlkw:walkways] , exclusive of doors, shall not exceed 25 over not less than 90% of the exposed surface area and not more than 150 over the remaining surface area.

Except within [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , corridors that provide [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from sleeping rooms and that have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 45 min shall have a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] conforming to the appropriate requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17:long]

Except in [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling units] , corridors providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt:access to exit] from sleeping rooms in construction camp [REF:term:bldng:buildings] with sleeping accommodation for more than 10 persons shall be provided with a [REF:term:mk-dtctr:smoke detector] connected to the [REF:term:bldng:building] alarm system.

Each construction camp [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be provided with portable fire extinguishers in conformance with the appropriate provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws or, in the absence of such regulations or bylaws, in conformance with the [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc] .

Every construction camp [REF:term:bldng:building] providing sleeping accommodation for more than 30 persons shall be provided with a hose station that is protected from freezing and is equipped with a hose of sufficient length so that every portion of the [REF:term:bldng:building] is within reach of a hose stream.
Hose stations required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art9.sent1:short] shall be located near an [REF:term:xt:exit] .

Hoses referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art9.sent1:short] shall be not less than 19 mm inside diam and shall be connected to a central water supply or to a storage tank having a capacity of not less than 4 500 L with a pumping system capable of supplying a flow of not less than 5 L/s at a gauge pressure of 300 kPa .

subsections.title: Fire Protection for Gas, Propane and Electric Cooktops and Ovens

content.text: Except as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art1.sent2:short] , natural gas and propane [REF:term:cktp:cooktops] and ovens shall be installed in accordance with the applicable provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws or, in the absence of such regulations or bylaws, with [REF:standard:csab149.1] (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect34.subsect1.art1:long] )

Clearances for and protection around gas, propane and electric ranges shall be not less than those provided in  Articles [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art3:long]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art2.sent2:short] , framing, finishes and cabinetry installed directly above the location of the [REF:term:cktp:cooktop] shall be not less than 750 mm above the level of [REF:term:cktp:cooktop] burners or elements.

The vertical clearance described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art2.sent1:short] for framing, finishes and cabinets located directly above the location of the [REF:term:cktp:cooktop] may be reduced to 600 mm above the level of the elements or burners, provided the framing, finishes and cabinets

clauses.text: are [REF:term:ncmbtbl:noncombustible] , or
are protected by a metal hood that projects 125 mm beyond the framing, finishes and cabinets.

content.text: Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art3.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art3.sent3:short] , [REF:term:cmbtbl:combustible] wall framing, finishes or cabinets within 450 mm of the area where the [REF:term:cktp:cooktop] is to be located shall be protected above the level of the heating elements or burners by

clauses.text: gypsum board not less than 9.5 mm thick , or
any material providing a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-:fire-resistance rating] of not less than 10 min and a [REF:term:flm-prd-:flame-spread rating] of not more than 25.

content.text: Counter-top splash boards or back plates that extend above the level of heating elements or burners need not be protected as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art3.sent1:short] .

Except for cabinetry described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art2:long] , cabinetry located not less than 450 mm above the level of the heating elements or burners need not be protected as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect22.art3.sent1:short] .

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art1.sent3:short] , a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall be separated from every other space in a [REF:term:bldng:building] in which noise may be generated by (See Note A-9.11.1.4.)

clauses.text: a separating assembly and adjoining constructions, which together provide an [REF:term:astc:apparent sound transmission class (ASTC)] rating of not less than 47, or

a separating assembly providing a [REF:term:stc:sound transmission class (STC)] rating of not less than 50 and adjoining constructions that conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art4:long]

content.text: Where a house contains a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t:secondary suite] , each [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] shall be separated from every other space in the house in which noise may be transmitted by

clauses.text: construction having

subclauses.text: whose joist spaces filled with sound-absorbing material of not less than 150 mm nominal thickness,

revisions.text: joist spaces are filled with sound-absorbing material of not less than 150 mm nominal thickness,
whose joist spaces filled with sound-absorbing material of not less than 150 mm nominal thickness,
revisions.change_summary: Amended Subclause 9.11.1.1.(2)(a)(i) by striking out "are"

subclauses.text: whose stud spaces filled with sound-absorbing material,

revisions.text: stud spaces are filled with sound-absorbing material,
whose stud spaces filled with sound-absorbing material,
revisions.change_summary: Amended Subclause 9.11.1.1.(2)(a)(ii) by striking out "are"

subclauses.text: resilient channel on one side of the separation spaced 400 or 600 mm o.c. , and
not less than 12.7 mm thick gypsum board on ceilings and on both sides of walls,

clauses.text: construction providing an [REF:term:stc:STC] rating of not less than 43, or
a separating assembly and adjoining constructions, which together provide an [REF:term:astc:ASTC] rating of not less than 40.

content.text: Construction separating a [REF:term:dwllng-n:dwelling unit] from an elevator shaft or refuse chute shall have an [REF:term:stc:STC] rating of not less than 55.
The [REF:term:stc:STC] ratings shall be determined in accordance with [REF:standard:astme413] using the results from measurements carried out in accordance with [REF:standard:astme90]
The [REF:term:astc:ASTC] ratings shall be

clauses.text: determined in accordance with [REF:standard:astme413] using the results from measurements carried out in accordance with [REF:standard:astme336] or
calculated in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part5.sect8.subsect1.art4:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part5.sect8.subsect1.art5:long]

content.text: Compliance with the required [REF:term:stc:STC] ratings shall be demonstrated through

clauses.text: measurements carried out in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art2.sent1:long] , or
the construction of separating assemblies conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table1:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table2:long] , as applicable.

content.text: Compliance with the required [REF:term:astc:ASTC] ratings shall be demonstrated through

clauses.text: measurements or calculations carried out in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art2.sent2:long] , or

the construction of separating assemblies conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table1:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table2:long] , as applicable, that have an [REF:term:stc:STC] rating of not less than 50 in conjunction with flanking assemblies constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art4:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote81:short] ).

content.text: This Article applies where the required protection is provided in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art1.sent1.clause2:long] and compliance is demonstrated in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art3.sent2.clause2:long] .
Flanking wall assemblies connected to a separating floor or ceiling assembly shall be constructed with

clauses.text: concrete or concrete block having a mass per area greater than 200 kg/m^{2} , or
gypsum board finish that

subclauses.text: is supported on wood or steel framing, and
ends or is interrupted where it meets the structure of the separating floor or ceiling assembly.

content.text: Flanking wall and ceiling assemblies connected to a separating wall assembly shall be constructed with

clauses.text: concrete or concrete block having a mass per area greater than 300 kg/m^{2} , or
gypsum board finish that

subclauses.text: is supported on wood or steel framing, and
ends or is interrupted where it meets the structure of the separating wall assembly or, for double-stud walls, where it meets the space between the two lines of studs.

content.text: Flanking floor assemblies connected to a separating wall assembly shall be

clauses.text: constructed

subclauses.text: with concrete having a mass per area greater than 300 kg/m^{2} , or
in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect16:long] , or

clauses.text: supported on joists or trusses that are not continuous across the junction and are covered with floor treatments in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art4.table1:long] for the applicable wall construction.

content.title: Floor Treatments for Flanking Wood-Framed Floor Assemblies in Horizontally Adjoining Spaces

table_notes.content: See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote83:short]

content.value: Type of Separating Wall Assembly with [REF:term:stc:STC] ≥ 50 from [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table1:long]
Minimum Requirements for Floor Treatments Applied Over Subfloor of Wood-Framed Flanking Floor Assemblies on Both Sides of Floor/Wall Junction

items.content: wood strip flooring not less than 16 mm thick aligned parallel to separating wall, or
one layer of OSB or plywood not less than 15.5 mm thick plus finished flooring, or
one additional material layer plus finished flooring having a combined mass per area not less than 8 kg/m^{2} See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appendix.appnote83:short]
one layer of OSB or plywood not less than 12.5 mm thick plus hardwood strip flooring not less than 19 mm thick aligned parallel to separating wall, or

concrete or gypsum concrete topping not less than 19 mm thick bonded to the subfloor plus finished flooring, or

articles.title: Removal of Topsoil and Organic Matter

content.text: The topsoil and vegetable matter in all unexcavated areas under a [REF:term:bldng:building] shall be removed.

In localities where termite infestation is known to be a problem, all stumps, roots and other wood debris shall be removed from the [REF:term:l:soil] to a depth of not less than 300 mm in unexcavated areas under a [REF:term:bldng:building] .
The bottom of every [REF:term:xcvtn:excavation] shall be free of all organic material.
[REF:term:xcvtn:Excavations] shall be kept free of standing water.
The bottom of [REF:term:xcvtn:excavations] shall be kept from freezing throughout the entire construction period.
[REF:term:xcvtn:Excavations] for [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] shall extend to undisturbed [REF:term:l:soil] .

Except as provided in  Sentences [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect12.subsect2.art2.sent4:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect12.subsect2.art2.sent7:short] , the minimum depth of [REF:term:fndtn:foundations] below finished ground level shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect12.subsect2.art2.table1:long]
